text_en: The words of Jeremias the son of Helcias, of the priests that were in Anathoth , in the land of Benjamin .
text_la: Verba Jeremiæ filii Helciæ, de sacerdotibus qui fuerunt in Anathoth, in terra Benjamin.
text_pt: Palavras de Jeremias, filho de Hilquias, um dos sacerdotes que estavam em Anatote, na terra de Benjamim;
text_el: τὸ ῥῆμα τοῦ θεοῦ ὃ ἐγένετο ἐπὶ Ιερεμιαν τὸν τοῦ Χελκιου ἐκ τῶν ἱερέων ὃς κατῴκει ἐν Αναθωθ ἐν γῇ Βενιαμιν

text_en: The word of the Lord which came to him in the days of Josias the son of Amon king of Juda , in the thirteenth year of his reign.
text_la: Quod factum est verbum Domini ad eum in diebus Josiæ filii Amon, regis Juda, in tertiodecimo anno regni ejus.
text_pt: Ao qual veio a palavra do Senhor, nos dias de Josias, filho de Amom, rei de Judá, no décimo terceiro ano do seu reinado.
text_el: ὃς ἐγενήθη λόγος τοῦ θεοῦ πρὸς αὐτὸν ἐν ταῖς ἡμέραις Ιωσια υἱοῦ Αμως βασιλέως Ιουδα ἔτους τρισκαιδεκάτου ἐν τῇ βασιλείᾳ αὐτοῦ

text_en: And which came to him in the days of Joakim the son of Josias king of Juda , unto the end of the eleventh year of Sedecias the son of Josias king of Juda , even unto the carrying away of Jerusalem captive , in the fifth month.
text_la: Et factum est in diebus Joakim filii Josiæ, regis Juda, usque ad consummationem undecimi anni Sedeciæ, filii Josiæ, regis Juda, usque ad transmigrationem Jerusalem, in mense quinto.
text_pt: E lhe veio também nos dias de Jeoiaquim, filho de Josias, rei de Judá, até ao fim do ano undécimo de Zedequias, filho de Josias, rei de Judá, até que Jerusalém foi levada em cativeiro no quinto mês.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο ἐν ταῖς ἡμέραις Ιωακιμ υἱοῦ Ιωσια βασιλέως Ιουδα ἕως ἑνδεκάτου ἔτους Σεδεκια υἱοῦ Ιωσια βασιλέως Ιουδα ἕως τῆς αἰχμαλωσίας Ιερουσαλημ ἐν τῷ πέμπτῳ μηνί

text_en: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying:
text_la: Et factum est verbum Domini ad me, dicens:
text_pt: Assim veio a mim a palavra do Senhor, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο λόγος κυρίου πρός με λέγων

text_en: Before I formed you in the bowels of your mother, I knew you: and before you came forth out of the womb, I sanctified you, and made you a prophet unto the nations .
text_la: Priusquam te formarem in utero, novi te, et antequam exires de vulva, sanctificavi te, et prophetam in gentibus dedi te.
text_pt: Antes que te formasse no ventre te conheci, e antes que saísses da madre, te santifiquei; às nações te dei por profeta.
text_el: πρὸ τοῦ με πλάσαι σε ἐν κοιλίᾳ ἐπίσταμαί σε καὶ πρὸ τοῦ σε ἐξελθεῖν ἐκ μήτρας ἡγίακά σε προφήτην εἰς ἔθνη τέθεικά σε

text_en: And I said: Ah, ah, ah, Lord God : behold, I cannot speak, for I am a child.
text_la: Et dixi : A, a, a, Domine Deus, ecce nescio loqui, quia puer ego sum.
text_pt: Então disse eu: Ah, Senhor DEUS! Eis que não sei falar; porque ainda sou um menino.
text_el: καὶ εἶπα ὦ δέσποτα κύριε ἰδοὺ οὐκ ἐπίσταμαι λαλεῖν ὅτι νεώτερος ἐγώ εἰμι

text_en: And the Lord said to me: Say not: I am a child: for you shall go to all that I shall send you: and whatsoever I shall command you, you shall speak.
text_la: Et dixit Dominus ad me : Noli dicere : Puer sum : quoniam ad omnia quæ mittam te ibis, et universa quæcumque mandavero tibi loqueris.
text_pt: Mas o Senhor me disse: Não digas: Eu sou um menino; porque a todos a quem eu te enviar, irás; e tudo quanto te mandar, falarás.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν κύριος πρός με μὴ λέγε ὅτι νεώτερος ἐγώ εἰμι ὅτι πρὸς πάντας οὓς ἐὰν ἐξαποστείλω σε πορεύσῃ καὶ κατὰ πάντα ὅσα ἐὰν ἐντείλωμαί σοι λαλήσεις

text_en: Be not afraid at their presence: for I am with you to deliver you, says the Lord .
text_la: Ne timeas a facie eorum, quia tecum ego sum ut eruam te, dicit Dominus.
text_pt: Não temas diante deles; porque estou contigo para te livrar, diz o Senhor.
text_el: μὴ φοβηθῇς ἀπὸ προσώπου αὐτῶν ὅτι μετὰ σοῦ ἐγώ εἰμι τοῦ ἐξαιρεῖσθαί σε λέγει κύριος

text_en: And the Lord put forth his hand, and touched my mouth: and the Lord said to me: Behold I have given my words in your mouth:
text_la: Et misit Dominus manum suam, et tetigit os meum, et dixit Dominus ad me : Ecce dedi verba mea in ore tuo :
text_pt: E estendeu o Senhor a sua mão, e tocou-me na boca; e disse-me o Senhor: Eis que ponho as minhas palavras na tua boca;
text_el: καὶ ἐξέτεινεν κύριος τὴν χεῖρα αὐτοῦ πρός με καὶ ἥψατο τοῦ στόματός μου καὶ εἶπεν κύριος πρός με ἰδοὺ δέδωκα τοὺς λόγους μου εἰς τὸ στόμα σου

text_en: Lo, I have set you this day over the nations , and over kingdoms, to root up, and to pull down, and to waste, and to destroy, and to build, and to plant.
text_la: ecce constitui te hodie super gentes et super regna, ut evellas, et destruas, et disperdas, et dissipes, et ædifices, et plantes.
text_pt: Olha, ponho-te neste dia sobre as nações, e sobre os reinos, para arrancares, e para derrubares, e para destruíres, e para arruinares; e também para edificares e para plantares.
text_el: ἰδοὺ κατέστακά σε σήμερον ἐπὶ ἔθνη καὶ βασιλείας ἐκριζοῦν καὶ κατασκάπτειν καὶ ἀπολλύειν καὶ ἀνοικοδομεῖν καὶ καταφυτεύειν

text_en: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying: What do you see, Jeremias ? And I said: I see a rod watching.
text_la: Et factum est verbum Domini ad me, dicens : Quid tu vides, Jeremia? Et dixi : Virgam vigilantem ego video.
text_pt: Ainda veio a mim a palavra do Senhor, dizendo: Que é que vês, Jeremias? E eu disse: Vejo uma vara de amendoeira.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο λόγος κυρίου πρός με λέγων τί σὺ ὁρᾷς Ιερεμια καὶ εἶπα βακτηρίαν καρυΐνην

text_en: And the Lord said to me: You have seen well: for I will watch over my word to perform it.
text_la: Et dixit Dominus ad me : Bene vidisti : quia vigilabo ego super verbo meo, ut faciam illud.
text_pt: E disse-me o Senhor: Viste bem; porque eu velo sobre a minha palavra para cumpri-la.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν κύριος πρός με καλῶς ἑώρακας διότι ἐγρήγορα ἐγὼ ἐπὶ τοὺς λόγους μου τοῦ ποιῆσαι αὐτούς

text_en: And the word of the Lord came to me a second time saying: What do you see? And I said: I see a boiling caldron, and the face thereof from the face of the north.
text_la: Et factum est verbum Domini secundo ad me, dicens : Quid tu vides? Et dixi : Ollam succensam ego video, et faciem ejus a facie aquilonis.
text_pt: E veio a mim a palavra do Senhor segunda vez, dizendo: Que é que vês? E eu disse: Vejo uma panela a ferver, cuja face está para o lado do norte.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο λόγος κυρίου πρός με ἐκ δευτέρου λέγων τί σὺ ὁρᾷς καὶ εἶπα λέβητα ὑποκαιόμενον καὶ τὸ πρόσωπον αὐτοῦ ἀπὸ προσώπου βορρᾶ

text_en: And the Lord said to me: From the north shall an evil break forth upon all the inhabitants of the land.
text_la: Et dixit Dominus ad me : Ab aquilone pandetur malum super omnes habitatores terræ :
text_pt: E disse-me o Senhor: Do norte se descobrirá o mal sobre todos os habitantes da terra.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν κύριος πρός με ἀπὸ προσώπου βορρᾶ ἐκκαυθήσεται τὰ κακὰ ἐπὶ πάντας τοὺς κατοικοῦντας τὴν γῆν

text_en: For behold I will call together all the families of the kingdoms of the north, says the Lord : and they shall come, and shall set every one his throne in the entrance of the gates of Jerusalem , and upon all the walls thereof round about, and upon all the cities of Juda .
text_la: quia ecce ego convocabo omnes cognationes regnorum aquilonis, ait Dominus : et venient, et ponent unusquisque solium suum in introitu portarum Jerusalem, et super omnes muros ejus in circuitu, et super universas urbes Juda :
text_pt: Porque eis que eu convoco todas as famílias dos reinos do norte, diz o Senhor; e virão, e cada um porá o seu trono à entrada das portas de Jerusalém, e contra todos os seus muros em redor, e contra todas as cidades de Judá.
text_el: διότι ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ συγκαλῶ πάσας τὰς βασιλείας ἀπὸ βορρᾶ τῆς γῆς λέγει κύριος καὶ ἥξουσιν καὶ θήσουσιν ἕκαστος τὸν θρόνον αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ τὰ πρόθυρα τῶν πυλῶν Ιερουσαλημ καὶ ἐπὶ πάντα τὰ τείχη τὰ κύκλῳ αὐτῆς καὶ ἐπὶ πάσας τὰς πόλεις Ιουδα

text_en: And I will pronounce my judgments against them, touching all their wickedness , who have forsaken me, and have sacrificed to strange gods , and have adored the work of their own hands.
text_la: et loquar judicia mea cum eis super omnem malitiam eorum qui dereliquerunt me, et libaverunt diis alienis, et adoraverunt opus manuum suarum.
text_pt: E eu pronunciarei contra eles os meus juízos, por causa de toda a sua malícia; pois me deixaram, e queimaram incenso a deuses estranhos, e se encurvaram diante das obras das suas mãos.
text_el: καὶ λαλήσω πρὸς αὐτοὺς μετὰ κρίσεως περὶ πάσης τῆς κακίας αὐτῶν ὡς ἐγκατέλιπόν με καὶ ἔθυσαν θεοῖς ἀλλοτρίοις καὶ προσεκύνησαν τοῖς ἔργοις τῶν χειρῶν αὐτῶν

text_en: You therefore gird up your loins, and arise, and speak to them all that I command you. Be not afraid at their presence: for I will make you not to fear their countenance.
text_la: Tu ergo, accinge lumbos tuos, et surge, et loquere ad eos omnia quæ ego præcipio tibi. Ne formides a facie eorum, nec enim timere te faciam vultum eorum.
text_pt: Tu, pois, cinge os teus lombos, e levanta-te, e dize-lhes tudo quanto eu te mandar; não te espantes diante deles, para que eu não te envergonhe diante deles.
text_el: καὶ σὺ περίζωσαι τὴν ὀσφύν σου καὶ ἀνάστηθι καὶ εἰπὸν πρὸς αὐτοὺς πάντα ὅσα ἂν ἐντείλωμαί σοι μὴ φοβηθῇς ἀπὸ προσώπου αὐτῶν μηδὲ πτοηθῇς ἐναντίον αὐτῶν ὅτι μετὰ σοῦ ἐγώ εἰμι τοῦ ἐξαιρεῖσθαί σε λέγει κύριος

text_en: For behold I have made you this day a fortified city, and a pillar of iron, and a wall of brass, over all the land, to the kings of Juda , to the princes thereof, and to the priests , and to the people of the land.
text_la: Ego quippe dedi te hodie in civitatem munitam, et in columnam ferream, et in murum æreum, super omnem terram, regibus Juda, principibus ejus, et sacerdotibus, et populo terræ.
text_pt: Porque, eis que hoje te ponho por cidade forte, e por coluna de ferro, e por muros de bronze, contra toda a terra, contra os reis de Judá, contra os seus príncipes, contra os seus sacerdotes, e contra o povo da terra.
text_el: ἰδοὺ τέθεικά σε ἐν τῇ σήμερον ἡμέρᾳ ὡς πόλιν ὀχυρὰν καὶ ὡς τεῖχος χαλκοῦν ὀχυρὸν ἅπασιν τοῖς βασιλεῦσιν Ιουδα καὶ τοῖς ἄρχουσιν αὐτοῦ καὶ τῷ λαῷ τῆς γῆς

text_en: And they shall fight against them, and shall not prevail: for I am with you, says the Lord , to deliver you.
text_la: Et bellabunt adversum te, et non prævalebunt, quia ego tecum sum, ait Dominus, ut liberem te.
text_pt: E pelejarão contra ti, mas não prevalecerão contra ti; porque eu sou contigo, diz o Senhor, para te livrar.
text_el: καὶ πολεμήσουσίν σε καὶ οὐ μὴ δύνωνται πρὸς σέ διότι μετὰ σοῦ ἐγώ εἰμι τοῦ ἐξαιρεῖσθαί σε εἶπεν κύριος

text_en: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying:
text_la: Et factum est verbum Domini ad me, dicens:
text_pt: E veio a mim a palavra do SENHOR, dizendo:

text_en: Go, and cry in the ears of Jerusalem , saying: Thus says the Lord : I have remembered you, pitying your youth, and the love of your espousals, when you followed me in the desert , in a land that is not sown.
text_la: Vade, et clama in auribus Jerusalem, dicens : Hæc dicit Dominus : Recordatus sum tui, miserans adolescentiam tuam, et caritatem desponsationis tuæ, quando secuta es me in deserto, in terra quæ non seminatur.
text_pt: Vai, e clama aos ouvidos de Jerusalém, dizendo: Assim diz o Senhor: Lembro-me de ti, da piedade da tua mocidade, e do amor do teu noivado, quando me seguias no deserto, numa terra que não se semeava.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν τάδε λέγει κύριος ἐμνήσθην ἐλέους νεότητός σου καὶ ἀγάπης τελειώσεώς σου τοῦ ἐξακολουθῆσαί σε τῷ ἁγίῳ Ισραηλ λέγει κύριος

text_en: Israel is holy to the Lord , the firstfruits of his increase: all they that devour him offend : evils shall come upon them, says the Lord .
text_la: Sanctus Israël Domino, primitiæ frugum ejus : omnes qui devorant eum delinquunt : mala venient super eos, dicit Dominus.
text_pt: Então Israel era santidade para o Senhor, e as primícias da sua novidade; todos os que o devoravam eram tidos por culpados; o mal vinha sobre eles, diz o Senhor.
text_el: ἅγιος Ισραηλ τῷ κυρίῳ ἀρχὴ γενημάτων αὐτοῦ πάντες οἱ ἔσθοντες αὐτὸν πλημμελήσουσιν κακὰ ἥξει ἐπ' αὐτούς φησὶν κύριος

text_en: Hear the word of the Lord , O house of Jacob , and all you families of the house of Israel :
text_la: Audite verbum Domini, domus Jacob, et omnes cognationes domus Israël.
text_pt: Ouvi a palavra do Senhor, ó casa de Jacó, e todas as famílias da casa de Israel;
text_el: ἀκούσατε λόγον κυρίου οἶκος Ιακωβ καὶ πᾶσα πατριὰ οἴκου Ισραηλ

text_en: Thus says the Lord : What iniquity have your fathers found in me, that they have gone far from me, and have walked after vanity, and have become vain?
text_la: Hæc dicit Dominus : Quid invenerunt patres vestri in me iniquitatis, quia elongaverunt a me, et ambulaverunt post vanitatem, et vani facti sunt?
text_pt: Assim diz o Senhor: Que injustiça acharam vossos pais em mim, para se afastarem de mim, indo após a vaidade, e tornando-se levianos?
text_el: τάδε λέγει κύριος τί εὕροσαν οἱ πατέρες ὑμῶν ἐν ἐμοὶ πλημμέλημα ὅτι ἀπέστησαν μακρὰν ἀπ' ἐμοῦ καὶ ἐπορεύθησαν ὀπίσω τῶν ματαίων καὶ ἐματαιώθησαν

text_en: And they have not said: Where is the Lord , that made us come up out of the land of Egypt ? That led us through the desert , through a land uninhabited and unpassable, through a land of drought, and the image of death, through a land wherein no man walked, nor any man dwelt?
text_la: Et non dixerunt : Ubi est Dominus qui ascendere nos fecit de terra Ægypti; qui traduxit nos per desertum, per terram inhabitabilem et inviam, per terram sitis, et imaginem mortis, per terram in qua non ambulavit vir, neque habitavit homo?
text_pt: E não disseram: Onde está o Senhor, que nos fez subir da terra do Egito, que nos guiou através do deserto, por uma terra árida, e de covas, por uma terra de sequidão e sombra de morte, por uma terra pela qual ninguém transitava, e na qual não morava homem algum?
text_el: καὶ οὐκ εἶπαν ποῦ ἐστιν κύριος ὁ ἀναγαγὼν ἡμᾶς ἐκ γῆς Αἰγύπτου ὁ καθοδηγήσας ἡμᾶς ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ ἐν γῇ ἀπείρῳ καὶ ἀβάτῳ ἐν γῇ ἀνύδρῳ καὶ ἀκάρπῳ ἐν γῇ ἐν ᾗ οὐ διώδευσεν ἐν αὐτῇ οὐθὲν καὶ οὐ κατῴκησεν ἐκεῖ υἱὸς ἀνθρώπου

text_en: And I brought you into the land of Carmel , to eat the fruit thereof, and the best things thereof: and when you entered in, you defiled my land and made my inheritance an abomination.
text_la: Et induxi vos in terram Carmeli, ut comederetis fructum ejus et optima illius : et ingressi contaminastis terram meam, et hæreditatem meam posuistis in abominationem.
text_pt: E eu vos introduzi numa terra fértil, para comerdes o seu fruto e o seu bem; mas quando nela entrastes contaminastes a minha terra, e da minha herança fizestes uma abominação.
text_el: καὶ εἰσήγαγον ὑμᾶς εἰς τὸν Κάρμηλον τοῦ φαγεῖν ὑμᾶς τοὺς καρποὺς αὐτοῦ καὶ τὰ ἀγαθὰ αὐτοῦ καὶ εἰσήλθατε καὶ ἐμιάνατε τὴν γῆν μου καὶ τὴν κληρονομίαν μου ἔθεσθε εἰς βδέλυγμα

text_en: The priests did not say: Where is the Lord ? And they that held the law knew me not, and the pastors transgressed against me: and the prophets prophesied in Baal , and followed idols .
text_la: Sacerdotes non dixerunt : Ubi est Dominus? et tenentes legem nescierunt me, et pastores prævaricati sunt in me, et prophetæ prophetaverunt in Baal, et idola secuti sunt.
text_pt: Os sacerdotes não disseram: Onde está o Senhor? E os que tratavam da lei não me conheciam, e os pastores prevaricavam contra mim, e os profetas profetizavam por Baal, e andaram após o que é de nenhum proveito.
text_el: οἱ ἱερεῖς οὐκ εἶπαν ποῦ ἐστιν κύριος καὶ οἱ ἀντεχόμενοι τοῦ νόμου οὐκ ἠπίσταντό με καὶ οἱ ποιμένες ἠσέβουν εἰς ἐμέ καὶ οἱ προφῆται ἐπροφήτευον τῇ Βααλ καὶ ὀπίσω ἀνωφελοῦς ἐπορεύθησαν

text_en: Therefore will I yet contend in judgment with you, says the Lord , and I will plead with your children.
text_la: Propterea adhuc judicio contendam vobiscum, ait Dominus, et cum filiis vestris disceptabo.
text_pt: Portanto ainda contenderei convosco, diz o Senhor; e até com os filhos de vossos filhos contenderei.
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο ἔτι κριθήσομαι πρὸς ὑμᾶς λέγει κύριος καὶ πρὸς τοὺς υἱοὺς τῶν υἱῶν ὑμῶν κριθήσομαι

text_en: Pass over to the isles of Cethim, and see: and send into Cedar , and consider diligently: and see if there has been done anything like this.
text_la: Transite ad insulas Cethim, et videte : et in Cedar mittite, et considerate vehementer : et videte si factum est hujuscemodi :
text_pt: Pois, passai às ilhas de Quitim, e vede; e enviai a Quedar, e atentai bem, e vede se jamais sucedeu coisa semelhante.
text_el: διότι διέλθετε εἰς νήσους Χεττιιμ καὶ ἴδετε καὶ εἰς Κηδαρ ἀποστείλατε καὶ νοήσατε σφόδρα καὶ ἴδετε εἰ γέγονεν τοιαῦτα

text_en: If a nation has changed their gods, and indeed they are not gods: but my people have changed their glory into an idol .
text_la: si mutavit gens deos suos, et certe ipsi non sunt dii : populus vero meus mutavit gloriam suam in idolum.
text_pt: Houve alguma nação que trocasse os seus deuses, ainda que não fossem deuses? Todavia o meu povo trocou a sua glória por aquilo que é de nenhum proveito.
text_el: εἰ ἀλλάξονται ἔθνη θεοὺς αὐτῶν καὶ οὗτοι οὔκ εἰσιν θεοί ὁ δὲ λαός μου ἠλλάξατο τὴν δόξαν αὐτοῦ ἐξ ἧς οὐκ ὠφεληθήσονται

text_en: Be astonished, O you heavens , at this, and you gates thereof, be very desolate, says the Lord .
text_la: Obstupescite, cæli, super hoc, et portæ ejus, desolamini vehementer, dicit Dominus.
text_pt: Espantai-vos disto, ó céus, e horrorizai-vos! Ficai verdadeiramente desolados, diz o Senhor.
text_el: ἐξέστη ὁ οὐρανὸς ἐπὶ τούτῳ καὶ ἔφριξεν ἐπὶ πλεῖον σφόδρα λέγει κύριος

text_en: For my people have done two evils . They have forsaken me, the fountain of living water, and have digged to themselves cisterns , broken cisterns , that can hold no water.
text_la: Duo enim mala fecit populus meus : me dereliquerunt fontem aquæ vivæ, et foderunt sibi cisternas, cisternas dissipatas, quia continere non valent aquas.
text_pt: Porque o meu povo fez duas maldades: a mim me deixaram, o manancial de águas vivas, e cavaram cisternas, cisternas rotas, que não retêm águas.
text_el: ὅτι δύο πονηρὰ ἐποίησεν ὁ λαός μου ἐμὲ ἐγκατέλιπον πηγὴν ὕδατος ζωῆς καὶ ὤρυξαν ἑαυτοῖς λάκκους συντετριμμένους οἳ οὐ δυνήσονται ὕδωρ συνέχειν

text_en: Is Israel a bondman, or a homeborn slave? Why then is he become a prey?
text_la: Numquid servus est Israël, aut vernaculus? quare ergo factus est in prædam?
text_pt: Acaso é Israel um servo? É ele um escravo nascido em casa? Por que, pois, veio a ser presa?
text_el: μὴ δοῦλός ἐστιν Ισραηλ ἢ οἰκογενής ἐστιν διὰ τί εἰς προνομὴν ἐγένετο

text_en: The lions have roared upon him, and have made a noise, they have made his land a wilderness : his cities are burnt down, and there is none to dwell in them.
text_la: Super eum rugierunt leones, et dederunt vocem suam : posuerunt terram ejus in solitudinem. Civitates ejus exustæ sunt, et non est qui habitet in eis.
text_pt: Os filhos de leão rugiram sobre ele, levantaram a sua voz; e fizeram da sua terra uma desolação; as suas cidades se queimaram, e ninguém habita nelas.
text_el: ἐπ' αὐτὸν ὠρύοντο λέοντες καὶ ἔδωκαν τὴν φωνὴν αὐτῶν οἳ ἔταξαν τὴν γῆν αὐτοῦ εἰς ἔρημον καὶ αἱ πόλεις αὐτοῦ κατεσκάφησαν παρὰ τὸ μὴ κατοικεῖσθαι

text_en: The children also of Memphis , and of Taphnes have defloured you, even to the crown of the head.
text_la: Filii quoque Mempheos et Taphnes constupraverunt te usque ad verticem.
text_pt: Até os filhos de Nofe e de Tafnes te quebraram o alto da cabeça.
text_el: καὶ υἱοὶ Μέμφεως καὶ Ταφνας ἔγνωσάν σε καὶ κατέπαιζόν σου

text_en: Hath not this been done to you, because you have forsaken the Lord your God at that time, when he led you by the way?
text_la: Numquid non istud factum est tibi, quia dereliquisti Dominum Deum tuum eo tempore quo ducebat te per viam?
text_pt: Porventura não fizeste isto a ti mesmo, deixando o Senhor teu Deus, no tempo em que ele te guiava pelo caminho?
text_el: οὐχὶ ταῦτα ἐποίησέν σοι τὸ καταλιπεῖν σε ἐμέ λέγει κύριος ὁ θεός σου

text_en: And now what have you to do in the way of Egypt , to drink the troubled water? And what have you to do with the way of the Assyrians , to drink the water of the river?
text_la: Et nunc quid tibi vis in via Ægypti, ut bibas aquam turbidam? et quid tibi cum via Assyriorum, ut bibas aquam fluminis?
text_pt: Agora, pois, que te importa a ti o caminho do Egito, para beberes as águas de Sior? E que te importa a ti o caminho da Assíria, para beberes as águas do rio?
text_el: καὶ νῦν τί σοι καὶ τῇ ὁδῷ Αἰγύπτου τοῦ πιεῖν ὕδωρ Γηων καὶ τί σοι καὶ τῇ ὁδῷ Ἀσσυρίων τοῦ πιεῖν ὕδωρ ποταμῶν

text_en: Your own wickedness shall reprove you, and your apostasy shall rebuke you. Know and see that it is an evil and a bitter thing for you, to have left the Lord your God , and that my fear is not with you, says the Lord the God of hosts .
text_la: Arguet te malitia tua, et aversio tua increpabit te. Scito et vide quia malum et amarum est reliquisse te Dominum Deum tuum, et non esse timorem mei apud te, dicit Dominus Deus exercituum.
text_pt: A tua malícia te castigará, e as tuas apostasias te repreenderão; sabe, pois, e vê, que mal e quão amargo é deixares ao SENHOR teu Deus, e não teres em ti o meu temor, diz o Senhor DEUS dos Exércitos.
text_el: παιδεύσει σε ἡ ἀποστασία σου καὶ ἡ κακία σου ἐλέγξει σε καὶ γνῶθι καὶ ἰδὲ ὅτι πικρόν σοι τὸ καταλιπεῖν σε ἐμέ λέγει κύριος ὁ θεός σου καὶ οὐκ εὐδόκησα ἐπὶ σοί λέγει κύριος ὁ θεός σου

text_en: Of old time you have broken my yoke, you have burst my bands, and you said: I will not serve. For on every high hill, and under every green tree, you prostituted yourself.
text_la: A sæculo confregisti jugum meum : rupisti vincula mea, et dixisti : Non serviam. In omni enim colle sublimi, et sub omni ligno frondoso, tu prosternebaris meretrix.
text_pt: Quando eu já há muito quebrava o teu jugo, e rompia as tuas ataduras, dizias tu: Nunca mais transgredirei; contudo em todo o outeiro alto e debaixo de toda a árvore verde te andas encurvando e prostituindo-te.
text_el: ὅτι ἀπ' αἰῶνος συνέτριψας τὸν ζυγόν σου διέσπασας τοὺς δεσμούς σου καὶ εἶπας οὐ δουλεύσω ἀλλὰ πορεύσομαι ἐπὶ πᾶν βουνὸν ὑψηλὸν καὶ ὑποκάτω παντὸς ξύλου κατασκίου ἐκεῖ διαχυθήσομαι ἐν τῇ πορνείᾳ μου

text_en: Yet, I planted you a chosen vineyard, all true seed: how then are you turned unto me into that which is good for nothing, O strange vineyard?
text_la: Ego autem plantavi te vineam electam, omne semen verum : quomodo ergo conversa es mihi in pravum, vinea aliena?
text_pt: Eu mesmo te plantei como vide excelente, uma semente inteiramente fiel; como, pois, te tornaste para mim uma planta degenerada como vide estranha?
text_el: ἐγὼ δὲ ἐφύτευσά σε ἄμπελον καρποφόρον πᾶσαν ἀληθινήν πῶς ἐστράφης εἰς πικρίαν ἡ ἄμπελος ἡ ἀλλοτρία

text_en: Though you wash yourself with nitre, and multiply to yourself the herb borith, you are stained in your iniquity before me, says the Lord God .
text_la: Si laveris te nitro, et multiplicaveris tibi herbam borith, maculata es in iniquitate tua coram me, dicit Dominus Deus.
text_pt: Por isso, ainda que te laves com salitre, e amontoes sabão, a tua iniqüidade está gravada diante de mim, diz o Senhor DEUS.
text_el: ἐὰν ἀποπλύνῃ ἐν νίτρῳ καὶ πληθύνῃς σεαυτῇ πόαν κεκηλίδωσαι ἐν ταῖς ἀδικίαις σου ἐναντίον ἐμοῦ λέγει κύριος

text_en: How can you say: I am not polluted, I have not walked after Baalim ? See your ways in the valley, know what you have done: as a swift runner pursuing his course.
text_la: Quomodo dicis : Non sum polluta; post Baalim non ambulavi? Vide vias tuas in convalle; scito quid feceris : cursor levis explicans vias suas.
text_pt: Como dizes logo: Não estou contaminada nem andei após os baalins? Vê o teu caminho no vale, conhece o que fizeste; dromedária ligeira és, que anda torcendo os seus caminhos.
text_el: πῶς ἐρεῖς οὐκ ἐμιάνθην καὶ ὀπίσω τῆς Βααλ οὐκ ἐπορεύθην ἰδὲ τὰς ὁδούς σου ἐν τῷ πολυανδρίῳ καὶ γνῶθι τί ἐποίησας ὀψὲ φωνὴ αὐτῆς ὠλόλυξεν τὰς ὁδοὺς αὐτῆς

text_en: A wild ass accustomed to the wilderness in the desire of his heart, snuffed up the wind of his love : none shall turn her away: all that seek her shall not fail: in her monthly filth they shall find her.
text_la: Onager assuetus in solitudine, in desiderio animæ suæ attraxit ventum amoris sui : nullus avertet eam : omnes qui quærunt eam non deficient : in menstruis ejus invenient eam.
text_pt: Jumenta montês, acostumada ao deserto, que, conforme o desejo da sua alma, sorve o vento, quem a deteria no seu cio? Todos os que a buscarem não se cansarão; no mês dela a acharão.
text_el: ἐπλάτυνεν ἐφ' ὕδατα ἐρήμου ἐν ἐπιθυμίαις ψυχῆς αὐτῆς ἐπνευματοφορεῖτο παρεδόθη τίς ἐπιστρέψει αὐτήν πάντες οἱ ζητοῦντες αὐτὴν οὐ κοπιάσουσιν ἐν τῇ ταπεινώσει αὐτῆς εὑρήσουσιν αὐτήν

text_en: Keep your foot from being bare, and your throat from thirst. But you said: I have lost all hope , I will not do it: for I have loved strangers, and I will walk after them.
text_la: Prohibe pedem tuum a nuditate, et guttur tuum a siti. Et dixisti : Desperavi : nequaquam faciam : adamavi quippe alienos, et post eos ambulabo.
text_pt: Evita que o teu pé ande descalço, e a tua garganta tenha sede. Mas tu dizes: Não há esperança; porque amo os estranhos, após eles andarei.
text_el: ἀπόστρεψον τὸν πόδα σου ἀπὸ ὁδοῦ τραχείας καὶ τὸν φάρυγγά σου ἀπὸ δίψους ἡ δὲ εἶπεν ἀνδριοῦμαι ὅτι ἠγαπήκει ἀλλοτρίους καὶ ὀπίσω αὐτῶν ἐπορεύετο

text_en: As the thief is confounded when he is taken, so is the house of Israel confounded, they and their kings, their princes and their priests , and their prophets .
text_la: Quomodo confunditur fur quando deprehenditur, sic confusi sunt domus Israël, ipsi et reges eorum, principes, et sacerdotes, et prophetæ eorum,
text_pt: Como fica confundido o ladrão quando o apanham, assim se confundem os da casa de Israel; eles, os seus reis, os seus príncipes, e os seus sacerdotes, e os seus profetas,
text_el: ὡς αἰσχύνη κλέπτου ὅταν ἁλῷ οὕτως αἰσχυνθήσονται οἱ υἱοὶ Ισραηλ αὐτοὶ καὶ οἱ βασιλεῖς αὐτῶν καὶ οἱ ἄρχοντες αὐτῶν καὶ οἱ ἱερεῖς αὐτῶν καὶ οἱ προφῆται αὐτῶν

text_en: Saying to a stock: You are my father: and to a stone: You have begotten me: they have turned their back to me, and not their face: and in the time of their affliction they will say: Arise, and deliver us.
text_la: dicentes ligno : Pater meus es tu : et lapidi : Tu me genuisti. Verterunt ad me tergum et non faciem, et in tempore afflictionis suæ dicent : Surge, et libera nos.
text_pt: Que dizem ao pau: Tu és meu pai; e à pedra: Tu me geraste; porque me viraram as costas, e não o rosto; mas no tempo da sua angústia dirão: Levanta-te, e livra-nos.
text_el: τῷ ξύλῳ εἶπαν ὅτι πατήρ μου εἶ σύ καὶ τῷ λίθῳ σὺ ἐγέννησάς με καὶ ἔστρεψαν ἐπ' ἐμὲ νῶτα καὶ οὐ πρόσωπα αὐτῶν καὶ ἐν τῷ καιρῷ τῶν κακῶν αὐτῶν ἐροῦσιν ἀνάστα καὶ σῶσον ἡμᾶς

text_en: Where are the gods, whom you have made you? Let them arise and deliver you in the time of your affliction: for according to the number of your cities were your gods, O Juda .
text_la: Ubi sunt dii tui quos fecisti tibi? surgant, et liberent te in tempore afflictionis tuæ : secundum numerum quippe civitatum tuarum erant dii tui, Juda.
text_pt: Onde, pois, estão os teus deuses, que fizeste para ti? Que se levantem, se te podem livrar no tempo da tua angústia; porque os teus deuses, ó Judá, são tão numerosos como as tuas cidades.
text_el: καὶ ποῦ εἰσιν οἱ θεοί σου οὓς ἐποίησας σεαυτῷ εἰ ἀναστήσονται καὶ σώσουσίν σε ἐν καιρῷ τῆς κακώσεώς σου ὅτι κατ' ἀριθμὸν τῶν πόλεών σου ἦσαν θεοί σου Ιουδα καὶ κατ' ἀριθμὸν διόδων τῆς Ιερουσαλημ ἔθυον τῇ Βααλ

text_en: Why will you contend with me in judgment? You have all forsaken me, says the Lord .
text_la: Quid vultis mecum judicio contendere? omnes dereliquistis me, dicit Dominus.
text_pt: Por que contendeis comigo? Todos vós transgredistes contra mim, diz o Senhor.
text_el: ἵνα τί λαλεῖτε πρός με πάντες ὑμεῖς ἠσεβήσατε καὶ πάντες ὑμεῖς ἠνομήσατε εἰς ἐμέ λέγει κύριος

text_en: In vain have I struck your children, they have not received correction: your sword has devoured your prophets , your generation is like a ravaging lion.
text_la: Frustra percussi filios vestros : disciplinam non receperunt. Devoravit gladius vester prophetas vestros : quasi leo vastator
text_pt: Em vão castiguei os vossos filhos; eles não aceitaram a correção; a vossa espada devorou os vossos profetas como um leão destruidor.
text_el: μάτην ἐπάταξα τὰ τέκνα ὑμῶν παιδείαν οὐκ ἐδέξασθε μάχαιρα κατέφαγεν τοὺς προφήτας ὑμῶν ὡς λέων ὀλεθρεύων καὶ οὐκ ἐφοβήθητε

text_en: See the word of the Lord : Am I become a wilderness to Israel , or a lateward springing land? Why then have my people said: We are revolted, we will come to you no more?
text_la: generatio vestra. Videte verbum Domini : numquid solitudo factus sum Israëli, aut terra serotina? quare ergo dixit populus meus : Recessimus; non veniemus ultra ad te?
text_pt: Oh geração! Considerai vós a palavra do Senhor: Porventura tenho eu sido para Israel um deserto? Ou uma terra da mais espessa escuridão? Por que, pois, diz o meu povo: Temos determinado; não viremos mais a ti?
text_el: ἀκούσατε λόγον κυρίου τάδε λέγει κύριος μὴ ἔρημος ἐγενόμην τῷ Ισραηλ ἢ γῆ κεχερσωμένη διὰ τί εἶπεν ὁ λαός μου οὐ κυριευθησόμεθα καὶ οὐχ ἥξομεν πρὸς σὲ ἔτι

text_en: Will a virgin forget her ornament, or a bride her stomacher? But my people has forgotten me days without number.
text_la: Numquid obliviscetur virgo ornamenti sui, aut sponsa fasciæ pectoralis suæ? populus vero meus oblitus est mei diebus innumeris.
text_pt: Porventura esquece-se a virgem dos seus enfeites, ou a noiva dos seus adornos? Todavia o meu povo se esqueceu de mim por inumeráveis dias.
text_el: μὴ ἐπιλήσεται νύμφη τὸν κόσμον αὐτῆς καὶ παρθένος τὴν στηθοδεσμίδα αὐτῆς ὁ δὲ λαός μου ἐπελάθετό μου ἡμέρας ὧν οὐκ ἔστιν ἀριθμός

text_en: Why do you endeavour to show your way good to seek my love , you who have also taught your malices to be your ways,
text_la: Quid niteris bonam ostendere viam tuam ad quærendam dilectionem, quæ insuper et malitias tuas docuisti vias tuas,
text_pt: Por que ornamentas o teu caminho, para buscares o amor? Pois até às malignas ensinaste os teus caminhos.
text_el: τί ἔτι καλὸν ἐπιτηδεύσεις ἐν ταῖς ὁδοῖς σου τοῦ ζητῆσαι ἀγάπησιν οὐχ οὕτως ἀλλὰ καὶ σὺ ἐπονηρεύσω τοῦ μιᾶναι τὰς ὁδούς σου

text_en: and in your skirts is found the blood of the souls of the poor and innocent? not in ditches have I found them, but in all places, which I mentioned before.
text_la: et in alis tuis inventus est sanguis animarum pauperum et innocentum? non in fossis inveni eos, sed in omnibus quæ supra memoravi.
text_pt: Até nas orlas dos teus vestidos se achou o sangue das almas dos inocentes e necessitados; não cavei para achar, pois se vê em todas estas coisas.
text_el: καὶ ἐν ταῖς χερσίν σου εὑρέθησαν αἵματα ψυχῶν ἀθῴων οὐκ ἐν διορύγμασιν εὗρον αὐτούς ἀλλ' ἐπὶ πάσῃ δρυί

text_en: And you have said: I am without sin and am innocent: and therefore let your anger be turned away from me. Behold, I will contend with you in judgment, because you have said: I have not sinned .
text_la: Et dixisti : Absque peccato et innocens ego sum, et propterea avertatur furor tuus a me. Ecce ego judicio contendam tecum, eo quod dixeris : Non peccavi.
text_pt: E ainda dizes: Eu estou inocente; certamente a sua ira se desviou de mim. Eis que entrarei em juízo contigo, porquanto dizes: Não pequei.
text_el: καὶ εἶπας ἀθῷός εἰμι ἀλλὰ ἀποστραφήτω ὁ θυμὸς αὐτοῦ ἀπ' ἐμοῦ ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ κρίνομαι πρὸς σὲ ἐν τῷ λέγειν σε οὐχ ἥμαρτον

text_en: How exceeding base are you become, going the same ways over again! And you shall be ashamed of Egypt , as you were ashamed of Assyria .
text_la: Quam vilis facta es nimis, iterans vias tuas! et ab Ægypto confunderis, sicut confusa es ab Assur.
text_pt: Por que te desvias tanto, mudando o teu caminho? Também do Egito serás envergonhada, como foste envergonhada da Assíria.
text_el: τί κατεφρόνησας σφόδρα τοῦ δευτερῶσαι τὰς ὁδούς σου καὶ ἀπὸ Αἰγύπτου καταισχυνθήσῃ καθὼς κατῃσχύνθης ἀπὸ Ασσουρ

text_en: For from thence you shall go, and your hand shall be upon your head: for the Lord has destroyed your trust, and you shall have nothing prosperous therein.
text_la: Nam et ab ista egredieris, et manus tuæ erunt super caput tuum : quoniam obtrivit Dominus confidentiam tuam, et nihil habebis prosperum in ea.
text_pt: Também daquele sairás com as mãos sobre a tua cabeça; porque o Senhor rejeitou a tua confiança, e não prosperarás com eles.
text_el: ὅτι καὶ ἐντεῦθεν ἐξελεύσῃ καὶ αἱ χεῖρές σου ἐπὶ τῆς κεφαλῆς σου ὅτι ἀπώσατο κύριος τὴν ἐλπίδα σου καὶ οὐκ εὐοδωθήσῃ ἐν αὐτῇ

text_en: It is commonly said: If a man put away his wife, and she go from him, and marry another man , shall he return to her any more? Shall not that woman be polluted, and defiled? But you have prostituted yourself to many lovers: nevertheless return to me, says the Lord , and I will receive you.
text_la: Vulgo dicitur : Si dimiserit vir uxorem suam, et recedens ab eo duxerit virum alterum, numquid revertetur ad eam ultra? numquid non polluta et contaminata erit mulier illa? Tu autem fornicata es cum amatoribus multis : tamen revertere ad me, dicit Dominus, et ego suscipiam te.
text_pt: Eles dizem: Se um homem despedir sua mulher, e ela o deixar, e se ajuntar a outro homem, porventura tornará ele outra vez para ela? Não se poluirá de todo aquela terra? Ora, tu te prostituíste com muitos amantes; mas ainda assim, torna para mim, diz o SENHOR.
text_el: ἐὰν ἐξαποστείλῃ ἀνὴρ τὴν γυναῖκα αὐτοῦ καὶ ἀπέλθῃ ἀπ' αὐτοῦ καὶ γένηται ἀνδρὶ ἑτέρῳ μὴ ἀνακάμπτουσα ἀνακάμψει πρὸς αὐτὸν ἔτι οὐ μιαινομένη μιανθήσεται ἡ γυνὴ ἐκείνη καὶ σὺ ἐξεπόρνευσας ἐν ποιμέσιν πολλοῖς καὶ ἀνέκαμπτες πρός με λέγει κύριος

text_en: Lift up your eyes on high: and see where you have not prostituted yourself: you sat in the ways, waiting for them as a robber in the wilderness : and you have polluted the land with your fornications, and with your wickedness .
text_la: Leva oculos tuos in directum, et vide ubi non prostrata sis. In viis sedebas, exspectans eos quasi latro in solitudine : et polluisti terram in fornicationibus tuis, et in malitiis tuis.
text_pt: Levanta os teus olhos aos altos, e vê: onde não te prostituíste? Nos caminhos te assentavas para eles, como o árabe no deserto; assim poluíste a terra com as tuas fornicações e com a tua malícia.
text_el: ἆρον εἰς εὐθεῖαν τοὺς ὀφθαλμούς σου καὶ ἰδέ ποῦ οὐχὶ ἐξεφύρθης ἐπὶ ταῖς ὁδοῖς ἐκάθισας αὐτοῖς ὡσεὶ κορώνη ἐρημουμένη καὶ ἐμίανας τὴν γῆν ἐν ταῖς πορνείαις σου καὶ ἐν ταῖς κακίαις σου

text_en: Therefore the showers were withholden, and there was no lateward rain: you had a harlot's forehead, you would not blush.
text_la: Quam ob rem prohibitæ sunt stillæ pluviarum, et serotinus imber non fuit. Frons mulieris meretricis facta est tibi; noluisti erubescere.
text_pt: Por isso foram retiradas as chuvas, e não houve chuva serôdia; mas tu tens a fronte de uma prostituta, e não queres ter vergonha.
text_el: καὶ ἔσχες ποιμένας πολλοὺς εἰς πρόσκομμα σεαυτῇ ὄψις πόρνης ἐγένετό σοι ἀπηναισχύντησας πρὸς πάντας

text_en: Therefore at the least from this time call to me: You are my father, the guide of my virginity:
text_la: Ergo saltem amodo voca me : Pater meus, dux virginitatis meæ tu es :
text_pt: Ao menos desde agora não chamarás por mim, dizendo: Pai meu, tu és o guia da minha mocidade?
text_el: οὐχ ὡς οἶκόν με ἐκάλεσας καὶ πατέρα καὶ ἀρχηγὸν τῆς παρθενίας σου

text_en: Will you be angry for ever, or will you continue unto the end? Behold, you have spoken, and have done evil things, and have been able.
text_la: numquid irasceris in perpetuum, aut perseverabis in finem? ecce locuta es, et fecisti mala, et potuisti.
text_pt: Conservará ele para sempre a sua ira? Ou a guardará continuamente? Eis que tens falado e feito quantas maldades pudeste.
text_el: μὴ διαμενεῖ εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα ἢ διαφυλαχθήσεται εἰς νεῖκος ἰδοὺ ἐλάλησας καὶ ἐποίησας τὰ πονηρὰ ταῦτα καὶ ἠδυνάσθης

text_en: And the Lord said to me in the days of king Josias : Have you seen what rebellious Israel has done? She has gone of herself upon every high mountain, and under every green tree, and has played the harlot there.
text_la: Et dixit Dominus ad me in diebus Josiæ regis : Numquid vidisti quæ fecerit aversatrix Israël? Abiit sibimet super omnem montem excelsum, et sub omni ligno frondoso, et fornicata est ibi.
text_pt: Disse mais o Senhor nos dias do rei Josias: Viste o que fez a rebelde Israel? Ela foi a todo o monte alto, e debaixo de toda a árvore verde, e ali andou prostituindo-se.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν κύριος πρός με ἐν ταῖς ἡμέραις Ιωσια τοῦ βασιλέως εἶδες ἃ ἐποίησέν μοι ἡ κατοικία τοῦ Ισραηλ ἐπορεύθησαν ἐπὶ πᾶν ὄρος ὑψηλὸν καὶ ὑποκάτω παντὸς ξύλου ἀλσώδους καὶ ἐπόρνευσαν ἐκεῖ

text_en: And when she had done all these things, I said: Return to me, and she did not return. And her treacherous sister Juda saw,
text_la: Et dixi, cum fecisset hæc omnia : Ad me revertere : et non est reversa. Et vidit prævaricatrix soror ejus Juda
text_pt: E eu disse: Depois que fizer tudo isto, voltará para mim; mas não voltou; e viu isto a sua aleivosa irmã Judá.
text_el: καὶ εἶπα μετὰ τὸ πορνεῦσαι αὐτὴν ταῦτα πάντα πρός με ἀνάστρεψον καὶ οὐκ ἀνέστρεψεν καὶ εἶδεν τὴν ἀσυνθεσίαν αὐτῆς ἡ ἀσύνθετος Ιουδα

text_en: that because the rebellious Israel had played the harlot, I had put her away , and given her a bill of divorce : yet her treacherous sister Juda was not afraid, but went and played the harlot also herself.
text_la: quia pro eo quod mœchata esset aversatrix Israël, dimisissem eam, et dedissem ei libellum repudii : et non timuit prævaricatrix Juda soror ejus, sed abiit, et fornicata est etiam ipsa :
text_pt: E vi que, por causa de tudo isto, por ter cometido adultério a rebelde Israel, a despedi, e lhe dei a sua carta de divórcio, que a aleivosa Judá, sua irmã, não temeu; mas se foi e também ela mesma se prostituiu.
text_el: καὶ εἶδον διότι περὶ πάντων ὧν κατελήμφθη ἐν οἷς ἐμοιχᾶτο ἡ κατοικία τοῦ Ισραηλ καὶ ἐξαπέστειλα αὐτὴν καὶ ἔδωκα αὐτῇ βιβλίον ἀποστασίου εἰς τὰς χεῖρας αὐτῆς καὶ οὐκ ἐφοβήθη ἡ ἀσύνθετος Ιουδα καὶ ἐπορεύθη καὶ ἐπόρνευσεν καὶ αὐτή

text_en: And by the facility of her fornication she defiled the land, and played the harlot with stones and with stocks.
text_la: et facilitate fornicationis suæ contaminavit terram, et mœchata est cum lapide et ligno :
text_pt: E sucedeu que pela fama da sua prostituição, contaminou a terra; porque adulterou com a pedra e com a madeira.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο εἰς οὐθὲν ἡ πορνεία αὐτῆς καὶ ἐμοίχευσεν τὸ ξύλον καὶ τὸν λίθον

text_en: And after all this, her treacherous sister Juda has not returned to me with her whole heart, but with falsehood, says the Lord .
text_la: et in omnibus his non est reversa ad me prævaricatrix soror ejus Juda in toto corde suo, sed in mendacio, ait Dominus.
text_pt: E, contudo, apesar de tudo isso a sua aleivosa irmã Judá não voltou para mim de todo o seu coração, mas falsamente, diz o Senhor.
text_el: καὶ ἐν πᾶσιν τούτοις οὐκ ἐπεστράφη πρός με ἡ ἀσύνθετος Ιουδα ἐξ ὅλης τῆς καρδίας αὐτῆς ἀλλ' ἐπὶ ψεύδει

text_en: And the Lord said to me: The rebellious Israel has justified her soul , in comparison of the treacherous Juda .
text_la: Et dixit Dominus ad me : Justificavit animam suam aversatrix Israël, comparatione prævaricatricis Judæ.
text_pt: E o Senhor me disse: Já a rebelde Israel mostrou-se mais justa do que a aleivosa Judá.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν κύριος πρός με ἐδικαίωσεν τὴν ψυχὴν αὐτοῦ Ισραηλ ἀπὸ τῆς ἀσυνθέτου Ιουδα

text_en: Go, and proclaim these words towards the north, and you shall say: Return, O rebellious Israel , says the Lord , and I will not turn away my face from you: for I am holy , says the Lord , and I will not be angry for ever.
text_la: Vade, et clama sermones istos contra aquilonem, et dices : Revertere, aversatrix Israël, ait Dominus, et non avertam faciem meam a vobis, quia sanctus ego sum, dicit Dominus, et non irascar in perpetuum.
text_pt: Vai, pois, e apregoa estas palavras para o lado norte, e dize: Volta, ó rebelde Israel, diz o Senhor, e não farei cair a minha ira sobre ti; porque misericordioso sou, diz o Senhor, e não conservarei para sempre a minha ira.
text_el: πορεύου καὶ ἀνάγνωθι τοὺς λόγους τούτους πρὸς βορρᾶν καὶ ἐρεῖς ἐπιστράφητι πρός με ἡ κατοικία τοῦ Ισραηλ λέγει κύριος καὶ οὐ στηριῶ τὸ πρόσωπόν μου ἐφ' ὑμᾶς ὅτι ἐλεήμων ἐγώ εἰμι λέγει κύριος καὶ οὐ μηνιῶ ὑμῖν εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα

text_en: But yet acknowledge your iniquity , that you have transgressed against the Lord your God : and you have scattered your ways to strangers under every green tree, and have not heard my voice, says the Lord .
text_la: Verumtamen scito iniquitatem tuam, quia in Dominum Deum tuum prævaricata es, et dispersisti vias tuas alienis sub omni ligno frondoso, et vocem meam non audisti, ait Dominus.
text_pt: Somente reconhece a tua iniqüidade, que transgrediste contra o Senhor teu Deus; e estendeste os teus caminhos aos estranhos, debaixo de toda a árvore verde, e não deste ouvidos à minha voz, diz o Senhor.
text_el: πλὴν γνῶθι τὴν ἀδικίαν σου ὅτι εἰς κύριον τὸν θεόν σου ἠσέβησας καὶ διέχεας τὰς ὁδούς σου εἰς ἀλλοτρίους ὑποκάτω παντὸς ξύλου ἀλσώδους τῆς δὲ φωνῆς μου οὐχ ὑπήκουσας λέγει κύριος

text_en: Return, O you revolting children, says the Lord : for I am your I husband: and I will take you, one of a city, and two of a kindred, and will bring you into Sion.
text_la: Convertimini, filii revertentes, dicit Dominus, quia ego vir vester : et assumam vos unum de civitate, et duos de cognatione, et introducam vos in Sion.
text_pt: Convertei-vos, ó filhos rebeldes, diz o Senhor; pois eu vos desposei; e vos tomarei, a um de uma cidade, e a dois de uma família; e vos levarei a Sião.
text_el: ἐπιστράφητε υἱοὶ ἀφεστηκότες λέγει κύριος διότι ἐγὼ κατακυριεύσω ὑμῶν καὶ λήμψομαι ὑμᾶς ἕνα ἐκ πόλεως καὶ δύο ἐκ πατριᾶς καὶ εἰσάξω ὑμᾶς εἰς Σιων

text_en: And I will give you pastors according to my own heart, and they shall feed you with knowledge and doctrine.
text_la: Et dabo vobis pastores juxta cor meum, et pascent vos scientia et doctrina.
text_pt: E dar-vos-ei pastores segundo o meu coração, os quais vos apascentarão com ciência e com inteligência.
text_el: καὶ δώσω ὑμῖν ποιμένας κατὰ τὴν καρδίαν μου καὶ ποιμανοῦσιν ὑμᾶς ποιμαίνοντες μετ' ἐπιστήμης

text_en: And when you shall be multiplied, and increase in the land in those days, says the Lord , they shall say no more: The ark of the covenant of the Lord : neither shall it come upon the heart, neither shall they remember it, neither shall it be visited, neither shall that be done any more.
text_la: Cumque multiplicati fueritis, et creveritis in terra in diebus illis, ait Dominus, non dicent ultra : Arca testamenti Domini : neque ascendet super cor, neque recordabuntur illius, nec visitabitur, nec fiet ultra.
text_pt: E sucederá que, quando vos multiplicardes e frutificardes na terra, naqueles dias, diz o Senhor, nunca mais se dirá: A arca da aliança do Senhor, nem lhes virá ao coração; nem dela se lembrarão, nem a visitarão; nem se fará outra.
text_el: καὶ ἔσται ἐὰν πληθυνθῆτε καὶ αὐξηθῆτε ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς ἐν ταῖς ἡμέραις ἐκείναις λέγει κύριος οὐκ ἐροῦσιν ἔτι κιβωτὸς διαθήκης ἁγίου Ισραηλ οὐκ ἀναβήσεται ἐπὶ καρδίαν οὐκ ὀνομασθήσεται οὐδὲ ἐπισκεφθήσεται καὶ οὐ ποιηθήσεται ἔτι

text_en: At that time Jerusalem shall be called the throne of the Lord : and all the nations shall be gathered together to it, in the name of the Lord to Jerusalem , and they shall not walk after the perversity of their most wicked heart.
text_la: In tempore illo vocabunt Jerusalem solium Domini : et congregabuntur ad eam omnes gentes in nomine Domini in Jerusalem, et non ambulabunt post pravitatem cordis sui pessimi.
text_pt: Naquele tempo chamarão a Jerusalém o trono do Senhor, e todas as nações se ajuntarão a ela, em nome do Senhor, em Jerusalém; e nunca mais andarão segundo o propósito do seu coração maligno.
text_el: ἐν ταῖς ἡμέραις ἐκείναις καὶ ἐν τῷ καιρῷ ἐκείνῳ καλέσουσιν τὴν Ιερουσαλημ θρόνος κυρίου καὶ συναχθήσονται εἰς αὐτὴν πάντα τὰ ἔθνη καὶ οὐ πορεύσονται ἔτι ὀπίσω τῶν ἐνθυμημάτων τῆς καρδίας αὐτῶν τῆς πονηρᾶς

text_en: In those days the house of Juda shall go to the house of Israel , and they shall come together out of the land of the north to the land which I gave to your fathers.
text_la: In diebus illis ibit domus Juda ad domum Israël, et venient simul de terra aquilonis ad terram quam dedi patribus vestris.
text_pt: Naqueles dias andará a casa de Judá com a casa de Israel; e virão juntas da terra do norte, para a terra que dei em herança a vossos pais.
text_el: ἐν ταῖς ἡμέραις ἐκείναις συνελεύσονται οἶκος Ιουδα ἐπὶ τὸν οἶκον τοῦ Ισραηλ καὶ ἥξουσιν ἐπὶ τὸ αὐτὸ ἀπὸ γῆς βορρᾶ καὶ ἀπὸ πασῶν τῶν χωρῶν ἐπὶ τὴν γῆν ἣν κατεκληρονόμησα τοὺς πατέρας αὐτῶν

text_en: But I said: How shall I put you among the children, and give you a lovely land, the goodly inheritance of the armies of the Gentiles ? And I said: You shall call me father and shall not cease to walk after me.
text_la: Ego autem dixi : Quomodo ponam te in filios, et tribuam tibi terram desiderabilem, hæreditatem præclaram exercituum gentium? Et dixi : Patrem vocabis me, et post me ingredi non cessabis.
text_pt: Mas eu dizia: Como te porei entre os filhos, e te darei a terra desejável, a excelente herança dos exércitos das nações? Mas eu disse: Tu me chamarás meu pai, e de mim não te desviarás.
text_el: καὶ ἐγὼ εἶπα γένοιτο κύριε ὅτι τάξω σε εἰς τέκνα καὶ δώσω σοι γῆν ἐκλεκτὴν κληρονομίαν θεοῦ παντοκράτορος ἐθνῶν καὶ εἶπα πατέρα καλέσετέ με καὶ ἀπ' ἐμοῦ οὐκ ἀποστραφήσεσθε

text_en: But as a woman that despises her lover, so has the house of Israel despised me, says the Lord .
text_la: Sed quomodo si contemnat mulier amatorem suum, sic contempsit me domus Israël, dicit Dominus.
text_pt: Deveras, como a mulher se aparta aleivosamente do seu marido, assim aleivosamente te houveste comigo, ó casa de Israel, diz o Senhor.
text_el: πλὴν ὡς ἀθετεῖ γυνὴ εἰς τὸν συνόντα αὐτῇ οὕτως ἠθέτησεν εἰς ἐμὲ οἶκος Ισραηλ λέγει κύριος

text_en: A voice was heard in the highways, weeping and howling of the children of Israel : because they have made their way wicked , they have forgotten the Lord their God .
text_la: Vox in viis audita est, ploratus et ululatus filiorum Israël : quoniam iniquam fecerunt viam suam; obliti sunt Domini Dei sui.
text_pt: Nos lugares altos se ouviu uma voz, pranto e súplicas dos filhos de Israel; porquanto perverteram o seu caminho, e se esqueceram do Senhor seu Deus.
text_el: φωνὴ ἐκ χειλέων ἠκούσθη κλαυθμοῦ καὶ δεήσεως υἱῶν Ισραηλ ὅτι ἠδίκησαν ἐν ταῖς ὁδοῖς αὐτῶν ἐπελάθοντο θεοῦ ἁγίου αὐτῶν

text_en: Return, you rebellious children, and I will heal your rebellions. Behold we come to you: for you are the Lord our God .
text_la: Convertimini, filii revertentes, et sanabo aversiones vestras. Ecce nos venimus ad te : tu enim es Dominus Deus noster.
text_pt: Voltai, ó filhos rebeldes, eu curarei as vossas rebeliões. Eis-nos aqui, vimos a ti; porque tu és o Senhor nosso Deus.
text_el: ἐπιστράφητε υἱοὶ ἐπιστρέφοντες καὶ ἰάσομαι τὰ συντρίμματα ὑμῶν ἰδοὺ δοῦλοι ἡμεῖς ἐσόμεθά σοι ὅτι σὺ κύριος ὁ θεὸς ἡμῶν εἶ

text_en: In very deed the hills were liars , and the multitude of the mountains: truly in the Lord our God is the salvation of Israel .
text_la: Vere mendaces erant colles, et multitudo montium : vere in Domino Deo nostro salus Israël.
text_pt: Certamente em vão se confia nos outeiros e na multidão das montanhas; deveras no Senhor nosso Deus está a salvação de Israel.
text_el: ὄντως εἰς ψεῦδος ἦσαν οἱ βουνοὶ καὶ ἡ δύναμις τῶν ὀρέων πλὴν διὰ κυρίου θεοῦ ἡμῶν ἡ σωτηρία τοῦ Ισραηλ

text_en: Confusion has devoured the labour of our fathers from our youth, their flocks and their herds, their sons and their daughters.
text_la: Confusio comedit laborem patrum nostrorum ab adolescentia nostra : greges eorum, et armenta eorum, filios eorum, et filias eorum.
text_pt: Porque a confusão devorou o trabalho de nossos pais desde a nossa mocidade; as suas ovelhas e o seu gado, os seus filhos e as suas filhas.
text_el: ἡ δὲ αἰσχύνη κατανάλωσεν τοὺς μόχθους τῶν πατέρων ἡμῶν ἀπὸ νεότητος ἡμῶν τὰ πρόβατα αὐτῶν καὶ τοὺς μόσχους αὐτῶν καὶ τοὺς υἱοὺς αὐτῶν καὶ τὰς θυγατέρας αὐτῶν

text_en: We shall sleep in our confusion, and our shame shall cover us, because we have sinned against the Lord our God , we and our fathers from our youth even to this day, and we have not hearkened to the voice of the Lord our God .
text_la: Dormiemus in confusione nostra, et operiet nos ignominia nostra : quoniam Domino Deo nostro peccavimus nos, et patres nostri, ab adolescentia nostra usque ad diem hanc : et non audivimus vocem Domini Dei nostri.
text_pt: Deitemo-nos em nossa vergonha; e cubra-nos a nossa confusão, porque pecamos contra o Senhor nosso Deus, nós e nossos pais, desde a nossa mocidade até o dia de hoje; e não demos ouvidos à voz do Senhor nosso Deus.
text_el: ἐκοιμήθημεν ἐν τῇ αἰσχύνῃ ἡμῶν καὶ ἐπεκάλυψεν ἡμᾶς ἡ ἀτιμία ἡμῶν διότι ἔναντι τοῦ θεοῦ ἡμῶν ἡμάρτομεν ἡμεῖς καὶ οἱ πατέρες ἡμῶν ἀπὸ νεότητος ἡμῶν ἕως τῆς ἡμέρας ταύτης καὶ οὐχ ὑπηκούσαμεν τῆς φωνῆς κυρίου τοῦ θεοῦ ἡμῶν

text_en: If you will return, O Israel , says the Lord , return to me: if you will take away your stumbling blocks out of my sight, you shall not be moved.
text_la: Si reverteris, Israël, ait Dominus, ad me convertere : si abstuleris offendicula tua a facie mea, non commoveberis.
text_pt: Se voltares, ó Israel, diz o SENHOR, volta para mim; e se tirares as tuas abominações de diante de mim, não andarás mais vagueando,
text_el: ἐὰν ἐπιστραφῇ Ισραηλ λέγει κύριος πρός με ἐπιστραφήσεται ἐὰν περιέλῃ τὰ βδελύγματα αὐτοῦ ἐκ στόματος αὐτοῦ καὶ ἀπὸ τοῦ προσώπου μου εὐλαβηθῇ

text_en: And you shall swear : As the Lord lives, in truth , and in judgment, and in justice : and the Gentiles shall bless him, and shall praise him.
text_la: Et jurabis : Vivit Dominus in veritate, et in judicio, et in justitia : et benedicent eum gentes, ipsumque laudabunt.
text_pt: E jurarás: Vive o Senhor na verdade, no juízo e na justiça; e nele se bendirão as nações, e nele se gloriarão.
text_el: καὶ ὀμόσῃ ζῇ κύριος μετὰ ἀληθείας καὶ ἐν κρίσει καὶ ἐν δικαιοσύνῃ καὶ εὐλογήσουσιν ἐν αὐτῇ ἔθνη καὶ ἐν αὐτῷ αἰνέσουσιν τῷ θεῷ ἐν Ιερουσαλημ

text_en: For thus says the Lord to the men of Juda and Jerusalem : Break up anew your fallow ground, and sow not upon thorns:
text_la: Hæc enim dicit Dominus viro Juda et Jerusalem : Novate vobis novale, et nolite serere super spinas.
text_pt: Porque assim diz o Senhor aos homens de Judá e a Jerusalém: Preparai para vós o campo de lavoura, e não semeeis entre espinhos.
text_el: ὅτι τάδε λέγει κύριος τοῖς ἀνδράσιν Ιουδα καὶ τοῖς κατοικοῦσιν Ιερουσαλημ νεώσατε ἑαυτοῖς νεώματα καὶ μὴ σπείρητε ἐπ' ἀκάνθαις

text_en: Be circumcised to the Lord , and take away the foreskins of your hearts, you men of Juda , and you inhabitants of Jerusalem : lest my indignation come forth like fire, and burn, and there be none that can quench it because of the wickedness of your thoughts.
text_la: Circumcidimini Domino, et auferte præputia cordium vestrorum, viri Juda, et habitatores Jerusalem : ne forte egrediatur ut ignis indignatio mea, et succendatur, et non sit qui extinguat, propter malitiam cogitationum vestrarum.
text_pt: Circuncidai-vos ao Senhor, e tirai os prepúcios do vosso coração, ó homens de Judá e habitantes de Jerusalém, para que o meu furor não venha a sair como fogo, e arda de modo que não haja quem o apague, por causa da malícia das vossas obras.
text_el: περιτμήθητε τῷ θεῷ ὑμῶν καὶ περιτέμεσθε τὴν σκληροκαρδίαν ὑμῶν ἄνδρες Ιουδα καὶ οἱ κατοικοῦντες Ιερουσαλημ μὴ ἐξέλθῃ ὡς πῦρ ὁ θυμός μου καὶ ἐκκαυθήσεται καὶ οὐκ ἔσται ὁ σβέσων ἀπὸ προσώπου πονηρίας ἐπιτηδευμάτων ὑμῶν

text_en: Declare in Juda , and make it heard in Jerusalem : speak, and sound with the trumpet in the land: cry aloud, and say: Assemble yourselves, and let us go into strong cities.
text_la: Annuntiate in Juda, et in Jerusalem auditum facite : loquimini, et canite tuba in terra, clamate fortiter, et dicite : Congregamini, et ingrediamur civitates munitas.
text_pt: Anunciai em Judá, e fazei ouvir em Jerusalém, e dizei: Tocai a trombeta na terra, gritai em alta voz, dizendo: Ajuntai-vos, e entremos nas cidades fortificadas.
text_el: ἀναγγείλατε ἐν τῷ Ιουδα καὶ ἀκουσθήτω ἐν Ιερουσαλημ εἴπατε σημάνατε ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς σάλπιγγι καὶ κεκράξατε μέγα εἴπατε συνάχθητε καὶ εἰσέλθωμεν εἰς τὰς πόλεις τὰς τειχήρεις

text_en: Set up the standard in Sion. Strengthen yourselves, stay not: for I bring evil from the north, and great destruction.
text_la: Levate signum in Sion; confortamini, nolite stare : quia malum ego adduco ab aquilone, et contritionem magnam.
text_pt: Arvorai a bandeira rumo a Sião, fugi, não vos detenhais; porque eu trago do norte um mal, e uma grande destruição.
text_el: ἀναλαβόντες φεύγετε εἰς Σιων σπεύσατε μὴ στῆτε ὅτι κακὰ ἐγὼ ἐπάγω ἀπὸ βορρᾶ καὶ συντριβὴν μεγάλην

text_en: The lion has come up out of his den, and the robber of nations has roused himself: he has come forth out of his place, to make your land desolate: your cities shall be laid waste, remaining without an inhabitant.
text_la: Ascendit leo de cubili suo, et prædo gentium se levavit : egressus est de loco suo ut ponat terram tuam in solitudinem : civitates tuæ vastabuntur, remanentes absque habitatore.
text_pt: Já um leão subiu da sua ramada, e um destruidor dos gentios; ele já partiu, e saiu do seu lugar para fazer da tua terra uma desolação, a fim de que as tuas cidades sejam destruídas, e ninguém habite nelas.
text_el: ἀνέβη λέων ἐκ τῆς μάνδρας αὐτοῦ ἐξολεθρεύων ἔθνη ἐξῆρεν καὶ ἐξῆλθεν ἐκ τοῦ τόπου αὐτοῦ τοῦ θεῖναι τὴν γῆν εἰς ἐρήμωσιν καὶ πόλεις καθαιρεθήσονται παρὰ τὸ μὴ κατοικεῖσθαι αὐτάς

text_en: For this gird yourselves with haircloth, lament and howl: for the fierce anger of the Lord is not turned away from us.
text_la: Super hoc accingite vos ciliciis; plangite, et ululate : quia non est aversa ira furoris Domini a nobis.
text_pt: Por isto cingi-vos de sacos, lamentai, e uivai, porque o ardor da ira do Senhor não se desviou de nós.
text_el: ἐπὶ τούτοις περιζώσασθε σάκκους καὶ κόπτεσθε καὶ ἀλαλάξατε διότι οὐκ ἀπεστράφη ὁ θυμὸς κυρίου ἀφ' ὑμῶν

text_en: And it shall come to pass in that day, says the Lord : That the heart of the king shall perish, and the heart of the princes: and the priests shall be astonished, and the prophets shall be amazed.
text_la: Et erit in die illa, dicit Dominus : peribit cor regis, et cor principum, et obstupescent sacerdotes, et prophetæ consternabuntur.
text_pt: E sucederá naquele tempo, diz o Senhor, que se desfará o coração do rei e o coração dos príncipes; e os sacerdotes pasmarão, e os profetas se maravilharão.
text_el: καὶ ἔσται ἐν ἐκείνῃ τῇ ἡμέρᾳ λέγει κύριος ἀπολεῖται ἡ καρδία τοῦ βασιλέως καὶ ἡ καρδία τῶν ἀρχόντων καὶ οἱ ἱερεῖς ἐκστήσονται καὶ οἱ προφῆται θαυμάσονται

text_en: And I said: Alas, alas, alas, O Lord God , have you then deceived this people and Jerusalem , saying: You shall have peace: and behold the sword reaches even to the soul ?
text_la: Et dixi : Heu! heu! heu! Domine Deus, ergone decepisti populum istum et Jerusalem, dicens : Pax erit vobis : et ecce pervenit gladius usque ad animam?
text_pt: Então disse eu: Ah, Senhor DEUS! Verdadeiramente enganaste grandemente a este povo e a Jerusalém, dizendo: Tereis paz; pois a espada penetra-lhe até à alma.
text_el: καὶ εἶπα ὦ δέσποτα κύριε ἄρα γε ἀπατῶν ἠπάτησας τὸν λαὸν τοῦτον καὶ τὴν Ιερουσαλημ λέγων εἰρήνη ἔσται ὑμῖν καὶ ἰδοὺ ἥψατο ἡ μάχαιρα ἕως τῆς ψυχῆς αὐτῶν

text_en: At that time it shall be said to this people, and to Jerusalem : A burning wind is in the ways that are in the desert of the way of the daughter of my people, not to fan, nor to cleanse.
text_la: In tempore illo dicetur populo huic et Jerusalem : Ventus urens in viis quæ sunt in deserto viæ filiæ populi mei, non ad ventilandum et ad purgandum.
text_pt: Naquele tempo se dirá a este povo e a Jerusalém: Um vento seco das alturas do deserto veio ao caminho da filha do meu povo; não para padejar, nem para limpar;
text_el: ἐν τῷ καιρῷ ἐκείνῳ ἐροῦσιν τῷ λαῷ τούτῳ καὶ τῇ Ιερουσαλημ πνεῦμα πλανήσεως ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ ὁδὸς τῆς θυγατρὸς τοῦ λαοῦ μου οὐκ εἰς καθαρὸν οὐδ' εἰς ἅγιον

text_en: A full wind from these places shall come to me: and now I will speak my judgments with them.
text_la: Spiritus plenus ex his veniet mihi, et nunc ego loquar judicia mea cum eis.
text_pt: Mas um vento mais veemente virá da minha parte; agora também eu pronunciarei juízos contra eles.
text_el: πνεῦμα πληρώσεως ἥξει μοι νῦν δὲ ἐγὼ λαλῶ κρίματα πρὸς αὐτούς

text_en: Behold he shall come up as a cloud, and his chariots as a tempest: his horses are swifter than eagles: woe unto us, for we are laid waste.
text_la: Ecce quasi nubes ascendet, et quasi tempestas currus ejus : velociores aquilis equi illius. Væ nobis, quoniam vastati sumus.
text_pt: Eis que virá subindo como nuvens e os seus carros como a tormenta; os seus cavalos serão mais ligeiros do que as águias; ai de nós, que somos assolados!
text_el: ἰδοὺ ὡς νεφέλη ἀναβήσεται καὶ ὡς καταιγὶς τὰ ἅρματα αὐτοῦ κουφότεροι ἀετῶν οἱ ἵπποι αὐτοῦ οὐαὶ ἡμῖν ὅτι ταλαιπωροῦμεν

text_en: Wash your heart from wickedness , O Jerusalem , that you may be saved: how long shall hurtful thoughts abide in you?
text_la: Lava a malitia cor tuum, Jerusalem, ut salva fias : usquequo morabuntur in te cogitationes noxiæ?
text_pt: Lava o teu coração da malícia, ó Jerusalém, para que sejas salva; até quando permanecerão no meio de ti os pensamentos da tua iniqüidade?
text_el: ἀπόπλυνε ἀπὸ κακίας τὴν καρδίαν σου Ιερουσαλημ ἵνα σωθῇς ἕως πότε ὑπάρξουσιν ἐν σοὶ διαλογισμοὶ πόνων σου

text_en: For a voice of one declaring from Dan , and giving notice of the idol from mount Ephraim.
text_la: Vox enim annuntiantis a Dan, et notum facientis idolum de monte Ephraim.
text_pt: Porque uma voz anuncia desde Dã, e faz ouvir a calamidade desde o monte de Efraim.
text_el: διότι φωνὴ ἀναγγέλλοντος ἐκ Δαν ἥξει καὶ ἀκουσθήσεται πόνος ἐξ ὄρους Εφραιμ

text_en: Say to the nations: Behold it is heard in Jerusalem , that guards are coming from a far country, and give out their voice against the cities of Juda .
text_la: Dicite gentibus : Ecce auditum est in Jerusalem custodes venire de terra longinqua, et dare super civitates Juda vocem suam :
text_pt: Lembrai isto às nações; fazei ouvir contra Jerusalém, que vigias vêm de uma terra remota, e levantarão a sua voz contra as cidades de Judá.
text_el: ἀναμνήσατε ἔθνη ἰδοὺ ἥκασιν ἀναγγείλατε ἐν Ιερουσαλημ συστροφαὶ ἔρχονται ἐκ γῆς μακρόθεν καὶ ἔδωκαν ἐπὶ τὰς πόλεις Ιουδα φωνὴν αὐτῶν

text_en: They are set round about her, as keepers of fields: because she has provoked me to wrath , says the Lord .
text_la: quasi custodes agrorum facti sunt super eam in gyro, quia me ad iracundiam provocavit, dicit Dominus.
text_pt: Como os guardas de um campo, estão contra ela ao redor; porquanto ela se rebelou contra mim, diz o Senhor.
text_el: ὡς φυλάσσοντες ἀγρὸν ἐγένοντο ἐπ' αὐτὴν κύκλῳ ὅτι ἐμοῦ ἠμέλησας λέγει κύριος

text_en: Your ways, and your devices have brought these things upon you: this is your wickedness , because it is bitter, because it has touched your heart.
text_la: Viæ tuæ et cogitationes tuæ fecerunt hæc tibi : ista malitia tua, quia amara, quia tetigit cor tuum.
text_pt: O teu caminho e as tuas obras te fizeram estas coisas; esta é a tua maldade, e amargosa é, que te chega até ao coração.
text_el: αἱ ὁδοί σου καὶ τὰ ἐπιτηδεύματά σου ἐποίησαν ταῦτά σοι αὕτη ἡ κακία σου ὅτι πικρά ὅτι ἥψατο ἕως τῆς καρδίας σου

text_en: My bowels, my bowels are in part, the senses of my heart are troubled within me, I will not hold my peace, for my soul has heard the sound of the trumpet, the cry of battle.
text_la: Ventrem meum, ventrem meum doleo; sensus cordis mei turbati sunt in me. Non tacebo, quoniam vocem buccinæ audivit anima mea, clamorem prælii.
text_pt: Ah, entranhas minhas, entranhas minhas! Estou com dores no meu coração! O meu coração se agita em mim. Não posso me calar; porque tu, ó minha alma, ouviste o som da trombeta e o alarido da guerra.
text_el: τὴν κοιλίαν μου τὴν κοιλίαν μου ἀλγῶ καὶ τὰ αἰσθητήρια τῆς καρδίας μου μαιμάσσει ἡ ψυχή μου σπαράσσεται ἡ καρδία μου οὐ σιωπήσομαι ὅτι φωνὴν σάλπιγγος ἤκουσεν ἡ ψυχή μου κραυγὴν πολέμου

text_en: Destruction upon destruction is called for, and all the earth is laid waste: my tents are destroyed on a sudden, and my pavilions in a moment.
text_la: Contritio super contritionem vocata est, et vastata est omnis terra : repente vastata sunt tabernacula mea; subito pelles meæ.
text_pt: Destruição sobre destruição se apregoa; porque já toda a terra está destruída; de repente foram destruídas as minhas tendas, e as minhas cortinas num momento.
text_el: καὶ ταλαιπωρίαν συντριμμὸν ἐπικαλεῖται ὅτι τεταλαιπώρηκεν πᾶσα ἡ γῆ ἄφνω τεταλαιπώρηκεν ἡ σκηνή διεσπάσθησαν αἱ δέρρεις μου

text_en: How long shall I see men fleeing away, how long shall I hear the sound of the trumpet?
text_la: Usquequo videbo fugientem; audiam vocem buccinæ?
text_pt: Até quando verei a bandeira, e ouvirei a voz da trombeta?
text_el: ἕως πότε ὄψομαι φεύγοντας ἀκούων φωνὴν σαλπίγγων

text_en: For my foolish people have not known me: they are foolish and senseless children: they are wise to do evil , but to do good they have no knowledge .
text_la: Quia stultus populus meus me non cognovit : filii insipientes sunt et vecordes : sapientes sunt ut faciant mala, bene autem facere nescierunt.
text_pt: Deveras o meu povo está louco, já não me conhece; são filhos néscios, e não entendidos; são sábios para fazer mal, mas não sabem fazer o bem.
text_el: διότι οἱ ἡγούμενοι τοῦ λαοῦ μου ἐμὲ οὐκ ᾔδεισαν υἱοὶ ἄφρονές εἰσιν καὶ οὐ συνετοί σοφοί εἰσιν τοῦ κακοποιῆσαι τὸ δὲ καλῶς ποιῆσαι οὐκ ἐπέγνωσαν

text_en: I beheld the earth, and lo it was void, and nothing: and the heavens , and there was no light in them.
text_la: Aspexi terram, et ecce vacua erat et nihili; et cælos, et non erat lux in eis.
text_pt: Observei a terra, e eis que era sem forma e vazia; também os céus, e não tinham a sua luz.
text_el: ἐπέβλεψα ἐπὶ τὴν γῆν καὶ ἰδοὺ οὐθέν καὶ εἰς τὸν οὐρανόν καὶ οὐκ ἦν τὰ φῶτα αὐτοῦ

text_en: I looked upon the mountains, and behold they trembled: and all the hills were troubled.
text_la: Vidi montes, et ecce movebantur : et omnes colles conturbati sunt.
text_pt: Observei os montes, e eis que estavam tremendo; e todos os outeiros estremeciam.
text_el: εἶδον τὰ ὄρη καὶ ἦν τρέμοντα καὶ πάντας τοὺς βουνοὺς ταρασσομένους

text_en: I beheld, and lo there was no man : and all the birds of the air had gone.
text_la: Intuitus sum, et non erat homo : et omne volatile cæli recessit.
text_pt: Observei, e eis que não havia homem algum; e todas as aves do céu tinham fugido.
text_el: ἐπέβλεψα καὶ ἰδοὺ οὐκ ἦν ἄνθρωπος καὶ πάντα τὰ πετεινὰ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ ἐπτοεῖτο

text_en: I looked, and behold Carmel was a wilderness : and all its cities were destroyed at the presence of the Lord , and at the presence of the wrath of his indignation.
text_la: Aspexi, et ecce Carmelus desertus, et omnes urbes ejus destructæ sunt a facie Domini, et a facie iræ furoris ejus.
text_pt: Vi também que a terra fértil era um deserto; e todas as suas cidades estavam derrubadas diante do Senhor, diante do furor da sua ira.
text_el: εἶδον καὶ ἰδοὺ ὁ Κάρμηλος ἔρημος καὶ πᾶσαι αἱ πόλεις ἐμπεπυρισμέναι πυρὶ ἀπὸ προσώπου κυρίου καὶ ἀπὸ προσώπου ὀργῆς θυμοῦ αὐτοῦ ἠφανίσθησαν

text_en: For thus says the Lord : All the land shall be desolate, but yet I will not utterly destroy.
text_la: Hæc enim dicit Dominus : Deserta erit omnis terra, sed tamen consummationem non faciam.
text_pt: Porque assim diz o Senhor: Toda esta terra será assolada; de todo, porém, não a consumirei.
text_el: τάδε λέγει κύριος ἔρημος ἔσται πᾶσα ἡ γῆ συντέλειαν δὲ οὐ μὴ ποιήσω

text_en: The Earth shall mourn, and the heavens shall lament from above: because I have spoken, I have purposed, and I have not repented, neither am I turned away from it.
text_la: Lugebit terra, et mœrebunt cæli desuper, eo quod locutus sum. Cogitavi, et non pœnituit me, nec aversus sum ab eo.
text_pt: Por isto lamentará a terra, e os céus em cima se enegrecerão; porquanto assim o disse, assim o propus, e não me arrependi nem me desviarei disso.
text_el: ἐπὶ τούτοις πενθείτω ἡ γῆ καὶ συσκοτασάτω ὁ οὐρανὸς ἄνωθεν διότι ἐλάλησα καὶ οὐ μετανοήσω ὥρμησα καὶ οὐκ ἀποστρέψω ἀπ' αὐτῆς

text_en: At the voice of the horsemen, and the archers, all the city is fled away: they have entered into thickets and climbed up the rocks: all the cities are forsaken, and there dwells not a man in them.
text_la: A voce equitis et mittentis sagittam fugit omnis civitas : ingressi sunt ardua, et ascenderunt rupes : universæ urbes derelictæ sunt, et non habitat in eis homo.
text_pt: Ao clamor dos cavaleiros e dos flecheiros fugiram todas as cidades; entraram pelas matas e treparam pelos penhascos; todas as cidades ficaram abandonadas, e já ninguém habita nelas.
text_el: ἀπὸ φωνῆς ἱππέως καὶ ἐντεταμένου τόξου ἀνεχώρησεν πᾶσα χώρα εἰσέδυσαν εἰς τὰ σπήλαια καὶ εἰς τὰ ἄλση ἐκρύβησαν καὶ ἐπὶ τὰς πέτρας ἀνέβησαν πᾶσα πόλις ἐγκατελείφθη οὐ κατοικεῖ ἐν αὐταῖς ἄνθρωπος

text_en: But when you are spoiled what will you do? Though you clothe yourself with scarlet, though you deck yourself with ornaments of gold, and paint your eyes with stibic stone, you shall dress yourself out in vain: your lovers have despised you, they will seek your life.
text_la: Tu autem vastata, quid facies? cum vestieris te coccino, cum ornata fueris monili aureo, et pinxeris stibio oculos tuos, frustra componeris : contempserunt te amatores tui; animam tuam quærent.
text_pt: Agora, pois, que farás, ó assolada? Ainda que te vistas de carmesim, ainda que te adornes com enfeites de ouro, ainda que te pintes em volta dos teus olhos, debalde te farias bela; os amantes te desprezam, e procuram tirar-te a vida.
text_el: καὶ σὺ τί ποιήσεις ἐὰν περιβάλῃ κόκκινον καὶ κοσμήσῃ κόσμῳ χρυσῷ καὶ ἐὰν ἐγχρίσῃ στίβι τοὺς ὀφθαλμούς σου εἰς μάτην ὁ ὡραϊσμός σου ἀπώσαντό σε οἱ ἐρασταί σου τὴν ψυχήν σου ζητοῦσιν

text_en: For I have heard the voice as of a woman in travail, anguishes as of a woman in labour of a child. The voice of the daughter of Sion, dying away, spreading her hands: Woe is me, for my soul has fainted because of them that are slain.
text_la: Vocem enim quasi parturientis audivi, angustias ut puerperæ : vox filiæ Sion intermorientis, expandentisque manus suas : Væ mihi, quia defecit anima mea propter interfectos!
text_pt: Porquanto ouço uma voz, como a de uma mulher que está de parto, uma angústia como a de que está com dores de parto do primeiro filho; a voz da filha de Sião, ofegante, que estende as suas mãos, dizendo: Oh! ai de mim agora, porque já a minha alma desmaia por causa dos assassinos.
text_el: ὅτι φωνὴν ὡς ὠδινούσης ἤκουσα τοῦ στεναγμοῦ σου ὡς πρωτοτοκούσης φωνὴ θυγατρὸς Σιων ἐκλυθήσεται καὶ παρήσει τὰς χεῖρας αὐτῆς οἴμμοι ἐγώ ὅτι ἐκλείπει ἡ ψυχή μου ἐπὶ τοῖς ἀνῃρημένοις

text_en: Go about through the streets of Jerusalem , and see, and consider, and seek in the broad places thereof, if you can find a man that executes judgment, and seeks faith : and I will be merciful unto it.
text_la: Circuite vias Jerusalem, et aspicite, et considerate, et quærite in plateis ejus, an inveniatis virum facientem judicium, et quærentem fidem : et propitius ero ei.
text_pt: Dai voltas às ruas de Jerusalém, e vede agora; e informai-vos, e buscai pelas suas praças, a ver se achais alguém, ou se há homem que pratique a justiça ou busque a verdade; e eu lhe perdoarei.
text_el: περιδράμετε ἐν ταῖς ὁδοῖς Ιερουσαλημ καὶ ἴδετε καὶ γνῶτε καὶ ζητήσατε ἐν ταῖς πλατείαις αὐτῆς ἐὰν εὕρητε ἄνδρα εἰ ἔστιν ποιῶν κρίμα καὶ ζητῶν πίστιν καὶ ἵλεως ἔσομαι αὐτοῖς λέγει κύριος

text_en: And though they say: The Lord lives; this also they will swear falsely .
text_la: Quod si etiam : Vivit Dominus, dixerint, et hoc falso jurabunt.
text_pt: E ainda que digam: Vive o Senhor, de certo falsamente juram.
text_el: ζῇ κύριος λέγουσιν διὰ τοῦτο οὐκ ἐπὶ ψεύδεσιν ὀμνύουσιν

text_en: O Lord , your eyes are upon truth : you have struck them, and they have not grieved: you have bruised them, and they have refused to receive correction: they have made their faces harder than the rock, and they have refused to return.
text_la: Domine, oculi tui respiciunt fidem : percussisti eos, et non doluerunt; attrivisti eos, et renuerunt accipere disciplinam : induraverunt facies suas supra petram, et noluerunt reverti.
text_pt: Ah Senhor, porventura não atentam os teus olhos para a verdade? Feriste-os, e não lhes doeu; consumiste-os, e não quiseram receber a correção; endureceram as suas faces mais do que uma rocha; não quiseram voltar.
text_el: κύριε οἱ ὀφθαλμοί σου εἰς πίστιν ἐμαστίγωσας αὐτούς καὶ οὐκ ἐπόνεσαν συνετέλεσας αὐτούς καὶ οὐκ ἠθέλησαν δέξασθαι παιδείαν ἐστερέωσαν τὰ πρόσωπα αὐτῶν ὑπὲρ πέτραν καὶ οὐκ ἠθέλησαν ἐπιστραφῆναι

text_en: But I said: Perhaps these are poor and foolish, that know not the way of the Lord , the judgment of their God .
text_la: Ego autem dixi : Forsitan pauperes sunt et stulti, ignorantes viam Domini, judicium Dei sui.
text_pt: Eu, porém, disse: Deveras estes são pobres; são loucos, pois não sabem o caminho do Senhor, nem o juízo do seu Deus.
text_el: καὶ ἐγὼ εἶπα ἴσως πτωχοί εἰσιν διότι οὐκ ἐδυνάσθησαν ὅτι οὐκ ἔγνωσαν ὁδὸν κυρίου καὶ κρίσιν θεοῦ

text_en: I will go therefore to the great men , and will speak to them: for they have known the way of the Lord , the judgment of their God : and behold these have altogether broken the yoke more, and have burst the bonds.
text_la: Ibo igitur ad optimates, et loquar eis : ipsi enim cognoverunt viam Domini, judicium Dei sui : et ecce magis hi simul confregerunt jugum; ruperunt vincula.
text_pt: Irei aos grandes, e falarei com eles; porque eles sabem o caminho do Senhor, o juízo do seu Deus; mas estes juntamente quebraram o jugo, e romperam as ataduras.
text_el: πορεύσομαι πρὸς τοὺς ἁδροὺς καὶ λαλήσω αὐτοῖς ὅτι αὐτοὶ ἐπέγνωσαν ὁδὸν κυρίου καὶ κρίσιν θεοῦ καὶ ἰδοὺ ὁμοθυμαδὸν συνέτριψαν ζυγόν διέρρηξαν δεσμούς

text_en: Wherefore a lion out of the wood has slain them, a wolf in the evening has spoiled them, a leopard watches for their cities: every one that shall go out thence shall be taken, because their transgressions are multiplied, their rebellions are strengthened.
text_la: Idcirco percussit eos leo de silva; lupus ad vesperam vastavit eos : pardus vigilans super civitates eorum : omnis qui egressus fuerit ex eis capietur : quia multiplicatæ sunt prævaricationes eorum; confortatæ sunt aversiones eorum.
text_pt: Por isso um leão do bosque os feriu, um lobo dos desertos os assolará; um leopardo vigia contra as suas cidades; qualquer que sair delas será despedaçado; porque as suas transgressões se avolumam, multiplicaram-se as suas apostasias.
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο ἔπαισεν αὐτοὺς λέων ἐκ τοῦ δρυμοῦ καὶ λύκος ἕως τῶν οἰκιῶν ὠλέθρευσεν αὐτούς καὶ πάρδαλις ἐγρηγόρησεν ἐπὶ τὰς πόλεις αὐτῶν πάντες οἱ ἐκπορευόμενοι ἀπ' αὐτῶν θηρευθήσονται ὅτι ἐπλήθυναν ἀσεβείας αὐτῶν ἴσχυσαν ἐν ταῖς ἀποστροφαῖς αὐτῶν

text_en: How can I be merciful to you? Your children have forsaken me, and swear by them that are not gods: I fed them to the full, and they committed adultery , and rioted in the harlot's house.
text_la: Super quo propitius tibi esse potero? filii tui dereliquerunt me, et jurant in his qui non sunt dii. Saturavi eos, et mœchati sunt, et in domo meretricis luxuriabantur.
text_pt: Como, vendo isto, te perdoaria? Teus filhos me deixam a mim e juram pelos que não são deuses; quando os fartei, então adulteraram, e em casa de meretrizes se ajuntaram em bandos.
text_el: ποίᾳ τούτων ἵλεως γένωμαί σοι οἱ υἱοί σου ἐγκατέλιπόν με καὶ ὤμνυον ἐν τοῖς οὐκ οὖσιν θεοῖς καὶ ἐχόρτασα αὐτούς καὶ ἐμοιχῶντο καὶ ἐν οἴκοις πορνῶν κατέλυον

text_en: They have become as amorous horses and stallions: every one neighed after his neighbour's wife.
text_la: Equi amatores et emissarii facti sunt : unusquisque ad uxorem proximi sui hinniebat.
text_pt: Como cavalos bem fartos, levantam-se pela manhã, rinchando cada um à mulher do seu próximo.
text_el: ἵπποι θηλυμανεῖς ἐγενήθησαν ἕκαστος ἐπὶ τὴν γυναῖκα τοῦ πλησίον αὐτοῦ ἐχρεμέτιζον

text_en: Shall I not visit for these things, says the Lord ? And shall not my soul take revenge on such a nation?
text_la: Numquid super his non visitabo, dicit Dominus, et in gente tali non ulciscetur anima mea?
text_pt: Deixaria eu de castigar por estas coisas, diz o Senhor, ou não se vingaria a minha alma de uma nação como esta?
text_el: μὴ ἐπὶ τούτοις οὐκ ἐπισκέψομαι λέγει κύριος ἢ ἐν ἔθνει τοιούτῳ οὐκ ἐκδικήσει ἡ ψυχή μου

text_en: Scale the walls thereof, and throw them down, but do not utterly destroy: take away the branches thereof, because they are not the Lord's .
text_la: Ascendite muros ejus, et dissipate : consummationem autem nolite facere : auferte propagines ejus, quia non sunt Domini.
text_pt: Subi aos seus muros, e destruí-os (porém não façais uma destruição final); tirai os seus ramos, porque não são do Senhor.
text_el: ἀνάβητε ἐπὶ τοὺς προμαχῶνας αὐτῆς καὶ κατασκάψατε συντέλειαν δὲ μὴ ποιήσητε ὑπολίπεσθε τὰ ὑποστηρίγματα αὐτῆς ὅτι τοῦ κυρίου εἰσίν

text_en: For the house of Israel , and the house of Juda have greatly transgressed against me, says the Lord .
text_la: Prævaricatione enim prævaricata est in me domus Israël, et domus Juda, ait Dominus.
text_pt: Porque aleivosissimamente se houveram contra mim a casa de Israel e a casa de Judá, diz o Senhor.
text_el: ὅτι ἀθετῶν ἠθέτησεν εἰς ἐμέ λέγει κύριος οἶκος Ισραηλ καὶ οἶκος Ιουδα

text_en: They have denied the Lord , and said, It is not he: and the evil shall not come upon us: we shall not see the sword and famine.
text_la: Negaverunt Dominum, et dixerunt : Non est ipse : neque veniet super nos malum : gladium et famem non videbimus.
text_pt: Negaram ao Senhor, e disseram: Não é ele; nem mal nos sobrevirá, nem veremos espada nem fome.
text_el: ἐψεύσαντο τῷ κυρίῳ ἑαυτῶν καὶ εἶπαν οὐκ ἔστιν ταῦτα οὐχ ἥξει ἐφ' ἡμᾶς κακά καὶ μάχαιραν καὶ λιμὸν οὐκ ὀψόμεθα

text_en: The prophets have spoken in the wind, and there was no word of God in them: these things therefore shall befall them.
text_la: Prophetæ fuerunt in ventum locuti, et responsum non fuit in eis : hæc ergo evenient illis.
text_pt: E até os profetas serão como vento, porque a palavra não está com eles; assim se lhes sucederá.
text_el: οἱ προφῆται ἡμῶν ἦσαν εἰς ἄνεμον καὶ λόγος κυρίου οὐχ ὑπῆρχεν ἐν αὐτοῖς οὕτως ἔσται αὐτοῖς

text_en: Thus says the Lord the God of hosts : because you have spoken this word, behold I will make my words in your mouth as fire, and this people as wood, and it shall devour them.
text_la: Hæc dicit Dominus Deus exercituum : Quia locuti estis verbum istud, ecce ego do verba mea in ore tuo in ignem, et populum istum in ligna, et vorabit eos.
text_pt: Portanto assim diz o Senhor Deus dos Exércitos: Porquanto disseste tal palavra, eis que converterei as minhas palavras na tua boca em fogo, e a este povo em lenha, eles serão consumidos.
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο τάδε λέγει κύριος παντοκράτωρ ἀνθ' ὧν ἐλαλήσατε τὸ ῥῆμα τοῦτο ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ δέδωκα τοὺς λόγους μου εἰς τὸ στόμα σου πῦρ καὶ τὸν λαὸν τοῦτον ξύλα καὶ καταφάγεται αὐτούς

text_en: Behold I will bring upon you a nation from afar, O house of Israel , says the Lord : a strong nation, an ancient nation, a nation whose language you shall not know , nor understand what they say.
text_la: Ecce ego adducam super vos gentem de longinquo, domus Israël, ait Dominus : gentem robustam, gentem antiquam, gentem cujus ignorabis linguam, nec intelliges quid loquatur.
text_pt: Eis que trarei sobre vós uma nação de longe, ó casa de Israel, diz o Senhor; é uma nação robusta, é uma nação antiqüíssima, uma nação cuja língua ignorarás, e não entenderás o que ela falar.
text_el: ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ ἐπάγω ἐφ' ὑμᾶς ἔθνος πόρρωθεν οἶκος Ισραηλ λέγει κύριος ἔθνος οὗ οὐκ ἀκούσῃ τῆς φωνῆς τῆς γλώσσης αὐτοῦ

text_en: Their quiver is as an open sepulchre, they are all valiant .
text_la: Pharetra ejus quasi sepulchrum patens; universi fortes.
text_pt: A sua aljava é como uma sepultura aberta; todos eles são poderosos.
text_el: πάντες ἰσχυροὶ

text_en: And they shall eat up your corn, and your bread: they shall devour your sons, and your daughters: they shall eat up your flocks, and your herds: they shall eat your vineyards, and your figs: and with the sword they shall destroy your strong cities, wherein you trust.
text_la: Et comedet segetes tuas et panem tuum; devorabit filios tuos et filias tuas; comedet gregem tuum et armenta tua; comedet vineam tuam et ficum tuam : et conteret urbes munitas tuas, in quibus tu habes fiduciam, gladio.
text_pt: E comerão a tua sega e o teu pão, que teus filhos e tuas filhas haviam de comer; comerão as tuas ovelhas e as tuas vacas; comerão a tua vide e a tua figueira; as tuas cidades fortificadas, em que confiavas, abatê-las-ão à espada.
text_el: καὶ κατέδονται τὸν θερισμὸν ὑμῶν καὶ τοὺς ἄρτους ὑμῶν καὶ κατέδονται τοὺς υἱοὺς ὑμῶν καὶ τὰς θυγατέρας ὑμῶν καὶ κατέδονται τὰ πρόβατα ὑμῶν καὶ τοὺς μόσχους ὑμῶν καὶ κατέδονται τοὺς ἀμπελῶνας ὑμῶν καὶ τοὺς συκῶνας ὑμῶν καὶ τοὺς ἐλαιῶνας ὑμῶν καὶ ἀλοήσουσιν τὰς πόλεις τὰς ὀχυρὰς ὑμῶν ἐφ' αἷς ὑμεῖς πεποίθατε ἐπ' αὐταῖς ἐν ῥομφαίᾳ

text_en: Nevertheless in those days, says the Lord , I will not bring you to utter destruction.
text_la: Verumtamen in diebus illis, ait Dominus, non faciam vos in consummationem.
text_pt: Contudo, ainda naqueles dias, diz o Senhor, não farei de vós uma destruição final.
text_el: καὶ ἔσται ἐν ταῖς ἡμέραις ἐκείναις λέγει κύριος ὁ θεός σου οὐ μὴ ποιήσω ὑμᾶς εἰς συντέλειαν

text_en: And if you shall say: Why has the Lord our God done all these things to us? You shall say to them: As you have forsaken me, and served a strange god in your own land, so shall you serve strangers in a land that is not your own.
text_la: Quod si dixeritis : Quare fecit nobis Dominus Deus noster hæc omnia? dices ad eos : Sicut dereliquistis me, et servistis deo alieno in terra vestra, sic servietis alienis in terra non vestra.
text_pt: E sucederá que, quando disserdes: Por que nos fez o Senhor nosso Deus todas estas coisas? Então lhes dirás: Como vós me deixastes, e servistes a deuses estranhos na vossa terra, assim servireis a estrangeiros, em terra que não é vossa.
text_el: καὶ ἔσται ὅταν εἴπητε τίνος ἕνεκεν ἐποίησεν κύριος ὁ θεὸς ἡμῶν ἡμῖν ἅπαντα ταῦτα καὶ ἐρεῖς αὐτοῖς ἀνθ' ὧν ἐδουλεύσατε θεοῖς ἀλλοτρίοις ἐν τῇ γῇ ὑμῶν οὕτως δουλεύσετε ἀλλοτρίοις ἐν γῇ οὐχ ὑμῶν

text_en: Declare this to the house of Jacob , and publish it in Juda , saying:
text_la: Annuntiate hoc domui Jacob, et auditum facite in Juda, dicentes :
text_pt: Anunciai isto na casa de Jacó, e fazei-o ouvir em Judá, dizendo:
text_el: ἀναγγείλατε ταῦτα εἰς τὸν οἶκον Ιακωβ καὶ ἀκουσθήτω ἐν τῷ Ιουδα

text_en: Hear, O foolish people, and without understanding: who have eyes, and see not: and ears, and hear not.
text_la: Audi, popule stulte, qui non habes cor : qui habentes oculos, non videtis; et aures, et non auditis.
text_pt: Ouvi agora isto, ó povo insensato, e sem coração, que tendes olhos e não vedes, que tendes ouvidos e não ouvis.
text_el: ἀκούσατε δὴ ταῦτα λαὸς μωρὸς καὶ ἀκάρδιος ὀφθαλμοὶ αὐτοῖς καὶ οὐ βλέπουσιν ὦτα αὐτοῖς καὶ οὐκ ἀκούουσιν

text_en: Will not you then fear me, says the Lord : and will you not repent at my presence? I have set the sand a bound for the sea, an everlasting ordinance, which it shall not pass over: and the waves thereof shall toss themselves, and shall not prevail: they shall swell, and shall not pass over it.
text_la: Me ergo non timebitis, ait Dominus, et a facie mea non dolebitis? qui posui arenam terminum mari, præceptum sempiternum quod non præteribit : et commovebuntur, et non poterunt; et intumescent fluctus ejus, et non transibunt illud.
text_pt: Porventura não me temereis a mim? diz o Senhor; não temereis diante de mim, que pus a areia por limite ao mar, por ordenança eterna, que ele não traspassará? Ainda que se levantem as suas ondas, não prevalecerão; ainda que bramem, não a traspassarão.
