text_el: μὴ ἐμὲ οὐ φοβηθήσεσθε λέγει κύριος ἢ ἀπὸ προσώπου μου οὐκ εὐλαβηθήσεσθε τὸν τάξαντα ἄμμον ὅριον τῇ θαλάσσῃ πρόσταγμα αἰώνιον καὶ οὐχ ὑπερβήσεται αὐτό καὶ ταραχθήσεται καὶ οὐ δυνήσεται καὶ ἠχήσουσιν τὰ κύματα αὐτῆς καὶ οὐχ ὑπερβήσεται αὐτό

text_en: But the heart of this people has become hard of belief and provoking, they are revolted and gone away.
text_la: Populo autem huic factum est cor incredulum et exasperans : recesserunt, et abierunt.
text_pt: Mas este povo é de coração rebelde e pertinaz: rebelaram-se e foram-se.
text_el: τῷ δὲ λαῷ τούτῳ ἐγενήθη καρδία ἀνήκοος καὶ ἀπειθής καὶ ἐξέκλιναν καὶ ἀπήλθοσαν

text_en: And they have not said in their heart: Let us fear the Lord our God , who gives us the early and the latter rain in due season: who preserves for us the fullness of the yearly harvest.
text_la: Et non dixerunt in corde suo : Metuamus Dominum Deum nostrum, qui dat nobis pluviam temporaneam et serotinam in tempore suo, plenitudinem annuæ messis custodientem nobis.
text_pt: E não dizem no seu coração: Temamos agora ao Senhor nosso Deus, que dá chuva, a temporã e a tardia, ao seu tempo; e nos conserva as semanas determinadas da sega.
text_el: καὶ οὐκ εἶπον ἐν τῇ καρδίᾳ αὐτῶν φοβηθῶμεν δὴ κύριον τὸν θεὸν ἡμῶν τὸν διδόντα ἡμῖν ὑετὸν πρόιμον καὶ ὄψιμον κατὰ καιρὸν πληρώσεως προστάγματος θερισμοῦ καὶ ἐφύλαξεν ἡμῖν

text_en: Your iniquities have turned these things away, and your sins have withholden good things from you.
text_la: Iniquitates vestræ declinaverunt hæc, et peccata vestra prohibuerunt bonum a vobis :
text_pt: As vossas iniqüidades desviam estas coisas, e os vossos pecados apartam de vós o bem.
text_el: αἱ ἀνομίαι ὑμῶν ἐξέκλιναν ταῦτα καὶ αἱ ἁμαρτίαι ὑμῶν ἀπέστησαν τὰ ἀγαθὰ ἀφ' ὑμῶν

text_en: For among my people are found wicked men , that lie in wait as fowlers, setting snares and traps to catch men .
text_la: quia inventi sunt in populo meo impii insidiantes quasi aucupes, laqueos ponentes et pedicas ad capiendos viros.
text_pt: Porque ímpios se acham entre o meu povo; andam espiando, como quem arma laços; põem armadilhas, com que prendem os homens.
text_el: ὅτι εὑρέθησαν ἐν τῷ λαῷ μου ἀσεβεῖς καὶ παγίδας ἔστησαν διαφθεῖραι ἄνδρας καὶ συνελαμβάνοσαν

text_en: As a net is full of birds, so their houses are full of deceit : therefore are they become great and enriched.
text_la: Sicut decipula plena avibus, sic domus eorum plenæ dolo : ideo magnificati sunt et ditati.
text_pt: Como uma gaiola está cheia de pássaros, assim as suas casas estão cheias de engano; por isso se engrandeceram, e enriqueceram;
text_el: ὡς παγὶς ἐφεσταμένη πλήρης πετεινῶν οὕτως οἱ οἶκοι αὐτῶν πλήρεις δόλου διὰ τοῦτο ἐμεγαλύνθησαν καὶ ἐπλούτησαν

text_en: They are grown gross and fat: and have most wickedly transgressed my words. They have not judged the cause of the widow , they have not managed the cause of the fatherless , and they have not judged the judgment of the poor.
text_la: Incrassati sunt et impinguati, et præterierunt sermones meos pessime. Causam viduæ non judicaverunt, causam pupilli non direxerunt, et judicium pauperum non judicaverunt.
text_pt: Engordam-se, estão nédios, e ultrapassam até os feitos dos malignos; não julgam a causa do órfão; todavia prosperam; nem julgam o direito dos necessitados.
text_el: καὶ παρέβησαν κρίσιν οὐκ ἔκριναν κρίσιν ὀρφανοῦ καὶ κρίσιν χήρας οὐκ ἐκρίνοσαν

text_en: Shall I not visit for these things, says the Lord ? Or shall not my soul take revenge on such a nation?
text_la: Numquid super his non visitabo, dicit Dominus, aut super gentem hujuscemodi non ulciscetur anima mea?
text_pt: Porventura não castigaria eu por causa destas coisas? diz o Senhor; não me vingaria eu de uma nação como esta?
text_el: μὴ ἐπὶ τούτοις οὐκ ἐπισκέψομαι λέγει κύριος ἢ ἐν ἔθνει τῷ τοιούτῳ οὐκ ἐκδικήσει ἡ ψυχή μου

text_en: Astonishing and wonderful things have been done in the land.
text_la: Stupor et mirabilia facta sunt in terra :
text_pt: Coisa espantosa e horrenda se anda fazendo na terra.
text_el: ἔκστασις καὶ φρικτὰ ἐγενήθη ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς

text_en: The prophets prophesied falsehood, and the priests clapped their hands: and my people loved such things: what then shall be done in the end thereof?
text_la: prophetæ prophetabant mendacium, et sacerdotes applaudebant manibus suis, et populus meus dilexit talia. Quid igitur fiet in novissimo ejus?
text_pt: Os profetas profetizam falsamente, e os sacerdotes dominam pelas mãos deles, e o meu povo assim o deseja; mas que fareis ao fim disto?
text_el: οἱ προφῆται προφητεύουσιν ἄδικα καὶ οἱ ἱερεῖς ἐπεκρότησαν ταῖς χερσὶν αὐτῶν καὶ ὁ λαός μου ἠγάπησεν οὕτως καὶ τί ποιήσετε εἰς τὰ μετὰ ταῦτα

text_en: Strengthen yourselves, you sons of Benjamin , in the midst of Jerusalem , and sound the trumpet in Thecua, and set up the standard over Bethacarem: for evil is seen out of the north, and a great destruction.
text_la: Confortamini, filii Benjamin, in medio Jerusalem : et in Thecua clangite buccina, et super Bethacarem levate vexillum, quia malum visum est ab aquilone, et contritio magna.
text_pt: Fugi para salvação vossa, filhos de Benjamim, do meio de Jerusalém; e tocai a buzina em Tecoa, e levantai um sinal de fogo sobre Bete-Haquerém; porque do lado norte surge um mal e uma grande destruição.
text_el: ἐνισχύσατε υἱοὶ Βενιαμιν ἐκ μέσου τῆς Ιερουσαλημ καὶ ἐν Θεκουε σημάνατε σάλπιγγι καὶ ὑπὲρ Βαιθαχαρμα ἄρατε σημεῖον ὅτι κακὰ ἐκκέκυφεν ἀπὸ βορρᾶ καὶ συντριβὴ μεγάλη γίνεται

text_en: I have likened the daughter of Sion to a beautiful and delicate woman .
text_la: Speciosæ et delicatæ assimilavi filiam Sion.
text_pt: À formosa e delicada assemelhei a filha de Sião.
text_el: καὶ ἀφαιρεθήσεται τὸ ὕψος σου θύγατερ Σιων

text_en: The shepherds shall come to her with their flocks: they have pitched their tents against her round about: every one shall feed them that are under his hand.
text_la: Ad eam venient pastores et greges eorum; fixerunt in ea tentoria in circuitu : pascet unusquisque eos qui sub manu sua sunt.
text_pt: Mas contra ela virão pastores com os seus rebanhos; levantarão contra ela tendas em redor, e cada um apascentará no seu lugar.
text_el: εἰς αὐτὴν ἥξουσιν ποιμένες καὶ τὰ ποίμνια αὐτῶν καὶ πήξουσιν ἐπ' αὐτὴν σκηνὰς κύκλῳ καὶ ποιμανοῦσιν ἕκαστος τῇ χειρὶ αὐτοῦ

text_en: Prepare war against her: arise, and let us go up at midday: woe unto us, for the day is declined, for the shadows of the evening are grown longer.
text_la: Sanctificate super eam bellum : consurgite, et ascendamus in meridie : væ nobis, quia declinavit dies; quia longiores factæ sunt umbræ vesperi!
text_pt: Preparai a guerra contra ela, levantai-vos, e subamos ao pino do meio-dia. Ai de nós! Já declina o dia, já se vão estendendo as sombras da tarde.
text_el: παρασκευάσασθε ἐπ' αὐτὴν εἰς πόλεμον ἀνάστητε καὶ ἀναβῶμεν ἐπ' αὐτὴν μεσημβρίας οὐαὶ ἡμῖν ὅτι κέκλικεν ἡ ἡμέρα ὅτι ἐκλείπουσιν αἱ σκιαὶ τῆς ἑσπέρας

text_en: Arise, and let us go up in the night, and destroy her houses.
text_la: Surgite, et ascendamus in nocte, et dissipemus domus ejus.
text_pt: Levantai-vos, e subamos de noite, e destruamos os seus palácios.
text_el: ἀνάστητε καὶ ἀναβῶμεν ἐν τῇ νυκτὶ καὶ διαφθείρωμεν τὰ θεμέλια αὐτῆς

text_en: For thus says the Lord of hosts : Hew down her trees, cast up a trench about Jerusalem : this is the city to be visited, all oppression is in the midst of her.
text_la: Quia hæc dicit Dominus exercituum : Cædite lignum ejus, et fundite circa Jerusalem aggerem. Hæc est civitas visitationis : omnis calumnia in medio ejus.
text_pt: Porque assim diz o SENHOR dos Exércitos: Cortai árvores, e levantai trincheiras contra Jerusalém; esta é a cidade que há de ser castigada, só opressão há no meio dela.
text_el: ὅτι τάδε λέγει κύριος ἔκκοψον τὰ ξύλα αὐτῆς ἔκχεον ἐπὶ Ιερουσαλημ δύναμιν ὦ πόλις ψευδής ὅλη καταδυναστεία ἐν αὐτῇ

text_en: As a cistern makes its water cold, so has she made her wickedness cold: violence and spoil shall be heard in her, infirmity and stripes are continually before me.
text_la: Sicut frigidam fecit cisterna aquam suam, sic frigidam fecit malitiam suam. Iniquitas et vastitas audietur in ea, coram me semper infirmitas et plaga.
text_pt: Como a fonte produz as suas águas, assim ela produz a sua malícia; violência e estrago se ouvem nela; enfermidade e feridas há diante de mim continuamente.
text_el: ὡς ψύχει λάκκος ὕδωρ οὕτως ψύχει κακία αὐτῆς ἀσέβεια καὶ ταλαιπωρία ἀκουσθήσεται ἐν αὐτῇ ἐπὶ πρόσωπον αὐτῆς διὰ παντός πόνῳ καὶ μάστιγι

text_en: Be instructed, O Jerusalem , lest my soul depart from you, lest I make you desolate, a land uninhabited.
text_la: Erudire, Jerusalem, ne forte recedat anima mea a te; ne forte ponam te desertam, terram inhabitabilem.
text_pt: Corrige-te, ó Jerusalém, para que a minha alma não se aparte de ti, para que não te torne em assolação e terra não habitada.
text_el: παιδευθήσῃ Ιερουσαλημ μὴ ἀποστῇ ἡ ψυχή μου ἀπὸ σοῦ μὴ ποιήσω σε ἄβατον γῆν ἥτις οὐ κατοικηθήσεται

text_en: Thus says the Lord of hosts : They shall gather the remains of Israel , as in a vine, even to one cluster: turn back your hand, as a grapegatherer into the basket.
text_la: Hæc dicit Dominus exercituum : Usque ad racemum colligent quasi in vinea reliquias Israël. Converte manum tuam quasi vindemiator ad cartallum.
text_pt: Assim diz o Senhor dos Exércitos: Diligentemente respigarão os resíduos de Israel como uma vinha; torna a tua mão, como o vindimador, aos cestos.
text_el: ὅτι τάδε λέγει κύριος καλαμᾶσθε καλαμᾶσθε ὡς ἄμπελον τὰ κατάλοιπα τοῦ Ισραηλ ἐπιστρέψατε ὡς ὁ τρυγῶν ἐπὶ τὸν κάρταλλον αὐτοῦ

text_en: To whom shall I speak? And to whom shall I testify, that he may hear? Behold, their ears are uncircumcised, and they cannot hear: behold the word of the Lord has become unto them a reproach: and they will not receive it.
text_la: Cui loquar, et quem contestabor ut audiat? ecce incircumcisæ aures eorum, et audire non possunt : ecce verbum Domini factum est eis in opprobrium, et non suscipient illud.
text_pt: A quem falarei e testemunharei, para que ouça? Eis que os seus ouvidos estão incircuncisos, e não podem ouvir; eis que a palavra do Senhor é para eles coisa vergonhosa, e não gostam dela.
text_el: πρὸς τίνα λαλήσω καὶ διαμαρτύρωμαι καὶ ἀκούσεται ἰδοὺ ἀπερίτμητα τὰ ὦτα αὐτῶν καὶ οὐ δύνανται ἀκούειν ἰδοὺ τὸ ῥῆμα κυρίου ἐγένετο αὐτοῖς εἰς ὀνειδισμόν οὐ μὴ βουληθῶσιν αὐτὸ ἀκοῦσαι

text_en: Therefore am I full of the fury of the Lord , I am weary with holding in: pour it out upon the child abroad, and upon the council of the young men together: for man and woman shall be taken, the ancient and he that is full of days.
text_la: Idcirco furore Domini plenus sum; laboravi sustinens. Effunde super parvulum foris, et super consilium juvenum simul : vir enim cum muliere capietur; senex cum pleno dierum.
text_pt: Por isso estou cheio do furor do Senhor; estou cansado de o conter; derramá-lo-ei sobre os meninos pelas ruas e na reunião de todos os jovens; porque até o marido com a mulher serão presos, e o velho com o que está cheio de dias.
text_el: καὶ τὸν θυμόν μου ἔπλησα καὶ ἐπέσχον καὶ οὐ συνετέλεσα αὐτούς ἐκχεῶ ἐπὶ νήπια ἔξωθεν καὶ ἐπὶ συναγωγὴν νεανίσκων ἅμα ὅτι ἀνὴρ καὶ γυνὴ συλλημφθήσονται πρεσβύτερος μετὰ πλήρους ἡμερῶν

text_en: And their houses shall be turned over to others, with their lands and their wives together: for I will stretch forth my hand upon the inhabitants of the land, says the Lord .
text_la: Et transibunt domus eorum ad alteros, agri et uxores pariter, quia extendam manum meam super habitantes terram, dicit Dominus :
text_pt: E as suas casas passarão a outros, como também as suas herdades e as suas mulheres juntamente; porque estenderei a minha mão contra os habitantes desta terra, diz o Senhor.
text_el: καὶ μεταστραφήσονται αἱ οἰκίαι αὐτῶν εἰς ἑτέρους ἀγροὶ καὶ αἱ γυναῖκες αὐτῶν ἐπὶ τὸ αὐτό ὅτι ἐκτενῶ τὴν χεῖρά μου ἐπὶ τοὺς κατοικοῦντας τὴν γῆν ταύτην λέγει κύριος

text_en: For from the least of them even to the greatest, all are given to covetousness : and from the prophet even to the priest , all are guilty of deceit .
text_la: a minore quippe usque ad majorem omnes avaritiæ student, et a propheta usque ad sacerdotem cuncti faciunt dolum.
text_pt: Porque desde o menor deles até ao maior, cada um se dá à avareza; e desde o profeta até ao sacerdote, cada um usa de falsidade.
text_el: ὅτι ἀπὸ μικροῦ αὐτῶν καὶ ἕως μεγάλου πάντες συνετελέσαντο ἄνομα ἀπὸ ἱερέως καὶ ἕως ψευδοπροφήτου πάντες ἐποίησαν ψευδῆ

text_en: And they healed the breach of the daughter of my people disgracefully, saying: Peace, peace: and there was no peace.
text_la: Et curabant contritionem filiæ populi mei cum ignominia, dicentes : Pax, pax! et non erat pax.
text_pt: E curam superficialmente a ferida da filha do meu povo, dizendo: Paz, paz; quando não há paz.
text_el: καὶ ἰῶντο τὸ σύντριμμα τοῦ λαοῦ μου ἐξουθενοῦντες καὶ λέγοντες εἰρήνη εἰρήνη καὶ ποῦ ἐστιν εἰρήνη

text_en: They were confounded, because they committed abomination: yea, rather they were not confounded with confusion, and they knew not how to blush: wherefore they shall fall among them that fall: in the time of their visitation they shall fall down, says the Lord .
text_la: Confusi sunt, quia abominationem fecerunt : quin potius confusione non sunt confusi, et erubescere nescierunt. Quam ob rem cadent inter ruentes : in tempore visitationis suæ corruent, dicit Dominus.
text_pt: Porventura envergonham-se de cometer abominação? Pelo contrário, de maneira nenhuma se envergonham, nem tampouco sabem que coisa é envergonhar-se; portanto cairão entre os que caem; no tempo em que eu os visitar, tropeçarão, diz o Senhor.
text_el: κατῃσχύνθησαν ὅτι ἐξελίποσαν καὶ οὐδ' ὧς καταισχυνόμενοι κατῃσχύνθησαν καὶ τὴν ἀτιμίαν αὐτῶν οὐκ ἔγνωσαν διὰ τοῦτο πεσοῦνται ἐν τῇ πτώσει αὐτῶν καὶ ἐν καιρῷ ἐπισκοπῆς αὐτῶν ἀπολοῦνται εἶπεν κύριος

text_en: Thus says the Lord : Stand on the ways, and see, and ask for the old paths, which is the good way, and walk in it: and you shall find refreshment for your souls . And they said: We will not walk.
text_la: Hæc dicit Dominus : State super vias, et videte, et interrogate de semitis antiquis quæ sit via bona, et ambulate in ea : et invenietis refrigerium animabus vestris. Et dixerunt : Non ambulabimus.
text_pt: Assim diz o Senhor: Ponde-vos nos caminhos, e vede, e perguntai pelas veredas antigas, qual é o bom caminho, e andai por ele; e achareis descanso para as vossas almas; mas eles dizem: Não andaremos nele.
text_el: τάδε λέγει κύριος στῆτε ἐπὶ ταῖς ὁδοῖς καὶ ἴδετε καὶ ἐρωτήσατε τρίβους κυρίου αἰωνίους καὶ ἴδετε ποία ἐστὶν ἡ ὁδὸς ἡ ἀγαθή καὶ βαδίζετε ἐν αὐτῇ καὶ εὑρήσετε ἁγνισμὸν ταῖς ψυχαῖς ὑμῶν καὶ εἶπαν οὐ πορευσόμεθα

text_en: And I appointed watchmen over you, saying: Hearken to the sound of the trumpet. And they said: We will not hearken.
text_la: Et constitui super vos speculatores : Audite vocem tubæ. Et dixerunt : Non audiemus.
text_pt: Também pus atalaias sobre vós, dizendo: Estai atentos ao som da trombeta; mas dizem: Não escutaremos.
text_el: κατέστακα ἐφ' ὑμᾶς σκοπούς ἀκούσατε τῆς φωνῆς τῆς σάλπιγγος καὶ εἶπαν οὐκ ἀκουσόμεθα

text_en: Therefore hear, you nations, and know , O congregation, what great things I will do to them.
text_la: Ideo audite, gentes, et cognosce, congregatio, quanta ego faciam eis.
text_pt: Portanto ouvi, vós, nações; e informa-te tu, ó congregação, do que se faz entre eles!
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο ἤκουσαν τὰ ἔθνη καὶ οἱ ποιμαίνοντες τὰ ποίμνια αὐτῶν

text_en: Hear, O earth: Behold I will bring evils upon this people, the fruits of their own thoughts: because they have not heard my words, and they have cast away my law.
text_la: Audi, terra : ecce ego adducam mala super populum istum, fructum cogitationum ejus : quia verba mea non audierunt, et legem meam projecerunt.
text_pt: Ouve tu, ó terra! Eis que eu trarei mal sobre este povo, o próprio fruto dos seus pensamentos; porque não estão atentos às minhas palavras, e rejeitam a minha lei.
text_el: ἄκουε γῆ ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ ἐπάγω ἐπὶ τὸν λαὸν τοῦτον κακά τὸν καρπὸν ἀποστροφῆς αὐτῶν ὅτι τῶν λόγων μου οὐ προσέσχον καὶ τὸν νόμον μου ἀπώσαντο

text_en: To what purpose do you bring me frankincense from Saba , and the sweet smelling cane from a far country? Your holocausts are not acceptable, nor are your sacrifices pleasing to me.
text_la: Ut quid mihi thus de Saba affertis, et calamum suave olentem de terra longinqua? Holocautomata vestra non sunt accepta, et victimæ vestræ non placuerunt mihi.
text_pt: Para que, pois, me vem o incenso de Sabá e a melhor cana aromática de terras remotas? Vossos holocaustos não me agradam, nem me são suaves os vossos sacrifícios.
text_el: ἵνα τί μοι λίβανον ἐκ Σαβα φέρετε καὶ κιννάμωμον ἐκ γῆς μακρόθεν τὰ ὁλοκαυτώματα ὑμῶν οὔκ εἰσιν δεκτά καὶ αἱ θυσίαι ὑμῶν οὐχ ἥδυνάν μοι

text_en: Therefore thus says the Lord : Behold I will bring destruction upon this people, by which fathers and sons together shall fall, neighbour and kinsman shall perish.
text_la: Propterea hæc dicit Dominus : Ecce ego dabo in populum istum ruinas : et ruent in eis patres et filii simul; vicinus et proximus peribunt.
text_pt: Portanto assim diz o Senhor: Eis que armarei tropeços a este povo; e tropeçarão neles pais e filhos juntamente; o vizinho e o seu companheiro perecerão.
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο τάδε λέγει κύριος ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ δίδωμι ἐπὶ τὸν λαὸν τοῦτον ἀσθένειαν καὶ ἀσθενήσουσιν ἐν αὐτῇ πατέρες καὶ υἱοὶ ἅμα γείτων καὶ ὁ πλησίον αὐτοῦ ἀπολοῦνται

text_en: Thus says the Lord : Behold a people comes from the land of the north, and a great nation shall rise up from the ends of the earth.
text_la: Hæc dicit Dominus : Ecce populus venit de terra aquilonis, et gens magna consurget a finibus terræ.
text_pt: Assim diz o Senhor: Eis que um povo vem da terra do norte, e uma grande nação se levantará das extremidades da terra.
text_el: τάδε λέγει κύριος ἰδοὺ λαὸς ἔρχεται ἀπὸ βορρᾶ καὶ ἔθνη ἐξεγερθήσεται ἀπ' ἐσχάτου τῆς γῆς

text_en: They shall lay hold on arrow and shield: they are cruel, and will have no mercy. Their voice shall roar like the sea: and they shall mount upon horses, prepared as men for war , against you, O daughter of Sion.
text_la: Sagittam et scutum arripiet : crudelis est et non miserebitur. Vox ejus quasi mare sonabit : et super equos ascendent, præparati quasi vir ad prælium adversum te, filia Sion.
text_pt: Arco e lança trarão; são cruéis, e não usarão de misericórdia; a sua voz rugirá como o mar, e em cavalos virão montados, dispostos como homens de guerra contra ti, ó filha de Sião.
text_el: τόξον καὶ ζιβύνην κρατήσουσιν ἰταμός ἐστιν καὶ οὐκ ἐλεήσει φωνὴ αὐτοῦ ὡς θάλασσα κυμαίνουσα ἐφ' ἵπποις καὶ ἅρμασιν παρατάξεται ὡς πῦρ εἰς πόλεμον πρὸς σέ θύγατερ Σιων

text_en: We have heard the fame thereof, our hands grow feeble: anguish has taken hold of us, as a woman in labour.
text_la: Audivimus famam ejus; dissolutæ sunt manus nostræ : tribulatio apprehendit nos, dolores ut parturientem.
text_pt: Ouvimos a sua fama, afrouxaram-se as nossas mãos; angústia nos tomou, e dores como as de parturiente.
text_el: ἠκούσαμεν τὴν ἀκοὴν αὐτῶν παρελύθησαν αἱ χεῖρες ἡμῶν θλῖψις κατέσχεν ἡμᾶς ὠδῖνες ὡς τικτούσης

text_en: Go not out into the fields, nor walk in the highway: for the sword of the enemy, and fear is on every side.
text_la: Nolite exire ad agros, et in via ne ambuletis, quoniam gladius inimici, pavor in circuitu.
text_pt: Não saiais ao campo, nem andeis pelo caminho; porque espada do inimigo e espanto há ao redor.
text_el: μὴ ἐκπορεύεσθε εἰς ἀγρὸν καὶ ἐν ταῖς ὁδοῖς μὴ βαδίζετε ὅτι ῥομφαία τῶν ἐχθρῶν παροικεῖ κυκλόθεν

text_en: Gird you with sackcloth , O daughter of my people, and sprinkle you with ashes: make you mourning as for an only son, a bitter lamentation, because the destroyer shall suddenly come upon us.
text_la: Filia populi mei, accingere cilicio, et conspergere cinere : luctum unigeniti fac tibi, planctum amarum, quia repente veniet vastator super nos.
text_pt: Ó filha do meu povo, cinge-te de saco, e revolve-te na cinza; pranteia como por um filho único, pranto de amargura; porque de repente virá o destruidor sobre nós.
text_el: θύγατερ λαοῦ μου περίζωσαι σάκκον κατάπασαι ἐν σποδῷ πένθος ἀγαπητοῦ ποίησαι σεαυτῇ κοπετὸν οἰκτρόν ὅτι ἐξαίφνης ἥξει ταλαιπωρία ἐφ' ὑμᾶς

text_en: I have set you for a strong trier among my people: and you shall know , and prove their way.
text_la: Probatorem dedi te in populo meo robustum : et scies, et probabis viam eorum.
text_pt: Por torre de guarda te pus entre o meu povo, por fortaleza, para que soubesses e examinasses o seu caminho.
text_el: δοκιμαστὴν δέδωκά σε ἐν λαοῖς δεδοκιμασμένοις καὶ γνώσῃ με ἐν τῷ δοκιμάσαι με τὴν ὁδὸν αὐτῶν

text_en: All these princes go out of the way, they walk deceitfully, they are brass and iron: they are all corrupted.
text_la: Omnes isti principes declinantes, ambulantes fraudulenter, æs et ferrum : universi corrupti sunt.
text_pt: Todos eles são os mais rebeldes, andam murmurando; são duros como bronze e ferro; todos eles são corruptores.
text_el: πάντες ἀνήκοοι πορευόμενοι σκολιῶς χαλκὸς καὶ σίδηρος πάντες διεφθαρμένοι εἰσίν

text_en: The bellows have failed, the lead is consumed in the fire, the founder has melted in vain: for their wicked deeds are not consumed.
text_la: Defecit sufflatorium; in igne consumptum est plumbum : frustra conflavit conflator, malitiæ enim eorum non sunt consumptæ.
text_pt: Já o fole se queimou, o chumbo se consumiu com o fogo; em vão fundiu o fundidor tão diligentemente, pois os maus não são arrancados.
text_el: ἐξέλιπεν φυσητὴρ ἀπὸ πυρός ἐξέλιπεν μόλιβος εἰς κενὸν ἀργυροκόπος ἀργυροκοπεῖ πονηρία αὐτῶν οὐκ ἐτάκη

text_en: Call them reprobate silver, for the Lord has rejected them.
text_la: Argentum reprobum vocate eos, quia Dominus projecit illos.
text_pt: Prata rejeitada lhes chamarão, porque o Senhor os rejeitou.
text_el: ἀργύριον ἀποδεδοκιμασμένον καλέσατε αὐτούς ὅτι ἀπεδοκίμασεν αὐτοὺς κύριος

text_en: The word that came to Jeremias from the Lord , saying:
text_la: Verbum quod factum est ad Jeremiam a Domino, dicens:
text_pt: A palavra que da parte do SENHOR, veio a Jeremias, dizendo:

text_en: Stand in the gate of the house of the Lord , and proclaim there this word, and say: Hear the word of the Lord , all you men of Juda , that enter in at these gates, to adore the Lord .
text_la: Sta in porta domus Domini, et prædica ibi verbum istud, et dic : Audite verbum Domini, omnis Juda, qui ingredimini per portas has ut adoretis Dominum.
text_pt: Põe-te à porta da casa do Senhor, e proclama ali esta palavra, e dize: Ouvi a palavra do Senhor, todos de Judá, os que entrais por estas portas, para adorardes ao Senhor.
text_el: ἀκούσατε λόγον κυρίου πᾶσα ἡ Ιουδαία

text_en: Thus says the Lord of hosts the God of Israel : Make your ways and your doings good : and I will dwell with you in this place.
text_la: Hæc dicit Dominus exercituum, Deus Israël : Bonas facite vias vestras, et studia vestra, et habitabo vobiscum in loco isto.
text_pt: Assim diz o Senhor dos Exércitos, o Deus de Israel: Melhorai os vossos caminhos e as vossas obras, e vos farei habitar neste lugar.
text_el: τάδε λέγει κύριος ὁ θεὸς Ισραηλ διορθώσατε τὰς ὁδοὺς ὑμῶν καὶ τὰ ἐπιτηδεύματα ὑμῶν καὶ κατοικιῶ ὑμᾶς ἐν τῷ τόπῳ τούτῳ

text_en: Trust not in lying words, saying: The temple of the Lord , the temple of the Lord , it is the temple of the Lord .
text_la: Nolite confidere in verbis mendacii, dicentes : Templum Domini, templum Domini, templum Domini est!
text_pt: Não vos fieis em palavras falsas, dizendo: Templo do Senhor, templo do Senhor, templo do Senhor é este.
text_el: μὴ πεποίθατε ἐφ' ἑαυτοῖς ἐπὶ λόγοις ψευδέσιν ὅτι τὸ παράπαν οὐκ ὠφελήσουσιν ὑμᾶς λέγοντες ναὸς κυρίου ναὸς κυρίου ἐστίν

text_en: For if you will order well your ways, and your doings: if you will execute judgment between a man and his neighbour,
text_la: Quoniam si bene direxeritis vias vestras, et studia vestra; si feceritis judicium inter virum et proximum ejus;
text_pt: Mas, se deveras melhorardes os vossos caminhos e as vossas obras; se deveras praticardes o juízo entre um homem e o seu próximo;
text_el: ὅτι ἐὰν διορθοῦντες διορθώσητε τὰς ὁδοὺς ὑμῶν καὶ τὰ ἐπιτηδεύματα ὑμῶν καὶ ποιοῦντες ποιήσητε κρίσιν ἀνὰ μέσον ἀνδρὸς καὶ ἀνὰ μέσον τοῦ πλησίον αὐτοῦ

text_en: if you oppress not the stranger, the fatherless , and the widow , and shed not innocent blood in this place, and walk not after strange gods to your own hurt,
text_la: advenæ, et pupillo, et viduæ non feceritis calumniam, nec sanguinem innocentem effuderitis in loco hoc, et post deos alienos non ambulaveritis in malum vobismetipsis :
text_pt: Se não oprimirdes o estrangeiro, e o órfão, e a viúva, nem derramardes sangue inocente neste lugar, nem andardes após outros deuses para vosso próprio mal,
text_el: καὶ προσήλυτον καὶ ὀρφανὸν καὶ χήραν μὴ καταδυναστεύσητε καὶ αἷμα ἀθῷον μὴ ἐκχέητε ἐν τῷ τόπῳ τούτῳ καὶ ὀπίσω θεῶν ἀλλοτρίων μὴ πορεύησθε εἰς κακὸν ὑμῖν

text_en: I will dwell with you in this place: in the land, which I gave to your fathers from the beginning and for evermore.
text_la: habitabo vobiscum in loco isto, in terra quam dedi patribus vestris a sæculo et usque in sæculum.
text_pt: Eu vos farei habitar neste lugar, na terra que dei a vossos pais, desde os tempos antigos e para sempre.
text_el: καὶ κατοικιῶ ὑμᾶς ἐν τῷ τόπῳ τούτῳ ἐν γῇ ᾗ ἔδωκα τοῖς πατράσιν ὑμῶν ἐξ αἰῶνος καὶ ἕως αἰῶνος

text_en: Behold you put your trust in lying words, which shall not profit you:
text_la: Ecce vos confiditis vobis in sermonibus mendacii, qui non proderunt vobis :
text_pt: Eis que vós confiais em palavras falsas, que para nada vos aproveitam.
text_el: εἰ δὲ ὑμεῖς πεποίθατε ἐπὶ λόγοις ψευδέσιν ὅθεν οὐκ ὠφεληθήσεσθε

text_en: To steal, to murder , to commit adultery , to swear falsely , to offer to Baalim , and to go after strange gods, which you know not.
text_la: furari, occidere, adulterari, jurare mendaciter, libare Baalim, et ire post deos alienos quos ignoratis :
text_pt: Porventura furtareis, e matareis, e adulterareis, e jurareis falsamente, e queimareis incenso a Baal, e andareis após outros deuses que não conhecestes,
text_el: καὶ φονεύετε καὶ μοιχᾶσθε καὶ κλέπτετε καὶ ὀμνύετε ἐπ' ἀδίκῳ καὶ ἐθυμιᾶτε τῇ Βααλ καὶ ἐπορεύεσθε ὀπίσω θεῶν ἀλλοτρίων ὧν οὐκ οἴδατε τοῦ κακῶς εἶναι ὑμῖν

text_en: And you have come, and stood before me in this house, in which my name is called upon, and have said: We are delivered, because we have done all these abominations.
text_la: et venistis, et stetistis coram me in domo hac, in qua invocatum est nomen meum, et dixistis : Liberati sumus, eo quod fecerimus omnes abominationes istas.
text_pt: E então vireis, e vos poreis diante de mim nesta casa, que se chama pelo meu nome, e direis: Fomos libertados para fazermos todas estas abominações?
text_el: καὶ ἤλθετε καὶ ἔστητε ἐνώπιον ἐμοῦ ἐν τῷ οἴκῳ οὗ ἐπικέκληται τὸ ὄνομά μου ἐπ' αὐτῷ καὶ εἴπατε ἀπεσχήμεθα τοῦ μὴ ποιεῖν πάντα τὰ βδελύγματα ταῦτα

text_en: Is this house then, in which my name has been called upon, in your eyes become a den of robbers? I, I am he: I have seen it, says the Lord .
text_la: Numquid ergo spelunca latronum facta est domus ista, in qua invocatum est nomen meum in oculis vestris? Ego, ego sum : ego vidi, dicit Dominus.
text_pt: É pois esta casa, que se chama pelo meu nome, uma caverna de salteadores aos vossos olhos? Eis que eu, eu mesmo, vi isto, diz o Senhor.
text_el: μὴ σπήλαιον λῃστῶν ὁ οἶκός μου οὗ ἐπικέκληται τὸ ὄνομά μου ἐπ' αὐτῷ ἐκεῖ ἐνώπιον ὑμῶν καὶ ἐγὼ ἰδοὺ ἑώρακα λέγει κύριος

text_en: Go to my place in Silo, where my name dwelt from the beginning: and see what I did to it for the wickedness of my people Israel :
text_la: Ite ad locum meum in Silo, ubi habitavit nomen meum a principio, et videte quæ fecerim ei propter malitiam populi mei Israël.
text_pt: Mas ide agora ao meu lugar, que estava em Siló, onde, ao princípio, fiz habitar o meu nome, e vede o que lhe fiz, por causa da maldade do meu povo Israel.
text_el: ὅτι πορεύθητε εἰς τὸν τόπον μου τὸν ἐν Σηλωμ οὗ κατεσκήνωσα τὸ ὄνομά μου ἐκεῖ ἔμπροσθεν καὶ ἴδετε ἃ ἐποίησα αὐτῷ ἀπὸ προσώπου κακίας λαοῦ μου Ισραηλ

text_en: And now, because you have done all these works, says the Lord : and I have spoken to you rising up early, and speaking, and you have not heard: and I have called you, and you have not answered:
text_la: Et nunc, quia fecistis omnia opera hæc, dicit Dominus, et locutus sum ad vos mane consurgens, et loquens, et non audistis : et vocavi vos, et non respondistis :
text_pt: Agora, pois, porquanto fazeis todas estas obras, diz o Senhor, e eu vos falei, madrugando, e falando, e não ouvistes, e chamei-vos, e não respondestes,
text_el: καὶ νῦν ἀνθ' ὧν ἐποιήσατε πάντα τὰ ἔργα ταῦτα καὶ ἐλάλησα πρὸς ὑμᾶς καὶ οὐκ ἠκούσατέ μου καὶ ἐκάλεσα ὑμᾶς καὶ οὐκ ἀπεκρίθητε

text_en: I will do to this house, in which my name is called upon, and in which you trust, and to the place which I have given you and your fathers, as I did to Silo.
text_la: faciam domui huic, in qua invocatum est nomen meum, et in qua vos habetis fiduciam, et loco quem dedi vobis et patribus vestris, sicut feci Silo :
text_pt: Farei também a esta casa, que se chama pelo meu nome, na qual confiais, e a este lugar, que vos dei a vós e a vossos pais, como fiz a Siló.
text_el: καὶ ποιήσω τῷ οἴκῳ τούτῳ ᾧ ἐπικέκληται τὸ ὄνομά μου ἐπ' αὐτῷ ἐφ' ᾧ ὑμεῖς πεποίθατε ἐπ' αὐτῷ καὶ τῷ τόπῳ ᾧ ἔδωκα ὑμῖν καὶ τοῖς πατράσιν ὑμῶν καθὼς ἐποίησα τῇ Σηλωμ

text_en: And I will cast you away from before my face, as I have cast away all your brethren, the whole seed of Ephraim.
text_la: et projiciam vos a facie mea sicut projeci omnes fratres vestros, universum semen Ephraim.
text_pt: E lançar-vos-ei de diante de minha face, como lancei a todos os vossos irmãos, a toda a geração de Efraim.
text_el: καὶ ἀπορρίψω ὑμᾶς ἀπὸ προσώπου μου καθὼς ἀπέρριψα τοὺς ἀδελφοὺς ὑμῶν πᾶν τὸ σπέρμα Εφραιμ

text_en: Therefore do not pray for this people, nor take to you praise and supplication for them: and do not withstand me: for I will not hear you.
text_la: Tu ergo, noli orare pro populo hoc, nec assumas pro eis laudem et orationem : et non obsistas mihi, quia non exaudiam te.
text_pt: Tu, pois, não ores por este povo, nem levantes por ele clamor ou oração, nem me supliques, porque eu não te ouvirei.
text_el: καὶ σὺ μὴ προσεύχου περὶ τοῦ λαοῦ τούτου καὶ μὴ ἀξίου τοῦ ἐλεηθῆναι αὐτοὺς καὶ μὴ εὔχου καὶ μὴ προσέλθῃς μοι περὶ αὐτῶν ὅτι οὐκ εἰσακούσομαι

text_en: Do you not see what they do in the cities of Juda , and in the streets of Jerusalem ?
text_la: Nonne vides quid isti faciunt in civitatibus Juda, et in plateis Jerusalem?
text_pt: Porventura não vês tu o que andam fazendo nas cidades de Judá, e nas ruas de Jerusalém?
text_el: ἦ οὐχ ὁρᾷς τί αὐτοὶ ποιοῦσιν ἐν ταῖς πόλεσιν Ιουδα καὶ ἐν ταῖς ὁδοῖς Ιερουσαλημ

text_en: The children gather wood, and the fathers kindle the fire, and the women knead the dough, to make cakes to the queen of heaven , and to offer libations to strange gods, and to provoke me to anger .
text_la: Filii colligunt ligna, et patres succendunt ignem, et mulieres conspergunt adipem, ut faciant placentas reginæ cæli, et libent diis alienis, et me ad iracundiam provocent.
text_pt: Os filhos apanham a lenha, e os pais acendem o fogo, e as mulheres preparam a massa, para fazerem bolos à rainha dos céus, e oferecem libações a outros deuses, para me provocarem à ira.
text_el: οἱ υἱοὶ αὐτῶν συλλέγουσιν ξύλα καὶ οἱ πατέρες αὐτῶν καίουσι πῦρ καὶ αἱ γυναῖκες αὐτῶν τρίβουσιν σταῖς τοῦ ποιῆσαι χαυῶνας τῇ στρατιᾷ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ καὶ ἔσπεισαν σπονδὰς θεοῖς ἀλλοτρίοις ἵνα παροργίσωσίν με

text_en: Do they provoke me to anger , says the Lord ? Is it not themselves, to the confusion of their own countenance?
text_la: Numquid me ad iracundiam provocant? dicit Dominus; nonne semetipsos in confusionem vultus sui?
text_pt: Acaso é a mim que eles provocam à ira? diz o Senhor, e não a si mesmos, para confusão dos seus rostos?
text_el: μὴ ἐμὲ αὐτοὶ παροργίζουσιν λέγει κύριος οὐχὶ ἑαυτούς ὅπως καταισχυνθῇ τὰ πρόσωπα αὐτῶν

text_en: Therefore thus says the Lord God : Behold my wrath and my indignation is enkindled against this place, upon men and upon beasts, and upon the trees of the field, and upon the fruits of the land, and it shall burn, and shall not be quenched.
text_la: Ideo hæc dicit Dominus Deus : Ecce furor meus et indignatio mea conflatur super locum istum, super viros, et super jumenta, et super lignum regionis, et super fruges terræ : et succendetur, et non extinguetur.
text_pt: Portanto assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Eis que a minha ira e o meu furor se derramarão sobre este lugar, sobre os homens e sobre os animais, e sobre as árvores do campo, e sobre os frutos da terra; e acender-se-á, e não se apagará.
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο τάδε λέγει κύριος ἰδοὺ ὀργὴ καὶ θυμός μου χεῖται ἐπὶ τὸν τόπον τοῦτον καὶ ἐπὶ τοὺς ἀνθρώπους καὶ ἐπὶ τὰ κτήνη καὶ ἐπὶ πᾶν ξύλον τοῦ ἀγροῦ αὐτῶν καὶ ἐπὶ πάντα τὰ γενήματα τῆς γῆς καὶ καυθήσεται καὶ οὐ σβεσθήσεται

text_en: Thus says the Lord of hosts the God of Israel : Add your burnt offerings to your sacrifices , and eat the flesh.
text_la: Hæc dicit Dominus exercituum, Deus Israël : Holocautomata vestra addite victimis vestris, et comedite carnes :
text_pt: Assim diz o Senhor dos Exércitos, o Deus de Israel: Ajuntai os vossos holocaustos aos vossos sacrifícios, e comei carne.
text_el: τάδε λέγει κύριος τὰ ὁλοκαυτώματα ὑμῶν συναγάγετε μετὰ τῶν θυσιῶν ὑμῶν καὶ φάγετε κρέα

text_en: For I spoke not to your fathers, and I commanded them not, in the day that I brought them out of the land of Egypt , concerning the matter of burnt offerings and sacrifices .
text_la: quia non sum locutus cum patribus vestris, et non præcepi eis, in die qua eduxi eos de terra Ægypti, de verbo holocautomatum et victimarum :
text_pt: Porque nunca falei a vossos pais, no dia em que os tirei da terra do Egito, nem lhes ordenei coisa alguma acerca de holocaustos ou sacrifícios.
text_el: ὅτι οὐκ ἐλάλησα πρὸς τοὺς πατέρας ὑμῶν καὶ οὐκ ἐνετειλάμην αὐτοῖς ἐν ἡμέρᾳ ᾗ ἀνήγαγον αὐτοὺς ἐκ γῆς Αἰγύπτου περὶ ὁλοκαυτωμάτων καὶ θυσίας

text_en: But this thing I commanded them, saying: Hearken to my voice, and I will be your God , and you shall be my people: and walk in all the way that I have commanded you, that it may be well with you.
text_la: sed hoc verbum præcepi eis, dicens : Audite vocem meam, et ero vobis Deus, et vos eritis mihi populus : et ambulate in omni via quam mandavi vobis, ut bene sit vobis.
text_pt: Mas isto lhes ordenei, dizendo: Dai ouvidos à minha voz, e eu serei o vosso Deus, e vós sereis o meu povo; e andai em todo o caminho que eu vos mandar, para que vos vá bem.
text_el: ἀλλ' ἢ τὸ ῥῆμα τοῦτο ἐνετειλάμην αὐτοῖς λέγων ἀκούσατε τῆς φωνῆς μου καὶ ἔσομαι ὑμῖν εἰς θεόν καὶ ὑμεῖς ἔσεσθέ μοι εἰς λαόν καὶ πορεύεσθε ἐν πάσαις ταῖς ὁδοῖς μου αἷς ἂν ἐντείλωμαι ὑμῖν ὅπως ἂν εὖ ᾖ ὑμῖν

text_en: But they hearkened not, nor inclined their ear: but walked in their own will, and in the perversity of their wicked heart: and went backward and not forward,
text_la: Et non audierunt, nec inclinaverunt aurem suam : sed abierunt in voluntatibus et in pravitate cordis sui mali : factique sunt retrorsum, et non in ante,
text_pt: Mas não ouviram, nem inclinaram os seus ouvidos, mas andaram nos seus próprios conselhos, no propósito do seu coração malvado; e andaram para trás, e não para diante.
text_el: καὶ οὐκ ἤκουσάν μου καὶ οὐ προσέσχεν τὸ οὖς αὐτῶν ἀλλ' ἐπορεύθησαν ἐν τοῖς ἐνθυμήμασιν τῆς καρδίας αὐτῶν τῆς κακῆς καὶ ἐγενήθησαν εἰς τὰ ὄπισθεν καὶ οὐκ εἰς τὰ ἔμπροσθεν

text_en: from the day that their fathers came out of the land of Egypt , even to this day. And I have sent to you all my servants the prophets , from day to day, rising up early and sending.
text_la: a die qua egressi sunt patres eorum de terra Ægypti usque ad diem hanc. Et misi ad vos omnes servos meos prophetas per diem, consurgens diluculo, et mittens :
text_pt: Desde o dia em que vossos pais saíram da terra do Egito, até hoje, enviei-vos todos os meus servos, os profetas, todos os dias madrugando e enviando-os.
text_el: ἀφ' ἧς ἡμέρας ἐξήλθοσαν οἱ πατέρες αὐτῶν ἐκ γῆς Αἰγύπτου καὶ ἕως τῆς ἡμέρας ταύτης καὶ ἐξαπέστειλα πρὸς ὑμᾶς πάντας τοὺς δούλους μου τοὺς προφήτας ἡμέρας καὶ ὄρθρου καὶ ἀπέστειλα

text_en: And they have not hearkened to me: nor inclined their ear: but have hardened their neck, and have done worse than their fathers.
text_la: et non audierunt me, nec inclinaverunt aurem suam : sed induraverunt cervicem suam, et pejus operati sunt quam patres eorum.
text_pt: Mas não me deram ouvidos, nem inclinaram os seus ouvidos, mas endureceram a sua cerviz, e fizeram pior do que seus pais.
text_el: καὶ οὐκ ἤκουσάν μου καὶ οὐ προσέσχεν τὸ οὖς αὐτῶν καὶ ἐσκλήρυναν τὸν τράχηλον αὐτῶν ὑπὲρ τοὺς πατέρας αὐτῶν

text_en: And you shall speak to them all these words, but they will not hearken to you: and you shall call them, but they will not answer you.
text_la: Et loqueris ad eos omnia verba hæc, et non audient te : et vocabis eos, et non respondebunt tibi.
text_pt: Dir-lhes-ás, pois, todas estas palavras, mas não te darão ouvidos; chamá-los-ás, mas não te responderão.
text_el: καὶ ἐρεῖς αὐτοῖς τὸν λόγον τοῦτον

text_en: And you shall say to them: This is a nation which has not hearkened to the voice of the Lord their God , nor received instruction: faith is lost, and is taken away out of their mouth.
text_la: Et dices ad eos : Hæc est gens quæ non audivit vocem Domini Dei sui, nec recepit disciplinam; periit fides, et ablata est de ore eorum.
text_pt: E lhes dirás: Esta é a nação que não deu ouvidos à voz do Senhor seu Deus e não aceitou a correção; já pereceu a verdade, e foi cortada da sua boca.
text_el: τοῦτο τὸ ἔθνος ὃ οὐκ ἤκουσεν τῆς φωνῆς κυρίου οὐδὲ ἐδέξατο παιδείαν ἐξέλιπεν ἡ πίστις ἐκ στόματος αὐτῶν

text_en: Cut off your hair, and cast it away: and take up a lamentation on high: for the Lord has rejected, and forsaken the generation of his wrath ,
text_la: Tonde capillum tuum, et projice, et sume in directum planctum : quia projecit Dominus et reliquit generationem furoris sui;
text_pt: Corta o teu cabelo e lança-o de ti, e levanta um pranto sobre as alturas; porque já o Senhor rejeitou e desamparou a geração do seu furor.
text_el: κεῖραι τὴν κεφαλήν σου καὶ ἀπόρριπτε καὶ ἀνάλαβε ἐπὶ χειλέων θρῆνον ὅτι ἀπεδοκίμασεν κύριος καὶ ἀπώσατο τὴν γενεὰν τὴν ποιοῦσαν ταῦτα

text_en: because the children of Juda have done evil in my eyes, says the Lord . They have set their abominations in the house in which my name is called upon, to pollute it;
text_la: quia fecerunt filii Juda malum in oculis meis, dicit Dominus. Posuerunt offendicula sua in domo in qua invocatum est nomen meum, ut polluerent eam :
text_pt: Porque os filhos de Judá fizeram o que era mau aos meus olhos, diz o Senhor; puseram as suas abominações na casa que se chama pelo meu nome, para contaminá-la.
text_el: ὅτι ἐποίησαν οἱ υἱοὶ Ιουδα τὸ πονηρὸν ἐναντίον ἐμοῦ λέγει κύριος ἔταξαν τὰ βδελύγματα αὐτῶν ἐν τῷ οἴκῳ οὗ ἐπικέκληται τὸ ὄνομά μου ἐπ' αὐτόν τοῦ μιᾶναι αὐτόν

text_en: and they have built the high places of Topheth, which is in the valley of the son of Ennom, to burn their sons, and their daughters in the fire: which I commanded not, nor thought on in my heart.
text_la: et ædificaverunt excelsa Topheth, quæ est in valle filii Ennom, ut incenderent filios suos et filias suas igni, quæ non præcepi, nec cogitavi in corde meo.
text_pt: E edificaram os altos de Tofete, que está no Vale do Filho de Hinom, para queimarem no fogo a seus filhos e a suas filhas, o que nunca ordenei, nem me subiu ao coração.
text_el: καὶ ᾠκοδόμησαν τὸν βωμὸν τοῦ Ταφεθ ὅς ἐστιν ἐν φάραγγι υἱοῦ Εννομ τοῦ κατακαίειν τοὺς υἱοὺς αὐτῶν καὶ τὰς θυγατέρας αὐτῶν ἐν πυρί ὃ οὐκ ἐνετειλάμην αὐτοῖς καὶ οὐ διενοήθην ἐν τῇ καρδίᾳ μου

text_en: Therefore behold the days shall come, says the Lord , and it shall no more be called Topheth, nor the valley of the son of Ennom: but the valley of slaughter: and they shall bury in Topheth, because there is no place.
text_la: Ideo ecce dies venient, dicit Dominus, et non dicetur amplius Topheth, et vallis filii Ennom, sed vallis interfectionis : et sepelient in Topheth, eo quod non sit locus.
text_pt: Portanto, eis que vêm dias, diz o Senhor, em que não se chamará mais Tofete, nem Vale do Filho de Hinom, mas o Vale da Matança; e enterrarão em Tofete, por não haver outro lugar.
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο ἰδοὺ ἡμέραι ἔρχονται λέγει κύριος καὶ οὐκ ἐροῦσιν ἔτι βωμὸς τοῦ Ταφεθ καὶ φάραγξ υἱοῦ Εννομ ἀλλ' ἢ φάραγξ τῶν ἀνῃρημένων καὶ θάψουσιν ἐν τῷ Ταφεθ διὰ τὸ μὴ ὑπάρχειν τόπον

text_en: And the carcasses of this people shall be meat for the fowls of the air, and for the beasts of the earth, and there shall be none to drive them away.
text_la: Et erit morticinum populi hujus in cibos volucribus cæli et bestiis terræ, et non erit qui abigat.
text_pt: E os cadáveres deste povo servirão de pasto às aves dos céus e aos animais da terra; e ninguém os espantará.
text_el: καὶ ἔσονται οἱ νεκροὶ τοῦ λαοῦ τούτου εἰς βρῶσιν τοῖς πετεινοῖς τοῦ οὐρανοῦ καὶ τοῖς θηρίοις τῆς γῆς καὶ οὐκ ἔσται ὁ ἀποσοβῶν

text_en: And I will cause to cease out of the cities of Juda , and out of the streets of Jerusalem , the voice of joy , and the voice of gladness , the voice of the bridegroom and the voice of the bride: for the land shall be desolate.
text_la: Et quiescere faciam de urbibus Juda, et de plateis Jerusalem, vocem gaudii et vocem lætitiæ, vocem sponsi et vocem sponsæ : in desolationem enim erit terra.
text_pt: E farei cessar nas cidades de Judá, e nas ruas de Jerusalém, a voz de gozo, e a voz de alegria, a voz de esposo e a voz de esposa; porque a terra se tornará em desolação.
text_el: καὶ καταλύσω ἐκ πόλεων Ιουδα καὶ ἐκ διόδων Ιερουσαλημ φωνὴν εὐφραινομένων καὶ φωνὴν χαιρόντων φωνὴν νυμφίου καὶ φωνὴν νύμφης ὅτι εἰς ἐρήμωσιν ἔσται πᾶσα ἡ γῆ

text_en: At that time, says the Lord , they shall cast out the bones of the kings of Juda , and the bones of the princes thereof, and the bones of the priests , and the bones of the prophets , and the bones of the inhabitants of Jerusalem , out of their graves.
text_la: In illo tempore, ait Dominus, ejicient ossa regum Juda, et ossa principum ejus, et ossa sacerdotum, et ossa prophetarum, et ossa eorum qui habitaverunt Jerusalem, de sepulchris suis :
text_pt: Naquele tempo, diz o SENHOR, tirarão para fora das suas sepulturas os ossos dos reis de Judá, e os ossos dos seus príncipes, e os ossos dos sacerdotes, e os ossos dos profetas, e os ossos dos habitantes de Jerusalém;
text_el: ἐν τῷ καιρῷ ἐκείνῳ λέγει κύριος ἐξοίσουσιν τὰ ὀστᾶ τῶν βασιλέων Ιουδα καὶ τὰ ὀστᾶ τῶν ἀρχόντων αὐτοῦ καὶ τὰ ὀστᾶ τῶν ἱερέων καὶ τὰ ὀστᾶ τῶν προφητῶν καὶ τὰ ὀστᾶ τῶν κατοικούντων Ιερουσαλημ ἐκ τῶν τάφων αὐτῶν

text_en: And they shall spread them abroad to the sun, and the moon, and all the host of heaven , whom they have loved , and whom they have served, and after whom have walked, and whom they have sought, and adored : they shall not be gathered, and they shall not be buried: they shall be as dung upon the face of the earth.
text_la: et expandent ea ad solem, et lunam, et omnem militiam cæli, quæ dilexerunt, et quibus servierunt, et post quæ ambulaverunt, et quæ quæsierunt, et adoraverunt. Non colligentur, et non sepelientur : in sterquilinium super faciem terræ erunt.
text_pt: E expô-los-ão ao sol, e à lua, e a todo o exército do céu, a quem tinham amado, e a quem tinham servido, e após quem tinham ido, e a quem tinham buscado e diante de quem se tinham prostrado; não serão recolhidos nem sepultados; serão como esterco sobre a face da terra.
text_el: καὶ ψύξουσιν αὐτὰ πρὸς τὸν ἥλιον καὶ τὴν σελήνην καὶ πρὸς πάντας τοὺς ἀστέρας καὶ πρὸς πᾶσαν τὴν στρατιὰν τοῦ οὐρανοῦ ἃ ἠγάπησαν καὶ οἷς ἐδούλευσαν καὶ ὧν ἐπορεύθησαν ὀπίσω αὐτῶν καὶ ὧν ἀντείχοντο καὶ οἷς προσεκύνησαν αὐτοῖς οὐ κοπήσονται καὶ οὐ ταφήσονται καὶ ἔσονται εἰς παράδειγμα ἐπὶ προσώπου τῆς γῆς

text_en: And death shall be chosen rather than life by all that shall remain of this wicked kindred in all places, which are left, to which I have cast them out, says the Lord of hosts .
text_la: Et eligent magis mortem quam vitam, omnes qui residui fuerint de cognatione hac pessima, in universis locis quæ derelicta sunt, ad quæ ejeci eos, dicit Dominus exercituum.
text_pt: E será escolhida antes a morte do que a vida por todos os que restarem desta raça maligna, que ficarem em todos os lugares onde os lancei, diz o Senhor dos Exércitos.
text_el: ὅτι εἵλοντο τὸν θάνατον ἢ τὴν ζωήν καὶ πᾶσιν τοῖς καταλοίποις τοῖς καταλειφθεῖσιν ἀπὸ τῆς γενεᾶς ἐκείνης ἐν παντὶ τόπῳ οὗ ἐὰν ἐξώσω αὐτοὺς ἐκεῖ

text_en: And you shall say to them: Thus says the Lord : Shall not he that falls, rise again? And he that is turned away, shall he not turn again?
text_la: Et dices ad eos : Hæc dicit Dominus : Numquid qui cadit non resurget? et qui aversus est non revertetur?
text_pt: Dize-lhes mais: Assim diz o Senhor: Porventura cairão e não se tornarão a levantar? Desviar-se-ão, e não voltarão?
text_el: ὅτι τάδε λέγει κύριος μὴ ὁ πίπτων οὐκ ἀνίσταται ἢ ὁ ἀποστρέφων οὐκ ἐπιστρέφει

text_en: Why then is this people in Jerusalem turned away with a stubborn revolting? They have laid hold on lying, and have refused to return.
text_la: Quare ergo aversus est populus iste in Jerusalem aversione contentiosa? Apprehenderunt mendacium, et noluerunt reverti.
text_pt: Por que, pois, se desvia este povo de Jerusalém com uma apostasia tão contínua? Persiste no engano, não quer voltar.
text_el: διὰ τί ἀπέστρεψεν ὁ λαός μου οὗτος ἀποστροφὴν ἀναιδῆ καὶ κατεκρατήθησαν ἐν τῇ προαιρέσει αὐτῶν καὶ οὐκ ἠθέλησαν τοῦ ἐπιστρέψαι

text_en: I attended, and hearkened; no man speaks what is good , there is none that does penance for his sin , saying: What have I done? They are all turned to their own course, as a horse rushing to the battle.
text_la: Attendi, et auscultavi : nemo quod bonum est loquitur; nullus est qui agat pœnitentiam super peccato suo, dicens : Quid feci? Omnes conversi sunt ad cursum suum, quasi equus impetu vadens ad prælium.
text_pt: Eu escutei e ouvi; não falam o que é reto, ninguém há que se arrependa da sua maldade, dizendo: Que fiz eu? Cada um se desvia na sua carreira, como um cavalo que arremete com ímpeto na batalha.
text_el: ἐνωτίσασθε δὴ καὶ ἀκούσατε οὐχ οὕτως λαλήσουσιν οὐκ ἔστιν ἄνθρωπος μετανοῶν ἀπὸ τῆς κακίας αὐτοῦ λέγων τί ἐποίησα διέλιπεν ὁ τρέχων ἀπὸ τοῦ δρόμου αὐτοῦ ὡς ἵππος κάθιδρος ἐν χρεμετισμῷ αὐτοῦ

text_en: The kite in the air has known her time: the turtle, and the swallow, and the stork have observed the time of their coming: but my people have not known the judgment of the Lord .
text_la: Milvus in cælo cognovit tempus suum : turtur, et hirundo, et ciconia custodierunt tempus adventus sui : populus autem meus non cognovit judicium Domini.
text_pt: Até a cegonha no céu conhece os seus tempos determinados; e a rola, e o grou e a andorinha observam o tempo da sua arribação; mas o meu povo não conhece o juízo do Senhor.
text_el: καὶ ἡ ασιδα ἐν τῷ οὐρανῷ ἔγνω τὸν καιρὸν αὐτῆς τρυγὼν καὶ χελιδών ἀγροῦ στρουθία ἐφύλαξαν καιροὺς εἰσόδων αὐτῶν ὁ δὲ λαός μου οὐκ ἔγνω τὰ κρίματα κυρίου

text_en: How do you say: We are wise, and the law of the Lord is with us? Indeed the lying pens of the scribes has wrought falsehood.
text_la: Quomodo dicitis : Sapientes nos sumus, et lex Domini nobiscum est? vere mendacium operatus est stylus mendax scribarum!
text_pt: Como, pois, dizeis: Nós somos sábios, e a lei do Senhor está conosco? Eis que em vão tem trabalhado a falsa pena dos escribas.
text_el: πῶς ἐρεῖτε ὅτι σοφοί ἐσμεν ἡμεῖς καὶ νόμος κυρίου ἐστὶν μεθ' ἡμῶν εἰς μάτην ἐγενήθη σχοῖνος ψευδὴς γραμματεῦσιν

text_en: The wise men are confounded, they are dismayed, and taken: for they have cast away the word of the Lord , and there is no wisdom in them.
text_la: Confusi sunt sapientes; perterriti et capti sunt : verbum enim Domini projecerunt, et sapientia nulla est in eis.
text_pt: Os sábios são envergonhados, espantados e presos; eis que rejeitaram a palavra do Senhor; que sabedoria, pois, têm eles?
text_el: ᾐσχύνθησαν σοφοὶ καὶ ἐπτοήθησαν καὶ ἑάλωσαν ὅτι τὸν λόγον κυρίου ἀπεδοκίμασαν σοφία τίς ἐστιν ἐν αὐτοῖς

text_en: Therefore will I give their women to strangers, their fields to others for an inheritance: because from the least even to the greatest all follow covetousness : from the prophet even to the priest all deal deceitfully.
text_la: Propterea dabo mulieres eorum exteris, agros eorum hæredibus, quia a minimo usque ad maximum omnes avaritiam sequuntur : a propheta usque ad sacerdotem cuncti faciunt mendacium.
text_pt: Portanto darei suas mulheres a outros, e os seus campos a novos possuidores; porque desde o menor até ao maior, cada um deles se dá à avareza; desde o profeta até ao sacerdote, cada um deles usa de falsidade.
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο δώσω τὰς γυναῖκας αὐτῶν ἑτέροις καὶ τοὺς ἀγροὺς αὐτῶν τοῖς κληρονόμοις

text_en: And they healed the breach of the daughter of my people disgracefully, saying: Peace, peace: when there was no peace.
text_la: Et sanabant contritionem filiæ populi mei ad ignominiam, dicentes : Pax, pax! cum non esset pax.
text_pt: E curam a ferida da filha de meu povo levianamente, dizendo: Paz, paz; quando não há paz.

text_en: They are confounded, because they have committed abomination: yea rather they are not confounded with confusion, and they have not known how to blush: therefore shall they fall among them that fall; in the time of their visitation they shall fall, says the Lord .
text_la: Confusi sunt, quia abominationem fecerunt : quinimmo confusione non sunt confusi, et erubescere nescierunt. Idcirco cadent inter corruentes : in tempore visitationis suæ corruent, dicit Dominus.
text_pt: Porventura envergonham-se de cometerem abominação? Não; de maneira nenhuma se envergonham, nem sabem que coisa é envergonhar-se; portanto cairão entre os que caem e tropeçarão no tempo em que eu os visitar, diz o Senhor.

text_en: Gathering I will gather them together, says the Lord , there is no grape on the vines, and there are no figs on the fig tree, the leaf is fallen: and I have given them the things that are passed away.
text_la: Congregans congregabo eos, ait Dominus. Non est uva in vitibus, et non sunt ficus in ficulnea : folium defluxit, et dedi eis quæ prætergressa sunt.
text_pt: Certamente os apanharei, diz o Senhor; já não há uvas na vide, nem figos na figueira, e até a folha caiu; e o que lhes dei passará deles.
text_el: καὶ συνάξουσιν τὰ γενήματα αὐτῶν λέγει κύριος οὐκ ἔστιν σταφυλὴ ἐν ταῖς ἀμπέλοις καὶ οὐκ ἔστιν σῦκα ἐν ταῖς συκαῖς καὶ τὰ φύλλα κατερρύηκεν

text_en: Why do we sit still? Assemble yourselves, and let us enter into the fenced city, and let us be silent there: for the Lord our God has put us to silence, and has given us water of gall to drink: for we have sinned against the Lord .
text_la: Quare sedemus? convenite, et ingrediamur civitatem munitam, et sileamus ibi : quia Dominus Deus noster silere nos fecit, et potum dedit nobis aquam fellis : peccavimus enim Domino.
text_pt: Por que nos assentamos ainda? Juntai-vos e entremos nas cidades fortificadas, e ali pereçamos; pois já o Senhor nosso Deus nos destinou a perecer e nos deu a beber água de fel; porquanto pecamos contra o Senhor.
text_el: ἐπὶ τί ἡμεῖς καθήμεθα συνάχθητε καὶ εἰσέλθωμεν εἰς τὰς πόλεις τὰς ὀχυρὰς καὶ ἀπορριφῶμεν ὅτι ὁ θεὸς ἀπέρριψεν ἡμᾶς καὶ ἐπότισεν ἡμᾶς ὕδωρ χολῆς ὅτι ἡμάρτομεν ἐναντίον αὐτοῦ

text_en: We looked for peace and no good came: for a time of healing, and behold fear.
text_la: Exspectavimus pacem, et non erat bonum : tempus medelæ, et ecce formido.
text_pt: Espera-se a paz, mas não há bem; o tempo da cura, e eis o terror.
text_el: συνήχθημεν εἰς εἰρήνην καὶ οὐκ ἦν ἀγαθά εἰς καιρὸν ἰάσεως καὶ ἰδοὺ σπουδή

text_en: The snorting of his horses was heard from Dan , all the land was moved at the sound of the neighing of his warriors: and they came and devoured the land, and all that was in it: the city and its inhabitants.
text_la: A Dan auditus est fremitus equorum ejus; a voce hinnituum pugnatorum ejus commota est omnis terra : et venerunt, et devoraverunt terram et plenitudinem ejus; urbem et habitatores ejus.
text_pt: Já desde Dã se ouve o resfolegar dos seus cavalos, toda a terra treme ao som dos rinchos dos seus fortes; e vêm, e devoram a terra, e sua abundância, a cidade e os que habitam nela.
text_el: ἐκ Δαν ἀκουσόμεθα φωνὴν ὀξύτητος ἵππων αὐτοῦ ἀπὸ φωνῆς χρεμετισμοῦ ἱππασίας ἵππων αὐτοῦ ἐσείσθη πᾶσα ἡ γῆ καὶ ἥξει καὶ καταφάγεται τὴν γῆν καὶ τὸ πλήρωμα αὐτῆς πόλιν καὶ τοὺς κατοικοῦντας ἐν αὐτῇ

text_en: For behold I will send among you serpents, basilisks, against which there is no charm: and they shall bite you, says the Lord .
text_la: Quia ecce ego mittam vobis serpentes regulos, quibus non est incantatio : et mordebunt vos, ait Dominus.
text_pt: Porque eis que envio entre vós serpentes e basiliscos, contra os quais não há encantamento, e vos morderão, diz o Senhor.
text_el: διότι ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ ἐξαποστέλλω εἰς ὑμᾶς ὄφεις θανατοῦντας οἷς οὐκ ἔστιν ἐπᾷσαι καὶ δήξονται ὑμᾶς

text_en: My sorrow is above sorrow, my heart mourns within me.
text_la: Dolor meus super dolorem, in me cor meum mœrens.
text_pt: Oh! se eu pudesse consolar-me na minha tristeza! O meu coração desfalece em mim.
text_el: ἀνίατα μετ' ὀδύνης καρδίας ὑμῶν ἀπορουμένης

text_en: Behold the voice of the daughter of my people from a far country: Is not the Lord in Sion, or is not her king in her? Why then have they provoked me to wrath with their idols , and strange vanities?
text_la: Ecce vox clamoris filiæ populi mei de terra longinqua : Numquid Dominus non est in Sion? aut rex ejus non est in ea? Quare ergo me ad iracundiam concitaverunt in sculptilibus suis, et in vanitatibus alienis?
text_pt: Eis a voz do clamor da filha do meu povo de terra mui remota; não está o Senhor em Sião? Não está nela o seu rei? Por que me provocaram à ira com as suas imagens de escultura, com vaidades estranhas?
text_el: ἰδοὺ φωνὴ κραυγῆς θυγατρὸς λαοῦ μου ἀπὸ γῆς μακρόθεν μὴ κύριος οὐκ ἔστιν ἐν Σιων ἢ βασιλεὺς οὐκ ἔστιν ἐκεῖ διὰ τί παρώργισάν με ἐν τοῖς γλυπτοῖς αὐτῶν καὶ ἐν ματαίοις ἀλλοτρίοις

text_en: The harvest is past, the summer is ended, and we are not saved.
text_la: Transiit messis, finita est æstas, et nos salvati non sumus.
text_pt: Passou a sega, findou o verão, e nós não estamos salvos.
text_el: διῆλθεν θέρος παρῆλθεν ἄμητος καὶ ἡμεῖς οὐ διεσώθημεν

text_en: For the affliction of the daughter of my people I am afflicted, and made sorrowful, astonishment has taken hold on me.
text_la: Super contritione filiæ populi mei contritus sum, et contristatus : stupor obtinuit me.
text_pt: Estou quebrantado pela ferida da filha do meu povo; ando de luto; o espanto se apoderou de mim.
text_el: ἐπὶ συντρίμματι θυγατρὸς λαοῦ μου ἐσκοτώθην ἀπορίᾳ κατίσχυσάν με ὠδῖνες ὡς τικτούσης

text_en: Is there no balm in Galaad? Or is there no physician there? Why then is not the wound of the daughter of my people closed?
text_la: Numquid resina non est in Galaad? aut medicus non est ibi? quare igitur non est obducta cicatrix filiæ populi mei?
text_pt: Porventura não há bálsamo em Gileade? Ou não há lá médico? Por que, pois, não se realizou a cura da filha do meu povo?
text_el: μὴ ῥητίνη οὐκ ἔστιν ἐν Γαλααδ ἢ ἰατρὸς οὐκ ἔστιν ἐκεῖ διὰ τί οὐκ ἀνέβη ἴασις θυγατρὸς λαοῦ μου

text_en: Who will give water to my head, and a fountain of tears to my eyes? And I will weep day and night for the slain of the daughter of my people.
text_la: Quis dabit capiti meo aquam, et oculis meis fontem lacrimarum, et plorabo die ac nocte interfectos filiæ populi mei?
text_pt: Oh! se a minha cabeça se tornasse em águas, e os meus olhos numa fonte de lágrimas! Então choraria de dia e de noite os mortos da filha do meu povo.
text_el: τίς δώσει κεφαλῇ μου ὕδωρ καὶ ὀφθαλμοῖς μου πηγὴν δακρύων καὶ κλαύσομαι τὸν λαόν μου τοῦτον ἡμέρας καὶ νυκτός τοὺς τετραυματισμένους θυγατρὸς λαοῦ μου

text_en: Who will give me in the wilderness a lodging place of wayfaring men , and I will leave my people, and depart from them? Because they are all adulterers, an assembly of transgressors.
text_la: Quis dabit me in solitudine diversorium viatorum, et derelinquam populum meum, et recedam ab eis? quia omnes adulteri sunt, cœtus prævaricatorum.
text_pt: Oh! se tivesse no deserto uma estalagem de caminhantes! Então deixaria o meu povo, e me apartaria dele, porque todos eles são adúlteros, um bando de aleivosos.
text_el: τίς δῴη μοι ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ σταθμὸν ἔσχατον καὶ καταλείψω τὸν λαόν μου καὶ ἀπελεύσομαι ἀπ' αὐτῶν ὅτι πάντες μοιχῶνται σύνοδος ἀθετούντων

text_en: And they have bent their tongue, as a bow, for lies, and not for truth : they have strengthened themselves upon the earth, for they have proceeded from evil to evil , and me they have not known , says the Lord .
text_la: Et extenderunt linguam suam quasi arcum mendacii et non veritatis : confortati sunt in terra, quia de malo ad malum egressi sunt, et me non cognoverunt, dicit Dominus.
text_pt: E encurvam a língua como se fosse o seu arco, para a mentira; fortalecem-se na terra, mas não para a verdade; porque avançam de malícia em malícia, e a mim não me conhecem, diz o Senhor.
text_el: καὶ ἐνέτειναν τὴν γλῶσσαν αὐτῶν ὡς τόξον ψεῦδος καὶ οὐ πίστις ἐνίσχυσεν ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς ὅτι ἐκ κακῶν εἰς κακὰ ἐξήλθοσαν καὶ ἐμὲ οὐκ ἔγνωσαν

text_en: Let every man take heed of his neighbour, and let him not trust in any brother of his: for every brother will utterly supplant, and every friend will walk deceitfully.
text_la: Unusquisque se a proximo suo custodiat, et in omni fratre suo non habeat fiduciam : quia omnis frater supplantans supplantabit, et omnis amicus fraudulenter incedet.
text_pt: Guardai-vos cada um do seu próximo, e de irmão nenhum vos fieis; porque todo o irmão não faz mais do que enganar, e todo o próximo anda caluniando.
text_el: ἕκαστος ἀπὸ τοῦ πλησίον αὐτοῦ φυλάξασθε καὶ ἐπ' ἀδελφοῖς αὐτῶν μὴ πεποίθατε ὅτι πᾶς ἀδελφὸς πτέρνῃ πτερνιεῖ καὶ πᾶς φίλος δολίως πορεύσεται

text_en: And a man shall mock his brother, and they will not speak the truth : for they have taught their tongue to speak lies : they have laboured to commit iniquity .
text_la: Et vir fratrem suum deridebit, et veritatem non loquentur : docuerunt enim linguam suam loqui mendacium; ut inique agerent laboraverunt.
text_pt: E zombará cada um do seu próximo, e não falam a verdade; ensinam a sua língua a falar a mentira, andam-se cansando em proceder perversamente.
text_el: ἕκαστος κατὰ τοῦ φίλου αὐτοῦ καταπαίξεται ἀλήθειαν οὐ μὴ λαλήσωσιν μεμάθηκεν ἡ γλῶσσα αὐτῶν λαλεῖν ψευδῆ ἠδίκησαν καὶ οὐ διέλιπον τοῦ ἐπιστρέψαι

text_en: Your habitation is in the midst of deceit : through deceit they have refused to know me, says the Lord .
text_la: Habitatio tua in medio doli : in dolo renuerunt scire me, dicit Dominus.
text_pt: A tua habitação está no meio do engano; pelo engano recusam conhecer-me, diz o Senhor.
text_el: τόκος ἐπὶ τόκῳ δόλος ἐπὶ δόλῳ οὐκ ἤθελον εἰδέναι με

text_en: Therefore thus says the Lord of hosts : Behold I will melt, and try them: for what else shall I do before the daughter of my people?
text_la: Propterea hæc dicit Dominus exercituum : Ecce ego conflabo, et probabo eos : quid enim aliud faciam a facie filiæ populi mei?
text_pt: Portanto assim diz o Senhor dos Exércitos: Eis que eu os fundirei e os provarei; pois, de que outra maneira procederia com a filha do meu povo?
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο τάδε λέγει κύριος ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ πυρώσω αὐτοὺς καὶ δοκιμῶ αὐτούς ὅτι ποιήσω ἀπὸ προσώπου πονηρίας θυγατρὸς λαοῦ μου

text_en: Their tongue is a piercing arrow, it has spoken deceit : with his mouth one speaks peace with his friend, and secretly he lies in wait for him.
text_la: Sagitta vulnerans lingua eorum, dolum locuta est. In ore suo pacem cum amico suo loquitur, et occulte ponit ei insidias.
text_pt: Uma flecha mortífera é a língua deles; fala engano; com a sua boca fala cada um de paz com o seu próximo mas no seu coração arma-lhe ciladas.
text_el: βολὶς τιτρώσκουσα ἡ γλῶσσα αὐτῶν δόλια τὰ ῥήματα τοῦ στόματος αὐτῶν τῷ πλησίον αὐτοῦ λαλεῖ εἰρηνικὰ καὶ ἐν ἑαυτῷ ἔχει τὴν ἔχθραν

text_en: Shall I not visit them for these things, says the Lord ? Or shall not my soul be revenged on such a nation?
text_la: Numquid super his non visitabo, dicit Dominus, aut in gente hujusmodi non ulciscetur anima mea?
text_pt: Porventura por estas coisas não os castigaria? diz o Senhor; ou não se vingaria a minha alma de nação tal como esta?
text_el: μὴ ἐπὶ τούτοις οὐκ ἐπισκέψομαι λέγει κύριος ἢ ἐν λαῷ τῷ τοιούτῳ οὐκ ἐκδικήσει ἡ ψυχή μου

text_en: For the mountains I will take up weeping and lamentation, and for the beautiful places of the desert , mourning: because they are burnt up, for that there is not a man that passes through them: and they have not heard the voice of the owner: from the fowl of the air to the beasts they have gone away and departed.
text_la: Super montes assumam fletum ac lamentum, et super speciosa deserti planctum, quoniam incensa sunt, eo quod non sit vir pertransiens, et non audierunt vocem possidentis : a volucre cæli usque ad pecora transmigraverunt et recesserunt.
text_pt: Pelos montes levantarei choro e pranto, e pelas pastagens do deserto lamentação; porque já estão queimadas, e ninguém passa por elas; nem se ouve mugido de gado; desde as aves dos céus, até os animais, andaram vagueando, e fugiram.
text_el: ἐπὶ τὰ ὄρη λάβετε κοπετὸν καὶ ἐπὶ τὰς τρίβους τῆς ἐρήμου θρῆνον ὅτι ἐξέλιπον παρὰ τὸ μὴ εἶναι ἀνθρώπους οὐκ ἤκουσαν φωνὴν ὑπάρξεως ἀπὸ πετεινῶν τοῦ οὐρανοῦ καὶ ἕως κτηνῶν ἐξέστησαν ᾤχοντο

text_en: And I will make Jerusalem to be heaps of sand, and dens of dragons: and I will make the cities of Juda desolate, for want of an inhabitant.
text_la: Et dabo Jerusalem in acervos arenæ, et cubilia draconum : et civitates Juda dabo in desolationem, eo quod non sit habitator.
text_pt: E farei de Jerusalém montões de pedras, morada de chacais, e das cidades de Judá farei assolação, de sorte que não haja habitante.
text_el: καὶ δώσω τὴν Ιερουσαλημ εἰς μετοικίαν καὶ εἰς κατοικητήριον δρακόντων καὶ τὰς πόλεις Ιουδα εἰς ἀφανισμὸν θήσομαι παρὰ τὸ μὴ κατοικεῖσθαι

text_en: Who is the wise man , that may understand this, and to whom the word of the mouth of the Lord may come that he may declare this, why the land has perished, and is burnt up like a wilderness , which none passes through?
text_la: Quis est vir sapiens qui intelligat hoc, et ad quem verbum oris Domini fiat, ut annuntiet istud, quare perierit terra, et exusta sit quasi desertum, eo quod non sit qui pertranseat?
text_pt: Quem é o homem sábio, que entenda isto? e a quem falou a boca do Senhor, para que o possa anunciar? Por que razão pereceu a terra, e se queimou como deserto, sem que ninguém passa por ela?
text_el: τίς ὁ ἄνθρωπος ὁ συνετός καὶ συνέτω τοῦτο καὶ ᾧ λόγος στόματος κυρίου πρὸς αὐτόν ἀναγγειλάτω ὑμῖν ἕνεκεν τίνος ἀπώλετο ἡ γῆ ἀνήφθη ὡς ἔρημος παρὰ τὸ μὴ διοδεύεσθαι αὐτήν

text_en: And the Lord said: Because they have forsaken my law, which I gave them, and have not heard my voice, and have not walked in it.
text_la: Et dixit Dominus : Quia dereliquerunt legem meam quam dedi eis, et non audierunt vocem meam, et non ambulaverunt in ea,
text_pt: E disse o Senhor: Porque deixaram a minha lei, que pus perante eles, e não deram ouvidos à minha voz, nem andaram nela,
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν κύριος πρός με διὰ τὸ ἐγκαταλιπεῖν αὐτοὺς τὸν νόμον μου ὃν ἔδωκα πρὸ προσώπου αὐτῶν καὶ οὐκ ἤκουσαν τῆς φωνῆς μου

text_en: But they have gone after the perverseness of their own heart, and after Baalim , which their fathers taught them.
text_la: et abierunt post pravitatem cordis sui, et post Baalim, quod didicerunt a patribus suis :
text_pt: Antes andaram após o propósito do seu próprio coração, e após os baalins, como lhes ensinaram os seus pais.
text_el: ἀλλ' ἐπορεύθησαν ὀπίσω τῶν ἀρεστῶν τῆς καρδίας αὐτῶν τῆς κακῆς καὶ ὀπίσω τῶν εἰδώλων ἃ ἐδίδαξαν αὐτοὺς οἱ πατέρες αὐτῶν

text_en: Therefore thus says the Lord of hosts the God of Israel : Behold I will feed this people with wormwood , and give them water of gall to drink.
text_la: idcirco hæc dicit Dominus exercituum, Deus Israël : Ecce ego cibabo populum istum absinthio, et potum dabo eis aquam fellis.
text_pt: Portanto assim diz o Senhor dos Exércitos, Deus de Israel: Eis que darei de comer losna a este povo, e lhe darei a beber água de fel.
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο τάδε λέγει κύριος ὁ θεὸς Ισραηλ ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ ψωμιῶ αὐτοὺς ἀνάγκας καὶ ποτιῶ αὐτοὺς ὕδωρ χολῆς

text_en: And I will scatter them among the nations, which they and their fathers have not known : and I will send the sword after them till they be consumed.
text_la: Et dispergam eos in gentibus quas non noverunt ipsi et patres eorum, et mittam post eos gladium, donec consumantur.
text_pt: E os espalharei entre gentios, que não conheceram, nem eles nem seus pais, e mandarei a espada após eles, até que venha a consumi-los.
text_el: καὶ διασκορπιῶ αὐτοὺς ἐν τοῖς ἔθνεσιν εἰς οὓς οὐκ ἐγίνωσκον αὐτοὶ καὶ οἱ πατέρες αὐτῶν καὶ ἐπαποστελῶ ἐπ' αὐτοὺς τὴν μάχαιραν ἕως τοῦ ἐξαναλῶσαι αὐτοὺς ἐν αὐτῇ

text_en: Thus says the Lord of hosts the God of Israel : Consider, and call for the mourning women , and let them come: and send to them that are wise women , and let them make haste:
text_la: Hæc dicit Dominus exercituum, Deus Israël : Contemplamini, et vocate lamentatrices, et veniant : et ad eas quæ sapientes sunt mittite, et properent :
text_pt: Assim diz o Senhor dos Exércitos: Considerai, e chamai carpideiras que venham; e mandai procurar mulheres hábeis, para que venham.
text_el: τάδε λέγει κύριος καλέσατε τὰς θρηνούσας καὶ ἐλθέτωσαν καὶ πρὸς τὰς σοφὰς ἀποστείλατε καὶ φθεγξάσθωσαν

text_en: Let them hasten and take up a lamentation for us: let our eyes shed tears, and our eyelids run down with waters.
text_la: festinent, et assumant super nos lamentum : deducant oculi nostri lacrimas, et palpebræ nostræ defluant aquis.
text_pt: E se apressem, e levantem o seu lamento sobre nós; e desfaçam-se em lágrimas os nossos olhos, e as nossas pálpebras destilem águas.
text_el: καὶ λαβέτωσαν ἐφ' ὑμᾶς θρῆνον καὶ καταγαγέτωσαν οἱ ὀφθαλμοὶ ὑμῶν δάκρυα καὶ τὰ βλέφαρα ὑμῶν ῥείτω ὕδωρ

text_en: For a voice of wailing is heard out of Sion: How are we wasted and greatly confounded? Because we have left the land, because our dwellings are cast down.
text_la: Quia vox lamentationis audita est de Sion : Quomodo vastati sumus, et confusi vehementer? quia dereliquimus terram; quoniam dejecta sunt tabernacula nostra.
text_pt: Porque uma voz de pranto se ouviu de Sião: Como estamos arruinados! Estamos mui envergonhados, porque deixamos a terra, e por terem eles lançado fora as nossas moradas.
text_el: ὅτι φωνὴ οἴκτου ἠκούσθη ἐν Σιων πῶς ἐταλαιπωρήσαμεν κατῃσχύνθημεν σφόδρα ὅτι ἐγκατελίπομεν τὴν γῆν καὶ ἀπερρίψαμεν τὰ σκηνώματα ἡμῶν

text_en: Hear therefore, you women , the word of the Lord : and let your ears receive the word of his mouth: and teach your daughters wailing: and every one her neighbour mourning.
text_la: Audite ergo, mulieres, verbum Domini, et assumant aures vestræ sermonem oris ejus, et docete filias vestras lamentum, et unaquæque proximam suam planctum :
text_pt: Ouvi, pois, vós, mulheres, a palavra do Senhor, e os vossos ouvidos recebam a palavra da sua boca; e ensinai o pranto a vossas filhas, e cada uma à sua vizinha a lamentação;
text_el: ἀκούσατε δή γυναῖκες λόγον θεοῦ καὶ δεξάσθω τὰ ὦτα ὑμῶν λόγους στόματος αὐτοῦ καὶ διδάξατε τὰς θυγατέρας ὑμῶν οἶκτον καὶ γυνὴ τὴν πλησίον αὐτῆς θρῆνον

text_en: For death has come up through our windows, it is entered into our houses to destroy the children from without, the young men from the streets.
text_la: quia ascendit mors per fenestras nostras; ingressa est domos nostras, disperdere parvulos deforis, juvenes de plateis.
text_pt: Porque a morte subiu pelas nossas janelas, e entrou em nossos palácios, para exterminar as crianças das ruas e os jovens das praças.
text_el: ὅτι ἀνέβη θάνατος διὰ τῶν θυρίδων ὑμῶν εἰσῆλθεν εἰς τὴν γῆν ὑμῶν τοῦ ἐκτρῖψαι νήπια ἔξωθεν καὶ νεανίσκους ἀπὸ τῶν πλατειῶν

text_en: Speak: Thus says the Lord : Even the carcass of man shall fall as dung upon the face of the country, and as grass behind the back of the mower, and there is none to gather it.
text_la: Loquere : Hæc dicit Dominus : Et cadet morticinum hominis quasi stercus super faciem regionis, et quasi fœnum post tergum metentis, et non est qui colligat.
text_pt: Fala: Assim diz o Senhor: Até os cadáveres dos homens jazerão como esterco sobre a face do campo, e como gavela atrás do segador, e não há quem a recolha.
text_el: καὶ ἔσονται οἱ νεκροὶ τῶν ἀνθρώπων εἰς παράδειγμα ἐπὶ προσώπου τοῦ πεδίου τῆς γῆς ὑμῶν καὶ ὡς χόρτος ὀπίσω θερίζοντος καὶ οὐκ ἔσται ὁ συνάγων

text_en: Thus says the Lord : Let not the wise man glory in his wisdom, and let not the strong man glory in his strength, and let not the rich man glory in his riches:
text_la: Hæc dicit Dominus : Non glorietur sapiens in sapientia sua, et non glorietur fortis in fortitudine sua, et non glorietur dives in divitiis suis :
text_pt: Assim diz o Senhor: Não se glorie o sábio na sua sabedoria, nem se glorie o forte na sua força; não se glorie o rico nas suas riquezas,
text_el: τάδε λέγει κύριος μὴ καυχάσθω ὁ σοφὸς ἐν τῇ σοφίᾳ αὐτοῦ καὶ μὴ καυχάσθω ὁ ἰσχυρὸς ἐν τῇ ἰσχύι αὐτοῦ καὶ μὴ καυχάσθω ὁ πλούσιος ἐν τῷ πλούτῳ αὐτοῦ

text_en: But let him that glories glory in this, that he understands and knows me, for I am the Lord that exercise mercy, and judgment, and justice in the earth: for these things please me, says the Lord .
text_la: sed in hoc glorietur, qui gloriatur, scire et nosse me, quia ego sum Dominus qui facio misericordiam, et judicium, et justitiam in terra : hæc enim placent mihi, ait Dominus.
text_pt: Mas o que se gloriar, glorie-se nisto: em me entender e me conhecer, que eu sou o Senhor, que faço beneficência, juízo e justiça na terra; porque destas coisas me agrado, diz o Senhor.
text_el: ἀλλ' ἢ ἐν τούτῳ καυχάσθω ὁ καυχώμενος συνίειν καὶ γινώσκειν ὅτι ἐγώ εἰμι κύριος ποιῶν ἔλεος καὶ κρίμα καὶ δικαιοσύνην ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς ὅτι ἐν τούτοις τὸ θέλημά μου λέγει κύριος

text_en: Behold, the days come, says the Lord , and I will visit upon every one that has the foreskin circumcised .
text_la: Ecce dies veniunt, dicit Dominus, et visitabo super omnem qui circumcisum habet præputium,
text_pt: Eis que vêm dias, diz o Senhor, em que castigarei a todo o circuncidado com o incircunciso.
text_el: ἰδοὺ ἡμέραι ἔρχονται λέγει κύριος καὶ ἐπισκέψομαι ἐπὶ πάντας περιτετμημένους ἀκροβυστίας αὐτῶν

text_en: Upon Egypt , and upon Juda , and upon Edom , and upon the children of Ammon , and upon Moab , and upon all that have their hair polled round, that dwell in the desert : for all the nations are uncircumcised in the flesh, but all the house of Israel are uncircumcised in the heart.
text_la: super Ægyptum, et super Juda, et super Edom, et super filios Ammon, et super Moab; et super omnes qui attonsi sunt in comam, habitantes in deserto : quia omnes gentes habent præputium, omnis autem domus Israël incircumcisi sunt corde.
text_pt: Ao Egito, e a Judá, e a Edom, e aos filhos de Amom, e a Moabe, e a todos os que cortam os cantos do seu cabelo, que habitam no deserto; porque todas as nações são incircuncisas, e toda a casa de Israel é incircuncisa de coração.
text_el: ἐπ' Αἴγυπτον καὶ ἐπὶ τὴν Ιουδαίαν καὶ ἐπὶ Εδωμ καὶ ἐπὶ υἱοὺς Αμμων καὶ ἐπὶ υἱοὺς Μωαβ καὶ ἐπὶ πάντα περικειρόμενον τὰ κατὰ πρόσωπον αὐτοῦ τοὺς κατοικοῦντας ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ ὅτι πάντα τὰ ἔθνη ἀπερίτμητα σαρκί καὶ πᾶς οἶκος Ισραηλ ἀπερίτμητοι καρδίας αὐτῶν

text_en: Hear the word which the Lord has spoken concerning you, O house of Israel .
text_la: Audite verbum quod locutus est Dominus super vos, domus Israël.
text_pt: Ouvi a palavra que o SENHOR vos fala a vós, ó casa de Israel.
text_el: ἀκούσατε τὸν λόγον κυρίου ὃν ἐλάλησεν ἐφ' ὑμᾶς οἶκος Ισραηλ

text_en: Thus says the Lord : Learn not according to the ways of the Gentiles : and be not afraid of the signs of heaven , which the heathens fear:
text_la: Hæc dicit Dominus : Juxta vias gentium nolite discere, et a signis cæli nolite metuere, quæ timent gentes,
text_pt: Assim diz o Senhor: Não aprendais o caminho dos gentios, nem vos espanteis dos sinais dos céus; porque com eles se atemorizam as nações.
text_el: τάδε λέγει κύριος κατὰ τὰς ὁδοὺς τῶν ἐθνῶν μὴ μανθάνετε καὶ ἀπὸ τῶν σημείων τοῦ οὐρανοῦ μὴ φοβεῖσθε ὅτι φοβοῦνται αὐτὰ τοῖς προσώποις αὐτῶν

text_en: For the laws of the people are vain: for the works of the hand of the workman has cut a tree out of the forest with an axe.
text_la: quia leges populorum vanæ sunt. Quia lignum de saltu præcidit opus manus artificis in ascia :
text_pt: Porque os costumes dos povos são vaidade; pois corta-se do bosque um madeiro, obra das mãos do artífice, feita com machado;
text_el: ὅτι τὰ νόμιμα τῶν ἐθνῶν μάταια ξύλον ἐστὶν ἐκ τοῦ δρυμοῦ ἐκκεκομμένον ἔργον τέκτονος καὶ χώνευμα

text_en: He has decked it with silver and gold: he has put it together with nails and hammers, that it may not fall asunder.
text_la: argento et auro decoravit illud : clavis et malleis compegit, ut non dissolvatur :
text_pt: Com prata e com ouro o enfeitam, com pregos e com martelos o firmam, para que não se mova.
text_el: ἀργυρίῳ καὶ χρυσίῳ κεκαλλωπισμένα ἐστίν ἐν σφύραις καὶ ἥλοις ἐστερέωσαν αὐτά καὶ οὐ κινηθήσονται

text_en: They are framed after the likeness of a palm tree, and shall not speak: they must be carried to be removed, because they cannot go. Therefore fear them not, for they can neither do evil nor good .
text_la: in similitudinem palmæ fabricata sunt, et non loquentur : portata tollentur, quia incedere non valent. Nolite ergo timere ea, quia nec male possunt facere, nec bene.
text_pt: São como a palmeira, obra torneada, porém não podem falar; certamente são levados, porquanto não podem andar. Não tenhais receio deles, pois não podem fazer mal, nem tampouco têm poder de fazer bem.
text_el: αἰρόμενα ἀρθήσονται ὅτι οὐκ ἐπιβήσονται μὴ φοβηθῆτε αὐτά ὅτι οὐ μὴ κακοποιήσωσιν καὶ ἀγαθὸν οὐκ ἔστιν ἐν αὐτοῖς

text_en: There is none like to you, O Lord : you are great, and great is your name in might.
text_la: Non est similis tui, Domine : magnus es tu, et magnum nomen tuum in fortitudine.
text_pt: Ninguém há semelhante a ti, ó Senhor; tu és grande, e grande o teu nome em poder.

text_en: Who shall not fear you, O king of nations? For yours is the glory : among all the wise men of the nations, and in all their kingdoms there is none like unto you.
text_la: Quis non timebit te, o Rex gentium? tuum est enim decus : inter cunctos sapientes gentium, et in universis regnis eorum, nullus est similis tui.
text_pt: Quem não te temeria a ti, ó Rei das nações? Pois isto só a ti pertence; porquanto entre todos os sábios das nações, e em todo o seu reino, ninguém há semelhante a ti.

text_en: They shall be all proved together to be senseless and foolish: the doctrine of their vanity is wood.
text_la: Pariter insipientes et fatui probabuntur : doctrina vanitatis eorum lignum est.
text_pt: Mas eles todos se embruteceram e tornaram-se loucos; ensino de vaidade é o madeiro.

text_en: Silver spread into plates is brought from Tharsis, and gold from Ophaz: the work of the artificer, and of the hand of the coppersmith: violet and purple is their clothing: all these things are the work of artificers.
text_la: Argentum involutum de Tharsis affertur, et aurum de Ophaz : opus artificis et manus ærarii. Hyacinthus et purpura indumentum eorum : opus artificum universa hæc.
text_pt: Trazem prata batida de Társis e ouro de Ufaz, trabalho do artífice, e das mãos do fundidor; fazem suas roupas de azul e púrpura; obra de peritos são todos eles.
text_el: ἀργύριον τορευτόν ἐστιν οὐ πορεύσονται ἀργύριον προσβλητὸν ἀπὸ Θαρσις ἥξει χρυσίον Μωφαζ καὶ χεὶρ χρυσοχόων ἔργα τεχνιτῶν πάντα ὑάκινθον καὶ πορφύραν ἐνδύσουσιν αὐτά

text_en: But the Lord is the true God : he is the living God , and the everlasting king: at his wrath the earth shall tremble, and the nations shall not be able to abide his threatening.
text_la: Dominus autem Deus verus est, ipse Deus vivens, et rex sempiternus. Ab indignatione ejus commovebitur terra, et non sustinebunt gentes comminationem ejus.
text_pt: Mas o Senhor Deus é a verdade; ele mesmo é o Deus vivo e o Rei eterno; ao seu furor treme a terra, e as nações não podem suportar a sua indignação.

text_en: Thus then shall you say to them: The gods that have not made heaven and earth, let them perish from the earth, and from among those places that are under heaven .
text_la: Sic ergo dicetis eis : Dii qui cælos et terram non fecerunt, pereant de terra et de his quæ sub cælo sunt!
text_pt: Assim lhes direis: Os deuses que não fizeram os céus e a terra desaparecerão da terra e de debaixo deste céu.
text_el: οὕτως ἐρεῖτε αὐτοῖς θεοί οἳ τὸν οὐρανὸν καὶ τὴν γῆν οὐκ ἐποίησαν ἀπολέσθωσαν ἀπὸ τῆς γῆς καὶ ὑποκάτωθεν τοῦ οὐρανοῦ τούτου

text_en: He that makes the earth by his power, that prepares the world by his wisdom, and stretches out the heavens by his knowledge .
text_la: Qui facit terram in fortitudine sua, præparat orbem in sapientia sua, et prudentia sua extendit cælos :
text_pt: Ele fez a terra com o seu poder; ele estabeleceu o mundo com a sua sabedoria, e com a sua inteligência estendeu os céus.
text_el: κύριος ὁ ποιήσας τὴν γῆν ἐν τῇ ἰσχύι αὐτοῦ ὁ ἀνορθώσας τὴν οἰκουμένην ἐν τῇ σοφίᾳ αὐτοῦ καὶ τῇ φρονήσει αὐτοῦ ἐξέτεινεν τὸν οὐρανὸν

text_en: At his voice he gives a multitude of waters in the heaven , and lifts up the clouds from the ends of the earth: he makes lightnings for rain, and brings forth the wind out of his treasures.
text_la: ad vocem suam dat multitudinem aquarum in cælo, et elevat nebulas ab extremitatibus terræ : fulgura in pluviam facit, et educit ventum de thesauris suis.
text_pt: Fazendo ele soar a sua voz, logo há rumor de águas no céu, e faz subir os vapores da extremidade da terra; faz os relâmpagos para a chuva, e dos seus tesouros faz sair o vento.
text_el: καὶ πλῆθος ὕδατος ἐν οὐρανῷ καὶ ἀνήγαγεν νεφέλας ἐξ ἐσχάτου τῆς γῆς ἀστραπὰς εἰς ὑετὸν ἐποίησεν καὶ ἐξήγαγεν φῶς ἐκ θησαυρῶν αὐτοῦ

text_en: Every man has become a fool for knowledge , every artist is confounded in his graven idol : for what he has cast is false , and there is no spirit in them.
text_la: Stultus factus est omnis homo a scientia : confusus est artifex omnis in sculptili, quoniam falsum est quod conflavit, et non est spiritus in eis.
text_pt: Todo o homem é embrutecido no seu conhecimento; envergonha-se todo o fundidor da sua imagem de escultura; porque sua imagem fundida é mentira, e nelas não há espírito.
text_el: ἐμωράνθη πᾶς ἄνθρωπος ἀπὸ γνώσεως κατῃσχύνθη πᾶς χρυσοχόος ἐπὶ τοῖς γλυπτοῖς αὐτοῦ ὅτι ψευδῆ ἐχώνευσαν οὐκ ἔστιν πνεῦμα ἐν αὐτοῖς

text_en: They are vain things, and a ridiculous work: in the time of their visitation they shall perish.
text_la: Vana sunt, et opus risu dignum : in tempore visitationis suæ peribunt.
text_pt: Vaidade são, obra de enganos: no tempo da sua visitação virão a perecer.
text_el: μάταιά ἐστιν ἔργα ἐμπεπαιγμένα ἐν καιρῷ ἐπισκοπῆς αὐτῶν ἀπολοῦνται

text_en: The portion of Jacob is not like these: for it is he who formed all things: and Israel is the rod of his inheritance: the Lord of hosts is his name .
text_la: Non est his similis pars Jacob : qui enim formavit omnia, ipse est, et Israël virga hæreditatis ejus : Dominus exercituum nomen illi.
text_pt: Não é semelhante a estes aquele que é a porção de Jacó; porque ele é o que formou tudo, e Israel é a vara da sua herança: Senhor dos Exércitos é o seu nome.
text_el: οὐκ ἔστιν τοιαύτη μερὶς τῷ Ιακωβ ὅτι ὁ πλάσας τὰ πάντα αὐτὸς κληρονομία αὐτοῦ κύριος ὄνομα αὐτῷ

text_en: Gather up your shame out of the land, you that dwell in a siege.
text_la: Congrega de terra confusionem tuam, quæ habitas in obsidione :
text_pt: Ajunta da terra a tua mercadoria, ó tu que habitas em lugar sitiado.
text_el: συνήγαγεν ἔξωθεν τὴν ὑπόστασίν σου κατοικοῦσα ἐν ἐκλεκτοῖς

text_en: For thus says he Lord : Behold I will cast away far off the inhabitants of the land at this time: and I will afflict them, so that they may be found.
