text_la: quia hæc dicit Dominus : Ecce ego longe projiciam habitatores terræ in hac vice, et tribulabo eos ita ut inveniantur.
text_pt: Porque assim diz o Senhor: Eis que desta vez arrojarei como se fora com uma funda aos moradores da terra, e os angustiarei, para que venham a achá-lo, dizendo:
text_el: ὅτι τάδε λέγει κύριος ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ σκελίζω τοὺς κατοικοῦντας τὴν γῆν ταύτην ἐν θλίψει ὅπως εὑρεθῇ ἡ πληγή σου

text_en: Woe is me for my destruction, my wound is very grievous. But I said: Truly this is my own evil , and I will bear it.
text_la: Væ mihi super contritione mea : pessima plaga mea. Ego autem dixi : Plane hæc infirmitas mea est, et portabo illam.
text_pt: Ai de mim por causa do meu quebrantamento! A minha chaga me causa grande dor; e eu havia dito: Certamente isto é enfermidade que eu poderei suportar.
text_el: οὐαὶ ἐπὶ συντρίμματί σου ἀλγηρὰ ἡ πληγή σου κἀγὼ εἶπα ὄντως τοῦτο τὸ τραῦμά μου καὶ κατέλαβέν με

text_en: My tabernacle is laid waste, all my cords are broken: my children have gone out from me, and they are not: there is none to stretch forth my tent any more, and to set up my curtains.
text_la: Tabernaculum meum vastatum est; omnes funiculi mei dirupti sunt : filii mei exierunt a me, et non subsistunt. Non est qui extendat ultra tentorium meum, et erigat pelles meas.
text_pt: A minha tenda está destruída, e todas as minhas cordas se romperam; os meus filhos foram-se de mim, e não existem; ninguém há mais que estenda a minha tenda, nem que levante as minhas cortinas,
text_el: ἡ σκηνή μου ἐταλαιπώρησεν ὤλετο καὶ πᾶσαι αἱ δέρρεις μου διεσπάσθησαν οἱ υἱοί μου καὶ τὰ πρόβατά μου οὔκ εἰσιν οὐκ ἔστιν ἔτι τόπος τῆς σκηνῆς μου τόπος τῶν δέρρεών μου

text_en: Because the pastors have done foolishly, and have not sought the Lord : therefore have they not understood, and all their flock is scattered .
text_la: Quia stulte egerunt pastores, et Dominum non quæsierunt : propterea non intellexerunt, et omnis grex eorum dispersus est.
text_pt: Porque os pastores se embruteceram, e não buscaram ao Senhor; por isso não prosperaram, e todos os seus rebanhos se espalharam.
text_el: ὅτι οἱ ποιμένες ἠφρονεύσαντο καὶ τὸν κύριον οὐκ ἐξεζήτησαν διὰ τοῦτο οὐκ ἐνόησεν πᾶσα ἡ νομὴ καὶ διεσκορπίσθησαν

text_en: Behold the sound of a noise comes, a great commotion out of the land of the north: to make the cities of Juda a desert , and a dwelling for dragons.
text_la: Vox auditionis ecce venit, et commotio magna de terra aquilonis : ut ponat civitates Juda solitudinem, et habitaculum draconum.
text_pt: Eis que vem uma voz de rumor, grande tremor da terra do norte, para fazer das cidades de Judá uma assolação, uma morada de chacais.
text_el: φωνὴ ἀκοῆς ἰδοὺ ἔρχεται καὶ σεισμὸς μέγας ἐκ γῆς βορρᾶ τοῦ τάξαι τὰς πόλεις Ιουδα εἰς ἀφανισμὸν καὶ κοίτην στρουθῶν

text_en: I know , O Lord , that the way of a man is not his: neither is it in a man to walk, and to direct his steps.
text_la: Scio, Domine, quia non est hominis via ejus, nec viri est ut ambulet, et dirigat gressus suos.
text_pt: Eu sei, ó Senhor, que não é do homem o seu caminho; nem do homem que caminha o dirigir os seus passos.
text_el: οἶδα κύριε ὅτι οὐχὶ τοῦ ἀνθρώπου ἡ ὁδὸς αὐτοῦ οὐδὲ ἀνὴρ πορεύσεται καὶ κατορθώσει πορείαν αὐτοῦ

text_en: Correct me, O Lord , but yet with judgment: and not in your fury, lest you bring me to nothing.
text_la: Corripe me, Domine, verumtamen in judicio, et non in furore tuo, ne forte ad nihilum redigas me.
text_pt: Castiga-me, ó Senhor, porém com juízo, não na tua ira, para que não me reduzas a nada.
text_el: παίδευσον ἡμᾶς κύριε πλὴν ἐν κρίσει καὶ μὴ ἐν θυμῷ ἵνα μὴ ὀλίγους ἡμᾶς ποιήσῃς

text_en: Pour out your indignation upon the nations that have not known you, and upon the provinces that have not called upon your name : because they have eaten up Jacob , and devoured him, and consumed him, and have destroyed his glory .
text_la: Effunde indignationem tuam super gentes quæ non cognoverunt te, et super provincias quæ nomen tuum non invocaverunt : quia comederunt Jacob, et devoraverunt eum, et consumpserunt illum, et decus ejus dissipaverunt.
text_pt: Derrama a tua indignação sobre os gentios que não te conhecem, e sobre as gerações que não invocam o teu nome; porque devoraram a Jacó, e devoraram-no e consumiram-no, e assolaram a sua morada.
text_el: ἔκχεον τὸν θυμόν σου ἐπὶ ἔθνη τὰ μὴ εἰδότα σε καὶ ἐπὶ γενεὰς αἳ τὸ ὄνομά σου οὐκ ἐπεκαλέσαντο ὅτι κατέφαγον τὸν Ιακωβ καὶ ἐξανήλωσαν αὐτὸν καὶ τὴν νομὴν αὐτοῦ ἠρήμωσαν

text_en: The word that came from the Lord to Jeremias, saying:
text_la: Verbum quod factum est a Domino ad Jeremiam, dicens:
text_pt: A palavra que veio a Jeremias, da parte do SENHOR, dizendo:
text_el: ὁ λόγος ὁ γενόμενος παρὰ κυρίου πρὸς Ιερεμιαν λέγων

text_en: Hear the words of this covenant, and speak to the men of Juda , and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem ,
text_la: Audite verba pacti hujus, et loquimini ad viros Juda, et ad habitatores Jerusalem,
text_pt: Ouvi as palavras desta aliança, e falai aos homens de Judá, e aos habitantes de Jerusalém.
text_el: ἀκούσατε τοὺς λόγους τῆς διαθήκης ταύτης καὶ λαλήσεις πρὸς ἄνδρας Ιουδα καὶ πρὸς τοὺς κατοικοῦντας Ιερουσαλημ

text_en: and you shall say to them: Thus says the Lord the God of Israel : Cursed is the man that shall not hearken to the words of this covenant,
text_la: et dices ad eos : Hæc dicit Dominus Deus Israël : Maledictus vir qui non audierit verba pacti hujus
text_pt: Dize-lhes pois: Assim diz o Senhor Deus de Israel: Maldito o homem que não escutar as palavras desta aliança,
text_el: καὶ ἐρεῖς πρὸς αὐτούς τάδε λέγει κύριος ὁ θεὸς Ισραηλ ἐπικατάρατος ὁ ἄνθρωπος ὃς οὐκ ἀκούσεται τῶν λόγων τῆς διαθήκης ταύτης

text_en: which I commanded your fathers in the day that I brought them out of the land of Egypt , from the iron furnace, saying: Hear my voice, and do all things that I command you: and you shall be my people, and I will be your God :
text_la: quod præcepi patribus vestris, in die qua eduxi eos de terra Ægypti, de fornace ferrea, dicens : Audite vocem meam, et facite omnia quæ præcipio vobis, et eritis mihi in populum, et ego ero vobis in Deum :
text_pt: Que ordenei a vossos pais no dia em que os tirei da terra do Egito, da fornalha de ferro, dizendo: Dai ouvidos à minha voz, e fazei conforme a tudo quanto vos mando; e vós sereis o meu povo, e eu serei o vosso Deus.
text_el: ἧς ἐνετειλάμην τοῖς πατράσιν ὑμῶν ἐν ἡμέρᾳ ᾗ ἀνήγαγον αὐτοὺς ἐκ γῆς Αἰγύπτου ἐκ καμίνου τῆς σιδηρᾶς λέγων ἀκούσατε τῆς φωνῆς μου καὶ ποιήσατε πάντα ὅσα ἐὰν ἐντείλωμαι ὑμῖν καὶ ἔσεσθέ μοι εἰς λαόν καὶ ἐγὼ ἔσομαι ὑμῖν εἰς θεόν

text_en: That I may accomplish the oath which I swore to your fathers, to give them a land flowing with milk and honey, as it is this day. And I answered and said: Amen , O Lord .
text_la: ut suscitem juramentum quod juravi patribus vestris, daturum me eis terram fluentem lacte et melle, sicut est dies hæc. Et respondi, et dixi : Amen, Domine.
text_pt: Para que confirme o juramento que fiz a vossos pais de dar-lhes uma terra que manasse leite e mel, como se vê neste dia. Então eu respondi, e disse: Amém, ó Senhor.
text_el: ὅπως στήσω τὸν ὅρκον μου ὃν ὤμοσα τοῖς πατράσιν ὑμῶν τοῦ δοῦναι αὐτοῖς γῆν ῥέουσαν γάλα καὶ μέλι καθὼς ἡ ἡμέρα αὕτη καὶ ἀπεκρίθην καὶ εἶπα γένοιτο κύριε

text_en: And the Lord said to me: Proclaim aloud all these words in the cities of Juda , and in the streets of Jerusalem , saying: Hear the words of the covenant, and do them:
text_la: Et dixit Dominus ad me : Vociferare omnia verba hæc in civitatibus Juda, et foris Jerusalem, dicens : Audite verba pacti hujus, et facite illa,
text_pt: E disse-me o Senhor: Apregoa todas estas palavras nas cidades de Judá, e nas ruas de Jerusalém, dizendo: Ouvi as palavras desta aliança, e cumpri-as.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν κύριος πρός με ἀνάγνωθι τοὺς λόγους τούτους ἐν πόλεσιν Ιουδα καὶ ἔξωθεν Ιερουσαλημ λέγων ἀκούσατε τοὺς λόγους τῆς διαθήκης ταύτης καὶ ποιήσατε αὐτούς

text_en: For protesting I conjured your fathers in the day that I brought them out of the land of Egypt even to this day: rising early I conjured them, and said: Hearken to my voice:
text_la: quia contestans contestatus sum patres vestros, in die qua eduxi eos de terra Ægypti, usque ad diem hanc : mane consurgens contestatus sum, et dixi : Audite vocem meam.
text_pt: Porque deveras adverti a vossos pais, no dia em que os tirei da terra do Egito, até ao dia de hoje, madrugando, e protestando, e dizendo: Dai ouvidos à minha voz.

text_en: And they obeyed not, nor inclined their ear: but walked every one in the perverseness of his own wicked heart: and I brought upon them all the words of this covenant, which I commanded them to do, but they did them not.
text_la: Et non audierunt, nec inclinaverunt aurem suam, sed abierunt, unusquisque in pravitate cordis sui mali : et induxi super eos omnia verba pacti hujus quod præcepi ut facerent, et non fecerunt.
text_pt: Mas não ouviram, nem inclinaram os seus ouvidos, antes andaram cada um conforme o propósito do seu coração malvado; por isso trouxe sobre eles todas as palavras desta aliança que lhes mandei que cumprissem, porém não cumpriram.
text_el: καὶ οὐκ ἐποίησαν

text_en: And the Lord said to me: A conspiracy is found among the men of Juda , and among the inhabitants of Jerusalem .
text_la: Et dixit Dominus ad me : Inventa est conjuratio in viris Juda et in habitatoribus Jerusalem.
text_pt: Disse-me mais o Senhor: Uma conspiração se achou entre os homens de Judá, entre os habitantes de Jerusalém.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν κύριος πρός με εὑρέθη σύνδεσμος ἐν ἀνδράσιν Ιουδα καὶ ἐν τοῖς κατοικοῦσιν Ιερουσαλημ

text_en: They are returned to the former iniquities of their fathers, who refused to hear my words: so these likewise have gone after strange gods, to serve them: the house of Israel , and the house of Juda have made void my covenant, which I made with their fathers.
text_la: Reversi sunt ad iniquitates patrum suorum priores, qui noluerunt audire verba mea : et hi ergo abierunt post deos alienos, ut servirent eis : irritum fecerunt domus Israël et domus Juda pactum meum quod pepigi cum patribus eorum.
text_pt: Tornaram às maldades de seus primeiros pais, que não quiseram ouvir as minhas palavras; e eles andaram após outros deuses para os servir; a casa de Israel e a casa de Judá quebraram a minha aliança, que tinha feito com seus pais.
text_el: ἐπεστράφησαν ἐπὶ τὰς ἀδικίας τῶν πατέρων αὐτῶν τῶν πρότερον οἳ οὐκ ἤθελον εἰσακοῦσαι τῶν λόγων μου καὶ ἰδοὺ αὐτοὶ βαδίζουσιν ὀπίσω θεῶν ἀλλοτρίων τοῦ δουλεύειν αὐτοῖς καὶ διεσκέδασαν οἶκος Ισραηλ καὶ οἶκος Ιουδα τὴν διαθήκην μου ἣν διεθέμην πρὸς τοὺς πατέρας αὐτῶν

text_en: Wherefore thus says the Lord : Behold I will bring in evils upon them, which they shall not be able to escape: and they shall cry to me, and I will not hearken to them.
text_la: Quam ob rem hæc dicit Dominus : Ecce ego inducam super eos mala de quibus exire non poterunt : et clamabunt ad me, et non exaudiam eos.
text_pt: Portanto assim diz o Senhor: Eis que trarei mal sobre eles, de que não poderão escapar; e clamarão a mim, mas eu não os ouvirei.
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο τάδε λέγει κύριος ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ ἐπάγω ἐπὶ τὸν λαὸν τοῦτον κακά ἐξ ὧν οὐ δυνήσονται ἐξελθεῖν ἐξ αὐτῶν καὶ κεκράξονται πρός με καὶ οὐκ εἰσακούσομαι αὐτῶν

text_en: And the cities of Juda , and the inhabitants of Jerusalem shall go, and cry to the gods to whom they offer sacrifice , and they shall not save them in the time of their affliction.
text_la: Et ibunt civitates Juda et habitatores Jerusalem, et clamabunt ad deos quibus libant, et non salvabunt eos in tempore afflictionis eorum.
text_pt: Então irão as cidades de Judá e os habitantes de Jerusalém e clamarão aos deuses a quem eles queimaram incenso; estes, porém, de nenhum modo os livrarão no tempo do seu mal.
text_el: καὶ πορεύσονται πόλεις Ιουδα καὶ οἱ κατοικοῦντες Ιερουσαλημ καὶ κεκράξονται πρὸς τοὺς θεούς οἷς αὐτοὶ θυμιῶσιν αὐτοῖς μὴ σώσουσιν αὐτοὺς ἐν καιρῷ τῶν κακῶν αὐτῶν

text_en: For according to the number of your cities were your gods, O Juda : and according to the number of the streets of Jerusalem you have set up altars of confusion, altars to offer sacrifice to Baalim .
text_la: Secundum numerum enim civitatum tuarum erant dii tui, Juda : et secundum numerum viarum Jerusalem, posuisti aras confusionis, aras ad libandum Baalim.
text_pt: Porque, segundo o número das tuas cidades, são os teus deuses, ó Judá! E, segundo o número das ruas de Jerusalém, levantastes altares à impudência, altares para queimardes incenso a Baal.
text_el: ὅτι κατ' ἀριθμὸν τῶν πόλεών σου ἦσαν θεοί σου Ιουδα καὶ κατ' ἀριθμὸν ἐξόδων τῆς Ιερουσαλημ ἐτάξατε βωμοὺς θυμιᾶν τῇ Βααλ

text_en: Therefore do not pray for this people, and do not take up praise and prayer for them: for I will not hear them in the time of their cry to me, in the time of their affliction.
text_la: Tu ergo noli orare pro populo hoc, et ne assumas pro eis laudem et orationem, quia non exaudiam in tempore clamoris eorum ad me, in tempore afflictionis eorum.
text_pt: Tu, pois, não ores por este povo, nem levantes por ele clamor nem oração; porque não os ouvirei no tempo em que eles clamarem a mim, por causa do seu mal.
text_el: καὶ σὺ μὴ προσεύχου περὶ τοῦ λαοῦ τούτου καὶ μὴ ἀξίου περὶ αὐτῶν ἐν δεήσει καὶ προσευχῇ ὅτι οὐκ εἰσακούσομαι ἐν τῷ καιρῷ ἐν ᾧ ἐπικαλοῦνταί με ἐν καιρῷ κακώσεως αὐτῶν

text_en: What is the meaning that my beloved has wrought much wickedness in my house? Shall the holy flesh take away from you your crimes, in which you have boasted?
text_la: Quid est, quod dilectus meus in domo mea fecit scelera multa? numquid carnes sanctæ auferent a te malitias tuas, in quibus gloriata es?
text_pt: Que direito tem a minha amada na minha casa, visto que com muitos tem cometido grande lascívia? Crês que os sacrifícios e as carnes santificadas poderão afastar de ti o mal? Então saltarias de prazer.
text_el: τί ἡ ἠγαπημένη ἐν τῷ οἴκῳ μου ἐποίησεν βδέλυγμα μὴ εὐχαὶ καὶ κρέα ἅγια ἀφελοῦσιν ἀπὸ σοῦ τὰς κακίας σου ἢ τούτοις διαφεύξῃ

text_en: The Lord called your name , a plentiful olive tree, fair, fruitful, and beautiful: at the noise of a word, a great fire was kindled in it, and the branches thereof are burnt.
text_la: Olivam uberem, pulchram, fructiferam, speciosam, vocavit Dominus nomen tuum : ad vocem loquelæ, grandis exarsit ignis in ea, et combusta sunt fruteta ejus.
text_pt: Denominou-te o Senhor oliveira verde, formosa por seus deliciosos frutos, mas agora à voz de um grande tumulto acendeu fogo ao redor dela e se quebraram os seus ramos.
text_el: ἐλαίαν ὡραίαν εὔσκιον τῷ εἴδει ἐκάλεσεν κύριος τὸ ὄνομά σου εἰς φωνὴν περιτομῆς αὐτῆς ἀνήφθη πῦρ ἐπ' αὐτήν μεγάλη ἡ θλῖψις ἐπὶ σέ ἠχρεώθησαν οἱ κλάδοι αὐτῆς

text_en: And the Lord of hosts that planted you, has pronounced evil against you: for the evils of the house of Israel , and of the house of Juda , which they have done to themselves, to provoke me, offering sacrifice to Baalim .
text_la: Et Dominus exercituum, qui plantavit te, locutus est super te malum, pro malis domus Israël, et domus Juda, quæ fecerunt sibi ad irritandum me, libantes Baalim.
text_pt: Porque o Senhor dos Exércitos, que te plantou, pronunciou contra ti o mal, pela maldade da casa de Israel e da casa de Judá, que para si mesma fizeram, pois me provocaram à ira, queimando incenso a Baal.
text_el: καὶ κύριος ὁ καταφυτεύσας σε ἐλάλησεν ἐπὶ σὲ κακὰ ἀντὶ τῆς κακίας οἴκου Ισραηλ καὶ οἴκου Ιουδα ὅτι ἐποίησαν ἑαυτοῖς τοῦ παροργίσαι με ἐν τῷ θυμιᾶν αὐτοὺς τῇ Βααλ

text_en: But you, O Lord , have shown me, and I have known : then you showed me their doings.
text_la: Tu autem, Domine, demonstrasti mihi, et cognovi : tunc ostendisti mihi studia eorum.
text_pt: E o Senhor me fez saber, e assim o soube; então me fizeste ver as suas ações.
text_el: κύριε γνώρισόν μοι καὶ γνώσομαι τότε εἶδον τὰ ἐπιτηδεύματα αὐτῶν

text_en: And I was as a meek lamb, that is carried to be a victim: and I knew not that they had devised counsels against me, saying: Let us put wood on his bread, and cut him off from the land of the living, and let his name be remembered no more.
text_la: Et ego quasi agnus mansuetus, qui portatur ad victimam : et non cognovi quia cogitaverunt super me consilia, dicentes : Mittamus lignum in panem ejus, et eradamus eum de terra viventium, et nomen ejus non memoretur amplius.
text_pt: E eu era como um cordeiro, como um boi que levam à matança; porque não sabia que maquinavam propósitos contra mim, dizendo: Destruamos a árvore com o seu fruto, e cortemo-lo da terra dos viventes, e não haja mais memória do seu nome.
text_el: ἐγὼ δὲ ὡς ἀρνίον ἄκακον ἀγόμενον τοῦ θύεσθαι οὐκ ἔγνων ἐπ' ἐμὲ ἐλογίσαντο λογισμὸν πονηρὸν λέγοντες δεῦτε καὶ ἐμβάλωμεν ξύλον εἰς τὸν ἄρτον αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐκτρίψωμεν αὐτὸν ἀπὸ γῆς ζώντων καὶ τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ οὐ μὴ μνησθῇ ἔτι

text_en: But you, O Lord of Sabaoth , who judges justly , and tries the reins and the hearts, let me see your revenge on them: for to you have I revealed my cause.
text_la: Tu autem, Domine Sabaoth, qui judicas juste, et probas renes et corda, videam ultionem tuam ex eis : tibi enim revelavi causam meam.
text_pt: Mas, ó Senhor dos Exércitos, justo Juiz, que provas os rins e o coração, veja eu a tua vingança sobre eles; pois a ti descobri a minha causa.
text_el: κύριε κρίνων δίκαια δοκιμάζων νεφροὺς καὶ καρδίας ἴδοιμι τὴν παρὰ σοῦ ἐκδίκησιν ἐξ αὐτῶν ὅτι πρὸς σὲ ἀπεκάλυψα τὸ δικαίωμά μου

text_en: Therefore thus says the Lord to the men of Anathoth , who seek your life, and say: You shall not prophesy in the name of the Lord , and you shall not die in our hands.
text_la: Propterea hæc dicit Dominus ad viros Anathoth, qui quærunt animam tuam, et dicunt : Non prophetabis in nomine Domini, et non morieris in manibus nostris :
text_pt: Portanto, assim diz o Senhor acerca dos homens de Anatote, que buscam a tua vida, dizendo: Não profetizes no nome do Senhor, para que não morras às nossas mãos.
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο τάδε λέγει κύριος ἐπὶ τοὺς ἄνδρας Αναθωθ τοὺς ζητοῦντας τὴν ψυχήν μου τοὺς λέγοντας οὐ μὴ προφητεύσῃς ἐπὶ τῷ ὀνόματι κυρίου εἰ δὲ μή ἀποθανῇ ἐν ταῖς χερσὶν ἡμῶν

text_en: Therefore thus says the Lord of hosts : Behold I will visit upon them: their young men shall die by the sword, their sons and their daughters shall die by famine.
text_la: propterea hæc dicit Dominus exercituum : Ecce ego visitabo super eos : juvenes morientur in gladio; filii eorum et filiæ eorum morientur in fame.
text_pt: Portanto, assim diz o Senhor dos Exércitos: Eis que eu os castigarei; os jovens morrerão à espada, os seus filhos e suas filhas morrerão de fome.
text_el: ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ ἐπισκέψομαι ἐπ' αὐτούς οἱ νεανίσκοι αὐτῶν ἐν μαχαίρᾳ ἀποθανοῦνται καὶ οἱ υἱοὶ αὐτῶν καὶ αἱ θυγατέρες αὐτῶν τελευτήσουσιν ἐν λιμῷ

text_en: And there shall be no remains of them: for I will bring in evil upon the men of Anathoth , the year of their visitation.
text_la: Et reliquiæ non erunt ex eis : inducam enim malum super viros Anathoth, annum visitationis eorum.
text_pt: E não haverá deles um remanescente, porque farei vir o mal sobre os homens de Anatote, no ano da sua visitação.
text_el: καὶ ἐγκατάλειμμα οὐκ ἔσται αὐτῶν ὅτι ἐπάξω κακὰ ἐπὶ τοὺς κατοικοῦντας ἐν Αναθωθ ἐν ἐνιαυτῷ ἐπισκέψεως αὐτῶν

text_en: You indeed, O Lord , are just , if I plead with you, but yet I will speak what is just to you: Why does the way of the wicked prosper: why is it well with all them that transgress, and do wickedly ?
text_la: Justus quidem tu es, Domine, si disputem tecum : verumtamen justa loquar ad te : Quare via impiorum prosperatur; bene est omnibus qui prævaricantur et inique agunt?
text_pt: Justo serias, ó SENHOR, ainda que eu entrasse contigo num pleito; contudo falarei contigo dos teus juízos. Por que prospera o caminho dos ímpios, e vivem em paz todos os que procedem aleivosamente?
text_el: δίκαιος εἶ κύριε ὅτι ἀπολογήσομαι πρὸς σέ πλὴν κρίματα λαλήσω πρὸς σέ τί ὅτι ὁδὸς ἀσεβῶν εὐοδοῦται εὐθήνησαν πάντες οἱ ἀθετοῦντες ἀθετήματα

text_en: You have planted them, and they have taken root: they prosper and bring forth fruit: you are near in their mouth, and far from their reins.
text_la: Plantasti eos, et radicem miserunt : proficiunt, et faciunt fructum : prope es tu ori eorum, et longe a renibus eorum.
text_pt: Plantaste-os, e eles se arraigaram; crescem, dão também fruto; chegado estás à sua boca, porém longe dos seus rins.
text_el: ἐφύτευσας αὐτοὺς καὶ ἐρριζώθησαν ἐτεκνοποίησαν καὶ ἐποίησαν καρπόν ἐγγὺς εἶ σὺ τοῦ στόματος αὐτῶν καὶ πόρρω ἀπὸ τῶν νεφρῶν αὐτῶν

text_en: And you, O Lord , have known me, you have seen me, and proved my heart with you: gather them together as for the day of slaughter.
text_la: Et tu, Domine, nosti me, vidisti me, et probasti cor meum tecum. Congrega eos quasi gregem ad victimam, et sanctifica eos in die occisionis.
text_pt: Mas tu, ó Senhor, me conheces, tu me vês, e provas o meu coração para contigo; arranca-os como as ovelhas para o matadouro, e dedica-os para o dia da matança.
text_el: καὶ σύ κύριε γινώσκεις με δεδοκίμακας τὴν καρδίαν μου ἐναντίον σου ἅγνισον αὐτοὺς εἰς ἡμέραν σφαγῆς αὐτῶν

text_en: How long shall the land mourn, and the herb of every field wither for the wickedness of them that dwell therein? The beasts and the birds are consumed: because they have said: He shall not see our last end.
text_la: Usquequo lugebit terra, et herba omnis regionis siccabitur, propter malitiam habitantium in ea? Consumptum est animal, et volucre, quoniam dixerunt : Non videbit novissima nostra.
text_pt: Até quando lamentará a terra, e se secará a erva de todo o campo? Pela maldade dos que habitam nela, perecem os animais e as aves; porquanto dizem: Ele não verá o nosso fim.
text_el: ἕως πότε πενθήσει ἡ γῆ καὶ πᾶς ὁ χόρτος τοῦ ἀγροῦ ξηρανθήσεται ἀπὸ κακίας τῶν κατοικούντων ἐν αὐτῇ ἠφανίσθησαν κτήνη καὶ πετεινά ὅτι εἶπαν οὐκ ὄψεται ὁ θεὸς ὁδοὺς ἡμῶν

text_en: If you have been wearied with running with footmen, how can you contend with horses? And if you have been secure in a land of peace, what will you do in the swelling of the Jordan ?
text_la: Si cum peditibus currens laborasti, quomodo contendere poteris cum equis? cum autem in terra pacis securus fueris, quid facies in superbia Jordanis?
text_pt: Se te fatigas correndo com homens que vão a pé, como poderás competir com os cavalos? Se tão-somente numa terra de paz estás confiado, como farás na enchente do Jordão?
text_el: σοῦ οἱ πόδες τρέχουσιν καὶ ἐκλύουσίν σε πῶς παρασκευάσῃ ἐφ' ἵπποις καὶ ἐν γῇ εἰρήνης σὺ πέποιθας πῶς ποιήσεις ἐν φρυάγματι τοῦ Ιορδάνου

text_en: For even your brethren, and the house of your father, even they have fought against you, and have cried after you with full voice: believe them not when they speak good things to you.
text_la: Nam et fratres tui, et domus patris tui, etiam ipsi pugnaverunt adversum te, et clamaverunt post te plena voce : ne credas eis, cum locuti fuerint tibi bona.
text_pt: Porque até os teus irmãos, e a casa de teu pai, eles próprios procedem deslealmente contigo; eles mesmos clamam após ti em altas vozes: Não te fies neles, ainda que te digam coisas boas.
text_el: ὅτι καὶ οἱ ἀδελφοί σου καὶ ὁ οἶκος τοῦ πατρός σου καὶ οὗτοι ἠθέτησάν σε καὶ αὐτοὶ ἐβόησαν ἐκ τῶν ὀπίσω σου ἐπισυνήχθησαν μὴ πιστεύσῃς ἐν αὐτοῖς ὅτι λαλήσουσιν πρὸς σὲ καλά

text_en: I have forsaken my house, I have left my inheritance: I have given my dear soul into the hand of her enemies.
text_la: Reliqui domum meam; dimisi hæreditatem meam : dedi dilectam animam meam in manu inimicorum ejus.
text_pt: Desamparei a minha casa, abandonei a minha herança; entreguei a amada da minha alma na mão de seus inimigos.
text_el: ἐγκαταλέλοιπα τὸν οἶκόν μου ἀφῆκα τὴν κληρονομίαν μου ἔδωκα τὴν ἠγαπημένην ψυχήν μου εἰς χεῖρας ἐχθρῶν αὐτῆς

text_en: My inheritance has become to me as a lion in the wood: it has cried out against me, therefore have I hated it.
text_la: Facta est mihi hæreditas mea quasi leo in silva : dedit contra me vocem, ideo odivi eam.
text_pt: Tornou-se a minha herança para mim como leão numa floresta; levantou a sua voz contra mim, por isso eu a odiei.
text_el: ἐγενήθη ἡ κληρονομία μου ἐμοὶ ὡς λέων ἐν δρυμῷ ἔδωκεν ἐπ' ἐμὲ τὴν φωνὴν αὐτῆς διὰ τοῦτο ἐμίσησα αὐτήν

text_en: Is my inheritance to me as a speckled bird? Is it as a bird dyed throughout? Come, assemble yourselves, all you beasts of the earth, make haste to devour.
text_la: Numquid avis discolor hæreditas mea mihi? numquid avis tincta per totum? Venite, congregamini, omnes bestiæ terræ : properate ad devorandum.
text_pt: A minha herança é para mim ave de rapina de várias cores. Andam as aves de rapina contra ela em redor. Vinde, pois, ajuntai todos os animais do campo, trazei-os para a devorarem.
text_el: μὴ σπήλαιον ὑαίνης ἡ κληρονομία μου ἐμοὶ ἢ σπήλαιον κύκλῳ αὐτῆς βαδίσατε συναγάγετε πάντα τὰ θηρία τοῦ ἀγροῦ καὶ ἐλθέτωσαν τοῦ φαγεῖν αὐτήν

text_en: Many pastors have destroyed my vineyard, they have trodden my portion under foot: they have changed my delightful portion into a desolate wilderness .
text_la: Pastores multi demoliti sunt vineam meam, conculcaverunt partem meam, dederunt portionem meam desiderabilem in desertum solitudinis.
text_pt: Muitos pastores destruíram a minha vinha, pisaram o meu campo; tornaram em desolado deserto o meu campo desejado.
text_el: ποιμένες πολλοὶ διέφθειραν τὸν ἀμπελῶνά μου ἐμόλυναν τὴν μερίδα μου ἔδωκαν μερίδα ἐπιθυμητήν μου εἰς ἔρημον ἄβατον

text_en: They have laid it waste, and it has mourned for me. With desolation is all the land made desolate; because there is none that considers in the heart.
text_la: Posuerunt eam in dissipationem, luxitque super me : desolatione desolata est omnis terra, quia nullus est qui recogitet corde.
text_pt: Em desolação a puseram, e clama a mim na sua desolação; e toda a terra está desolada, porquanto não há ninguém que tome isso a sério.
text_el: ἐτέθη εἰς ἀφανισμὸν ἀπωλείας δι' ἐμὲ ἀφανισμῷ ἠφανίσθη πᾶσα ἡ γῆ ὅτι οὐκ ἔστιν ἀνὴρ τιθέμενος ἐν καρδίᾳ

text_en: The spoilers have come upon all the ways of the wilderness , for the sword of the Lord shall devour from one end of the land to the other end thereof: there is no peace for all flesh.
text_la: Super omnes vias deserti venerunt vastatores, quia gladius Domini devorabit : ab extremo terræ usque ad extremum ejus, non est pax universæ carni.
text_pt: Sobre todos os lugares altos do deserto vieram destruidores; porque a espada do Senhor devora desde um extremo da terra até o outro; não há paz para nenhuma carne.
text_el: ἐπὶ πᾶσαν διεκβολὴν ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ ἦλθον ταλαιπωροῦντες ὅτι μάχαιρα τοῦ κυρίου καταφάγεται ἀπ' ἄκρου τῆς γῆς ἕως ἄκρου τῆς γῆς οὐκ ἔστιν εἰρήνη πάσῃ σαρκί

text_en: They have sown wheat, and reaped thorns: they have received an inheritance, and it shall not profit them: you shall be ashamed of your fruits, because of the fierce wrath of the Lord .
text_la: Seminaverunt triticum, et spinas messuerunt : hæreditatem acceperunt, et non eis proderit. Confundemini a fructibus vestris propter iram furoris Domini.
text_pt: Semearam trigo, e segaram espinhos; cansaram-se, mas de nada se aproveitaram; envergonhados sereis das vossas colheitas, e por causa do ardor da ira do Senhor.
text_el: σπείρατε πυροὺς καὶ ἀκάνθας θερίσατε οἱ κλῆροι αὐτῶν οὐκ ὠφελήσουσιν αὐτούς αἰσχύνθητε ἀπὸ καυχήσεως ὑμῶν ἀπὸ ὀνειδισμοῦ ἔναντι κυρίου

text_en: Thus says the Lord against all wicked neighbours, that touch the inheritance that I have shared out to my people Israel : Behold I will pluck them out of their land, and I will pluck the house of Juda out of the midst of them.
text_la: Hæc dicit Dominus adversum omnes vicinos meos pessimos, qui tangunt hæreditatem quam distribui populo meo Israël : Ecce ego evellam eos de terra sua, et domum Juda evellam de medio eorum.
text_pt: Assim diz o Senhor, acerca de todos os meus maus vizinhos, que tocam a minha herança, que fiz herdar ao meu povo Israel: Eis que os arrancarei da sua terra, e a casa de Judá arrancarei do meio deles.
text_el: ὅτι τάδε λέγει κύριος περὶ πάντων τῶν γειτόνων τῶν πονηρῶν τῶν ἁπτομένων τῆς κληρονομίας μου ἧς ἐμέρισα τῷ λαῷ μου Ισραηλ ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ ἀποσπῶ αὐτοὺς ἀπὸ τῆς γῆς αὐτῶν καὶ τὸν Ιουδαν ἐκβαλῶ ἐκ μέσου αὐτῶν

text_en: And when I shall have plucked them out, I will return, and have mercy on them: and will bring them back, every man to his inheritance, and every man into his land.
text_la: Et cum evulsero eos, convertar, et miserebor eorum, et reducam eos : virum ad hæreditatem suam, et virum in terram suam.
text_pt: E será que, depois de os haver arrancado, tornarei, e me compadecerei deles, e os farei voltar cada um à sua herança, e cada um à sua terra.
text_el: καὶ ἔσται μετὰ τὸ ἐκβαλεῖν με αὐτοὺς ἐπιστρέψω καὶ ἐλεήσω αὐτοὺς καὶ κατοικιῶ αὐτοὺς ἕκαστον εἰς τὴν κληρονομίαν αὐτοῦ καὶ ἕκαστον εἰς τὴν γῆν αὐτοῦ

text_en: And it shall come to pass, if they will be taught, and will learn the ways of my people, to swear by my name : The Lord lives, as they have taught my people to swear by Baal : that they shall be built up in the midst of my people.
text_la: Et erit : si eruditi didicerint vias populi mei, ut jurent in nomine meo : Vivit Dominus! sicut docuerunt populum meum jurare in Baal, ædificabuntur in medio populi mei.
text_pt: E será que, se diligentemente aprenderem os caminhos do meu povo, jurando pelo meu nome: Vive o Senhor, como ensinaram o meu povo a jurar por Baal; então edificar-se-ão no meio do meu povo.
text_el: καὶ ἔσται ἐὰν μαθόντες μάθωσιν τὴν ὁδὸν τοῦ λαοῦ μου τοῦ ὀμνύειν τῷ ὀνόματί μου ζῇ κύριος καθὼς ἐδίδαξαν τὸν λαόν μου ὀμνύειν τῇ Βααλ καὶ οἰκοδομηθήσονται ἐν μέσῳ τοῦ λαοῦ μου

text_en: But if they will not hear, I will utterly pluck out and destroy that nation, says the Lord .
text_la: Quod si non audierint, evellam gentem illam evulsione et perditione, ait Dominus.
text_pt: Mas se não quiserem ouvir, totalmente arrancarei a tal nação, e a farei perecer, diz o Senhor.
text_el: ἐὰν δὲ μὴ ἐπιστρέψωσιν καὶ ἐξαρῶ τὸ ἔθνος ἐκεῖνο ἐξάρσει καὶ ἀπωλείᾳ

text_en: Thus says the Lord to me: Go, and get you a linen girdle, and you shall put it about your loins, and shall not put it into water.
text_la: Hæc dicit Dominus ad me : Vade, et posside tibi lumbare lineum, et pones illud super lumbos tuos, et in aquam non inferes illud.
text_pt: Assim me disse o SENHOR: Vai, e compra um cinto de linho e põe-no sobre os teus lombos, mas não o coloques na água.
text_el: τάδε λέγει κύριος βάδισον καὶ κτῆσαι σεαυτῷ περίζωμα λινοῦν καὶ περίθου περὶ τὴν ὀσφύν σου καὶ ἐν ὕδατι οὐ διελεύσεται

text_en: And I got a girdle according to the word of the Lord , and put it about my loins.
text_la: Et possedi lumbare juxta verbum Domini, et posui circa lumbos meos.
text_pt: E comprei o cinto, conforme a palavra do Senhor, e o pus sobre os meus lombos.
text_el: καὶ ἐκτησάμην τὸ περίζωμα κατὰ τὸν λόγον κυρίου καὶ περιέθηκα περὶ τὴν ὀσφύν μου

text_en: And the word of the Lord came to me the second time, saying:
text_la: Et factus est sermo Domini ad me secundo, dicens:
text_pt: Então me veio a palavra do Senhor pela segunda vez, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ ἐγενήθη λόγος κυρίου πρός με λέγων

text_en: Take the girdle which you have got, which is about your loins, and arise, go to the Euphrates, and hide it there in a hole of the rock.
text_la: Tolle lumbare quod possedisti, quod est circa lumbos tuos : et surgens vade ad Euphraten, et absconde ibi illud in foramine petræ.
text_pt: Toma o cinto que compraste, e que trazes sobre os teus lombos, e levanta-te; vai ao Eufrates, e esconde-o ali na fenda de uma rocha.
text_el: λαβὲ τὸ περίζωμα τὸ περὶ τὴν ὀσφύν σου καὶ ἀνάστηθι καὶ βάδισον ἐπὶ τὸν Εὐφράτην καὶ κατάκρυψον αὐτὸ ἐκεῖ ἐν τῇ τρυμαλιᾷ τῆς πέτρας

text_en: And I went, and hid it by the Euphrates, as the Lord had commanded me.
text_la: Et abii, et abscondi illud in Euphrate, sicut præceperat mihi Dominus.
text_pt: E fui, e escondi-o junto ao Eufrates, como o Senhor me havia ordenado.
text_el: καὶ ἐπορεύθην καὶ ἔκρυψα αὐτὸ ἐν τῷ Εὐφράτῃ καθὼς ἐνετείλατό μοι κύριος

text_en: And it came to pass after many days, that the Lord said to me: Arise, go to the Euphrates, and take from thence the girdle, which I commanded you to hide there.
text_la: Et factum est post dies plurimos, dixit Dominus ad me : Surge, vade ad Euphraten, et tolle inde lumbare quod præcepi tibi ut absconderes illud ibi.
text_pt: Sucedeu, ao final de muitos dias, que me disse o Senhor: Levanta-te, vai ao Eufrates, e toma dali o cinto que te ordenei que o escondesses ali.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο μεθ' ἡμέρας πολλὰς καὶ εἶπεν κύριος πρός με ἀνάστηθι βάδισον ἐπὶ τὸν Εὐφράτην καὶ λαβὲ ἐκεῖθεν τὸ περίζωμα ὃ ἐνετειλάμην σοι τοῦ κατακρύψαι ἐκεῖ

text_en: And I went to the Euphrates, and digged, and took the girdle out of the place where I had hid it and behold the girdle was rotten, so that it was fit for no use.
text_la: Et abii ad Euphraten, et fodi, et tuli lumbare de loco ubi absconderam illud : et ecce computruerat lumbare, ita ut nulli usui aptum esset.
text_pt: E fui ao Eufrates, e cavei, e tomei o cinto do lugar onde o havia escondido; e eis que o cinto tinha apodrecido, e para nada prestava.
text_el: καὶ ἐπορεύθην ἐπὶ τὸν Εὐφράτην ποταμὸν καὶ ὤρυξα καὶ ἔλαβον τὸ περίζωμα ἐκ τοῦ τόπου οὗ κατώρυξα αὐτὸ ἐκεῖ καὶ ἰδοὺ διεφθαρμένον ἦν ὃ οὐ μὴ χρησθῇ εἰς οὐθέν

text_en: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying:
text_la: Et factum est verbum Domini ad me, dicens:
text_pt: Então veio a mim a palavra do Senhor, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ ἐγενήθη λόγος κυρίου πρός με λέγων

text_en: Thus says the Lord : After this manner will I make the pride of Juda , and the great pride of Jerusalem to rot.
text_la: Hæc dicit Dominus : Sic putrescere faciam superbiam Juda, et superbiam Jerusalem multam :
text_pt: Assim diz o Senhor: Do mesmo modo farei apodrecer a soberba de Judá, e a muita soberba de Jerusalém.
text_el: τάδε λέγει κύριος οὕτω φθερῶ τὴν ὕβριν Ιουδα καὶ τὴν ὕβριν Ιερουσαλημ

text_en: This wicked people, that will not hear my words, and that walk in the perverseness of their heart, and have gone after strange gods to serve them, and to adore them: and they shall be as this girdle which is fit for no use.
text_la: populum istum pessimum qui nolunt audire verba mea, et ambulant in pravitate cordis sui, abieruntque post deos alienos ut servirent eis et adorarent eos : et erunt sicut lumbare istud, quod nulli usui aptum est.
text_pt: Este povo maligno, que recusa ouvir as minhas palavras, que caminha segundo a dureza do seu coração, e anda após deuses alheios, para servi-los, e inclinar-se diante deles, será tal como este cinto, que para nada presta.
text_el: τὴν πολλὴν ταύτην ὕβριν τοὺς μὴ βουλομένους ὑπακούειν τῶν λόγων μου καὶ πορευθέντας ὀπίσω θεῶν ἀλλοτρίων τοῦ δουλεύειν αὐτοῖς καὶ τοῦ προσκυνεῖν αὐτοῖς καὶ ἔσονται ὥσπερ τὸ περίζωμα τοῦτο ὃ οὐ χρησθήσεται εἰς οὐθέν

text_en: For as the girdle sticks close to the loins of a man , so have I brought close to me all the house of Israel , and all the house of Juda , says the Lord : that they might be my people, and for a name , and for a praise, and for a glory : but they would not hear.
text_la: Sicut enim adhæret lumbare ad lumbos viri, sic agglutinavi mihi omnem domum Israël, et omnem domum Juda, dicit Dominus, ut essent mihi in populum, et in nomen, et in laudem, et in gloriam : et non audierunt.
text_pt: Porque, como o cinto está pegado aos lombos do homem, assim eu liguei a mim toda a casa de Israel, e toda a casa de Judá, diz o Senhor, para me serem por povo, e por nome, e por louvor, e por glória; mas não deram ouvidos.
text_el: ὅτι καθάπερ κολλᾶται τὸ περίζωμα περὶ τὴν ὀσφὺν τοῦ ἀνθρώπου οὕτως ἐκόλλησα πρὸς ἐμαυτὸν τὸν οἶκον τοῦ Ισραηλ καὶ πᾶν οἶκον Ιουδα τοῦ γενέσθαι μοι εἰς λαὸν ὀνομαστὸν καὶ εἰς καύχημα καὶ εἰς δόξαν καὶ οὐκ εἰσήκουσάν μου

text_en: You shall speak therefore to them this word: Thus says the Lord the God of Israel : Every bottle shall be filled with wine. And they shall say to you: Do we not know that every bottle shall be filled with wine?
text_la: Dices ergo ad eos sermonem istum : Hæc dicit Dominus Deus Israël : Omnis laguncula implebitur vino. Et dicent ad te : Numquid ignoramus quia omnis laguncula implebitur vino?
text_pt: Portanto, dize-lhes esta palavra: Assim diz o Senhor Deus de Israel: Todo o odre se encherá de vinho; e dir-te-ão: Porventura não sabemos nós muito bem que todo o odre se encherá de vinho?
text_el: καὶ ἐρεῖς πρὸς τὸν λαὸν τοῦτον πᾶς ἀσκὸς πληρωθήσεται οἴνου καὶ ἔσται ἐὰν εἴπωσιν πρὸς σέ μὴ γνόντες οὐ γνωσόμεθα ὅτι πᾶς ἀσκὸς πληρωθήσεται οἴνου

text_en: And you shall say to them: Thus says the Lord : Behold I will fill all the inhabitants of this land, and the kings of the race of David that sit upon his throne, and the priests , and the prophets , and all the inhabitants of Jerusalem , with drunkenness.
text_la: Et dices ad eos : Hæc dicit Dominus : Ecce ego implebo omnes habitatores terræ hujus, et reges qui sedent de stirpe David super thronum ejus, et sacerdotes, et prophetas, et omnes habitatores Jerusalem, ebrietate.
text_pt: Mas tu dize-lhes: Assim diz o Senhor: Eis que eu encherei de embriaguez a todos os habitantes desta terra, e aos reis da estirpe de Davi, que estão assentados sobre o seu trono, e aos sacerdotes, e aos profetas, e a todos os habitantes de Jerusalém.
text_el: καὶ ἐρεῖς πρὸς αὐτούς τάδε λέγει κύριος ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ πληρῶ τοὺς κατοικοῦντας τὴν γῆν ταύτην καὶ τοὺς βασιλεῖς αὐτῶν τοὺς καθημένους υἱοὺς Δαυιδ ἐπὶ θρόνου αὐτοῦ καὶ τοὺς ἱερεῖς καὶ τοὺς προφήτας καὶ τὸν Ιουδαν καὶ πάντας τοὺς κατοικοῦντας Ιερουσαλημ μεθύσματι

text_en: And I will scatter them every man from his brother, and fathers and sons in like manner, says the Lord : I will not spare, and I will not pardon: nor will I have mercy, but to destroy them.
text_la: Et dispergam eos virum a fratre suo, et patres et filios pariter, ait Dominus. Non parcam, et non concedam : neque miserebor, ut non disperdam eos.
text_pt: E fá-los-ei em pedaços atirando uns contra os outros, e juntamente os pais com os filhos, diz o Senhor; não perdoarei, nem pouparei, nem terei deles compaixão, para que não os destrua.
text_el: καὶ διασκορπιῶ αὐτοὺς ἄνδρα καὶ τὸν ἀδελφὸν αὐτοῦ καὶ τοὺς πατέρας αὐτῶν καὶ τοὺς υἱοὺς αὐτῶν ἐν τῷ αὐτῷ οὐκ ἐπιποθήσω λέγει κύριος καὶ οὐ φείσομαι καὶ οὐκ οἰκτιρήσω ἀπὸ διαφθορᾶς αὐτῶν

text_en: Hear, and give ear: Be not proud , for the Lord has spoken.
text_la: Audite, et auribus percipite : nolite elevari, quia Dominus locutus est.
text_pt: Escutai, e inclinai os ouvidos; não vos ensoberbeçais; porque o Senhor falou:
text_el: ἀκούσατε καὶ ἐνωτίσασθε καὶ μὴ ἐπαίρεσθε ὅτι κύριος ἐλάλησεν

text_en: Give glory to the Lord your God , before it be dark, and before your feet stumble upon the dark mountains: you shall look for light, and he will turn it into the shadow of death, and into darkness.
text_la: Date Domino Deo vestro gloriam antequam contenebrescat, et antequam offendant pedes vestri ad montes caliginosos : exspectabitis lucem, et ponet eam in umbram mortis, et in caliginem.
text_pt: Dai glória ao Senhor vosso Deus, antes que venha a escuridão e antes que tropecem vossos pés nos montes tenebrosos; antes que, esperando vós luz, ele a mude em sombra de morte, e a reduza à escuridão.
text_el: δότε τῷ κυρίῳ θεῷ ὑμῶν δόξαν πρὸ τοῦ συσκοτάσαι καὶ πρὸς τοῦ προσκόψαι πόδας ὑμῶν ἐπ' ὄρη σκοτεινὰ καὶ ἀναμενεῖτε εἰς φῶς καὶ ἐκεῖ σκιὰ θανάτου καὶ τεθήσονται εἰς σκότος

text_en: But if you will not hear this, my soul shall weep in secret for your pride : weeping it shall weep, and my eyes shall run down with tears, because the flock of the Lord is carried away captive.
text_la: Quod si hoc non audieritis, in abscondito plorabit anima mea a facie superbiæ : plorans plorabit, et deducet oculus meus lacrimam, quia captus est grex Domini.
text_pt: E, se isto não ouvirdes, a minha alma chorará em lugares ocultos, por causa da vossa soberba; e amargamente chorarão os meus olhos, e se desfarão em lágrimas, porquanto o rebanho do Senhor foi levado cativo.
text_el: ἐὰν δὲ μὴ ἀκούσητε κεκρυμμένως κλαύσεται ἡ ψυχὴ ὑμῶν ἀπὸ προσώπου ὕβρεως καὶ κατάξουσιν οἱ ὀφθαλμοὶ ὑμῶν δάκρυα ὅτι συνετρίβη τὸ ποίμνιον κυρίου

text_en: Say to the king, and to the queen: Humble yourselves, sit down: for the crown of your glory has come down from your head.
text_la: Dic regi et dominatrici : Humiliamini, sedete, quoniam descendit de capite vestro corona gloriæ vestræ.
text_pt: Dize ao rei e à rainha: Humilhai-vos, e assentai-vos no chão; porque já caiu todo o ornato de vossas cabeças, a coroa da vossa glória.
text_el: εἴπατε τῷ βασιλεῖ καὶ τοῖς δυναστεύουσιν ταπεινώθητε καὶ καθίσατε ὅτι καθῃρέθη ἀπὸ κεφαλῆς ὑμῶν στέφανος δόξης ὑμῶν

text_en: The cities of the south are shut up, and there is none to open them: all Juda is carried away captive with an entire captivity.
text_la: Civitates austri clausæ sunt, et non est qui aperiat : translata est omnis Juda transmigratione perfecta.
text_pt: As cidades do sul estão fechadas, e ninguém há que as abra; todo o Judá foi levado cativo, sim, inteiramente cativo.
text_el: πόλεις αἱ πρὸς νότον συνεκλείσθησαν καὶ οὐκ ἦν ὁ ἀνοίγων ἀπῳκίσθη Ιουδας συνετέλεσεν ἀποικίαν τελείαν

text_en: Lift up your eyes, and see, you that come from the north: where is the flock that is given you, your beautiful cattle?
text_la: Levate oculos vestros et videte, qui venitis ab aquilone : ubi est grex qui datus est tibi, pecus inclytum tuum?
text_pt: Levantai os vossos olhos, e vede os que vêm do norte; onde está o rebanho que se te deu, o rebanho da tua glória?
text_el: ἀνάλαβε ὀφθαλμούς σου Ιερουσαλημ καὶ ἰδὲ τοὺς ἐρχομένους ἀπὸ βορρᾶ ποῦ ἐστιν τὸ ποίμνιον ὃ ἐδόθη σοι πρόβατα δόξης σου

text_en: What will you say when he shall visit you? For you have taught them against you, and instructed them against your own head: shall not sorrows lay hold on you, as a woman in labour?
text_la: Quid dices cum visitaverit te? tu enim docuisti eos adversum te, et erudisti in caput tuum. Numquid non dolores apprehendent te, quasi mulierem parturientem?
text_pt: Que dirás, quando ele te castigar porque os ensinaste a serem capitães, e chefe sobre ti? Porventura não te tomarão as dores, como à mulher que está de parto?
text_el: τί ἐρεῖς ὅταν ἐπισκέπτωνταί σε καὶ σὺ ἐδίδαξας αὐτοὺς ἐπὶ σὲ μαθήματα εἰς ἀρχήν οὐκ ὠδῖνες καθέξουσίν σε καθὼς γυναῖκα τίκτουσαν

text_en: And if you shall say in your heart: Why are these things come upon me? For the greatness of your iniquity , your nakedness is discovered, the soles of your feet are defiled.
text_la: Quod si dixeris in corde tuo : Quare venerunt mihi hæc? propter multitudinem iniquitatis tuæ revelata sunt verecundiora tua, pollutæ sunt plantæ tuæ.
text_pt: Quando, pois, disseres no teu coração: Por que me sobrevieram estas coisas? Pela multidão das tuas maldades se descobriram as tuas fraldas, e os teus calcanhares sofrem violência.
text_el: καὶ ἐὰν εἴπῃς ἐν τῇ καρδίᾳ σου διὰ τί ἀπήντησέν μοι ταῦτα διὰ τὸ πλῆθος τῆς ἀδικίας σου ἀνεκαλύφθη τὰ ὀπίσθιά σου παραδειγματισθῆναι τὰς πτέρνας σου

text_en: If the Ethiopian can change his skin, or the leopard his spots: you also may do well, when you have learned evil .
text_la: Si mutare potest Æthiops pellem suam, aut pardus varietates suas, et vos poteritis benefacere, cum didiceritis malum.
text_pt: Porventura pode o etíope mudar a sua pele, ou o leopardo as suas manchas? Então podereis vós fazer o bem, sendo ensinados a fazer o mal.
text_el: εἰ ἀλλάξεται Αἰθίοψ τὸ δέρμα αὐτοῦ καὶ πάρδαλις τὰ ποικίλματα αὐτῆς καὶ ὑμεῖς δυνήσεσθε εὖ ποιῆσαι μεμαθηκότες τὰ κακά

text_en: And I will scatter them as stubble, which is carried away by the wind in the desert .
text_la: Et disseminabo eos quasi stipulam quæ vento raptatur in deserto.
text_pt: Assim os espalharei como o restolho, que passa com o vento do deserto.
text_el: καὶ διέσπειρα αὐτοὺς ὡς φρύγανα φερόμενα ὑπὸ ἀνέμου εἰς ἔρημον

text_en: This is your lot, and the portion of your measure from me, says the Lord , because you have forgotten me, and have trusted in falsehood.
text_la: Hæc sors tua, parsque mensuræ tuæ a me, dicit Dominus, quia oblita es mei, et confisa es in mendacio.
text_pt: Esta será a tua sorte, a porção que te será medida por mim, diz o Senhor; pois te esqueceste de mim, e confiaste em mentiras.
text_el: οὗτος ὁ κλῆρός σου καὶ μερὶς τοῦ ἀπειθεῖν ὑμᾶς ἐμοί λέγει κύριος ὡς ἐπελάθου μου καὶ ἤλπισας ἐπὶ ψεύδεσιν

text_en: Wherefore I have also bared your thighs against your face, and your shame has appeared.
text_la: Unde et ego nudavi femora tua contra faciem tuam, et apparuit ignominia tua :
text_pt: Assim também eu levantarei as tuas fraldas sobre o teu rosto; e aparecerá a tua ignomínia.
text_el: κἀγὼ ἀποκαλύψω τὰ ὀπίσω σου ἐπὶ τὸ πρόσωπόν σου καὶ ὀφθήσεται ἡ ἀτιμία σου

text_en: I have seen your adulteries, and your neighing, the wickedness of your fornication: and your abominations, upon the hills in the field. Woe to you, Jerusalem , will you not be made clean after me: how long yet?
text_la: adulteria tua, et hinnitus tuus, scelus fornicationis tuæ : super colles in agro vidi abominationes tuas. Væ tibi, Jerusalem! non mundaberis post me : usquequo adhuc?
text_pt: Já vi as tuas abominações, e os teus adultérios, e os teus rinchos, e a enormidade da tua prostituição sobre os outeiros no campo; ai de ti, Jerusalém! Até quando ainda não te purificarás?
text_el: καὶ ἡ μοιχεία σου καὶ ὁ χρεμετισμός σου καὶ ἡ ἀπαλλοτρίωσις τῆς πορνείας σου ἐπὶ τῶν βουνῶν καὶ ἐν τοῖς ἀγροῖς ἑώρακα τὰ βδελύγματά σου οὐαί σοι Ιερουσαλημ ὅτι οὐκ ἐκαθαρίσθης ὀπίσω μου ἕως τίνος ἔτι

text_en: The word of the Lord that came to Jeremias concerning the words of the drought.
text_la: Quod factum est verbum Domini ad Jeremiam, de sermonibus siccitatis.
text_pt: A palavra do SENHOR, que veio a Jeremias, a respeito da grande seca.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο λόγος κυρίου πρὸς Ιερεμιαν περὶ τῆς ἀβροχίας

text_en: Judea has mourned, and the gates thereof are fallen, and have become obscure on the ground, and the cry of Jerusalem has gone up.
text_la: Luxit Judæa, et portæ ejus corruerunt, et obscuratæ sunt in terra, et clamor Jerusalem ascendit.
text_pt: Anda chorando Judá, e as suas portas estão enfraquecidas; andam de luto até ao chão, e o clamor de Jerusalém vai subindo.
text_el: ἐπένθησεν ἡ Ιουδαία καὶ αἱ πύλαι αὐτῆς ἐκενώθησαν καὶ ἐσκοτώθησαν ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς καὶ ἡ κραυγὴ τῆς Ιερουσαλημ ἀνέβη

text_en: The great ones sent their inferiors to the water: they came to draw, they found no water, they carried back their vessels empty: they were confounded and afflicted, and covered their heads.
text_la: Majores miserunt minores suos ad aquam : venerunt ad hauriendum. Non invenerunt aquam : reportaverunt vasa sua vacua. Confusi sunt, et afflicti, et operuerunt capita sua.
text_pt: E os seus mais ilustres enviam os seus pequenos a buscar água; vão às cisternas, e não acham água; voltam com os seus cântaros vazios; envergonham-se e confundem-se, e cobrem as suas cabeças.
text_el: καὶ οἱ μεγιστᾶνες αὐτῆς ἀπέστειλαν τοὺς νεωτέρους αὐτῶν ἐφ' ὕδωρ ἤλθοσαν ἐπὶ τὰ φρέατα καὶ οὐχ εὕροσαν ὕδωρ καὶ ἀπέστρεψαν τὰ ἀγγεῖα αὐτῶν κενά

text_en: For the destruction of the land, because there came no rain upon the earth, the husbandman were confounded, they covered their heads.
text_la: Propter terræ vastitatem, quia non venit pluvia in terram, confusi sunt agricolæ : operuerunt capita sua.
text_pt: Por causa da terra que se fendeu, porque não há chuva sobre a terra, os lavradores se envergonham e cobrem as suas cabeças.
text_el: καὶ τὰ ἔργα τῆς γῆς ἐξέλιπεν ὅτι οὐκ ἦν ὑετός ᾐσχύνθησαν γεωργοί ἐπεκάλυψαν τὴν κεφαλὴν αὐτῶν

text_en: Yea, the hind also brought forth in the field, and left it, because there was no grass.
text_la: Nam et cerva in agro peperit, et reliquit, quia non erat herba.
text_pt: Porque até as cervas no campo têm as suas crias, e abandonam seus filhos, porquanto não há erva.
text_el: καὶ ἔλαφοι ἐν ἀγρῷ ἔτεκον καὶ ἐγκατέλιπον ὅτι οὐκ ἦν βοτάνη

text_en: And the wild asses stood upon the rocks, they snuffed up the wind like dragons, their eyes failed, because there was no grass.
text_la: Et onagri steterunt in rupibus; traxerunt ventum quasi dracones : defecerunt oculi eorum, quia non erat herba.
text_pt: E os jumentos monteses se põem nos lugares altos, sorvem o vento como os chacais; desfalecem os seus olhos, porquanto não há erva.
text_el: ὄνοι ἄγριοι ἔστησαν ἐπὶ νάπας εἵλκυσαν ἄνεμον ἐξέλιπον οἱ ὀφθαλμοὶ αὐτῶν ὅτι οὐκ ἦν χόρτος ἀπὸ λαοῦ ἀδικίας

text_en: If our iniquities have testified against us, O Lord , do it for your name's sake, for our rebellions are many, we have sinned against you.
text_la: Si iniquitates nostræ responderint nobis, Domine, fac propter nomen tuum : quoniam multæ sunt aversiones nostræ : tibi peccavimus.
text_pt: Posto que as nossas maldades testificam contra nós, ó Senhor, age por amor do teu nome; porque as nossas rebeldias se multiplicaram; contra ti pecamos.
text_el: εἰ αἱ ἁμαρτίαι ἡμῶν ἀντέστησαν ἡμῖν κύριε ποίησον ἡμῖν ἕνεκεν σοῦ ὅτι πολλαὶ αἱ ἁμαρτίαι ἡμῶν ἐναντίον σοῦ ὅτι σοὶ ἡμάρτομεν

text_en: O expectation of Israel , the Saviour thereof in time of trouble: why will you be as a stranger in the land, and as a wayfaring man turning in to lodge?
text_la: Exspectatio Israël, salvator ejus in tempore tribulationis, quare quasi colonus futurus es in terra, et quasi viator declinans ad manendum?
text_pt: Ó esperança de Israel, e Redentor seu no tempo da angústia, por que serias como um estrangeiro na terra e como o viandante que se retira a passar a noite?
text_el: ὑπομονὴ Ισραηλ κύριε καὶ σῴζεις ἐν καιρῷ κακῶν ἵνα τί ἐγενήθης ὡσεὶ πάροικος ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς καὶ ὡς αὐτόχθων ἐκκλίνων εἰς κατάλυμα

text_en: Why will you be as a wandering man , as a mighty man that cannot save? But you, O Lord , are among us, and your name is called upon by us, forsake us not.
text_la: quare futurus es velut vir vagus, ut fortis qui non potest salvare? Tu autem in nobis es, Domine, et nomen tuum invocatum est super nos : ne derelinquas nos.
text_pt: Por que serias como homem surpreendido, como poderoso que não pode livrar? Mas tu estás no meio de nós, ó Senhor, e nós somos chamados pelo teu nome; não nos desampares.
text_el: μὴ ἔσῃ ὥσπερ ἄνθρωπος ὑπνῶν ἢ ὡς ἀνὴρ οὐ δυνάμενος σῴζειν καὶ σὺ ἐν ἡμῖν εἶ κύριε καὶ τὸ ὄνομά σου ἐπικέκληται ἐφ' ἡμᾶς μὴ ἐπιλάθῃ ἡμῶν

text_en: Thus says the Lord to this people, that have loved to move their feet, and have not rested, and have not pleased the Lord : He will now remember their iniquities , and visit their sins .
text_la: Hæc dicit Dominus populo huic, qui dilexit movere pedes suos, et non quievit, et Domino non placuit : Nunc recordabitur iniquitatum eorum, et visitabit peccata eorum.
text_pt: Assim diz o Senhor, acerca deste povo: Pois que tanto gostaram de andar errantes, e não retiveram os seus pés, por isso o Senhor não se agrada deles, mas agora se lembrará da iniqüidade deles, e visitará os seus pecados.
text_el: οὕτως λέγει κύριος τῷ λαῷ τούτῳ ἠγάπησαν κινεῖν πόδας αὐτῶν καὶ οὐκ ἐφείσαντο καὶ ὁ θεὸς οὐκ εὐδόκησεν ἐν αὐτοῖς νῦν μνησθήσεται τῶν ἀδικιῶν αὐτῶν

text_en: And the Lord said to me: Pray not for this people for their good .
text_la: Et dixit Dominus ad me : Noli orare pro populo isto in bonum.
text_pt: Disse-me mais o Senhor: Não rogues por este povo para seu bem.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν κύριος πρός με μὴ προσεύχου περὶ τοῦ λαοῦ τούτου εἰς ἀγαθά

text_en: When they fast I will not hear their prayers : and if they offer holocausts and victims, I will not receive them: for I will consume them by the sword, and by famine, and by the pestilence.
text_la: Cum jejunaverint, non exaudiam preces eorum, et si obtulerint holocautomata et victimas, non suscipiam ea : quoniam gladio, et fame, et peste consumam eos.
text_pt: Quando jejuarem, não ouvirei o seu clamor, e quando oferecerem holocaustos e ofertas de alimentos, não me agradarei deles; antes eu os consumirei pela espada, e pela fome e pela peste.
text_el: ὅτι ἐὰν νηστεύσωσιν οὐκ εἰσακούσομαι τῆς δεήσεως αὐτῶν καὶ ἐὰν προσενέγκωσιν ὁλοκαυτώματα καὶ θυσίας οὐκ εὐδοκήσω ἐν αὐτοῖς ὅτι ἐν μαχαίρᾳ καὶ ἐν λιμῷ καὶ ἐν θανάτῳ ἐγὼ συντελέσω αὐτούς

text_en: And I said: Ah, ah, ah, O Lord God , the prophets say to them: You shall not see the sword, and there shall be no famine among you, but he will give you true peace in this place.
text_la: Et dixi : A, a, a, Domine Deus : prophetæ dicunt eis : Non videbitis gladium, et fames non erit in vobis : sed pacem veram dabit vobis in loco isto.
text_pt: Então disse eu: Ah! Senhor DEUS, eis que os profetas lhes dizem: Não vereis espada, e não tereis fome; antes vos darei paz verdadeira neste lugar.
text_el: καὶ εἶπα ὦ κύριε ἰδοὺ οἱ προφῆται αὐτῶν προφητεύουσιν καὶ λέγουσιν οὐκ ὄψεσθε μάχαιραν οὐδὲ λιμὸς ἔσται ἐν ὑμῖν ὅτι ἀλήθειαν καὶ εἰρήνην δώσω ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς καὶ ἐν τῷ τόπῳ τούτῳ

text_en: And the Lord said to me: The prophets prophesy falsely in my name : I sent them not, neither have I commanded them, nor have I spoken to them: they prophesy unto you a lying vision, and divination and deceit , and the seduction of their own heart.
text_la: Et dicit Dominus ad me : Falso prophetæ vaticinantur in nomine meo : non misi eos, et non præcepi eis, neque locutus sum ad eos. Visionem mendacem, et divinationem, et fraudulentiam, et seductionem cordis sui, prophetant vobis.
text_pt: E disse-me o Senhor: Os profetas profetizam falsamente no meu nome; nunca os enviei, nem lhes dei ordem, nem lhes falei; visão falsa, e adivinhação, e vaidade, e o engano do seu coração é o que eles vos profetizam.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν κύριος πρός με ψευδῆ οἱ προφῆται προφητεύουσιν ἐπὶ τῷ ὀνόματί μου οὐκ ἀπέστειλα αὐτοὺς καὶ οὐκ ἐνετειλάμην αὐτοῖς καὶ οὐκ ἐλάλησα πρὸς αὐτούς ὅτι ὁράσεις ψευδεῖς καὶ μαντείας καὶ οἰωνίσματα καὶ προαιρέσεις καρδίας αὐτῶν αὐτοὶ προφητεύουσιν ὑμῖν

text_en: Therefore thus says the Lord concerning the prophets that prophesy in my name , whom I did not send, that say: Sword and famine shall not be in this land: By sword and famine shall those prophets be consumed.
text_la: Idcirco hæc dicit Dominus de prophetis qui prophetant in nomine meo, quos ego non misi, dicentes : Gladius et fames non erit in terra hac : In gladio et fame consumentur prophetæ illi.
text_pt: Portanto assim diz o Senhor acerca dos profetas que profetizam no meu nome, sem que eu os tenha mandado, e que dizem: Nem espada, nem fome haverá nesta terra: À espada e à fome, serão consumidos esses profetas.
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο τάδε λέγει κύριος περὶ τῶν προφητῶν τῶν προφητευόντων ἐπὶ τῷ ὀνόματί μου ψευδῆ καὶ ἐγὼ οὐκ ἀπέστειλα αὐτούς οἳ λέγουσιν μάχαιρα καὶ λιμὸς οὐκ ἔσται ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς ταύτης ἐν θανάτῳ νοσερῷ ἀποθανοῦνται καὶ ἐν λιμῷ συντελεσθήσονται οἱ προφῆται

text_en: And the people to whom they prophesy , shall be cast out in the streets of Jerusalem because of the famine and the sword, and there shall be none to bury them: they and their wives, their sons and their daughters, and I will pour out their own wickedness upon them.
text_la: Et populi quibus prophetant erunt projecti in viis Jerusalem præ fame et gladio, et non erit qui sepeliat eos : ipsi et uxores eorum, filii et filiæ eorum : et effundam super eos malum suum.
text_pt: E o povo a quem eles profetizam será lançado nas ruas de Jerusalém, por causa da fome e da espada; e não haverá quem os sepultem, tanto a eles, como as suas mulheres, e os seus filhos e as suas filhas; porque derramarei sobre eles a sua maldade.
text_el: καὶ ὁ λαός οἷς αὐτοὶ προφητεύουσιν αὐτοῖς καὶ ἔσονται ἐρριμμένοι ἐν ταῖς διόδοις Ιερουσαλημ ἀπὸ προσώπου μαχαίρας καὶ τοῦ λιμοῦ καὶ οὐκ ἔσται ὁ θάπτων αὐτούς καὶ αἱ γυναῖκες αὐτῶν καὶ οἱ υἱοὶ αὐτῶν καὶ αἱ θυγατέρες αὐτῶν καὶ ἐκχεῶ ἐπ' αὐτοὺς τὰ κακὰ αὐτῶν

text_en: And you shall speak this word to them: Let my eyes shed down tears night and day, and let them not cease, because the virgin daughter of my people is afflicted with a great affliction, with an exceeding grievous evil .
text_la: Et dices ad eos verbum istud : Deducant oculi mei lacrimam per noctem et diem, et non taceant, quoniam contritione magna contrita est virgo filia populi mei, plaga pessima vehementer.
text_pt: Portanto lhes dirás esta palavra: Os meus olhos derramem lágrimas de noite e de dia, e não cessem; porque a virgem, filha do meu povo, está gravemente ferida, de chaga mui dolorosa.
text_el: καὶ ἐρεῖς πρὸς αὐτοὺς τὸν λόγον τοῦτον καταγάγετε ἐπ' ὀφθαλμοὺς ὑμῶν δάκρυα ἡμέρας καὶ νυκτός καὶ μὴ διαλιπέτωσαν ὅτι συντρίμματι συνετρίβη θυγάτηρ λαοῦ μου καὶ πληγῇ ὀδυνηρᾷ σφόδρα

text_en: If I go forth into the fields, behold the slain with the sword: and if I enter into the city, behold them that are consumed with famine. The prophet also and the priest have gone into a land which they knew not.
text_la: Si egressus fuero ad agros, ecce occisi gladio : et si introiero in civitatem, ecce attenuati fame. Propheta quoque et sacerdos abierunt in terram quam ignorabant.
text_pt: Se eu saio ao campo, eis ali os mortos à espada, e, se entro na cidade, estão ali os debilitados pela fome; e até os profetas e os sacerdotes percorrem uma terra, que não conhecem.
text_el: ἐὰν ἐξέλθω εἰς τὸ πεδίον καὶ ἰδοὺ τραυματίαι μαχαίρας καὶ ἐὰν εἰσέλθω εἰς τὴν πόλιν καὶ ἰδοὺ πόνος λιμοῦ ὅτι ἱερεὺς καὶ προφήτης ἐπορεύθησαν εἰς γῆν ἣν οὐκ ᾔδεισαν

text_en: Have you utterly cast away Juda , or has your soul abhorred Sion? Why then have you struck us, so that there is no healing for us? We have looked for peace, and there is no good : and for the time of healing, and behold trouble.
text_la: Numquid projiciens abjecisti Judam? aut Sion abominata est anima tua? quare ergo percussisti nos ita ut nulla sit sanitas? Exspectavimus pacem, et non est bonum : et tempus curationis, et ecce turbatio.
text_pt: Porventura já de todo rejeitaste a Judá? Ou repugna a tua alma a Sião? Por que nos feriste de tal modo que já não há cura para nós? Aguardamos a paz, e não aparece o bem; e o tempo da cura, e eis aqui turbação.
text_el: μὴ ἀποδοκιμάζων ἀπεδοκίμασας τὸν Ιουδαν καὶ ἀπὸ Σιων ἀπέστη ἡ ψυχή σου ἵνα τί ἔπαισας ἡμᾶς καὶ οὐκ ἔστιν ἡμῖν ἴασις ὑπεμείναμεν εἰς εἰρήνην καὶ οὐκ ἦν ἀγαθά εἰς καιρὸν ἰάσεως καὶ ἰδοὺ ταραχή

text_en: We acknowledge, O Lord , our wickedness , the iniquities of our fathers, because we have sinned against you.
text_la: Cognovimus, Domine, impietates nostras, iniquitates patrum nostrorum, quia peccavimus tibi.
text_pt: Ah! Senhor! conhecemos a nossa impiedade e a maldade de nossos pais; porque pecamos contra ti.
text_el: ἔγνωμεν κύριε ἁμαρτήματα ἡμῶν ἀδικίας πατέρων ἡμῶν ὅτι ἡμάρτομεν ἐναντίον σου

text_en: Give us not to be a reproach, for your name's sake, and do not disgrace in us the throne of your glory : remember, break not your covenant with us.
text_la: Ne des nos in opprobrium, propter nomen tuum, neque facias nobis contumeliam solii gloriæ tuæ : recordare, ne irritum facias fœdus tuum nobiscum.
text_pt: Não nos rejeites por amor do teu nome; não abatas o trono da tua glória; lembra-te, e não anules a tua aliança conosco.
text_el: κόπασον διὰ τὸ ὄνομά σου μὴ ἀπολέσῃς θρόνον δόξης σου μνήσθητι μὴ διασκεδάσῃς τὴν διαθήκην σου τὴν μεθ' ἡμῶν

text_en: Are there any among the graven things of the Gentiles that can send rain? Or can the heavens give showers? Are you not the Lord our God , whom we have looked for? For you have made all these things.
text_la: Numquid sunt in sculptilibus gentium qui pluant? aut cæli possunt dare imbres? nonne tu es Dominus Deus noster, quem exspectavimus? tu enim fecisti omnia hæc.
text_pt: Porventura há, entre as vaidades dos gentios, alguém que faça chover? Ou podem os céus dar chuvas? Não és tu, ó Senhor nosso Deus? Portanto em ti esperamos, pois tu fazes todas estas coisas.
text_el: μὴ ἔστιν ἐν εἰδώλοις τῶν ἐθνῶν ὑετίζων καὶ εἰ ὁ οὐρανὸς δώσει πλησμονὴν αὐτοῦ οὐχὶ σὺ εἶ αὐτός καὶ ὑπομενοῦμέν σε ὅτι σὺ ἐποίησας πάντα ταῦτα

text_en: And the Lord said to me: If Moses and Samuel shall stand before me, my soul is not towards this people: cast them out from my sight, and let them go forth.
text_la: Et dixit Dominus ad me : Si steterit Moyses et Samuel coram me, non est anima mea ad populum istum : ejice illos a facie mea, et egrediantur.
text_pt: Disse-me, porém, o SENHOR: Ainda que Moisés e Samuel se pusessem diante de mim, não estaria a minha alma com este povo; lança-os de diante da minha face, e saiam.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν κύριος πρός με ἐὰν στῇ Μωυσῆς καὶ Σαμουηλ πρὸ προσώπου μου οὐκ ἔστιν ἡ ψυχή μου πρὸς αὐτούς ἐξαπόστειλον τὸν λαὸν τοῦτον καὶ ἐξελθέτωσαν

text_en: And if they shall say unto you: Whither shall we go forth? You shall say to them: Thus says the Lord : Such as are for death, to death: and such as are for the sword, to the sword: and such as are for famine, to famine: and such as are for captivity, to captivity.
text_la: Quod si dixerint ad te : Quo egrediemur? dices ad eos : Hæc dicit Dominus : Qui ad mortem, ad mortem, et qui ad gladium, ad gladium, et qui ad famem, ad famem, et qui ad captivitatem, ad captivitatem.
text_pt: E será que, quando te disserem: Para onde iremos? Dir-lhes-ás: Assim diz o Senhor: Os que para a morte, para a morte, e os que para a espada, para a espada; e os que para a fome, para a fome; e os que para o cativeiro, para o cativeiro.
text_el: καὶ ἔσται ἐὰν εἴπωσιν πρὸς σέ ποῦ ἐξελευσόμεθα καὶ ἐρεῖς πρὸς αὐτούς τάδε λέγει κύριος ὅσοι εἰς θάνατον εἰς θάνατον καὶ ὅσοι εἰς μάχαιραν εἰς μάχαιραν καὶ ὅσοι εἰς λιμόν εἰς λιμόν καὶ ὅσοι εἰς αἰχμαλωσίαν εἰς αἰχμαλωσίαν

text_en: And I will visit them with four kinds, says the Lord : The sword to kill, and the dogs to tear, and the fowls of the air, and the beasts of the earth, to devour and to destroy.
text_la: Et visitabo super eos quatuor species, dicit Dominus : gladium ad occisionem, et canes ad lacerandum, et volatilia cæli et bestias terræ ad devorandum et dissipandum.
text_pt: Porque visitá-los-ei com quatro gêneros de males, diz o Senhor: com espada para matar, e com cães, para os arrastarem, e com aves dos céus, e com animais da terra, para os devorarem e destruírem.
text_el: καὶ ἐκδικήσω ἐπ' αὐτοὺς τέσσαρα εἴδη λέγει κύριος τὴν μάχαιραν εἰς σφαγὴν καὶ τοὺς κύνας εἰς διασπασμὸν καὶ τὰ θηρία τῆς γῆς καὶ τὰ πετεινὰ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ εἰς βρῶσιν καὶ εἰς διαφθοράν

text_en: And I will give them up to the rage of all the kingdoms of the earth: because of Manasses the son of Ezechias the king of Juda , for all that he did in Jerusalem .
text_la: Et dabo eos in fervorem universis regnis terræ, propter Manassen filium Ezechiæ regis Juda, super omnibus quæ fecit in Jerusalem.
text_pt: Entregá-los-ei ao desterro em todos os reinos da terra; por causa de Manassés, filho de Ezequias, rei de Judá, e por tudo quanto fez em Jerusalém.
text_el: καὶ παραδώσω αὐτοὺς εἰς ἀνάγκας πάσαις ταῖς βασιλείαις τῆς γῆς διὰ Μανασση υἱὸν Εζεκιου βασιλέα Ιουδα περὶ πάντων ὧν ἐποίησεν ἐν Ιερουσαλημ

text_en: For who shall have pity on you, O Jerusalem ? Or who shall bemoan you? Or who shall go to pray for your peace?
text_la: Quis enim miserebitur tui, Jerusalem, aut quis contristabitur pro te? aut quis ibit ad rogandum pro pace tua?
text_pt: Porque quem se compadeceria de ti, ó Jerusalém? Ou quem se entristeceria por ti? Ou quem se desviaria a perguntar pela tua paz?
text_el: τίς φείσεται ἐπὶ σοί Ιερουσαλημ καὶ τίς δειλιάσει ἐπὶ σοί ἢ τίς ἀνακάμψει εἰς εἰρήνην σοι

text_en: You have forsaken me, says the Lord , you have gone backward: and I will stretch out my hand against you, and I will destroy you: I am weary of entreating you.
text_la: Tu reliquisti me, dicit Dominus; retrorsum abiisti : et extendam manum meam super te, et interficiam te : laboravi rogans.
text_pt: Tu me deixaste, diz o Senhor, e tornaste-te para trás; por isso estenderei a minha mão contra ti, e te destruirei; já estou cansado de me arrepender.
text_el: σὺ ἀπεστράφης με λέγει κύριος ὀπίσω πορεύσῃ καὶ ἐκτενῶ τὴν χεῖρά μου καὶ διαφθερῶ σε καὶ οὐκέτι ἀνήσω αὐτούς

text_en: And I will scatter them with a fan in the gates of the land: I have killed and destroyed my people, and yet they are not returned from their ways.
text_la: Et dispergam eos ventilabro in portis terræ : interfeci et disperdidi populum meum, et tamen a viis suis non sunt reversi.
text_pt: E padejá-los-ei com a pá nas portas da terra; já desfilhei, e destruí o meu povo; não voltaram dos seus caminhos.
text_el: καὶ διασπερῶ αὐτοὺς ἐν διασπορᾷ ἐν πύλαις λαοῦ μου ἠτεκνώθησαν ἀπώλεσαν τὸν λαόν μου διὰ τὰς κακίας αὐτῶν

text_en: Their widows are multiplied unto me above the sand of the sea: I have brought upon them against the mother of the young man a spoiler at noonday: I have cast a terror on a sudden upon the cities.
text_la: Multiplicatæ sunt mihi viduæ ejus super arenam maris : induxi eis super matrem adolescentis vastatorem meridie : misi super civitates repente terrorem.
text_pt: As suas viúvas mais se multiplicaram do que a areia dos mares; trouxe ao meio-dia um destruidor sobre a mãe dos jovens; fiz que caísse de repente sobre ela, e enchesse a cidade de terrores.
text_el: ἐπληθύνθησαν χῆραι αὐτῶν ὑπὲρ τὴν ἄμμον τῆς θαλάσσης ἐπήγαγον ἐπὶ μητέρα νεανίσκου ταλαιπωρίαν ἐν μεσημβρίᾳ ἐπέρριψα ἐπ' αὐτὴν ἐξαίφνης τρόμον καὶ σπουδήν

text_en: She that has borne seven has become weak, her soul has fainted away: her sun has gone down, while it was yet day: she is confounded, and ashamed: and the residue of them I will give up to the sword in the sight of their enemies, says the Lord .
text_la: Infirmata est quæ peperit septem; defecit anima ejus : occidit ei sol cum adhuc esset dies : confusa est, et erubuit : et residuos ejus in gladium dabo in conspectu inimicorum eorum, ait Dominus.
text_pt: A que dava à luz sete se enfraqueceu; expirou a sua alma; pôs-se-lhe o sol sendo ainda de dia, confundiu-se, e envergonhou-se; e os que ficarem dela entregarei à espada, diante dos seus inimigos, diz o Senhor.
text_el: ἐκενώθη ἡ τίκτουσα ἑπτά ἀπεκάκησεν ἡ ψυχὴ αὐτῆς ἐπέδυ ὁ ἥλιος αὐτῇ ἔτι μεσούσης τῆς ἡμέρας κατῃσχύνθη καὶ ὠνειδίσθη τοὺς καταλοίπους αὐτῶν εἰς μάχαιραν δώσω ἐναντίον τῶν ἐχθρῶν αὐτῶν

text_en: Woe is me, my mother: why have you borne me a man of strife, a man of contention to all the earth? I have not lent on usury , neither has any man lent to me on usury : yet all curse me.
text_la: Væ mihi, mater mea! quare genuisti me, virum rixæ, virum discordiæ in universa terra? Non fœneravi, nec fœneravit mihi quisquam : omnes maledicunt mihi.
text_pt: Ai de mim, minha mãe, por que me deste à luz homem de rixa e homem de contendas para toda a terra? Nunca lhes emprestei com usura, nem eles me emprestaram com usura, todavia cada um deles me amaldiçoa.
text_el: οἴμμοι ἐγώ μῆτερ ὡς τίνα με ἔτεκες ἄνδρα δικαζόμενον καὶ διακρινόμενον πάσῃ τῇ γῇ οὔτε ὠφέλησα οὔτε ὠφέλησέν με οὐδείς ἡ ἰσχύς μου ἐξέλιπεν ἐν τοῖς καταρωμένοις με

text_en: The Lord says to me: Assuredly it shall be well with your remnant, assuredly I shall help you in the time of affliction, and in the time of tribulation against the enemy.
text_la: Dicit Dominus : Si non reliquiæ tuæ in bonum, si non occurri tibi in tempore afflictionis, et in tempore tribulationis adversus inimicum.
text_pt: Disse o Senhor: De certo que o teu remanescente será para o bem; de certo, no tempo da calamidade, e no tempo da angústia, farei que o inimigo te dirija súplicas.
text_el: γένοιτο δέσποτα κατευθυνόντων αὐτῶν εἰ μὴ παρέστην σοι ἐν καιρῷ τῶν κακῶν αὐτῶν καὶ ἐν καιρῷ θλίψεως αὐτῶν εἰς ἀγαθὰ πρὸς τὸν ἐχθρόν

text_en: Shall iron be allied with the iron from the north, and the brass?
text_la: Numquid fœderabitur ferrum ferro ab aquilone, et æs?
text_pt: Pode alguém quebrar o ferro, o ferro do norte, ou o aço?
text_el: εἰ γνωσθήσεται σίδηρος καὶ περιβόλαιον χαλκοῦν

text_en: Your riches and your treasures I will give unto spoil for nothing, because of all your sins , even in all your borders.
text_la: Divitias tuas et thesauros tuos in direptionem dabo gratis, in omnibus peccatis tuis, et in omnibus terminis tuis.
text_pt: As tuas riquezas e os teus tesouros entregarei sem preço ao saque; e isso por todos os teus pecados, mesmo em todos os teus limites.
text_el: ἡ ἰσχύς σου καὶ τοὺς θησαυρούς σου εἰς προνομὴν δώσω ἀντάλλαγμα διὰ πάσας τὰς ἁμαρτίας σου καὶ ἐν πᾶσι τοῖς ὁρίοις σου

text_en: And I will bring your enemies out of a land, which you know not: for a fire is kindled in my rage, it shall burn upon you.
text_la: Et adducam inimicos tuos de terra quam nescis, quia ignis succensus est in furore meo : super vos ardebit.
text_pt: E te farei passar aos teus inimigos numa terra que não conheces; porque o fogo se acendeu em minha ira, e sobre vós arderá;
text_el: καὶ καταδουλώσω σε κύκλῳ τοῖς ἐχθροῖς σου ἐν τῇ γῇ ᾗ οὐκ ᾔδεις ὅτι πῦρ ἐκκέκαυται ἐκ τοῦ θυμοῦ μου ἐφ' ὑμᾶς καυθήσεται

text_en: O Lord , you know , remember me, and visit me, and defend me from them that persecute me, do not defend me in your patience: know that for your sake I have suffered reproach.
text_la: Tu scis, Domine : recordare mei, et visita me, et tuere me ab his qui persequuntur me. Noli in patientia tua suscipere me : scito quoniam sustinui propter te opprobrium.
text_pt: Tu, ó Senhor, o sabes; lembra-te de mim, e visita-me, e vinga-me dos meus perseguidores; não me arrebates por tua longanimidade; sabe que por amor de ti tenho sofrido afronta.
text_el: κύριε μνήσθητί μου καὶ ἐπίσκεψαί με καὶ ἀθῴωσόν με ἀπὸ τῶν καταδιωκόντων με μὴ εἰς μακροθυμίαν γνῶθι ὡς ἔλαβον περὶ σοῦ ὀνειδισμὸν

text_en: Your words were found, and I ate them, and your word was to me a joy and gladness of my heart : for your name is called upon me, O Lord God of hosts .
text_la: Inventi sunt sermones tui, et comedi eos : et factum est mihi verbum tuum in gaudium et in lætitiam cordis mei, quoniam invocatum est nomen tuum super me, Domine Deus exercituum.
text_pt: Achando-se as tuas palavras, logo as comi, e a tua palavra foi para mim o gozo e alegria do meu coração; porque pelo teu nome sou chamado, ó Senhor Deus dos Exércitos.
text_el: ὑπὸ τῶν ἀθετούντων τοὺς λόγους σου συντέλεσον αὐτούς καὶ ἔσται ὁ λόγος σου ἐμοὶ εἰς εὐφροσύνην καὶ χαρὰν καρδίας μου ὅτι ἐπικέκληται τὸ ὄνομά σου ἐπ' ἐμοί κύριε παντοκράτωρ

text_en: I sat not in the assembly of jesters, nor did I make a boast of the presence of your hand: I sat alone, because you have filled me with threats.
text_la: Non sedi in concilio ludentium, et gloriatus sum a facie manus tuæ : solus sedebam, quoniam comminatione replesti me.
text_pt: Nunca me assentei na assembléia dos zombadores, nem me regozijei; por causa da tua mão me assentei solitário; pois me encheste de indignação.
text_el: οὐκ ἐκάθισα ἐν συνεδρίῳ αὐτῶν παιζόντων ἀλλὰ εὐλαβούμην ἀπὸ προσώπου χειρός σου κατὰ μόνας ἐκαθήμην ὅτι πικρίας ἐνεπλήσθην

text_en: Why is my sorrow become perpetual, and my wound desperate so as to refuse to be healed? It has become to me as the falsehood of deceitful waters that cannot be trusted.
text_la: Quare factus est dolor meus perpetuus, et plaga mea desperabilis renuit curari? facta est mihi quasi mendacium aquarum infidelium.
text_pt: Por que dura a minha dor continuamente, e a minha ferida me dói, e já não admite cura? Serias tu para mim como coisa mentirosa e como águas inconstantes?
text_el: ἵνα τί οἱ λυποῦντές με κατισχύουσίν μου ἡ πληγή μου στερεά πόθεν ἰαθήσομαι γινομένη ἐγενήθη μοι ὡς ὕδωρ ψευδὲς οὐκ ἔχον πίστιν

text_en: Therefore thus says the Lord : If you will be converted , I will convert you, and you shall stand before my face; and you will separate the precious from the vile, you shall be as my mouth: they shall be turned to you, and you shall not be turned to them.
text_la: Propter hoc hæc dicit Dominus : Si converteris, convertam te, et ante faciem meam stabis : et si separaveris pretiosum a vili, quasi os meum eris : convertentur ipsi ad te, et tu non converteris ad eos.
text_pt: Portanto assim diz o Senhor: Se tu voltares, então te trarei, e estarás diante de mim; e se apartares o precioso do vil, serás como a minha boca; tornem-se eles para ti, mas não voltes tu para eles.
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο τάδε λέγει κύριος ἐὰν ἐπιστρέψῃς καὶ ἀποκαταστήσω σε καὶ πρὸ προσώπου μου στήσῃ καὶ ἐὰν ἐξαγάγῃς τίμιον ἀπὸ ἀναξίου ὡς στόμα μου ἔσῃ καὶ ἀναστρέψουσιν αὐτοὶ πρὸς σέ καὶ σὺ οὐκ ἀναστρέψεις πρὸς αὐτούς

text_en: And I will make you to this people as a strong wall of brass: and they shall fight against you, and shall not prevail: for I am with you to save you, and to deliver you, says the Lord .
text_la: Et dabo te populo huic in murum æreum fortem : et bellabunt adversum te, et non prævalebunt, quia ego tecum sum ut salvem te, et eruam te, dicit Dominus :
text_pt: E eu te porei contra este povo como forte muro de bronze; e pelejarão contra ti, mas não prevalecerão contra ti; porque eu sou contigo para te guardar, para te livrar deles, diz o Senhor.
text_el: καὶ δώσω σε τῷ λαῷ τούτῳ ὡς τεῖχος ὀχυρὸν χαλκοῦν καὶ πολεμήσουσιν πρὸς σὲ καὶ οὐ μὴ δύνωνται πρὸς σέ διότι μετὰ σοῦ εἰμι τοῦ σῴζειν σε

text_en: And I will deliver you out of the hand of the wicked , and I will redeem you out of the hand of the mighty.
text_la: et liberabo te de manu pessimorum, et redimam te de manu fortium.
text_pt: E arrebatar-te-ei da mão dos malignos, e livrar-te-ei da mão dos fortes.
text_el: καὶ ἐξαιρεῖσθαί σε ἐκ χειρὸς πονηρῶν καὶ λυτρώσομαί σε ἐκ χειρὸς λοιμῶν

text_en: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying:
text_la: Et factum est verbum Domini ad me, dicens:
text_pt: E veio a mim a palavra do SENHOR, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ σὺ μὴ λάβῃς γυναῖκα λέγει κύριος ὁ θεὸς Ισραηλ

text_en: You shall not take you a wife, neither shall you have sons and daughters in this place.
text_la: Non accipies uxorem, et non erunt tibi filii et filiæ in loco isto.
text_pt: Não tomarás para ti mulher, nem terás filhos nem filhas neste lugar.
text_el: καὶ οὐ γεννηθήσεταί σοι υἱὸς οὐδὲ θυγάτηρ ἐν τῷ τόπῳ τούτῳ

text_en: For thus says the Lord concerning the sons and daughters, that are born in this place, and concerning their mothers that bore them: and concerning their fathers, of whom they were born in this land:
text_la: Quia hæc dicit Dominus super filios et filias qui generantur in loco isto, et super matres eorum, quæ genuerunt eos, et super patres eorum, de quorum stirpe sunt nati in terra hac :
text_pt: Porque assim diz o Senhor, acerca dos filhos e das filhas que nascerem neste lugar, acerca de suas mães, que os tiverem, e de seus pais que os gerarem nesta terra:
text_el: ὅτι τάδε λέγει κύριος περὶ τῶν υἱῶν καὶ περὶ τῶν θυγατέρων τῶν γεννωμένων ἐν τῷ τόπῳ τούτῳ καὶ περὶ τῶν μητέρων αὐτῶν τῶν τετοκυιῶν αὐτοὺς καὶ περὶ τῶν πατέρων αὐτῶν τῶν γεγεννηκότων αὐτοὺς ἐν τῇ γῇ ταύτῃ

text_en: They shall die by the death of grievous illnesses: they shall not be lamented, and they shall not be buried, they shall be as dung upon the face of the earth: and they shall be consumed with the sword, and with famine: and their carcasses shall be meat for the fowls of the air, and for the beasts of the earth.
text_la: Mortibus ægrotationum morientur : non plangentur, et non sepelientur : in sterquilinium super faciem terræ erunt, et gladio et fame consumentur : et erit cadaver eorum in escam volatilibus cæli et bestiis terræ.
text_pt: Morrerão de enfermidades dolorosas, e não serão pranteados nem sepultados; servirão de esterco sobre a face da terra; e pela espada e pela fome serão consumidos, e os seus cadáveres servirão de mantimento para as aves do céu e para os animais da terra.
text_el: ἐν θανάτῳ νοσερῷ ἀποθανοῦνται οὐ κοπήσονται καὶ οὐ ταφήσονται εἰς παράδειγμα ἐπὶ προσώπου τῆς γῆς ἔσονται καὶ τοῖς θηρίοις τῆς γῆς καὶ τοῖς πετεινοῖς τοῦ οὐρανοῦ ἐν μαχαίρᾳ πεσοῦνται καὶ ἐν λιμῷ συντελεσθήσονται

text_en: For thus says the Lord : Enter not into the house of feasting, neither go to mourn, nor to comfort them: because I have taken away my peace from this people, says the Lord , my mercy and commiserations.
text_la: Hæc enim dicit Dominus : Ne ingrediaris domum convivii, neque vadas ad plangendum, neque consoleris eos, quia abstuli pacem meam a populo isto, dicit Dominus, misericordiam et miserationes.
text_pt: Porque assim diz o Senhor: Não entres na casa do luto, nem vás a lamentar, nem te compadeças deles; porque deste povo, diz o Senhor, retirei a minha paz, benignidade e misericórdia.
text_el: τάδε λέγει κύριος μὴ εἰσέλθῃς εἰς θίασον αὐτῶν καὶ μὴ πορευθῇς τοῦ κόψασθαι καὶ μὴ πενθήσῃς αὐτούς ὅτι ἀφέστακα τὴν εἰρήνην μου ἀπὸ τοῦ λαοῦ τούτου

text_en: Both the great and the little shall die in this land: they shall not be buried nor lamented, and men shall not cut themselves, nor make themselves bald for them.
text_la: Et morientur grandes et parvi in terra ista : non sepelientur, neque plangentur, et non se incident, neque calvitium fiet pro eis.
text_pt: E morrerão grandes e pequenos nesta terra, e não serão sepultados, e não os prantearão, nem se farão por eles incisões, nem por eles se raparão os cabelos.
text_el: οὐ μὴ κόψωνται αὐτοὺς οὐδὲ ἐντομίδας οὐ μὴ ποιήσωσιν καὶ οὐ ξυρήσονται

text_en: And they shall not break bread among them to him that mourns, to comfort him for the dead: neither shall they give them for their father and mother.
text_la: Et non frangent inter eos lugenti panem ad consolandum super mortuo, et non dabunt eis potum calicis ad consolandum super patre suo et matre.
text_pt: E não se partirá pão para consolá-los por causa de seus mortos; nem lhes darão a beber do copo de consolação, pelo pai ou pela mãe de alguém.
text_el: καὶ οὐ μὴ κλασθῇ ἄρτος ἐν πένθει αὐτῶν εἰς παράκλησιν ἐπὶ τεθνηκότι οὐ ποτιοῦσιν αὐτὸν ποτήριον εἰς παράκλησιν ἐπὶ πατρὶ καὶ μητρὶ αὐτοῦ

text_en: And do not go into the house of feasting, to sit with them, and to eat and drink:
text_la: Et domum convivii non ingrediaris, ut sedeas cum eis, et comedas, et bibas.
text_pt: Nem entres na casa do banquete, para te assentares com eles a comer e a beber.
text_el: εἰς οἰκίαν πότου οὐκ εἰσελεύσῃ συγκαθίσαι μετ' αὐτῶν τοῦ φαγεῖν καὶ πιεῖν

text_en: For thus says the Lord of hosts , the God of Israel : Behold I will take away out of this place in your sight, and in your days the voice of mirth, and the voice of gladness , the voice of the bridegroom, and the voice of the bride.
text_la: Quia hæc dicit Dominus exercituum, Deus Israël : Ecce ego auferam de loco isto, in oculis vestris, et in diebus vestris, vocem gaudii et vocem lætitiæ, vocem sponsi et vocem sponsæ.
text_pt: Porque assim diz o Senhor dos Exércitos, o Deus de Israel: Eis que farei cessar, neste lugar, perante os vossos olhos, e em vossos dias, a voz de gozo e a voz de alegria, a voz do esposo e a voz da esposa.
text_el: διότι τάδε λέγει κύριος ὁ θεὸς Ισραηλ ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ καταλύω ἐκ τοῦ τόπου τούτου ἐνώπιον τῶν ὀφθαλμῶν ὑμῶν καὶ ἐν ταῖς ἡμέραις ὑμῶν φωνὴν χαρᾶς καὶ φωνὴν εὐφροσύνης φωνὴν νυμφίου καὶ φωνὴν νύμφης

text_en: And when you shall tell this people all these words, and they shall say to you: Wherefore has the Lord pronounced against us all this great evil ? What is our iniquity ? And what is our sin , that we have sinned against the Lord our God ?
text_la: Et cum annuntiaveris populo huic omnia verba hæc, et dixerint tibi : Quare locutus est Dominus super nos omne malum grande istud? quæ iniquitas nostra, et quod peccatum nostrum, quod peccavimus Domino Deo nostro?
text_pt: E será que, quando anunciares a este povo todas estas palavras, e eles te disserem: Por que pronuncia o Senhor sobre nós todo este grande mal? E qual é a nossa iniqüidade, e qual é o nosso pecado, que cometemos contra o Senhor nosso Deus?
text_el: καὶ ἔσται ὅταν ἀναγγείλῃς τῷ λαῷ τούτῳ ἅπαντα τὰ ῥήματα ταῦτα καὶ εἴπωσιν πρὸς σέ διὰ τί ἐλάλησεν κύριος ἐφ' ἡμᾶς πάντα τὰ κακὰ ταῦτα τίς ἡ ἀδικία ἡμῶν καὶ τίς ἡ ἁμαρτία ἡμῶν ἣν ἡμάρτομεν ἔναντι κυρίου τοῦ θεοῦ ἡμῶν

text_en: You shall say to them: Because your fathers forsook me, says the Lord : and went after strange gods, and served them, and adored them: and they forsook me, and kept not my law.
text_la: dices ad eos : Quia dereliquerunt me patres vestri, ait Dominus, et abierunt post deos alienos, et servierunt eis, et adoraverunt eos, et me dereliquerunt, et legem meam non custodierunt.
