text_el: διὰ τοῦτο τάδε λέγει κύριος ἐπὶ Ιωακιμ υἱὸν Ιωσια βασιλέα Ιουδα οὐαὶ ἐπὶ τὸν ἄνδρα τοῦτον οὐ μὴ κόψωνται αὐτόν ὦ ἀδελφέ οὐδὲ μὴ κλαύσονται αὐτόν οἴμμοι κύριε

text_en: He shall be buried with the burial of an ass, rotten and cast forth without the gates of Jerusalem .
text_la: Sepultura asini sepelietur, putrefactus et projectus extra portas Jerusalem.
text_pt: Em sepultura de jumento será sepultado, sendo arrastado e lançado para bem longe, fora das portas de Jerusalém.
text_el: ταφὴν ὄνου ταφήσεται συμψησθεὶς ῥιφήσεται ἐπέκεινα τῆς πύλης Ιερουσαλημ

text_en: Go up to Libanus , and cry: and lift up your voice in Basan, and cry to them that pass by, for all your lovers are destroyed.
text_la: Ascende Libanum, et clama, et in Basan da vocem tuam : et clama ad transeuntes, quia contriti sunt omnes amatores tui.
text_pt: Sobe ao Líbano, e clama, e levanta a tua voz em Basã, e clama desde Abarim; porque estão destruídos todos os teus namorados.
text_el: ἀνάβηθι εἰς τὸν Λίβανον καὶ κέκραξον καὶ εἰς τὴν Βασαν δὸς τὴν φωνήν σου καὶ βόησον εἰς τὸ πέραν τῆς θαλάσσης ὅτι συνετρίβησαν πάντες οἱ ἐρασταί σου

text_en: I spoke to you in your prosperity: and you said: I will not hear: this has been your way from your youth, because you have not heard my voice.
text_la: Locutus sum ad te in abundantia tua, et dixisti : Non audiam : hæc est via tua ab adolescentia tua, quia non audisti vocem meam.
text_pt: Falei contigo na tua prosperidade, mas tu disseste: Não ouvirei. Este tem sido o teu caminho, desde a tua mocidade, pois nunca deste ouvidos à minha voz.
text_el: ἐλάλησα πρὸς σὲ ἐν τῇ παραπτώσει σου καὶ εἶπας οὐκ ἀκούσομαι αὕτη ἡ ὁδός σου ἐκ νεότητός σου οὐκ ἤκουσας τῆς φωνῆς μου

text_en: The wind shall feed all your pastors, and your lovers shall go into captivity and then shall you be confounded, and ashamed of all your wickedness .
text_la: Omnes pastores tuos pascet ventus, et amatores tui in captivitatem ibunt : et tunc confunderis, et erubesces ab omni malitia tua.
text_pt: O vento apascentará a todos os teus pastores, e os teus namorados irão para o cativeiro; certamente então te confundirás, e te envergonharás por causa de toda a tua maldade.
text_el: πάντας τοὺς ποιμένας σου ποιμανεῖ ἄνεμος καὶ οἱ ἐρασταί σου ἐν αἰχμαλωσίᾳ ἐξελεύσονται ὅτι τότε αἰσχυνθήσῃ καὶ ἀτιμωθήσῃ ἀπὸ πάντων τῶν φιλούντων σε

text_en: You that sit in Libanus , and make your nest in the cedars , how have you mourned when sorrows came upon you, as the pains of a woman in labour?
text_la: Quæ sedes in Libano, et nidificas in cedris, quomodo congemuisti cum venissent tibi dolores, quasi dolores parturientis?
text_pt: Ó tu, que habitas no Líbano e fazes o teu ninho nos cedros, quão lastimada serás quando te vierem as dores e os ais como da que está de parto.
text_el: κατοικοῦσα ἐν τῷ Λιβάνῳ ἐννοσσεύουσα ἐν ταῖς κέδροις καταστενάξεις ἐν τῷ ἐλθεῖν σοι ὠδῖνας ὡς τικτούσης

text_en: As I live, says the Lord , if Jechonias the son of Joakim the king of Juda were a ring on my right hand, I would pluck him thence.
text_la: Vivo ego, dicit Dominus, quia si fuerit Jechonias filius Joakim regis Juda annulus in manu dextera mea, inde evellam eum,
text_pt: Vivo eu, diz o Senhor, que ainda que Conias, filho de Jeoiaquim, rei de Judá, fosse o anel do selo na minha mão direita, contudo dali te arrancaria.
text_el: ζῶ ἐγώ λέγει κύριος ἐὰν γενόμενος γένηται Ιεχονιας υἱὸς Ιωακιμ βασιλεὺς Ιουδα ἀποσφράγισμα ἐπὶ τῆς χειρὸς τῆς δεξιᾶς μου ἐκεῖθεν ἐκσπάσω σε

text_en: And I will give you into the hand of them that seek your life, and into the hand of them whose face you fear, and into the hand of Nabuchodonosor king of Babylon , and into the hand of the Chaldeans.
text_la: et dabo te in manu quærentium animam tuam, et in manu quorum tu formidas faciem, et in manu Nabuchodonosor regis Babylonis, et in manu Chaldæorum :
text_pt: E entregar-te-ei na mão dos que buscam a tua vida, e na mão daqueles diante de quem tu temes, a saber, na mão de Nabucodonosor, rei de babilônia, e na mão dos caldeus.
text_el: καὶ παραδώσω σε εἰς χεῖρας τῶν ζητούντων τὴν ψυχήν σου ὧν σὺ εὐλαβῇ ἀπὸ προσώπου αὐτῶν εἰς χεῖρας τῶν Χαλδαίων

text_en: And I will send you, and your mother that bore you, into a strange country, in which you were not born, and there you shall die:
text_la: et mittam te, et matrem tuam quæ genuit te, in terram alienam, in qua nati non estis, ibique moriemini.
text_pt: E lançar-te-ei, a ti e à tua mãe que te deu à luz, para uma terra estranha, em que não nasceste, e ali morrereis.
text_el: καὶ ἀπορρίψω σὲ καὶ τὴν μητέρα σου τὴν τεκοῦσάν σε εἰς γῆν οὗ οὐκ ἐτέχθης ἐκεῖ καὶ ἐκεῖ ἀποθανεῖσθε

text_en: And they shall not return into the land, whereunto they lift up their mind to return thither.
text_la: Et in terram ad quam ipsi levant animam suam ut revertantur illuc, non revertentur.
text_pt: Mas à terra, para a qual eles com toda a alma desejam voltar, para lá não voltarão.
text_el: εἰς δὲ τὴν γῆν ἣν αὐτοὶ εὔχονται ταῖς ψυχαῖς αὐτῶν οὐ μὴ ἀποστρέψωσιν

text_en: Is this man Jechonias an earthen and a broken vessel? Is he a vessel wherein is no pleasure? Why are they cast out, he and his seed, and are cast into a land which they know not?
text_la: Numquid vas fictile atque contritum vir iste Jechonias? numquid vas absque omni voluptate? quare abjecti sunt ipse et semen ejus, et projecti in terram quam ignoraverunt?
text_pt: É, pois, este homem Conias um ídolo desprezado e quebrado, ou um vaso de que ninguém se agrada? Por que razão foram arremessados fora, ele e a sua geração, e arrojados para uma terra que não conhecem?
text_el: ἠτιμώθη Ιεχονιας ὡς σκεῦος οὗ οὐκ ἔστιν χρεία αὐτοῦ ὅτι ἐξερρίφη καὶ ἐξεβλήθη εἰς γῆν ἣν οὐκ ᾔδει

text_en: O earth, earth, earth, hear the word of the Lord .
text_la: Terra, terra, terra, audi sermonem Domini.
text_pt: Ó terra, terra, terra! Ouve a palavra do Senhor.
text_el: γῆ γῆ ἄκουε λόγον κυρίου

text_en: Thus says the Lord : Write this man barren, a man that shall not prosper in his days: for there shall not be a man of his seed that shall sit upon the throne of David , and have power any more in Juda .
text_la: Hæc dicit Dominus : Scribe virum istum sterilem, virum qui in diebus suis non prosperabitur : nec enim erit de semine ejus vir qui sedeat super solium David, et potestatem habeat ultra in Juda.
text_pt: Assim diz o Senhor: Escrevei que este homem está privado de filhos, homem que não prosperará nos seus dias; porque nenhum da sua geração prosperará, para se assentar no trono de Davi, e reinar ainda em Judá.
text_el: γράψον τὸν ἄνδρα τοῦτον ἐκκήρυκτον ἄνθρωπον ὅτι οὐ μὴ αὐξηθῇ ἐκ τοῦ σπέρματος αὐτοῦ ἀνὴρ καθήμενος ἐπὶ θρόνου Δαυιδ ἄρχων ἔτι ἐν τῷ Ιουδα

text_en: Woe to the pastors, that destroy and tear the sheep of my pasture, says the Lord .
text_la: Væ pastoribus qui disperdunt et dilacerant gregem pascuæ meæ! dicit Dominus.
text_pt: Ai dos pastores que destroem e dispersam as ovelhas do meu pasto, diz o SENHOR.
text_el: ὦ οἱ ποιμένες οἱ διασκορπίζοντες καὶ ἀπολλύοντες τὰ πρόβατα τῆς νομῆς μου

text_en: Therefore thus says the Lord the God of Israel to the pastors that feed my people: You have scattered my flock, and driven them away, and have not visited them: behold I will visit upon you for the evil of your doings, says the Lord .
text_la: Ideo hæc dicit Dominus Deus Israël ad pastores qui pascunt populum meum : Vos dispersistis gregem meum, et ejecistis eos, et non visitastis eos : ecce ego visitabo super vos malitiam studiorum vestrorum, ait Dominus.
text_pt: Portanto assim diz o Senhor Deus de Israel, contra os pastores que apascentam o meu povo: Vós dispersastes as minhas ovelhas, e as afugentastes, e não as visitas-tes; eis que visitarei sobre vós a maldade das vossas ações, diz o Senhor.
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο τάδε λέγει κύριος ἐπὶ τοὺς ποιμαίνοντας τὸν λαόν μου ὑμεῖς διεσκορπίσατε τὰ πρόβατά μου καὶ ἐξώσατε αὐτὰ καὶ οὐκ ἐπεσκέψασθε αὐτά ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ ἐκδικῶ ἐφ' ὑμᾶς κατὰ τὰ πονηρὰ ἐπιτηδεύματα ὑμῶν

text_en: And I will gather together the remnant of my flock, out of all the lands into which I have cast them out: and I will make them return to their own fields, and they shall increase and be multiplied.
text_la: Et ego congregabo reliquias gregis mei de omnibus terris ad quas ejecero eos illuc : et convertam eos ad rura sua, et crescent et multiplicabuntur.
text_pt: E eu mesmo recolherei o restante das minhas ovelhas, de todas as terras para onde as tiver afugentado, e as farei voltar aos seus apriscos; e frutificarão, e se multiplicarão.
text_el: καὶ ἐγὼ εἰσδέξομαι τοὺς καταλοίπους τοῦ λαοῦ μου ἀπὸ πάσης τῆς γῆς οὗ ἐξῶσα αὐτοὺς ἐκεῖ καὶ καταστήσω αὐτοὺς εἰς τὴν νομὴν αὐτῶν καὶ αὐξηθήσονται καὶ πληθυνθήσονται

text_en: And I will set up pastors over them, and they shall feed them: they shall fear no more, and they shall not be dismayed: and none shall be wanting of their number, says the Lord .
text_la: Et suscitabo super eos pastores, et pascent eos : non formidabunt ultra, et non pavebunt, et nullus quæretur ex numero, dicit Dominus.
text_pt: E levantarei sobre elas pastores que as apascentem, e nunca mais temerão, nem se assombrarão, e nem uma delas faltará, diz o Senhor.
text_el: καὶ ἀναστήσω αὐτοῖς ποιμένας οἳ ποιμανοῦσιν αὐτούς καὶ οὐ φοβηθήσονται ἔτι οὐδὲ πτοηθήσονται λέγει κύριος

text_en: Behold the days come, says the Lord , and I will raise up to David a just branch: and a king shall reign, and shall be wise: and shall execute judgment and justice in the earth.
text_la: Ecce dies veniunt, dicit Dominus, et suscitabo David germen justum : et regnabit rex, et sapiens erit, et faciet judicium et justitiam in terra.
text_pt: Eis que vêm dias, diz o Senhor, em que levantarei a Davi um Renovo justo; e, sendo rei, reinará e agirá sabiamente, e praticará o juízo e a justiça na terra.
text_el: ἰδοὺ ἡμέραι ἔρχονται λέγει κύριος καὶ ἀναστήσω τῷ Δαυιδ ἀνατολὴν δικαίαν καὶ βασιλεύσει βασιλεὺς καὶ συνήσει καὶ ποιήσει κρίμα καὶ δικαιοσύνην ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς

text_en: In those days shall Juda be saved, and Israel shall dwell confidently: and this is the name that they shall call him: The Lord our just one.
text_la: In diebus illis salvabitur Juda, et Israël habitabit confidenter : et hoc est nomen quod vocabunt eum : Dominus justus noster.
text_pt: Nos seus dias Judá será salvo, e Israel habitará seguro; e este será o seu nome, com o qual Deus o chamará: O SENHOR JUSTIÇA NOSSA.
text_el: ἐν ταῖς ἡμέραις αὐτοῦ σωθήσεται Ιουδας καὶ Ισραηλ κατασκηνώσει πεποιθώς καὶ τοῦτο τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ ὃ καλέσει αὐτὸν κύριος Ιωσεδεκ

text_en: Therefore behold the days come, says the Lord , and they shall say no more: The Lord lives, who brought up the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt :
text_la: Propter hoc ecce dies veniunt, dicit Dominus, et non dicent ultra : Vivit Dominus, qui eduxit filios Israël de terra Ægypti,
text_pt: Portanto, eis que vêm dias, diz o Senhor, em que nunca mais dirão: Vive o Senhor, que fez subir os filhos de Israel da terra do Egito;
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο ἰδοὺ ἡμέραι ἔρχονται λέγει κύριος καὶ οὐκ ἐροῦσιν ἔτι ζῇ κύριος ὃς ἀνήγαγεν τὸν οἶκον Ισραηλ ἐκ γῆς Αἰγύπτου

text_en: But, The Lord lives, who has brought out, and brought hither the seed of the house of Israel from the land of the north, and out of all the lands, to which I had cast them forth: and they shall dwell in their own land.
text_la: sed : Vivit Dominus, qui eduxit et adduxit semen domus Israël de terra aquilonis, et de cunctis terris ad quas ejeceram eos illuc, et habitabunt in terra sua.
text_pt: Mas: Vive o Senhor, que fez subir, e que trouxe a geração da casa de Israel da terra do norte, e de todas as terras para onde os tinha arrojado; e habitarão na sua terra.
text_el: ἀλλά ζῇ κύριος ὃς συνήγαγεν ἅπαν τὸ σπέρμα Ισραηλ ἀπὸ γῆς βορρᾶ καὶ ἀπὸ πασῶν τῶν χωρῶν οὗ ἐξῶσεν αὐτοὺς ἐκεῖ καὶ ἀπεκατέστησεν αὐτοὺς εἰς τὴν γῆν αὐτῶν

text_en: To the prophets : My heart is broken within me, all my bones tremble: I have become as a drunken man , and as a man full of wine, at the presence of the Lord , and at the presence of his holy words.
text_la: Ad prophetas : Contritum est cor meum in medio mei; contremuerunt omnia ossa mea : factus sum quasi vir ebrius, et quasi homo madidus a vino, a facie Domini, et a facie verborum sanctorum ejus.
text_pt: Quanto aos profetas, já o meu coração está quebrantado dentro de mim; todos os meus ossos estremecem; sou como um homem embriagado, e como um homem vencido de vinho, por causa do Senhor, e por causa das suas santas palavras.
text_el: ἐν τοῖς προφήταις συνετρίβη ἡ καρδία μου ἐν ἐμοὶ ἐσαλεύθη πάντα τὰ ὀστᾶ μου ἐγενήθην ὡς ἀνὴρ συντετριμμένος καὶ ὡς ἄνθρωπος συνεχόμενος ἀπὸ οἴνου ἀπὸ προσώπου κυρίου καὶ ἀπὸ προσώπου εὐπρεπείας δόξης αὐτοῦ

text_en: Because the land is full of adulterers, because the land has mourned by reason of cursing , the fields of the desert are dried up: and their course has become evil , and their strength unlike.
text_la: Quia adulteris repleta est terra, quia a facie maledictionis luxit terra, arefacta sunt arva deserti : factus est cursus eorum malus, et fortitudo eorum dissimilis.
text_pt: Porque a terra está cheia de adúlteros, e a terra chora por causa da maldição; os pastos do deserto se secam; porque a sua carreira é má, e a sua força não é reta.
text_el: ὅτι ἀπὸ προσώπου τούτων ἐπένθησεν ἡ γῆ ἐξηράνθησαν αἱ νομαὶ τῆς ἐρήμου καὶ ἐγένετο ὁ δρόμος αὐτῶν πονηρὸς καὶ ἡ ἰσχὺς αὐτῶν οὐχ οὕτως

text_en: For the prophet and the priest are defiled: and in my house I have found their wickedness , says the Lord .
text_la: Propheta namque et sacerdos polluti sunt, et in domo mea inveni malum eorum, ait Dominus.
text_pt: Porque tanto o profeta, como o sacerdote, estão contaminados; até na minha casa achei a sua maldade, diz o Senhor.
text_el: ὅτι ἱερεὺς καὶ προφήτης ἐμολύνθησαν καὶ ἐν τῷ οἴκῳ μου εἶδον πονηρίας αὐτῶν

text_en: Therefore their way shall be as a slippery way in the dark: for they shall be driven on, and fall therein: for I will bring evils upon them, the year of their visitation, says the Lord .
text_la: Idcirco via eorum erit quasi lubricum in tenebris : impellentur enim, et corruent in ea : afferam enim super eos mala, annum visitationis eorum, ait Dominus.
text_pt: Portanto o seu caminho lhes será como lugares escorregadios na escuridão; serão empurrados, e cairão nele; porque trarei sobre eles mal, no ano da sua visitação, diz o Senhor.
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο γενέσθω ἡ ὁδὸς αὐτῶν αὐτοῖς εἰς ὀλίσθημα ἐν γνόφῳ καὶ ὑποσκελισθήσονται καὶ πεσοῦνται ἐν αὐτῇ διότι ἐπάξω ἐπ' αὐτοὺς κακὰ ἐν ἐνιαυτῷ ἐπισκέψεως αὐτῶν φησὶν κύριος

text_en: And I have seen folly in the prophets of Samaria : they prophesied in Baal and deceived my people Israel .
text_la: Et in prophetis Samariæ vidi fatuitatem : prophetabant in Baal, et decipiebant populum meum Israël.
text_pt: Nos profetas de Samaria bem vi loucura; profetizavam da parte de Baal, e faziam errar o meu povo Israel.
text_el: καὶ ἐν τοῖς προφήταις Σαμαρείας εἶδον ἀνομήματα ἐπροφήτευσαν διὰ τῆς Βααλ καὶ ἐπλάνησαν τὸν λαόν μου Ισραηλ

text_en: And I have seen the likeness of adulterers, and the way of lying in the prophets of Jerusalem : and they strengthened the hands of the wicked , that no man should return from his evil doings, they are all become unto me as Sodom , and the inhabitants thereof as Gomorrha .
text_la: Et in prophetis Jerusalem vidi similitudinem adulterantium, et iter mendacii : et confortaverunt manus pessimorum, ut non converteretur unusquisque a malitia sua : facti sunt mihi omnes ut Sodoma, et habitatores ejus quasi Gomorrha.
text_pt: Mas nos profetas de Jerusalém vejo uma coisa horrenda: cometem adultérios, e andam com falsidade, e fortalecem as mãos dos malfeitores, para que não se convertam da sua maldade; eles têm-se tornado para mim como Sodoma, e os seus moradores como Gomorra.
text_el: καὶ ἐν τοῖς προφήταις Ιερουσαλημ ἑώρακα φρικτά μοιχωμένους καὶ πορευομένους ἐν ψεύδεσι καὶ ἀντιλαμβανομένους χειρῶν πονηρῶν τοῦ μὴ ἀποστραφῆναι ἕκαστον ἀπὸ τῆς ὁδοῦ αὐτοῦ τῆς πονηρᾶς ἐγενήθησάν μοι πάντες ὡς Σοδομα καὶ οἱ κατοικοῦντες αὐτὴν ὥσπερ Γομορρα

text_en: Therefore thus says the Lord of hosts to the prophets : Behold I will feed them with wormwood , and will give them gall to drink: for from the prophets of Jerusalem corruption has gone forth into all the land.
text_la: Propterea hæc dicit Dominus exercituum ad prophetas : Ecce ego cibabo eos absinthio, et potabo eos felle : a prophetis enim Jerusalem egressa est pollutio super omnem terram.
text_pt: Portanto assim diz o Senhor dos Exércitos acerca dos profetas: Eis que lhes darei a comer losna, e lhes farei beber águas de fel; porque dos profetas de Jerusalém saiu a contaminação sobre toda a terra.
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο τάδε λέγει κύριος ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ ψωμιῶ αὐτοὺς ὀδύνην καὶ ποτιῶ αὐτοὺς ὕδωρ πικρόν ὅτι ἀπὸ τῶν προφητῶν Ιερουσαλημ ἐξῆλθεν μολυσμὸς πάσῃ τῇ γῇ

text_en: Thus says the Lord of hosts : Hearken not to the words of the prophets that prophesy to you, and deceive you: they speak a vision of their own heart, and not out of the mouth of the Lord .
text_la: Hæc dicit Dominus exercituum : Nolite audire verba prophetarum qui prophetant vobis, et decipiunt vos : visionem cordis sui loquuntur, non de ore Domini.
text_pt: Assim diz o Senhor dos Exércitos: Não deis ouvidos às palavras dos profetas, que entre vós profetizam; fazem-vos desvanecer; falam da visão do seu coração, não da boca do Senhor.
text_el: οὕτως λέγει κύριος παντοκράτωρ μὴ ἀκούετε τοὺς λόγους τῶν προφητῶν ὅτι ματαιοῦσιν ἑαυτοῖς ὅρασιν ἀπὸ καρδίας αὐτῶν λαλοῦσιν καὶ οὐκ ἀπὸ στόματος κυρίου

text_en: They say to them that blaspheme me: The Lord has said: You shall have peace: and to every one that walks in the perverseness of his own heart, they have said: No evil shall come upon you.
text_la: Dicunt his qui blasphemant me : Locutus est Dominus : Pax erit vobis : et omni qui ambulat in pravitate cordis sui dixerunt : Non veniet super vos malum.
text_pt: Dizem continuamente aos que me desprezam: O Senhor disse: Paz tereis; e a qualquer que anda segundo a dureza do seu coração, dizem: Não virá mal sobre vós.
text_el: λέγουσιν τοῖς ἀπωθουμένοις τὸν λόγον κυρίου εἰρήνη ἔσται ὑμῖν καὶ πᾶσιν τοῖς πορευομένοις τοῖς θελήμασιν αὐτῶν παντὶ τῷ πορευομένῳ πλάνῃ καρδίας αὐτοῦ εἶπαν οὐχ ἥξει ἐπὶ σὲ κακά

text_en: For who has stood in the counsel of the Lord , and has seen and heard his word? Who has considered his word and heard it?
text_la: Quis enim affuit in consilio Domini, et vidit, et audivit sermonem ejus? quis consideravit verbum illius, et audivit?
text_pt: Porque, quem esteve no conselho do Senhor, e viu, e ouviu a sua palavra? Quem esteve atento à sua palavra, e ouviu?
text_el: ὅτι τίς ἔστη ἐν ὑποστήματι κυρίου καὶ εἶδεν τὸν λόγον αὐτοῦ τίς ἐνωτίσατο καὶ ἤκουσεν

text_en: Behold the whirlwind of the Lord's indignation shall come forth, and a tempest shall break out and come upon the head of the wicked .
text_la: Ecce turbo Dominicæ indignationis egredietur, et tempestas erumpens super caput impiorum veniet.
text_pt: Eis que saiu com indignação a tempestade do Senhor; e uma tempestade penosa cairá cruelmente sobre a cabeça dos ímpios.
text_el: ἰδοὺ σεισμὸς παρὰ κυρίου καὶ ὀργὴ ἐκπορεύεται εἰς συσσεισμόν συστρεφομένη ἐπὶ τοὺς ἀσεβεῖς ἥξει

text_en: The wrath of the Lord shall not return till he execute it, and till he accomplish the thought of his heart: in the latter days you shall understand his counsel.
text_la: Non revertetur furor Domini, usque dum faciat et usque dum compleat cogitationem cordis sui : in novissimis diebus intelligetis consilium ejus.
text_pt: Não se desviará a ira do Senhor, até que execute e cumpra os desígnios do seu coração; nos últimos dias entendereis isso claramente.
text_el: καὶ οὐκέτι ἀποστρέψει ὁ θυμὸς κυρίου ἕως ἂν ποιήσῃ αὐτὸ καὶ ἕως ἂν ἀναστήσῃ αὐτὸ ἀπὸ ἐγχειρήματος καρδίας αὐτοῦ ἐπ' ἐσχάτου τῶν ἡμερῶν νοήσουσιν αὐτά

text_en: I did not send prophets , yet they ran: I have not spoken to them, yet they prophesied .
text_la: Non mittebam prophetas, et ipsi currebant : non loquebar ad eos, et ipsi prophetabant.
text_pt: Não mandei esses profetas, contudo eles foram correndo; não lhes falei, contudo eles profetizaram.
text_el: οὐκ ἀπέστελλον τοὺς προφήτας καὶ αὐτοὶ ἔτρεχον οὐκ ἐλάλησα πρὸς αὐτούς καὶ αὐτοὶ ἐπροφήτευον

text_en: If they had stood in my counsel, and had made my words known to my people, I should have turned them from their evil way, and from their wicked doings.
text_la: Si stetissent in consilio meo, et nota fecissent verba mea populo meo, avertissem utique eos a via sua mala, et a cogitationibus suis pessimis.
text_pt: Mas, se estivessem estado no meu conselho, então teriam feito o meu povo ouvir as minhas palavras, e o teriam feito voltar do seu mau caminho, e da maldade das suas ações.
text_el: καὶ εἰ ἔστησαν ἐν τῇ ὑποστάσει μου καὶ εἰσήκουσαν τῶν λόγων μου καὶ τὸν λαόν μου ἂν ἀπέστρεφον αὐτοὺς ἀπὸ τῶν πονηρῶν ἐπιτηδευμάτων αὐτῶν

text_en: Am I, do you think, a God at hand, says the Lord , and not a God afar off?
text_la: Putasne Deus e vicino ego sum, dicit Dominus, et non Deus de longe?
text_pt: Porventura sou eu Deus de perto, diz o Senhor, e não também Deus de longe?
text_el: θεὸς ἐγγίζων ἐγώ εἰμι λέγει κύριος καὶ οὐχὶ θεὸς πόρρωθεν

text_en: Shall a man be hid in secret places, and I not see him, says the Lord ? Do not I fill heaven and earth, says the Lord ?
text_la: Si occultabitur vir in absconditis, et ego non videbo eum? dicit Dominus. Numquid non cælum et terram ego impleo? dicit Dominus.
text_pt: Esconder-se-ia alguém em esconderijos, de modo que eu não o veja? diz o Senhor. Porventura não encho eu os céus e a terra? diz o Senhor.
text_el: εἰ κρυβήσεται ἄνθρωπος ἐν κρυφαίοις καὶ ἐγὼ οὐκ ὄψομαι αὐτόν μὴ οὐχὶ τὸν οὐρανὸν καὶ τὴν γῆν ἐγὼ πληρῶ λέγει κύριος

text_en: I have heard what the prophets said, that prophesy lies in my name , and say: I have dreamed, I have dreamed.
text_la: Audivi quæ dixerunt prophetæ prophetantes in nomine meo mendacium, atque dicentes : Somniavi, somniavi.
text_pt: Tenho ouvido o que dizem aqueles profetas, profetizando mentiras em meu nome, dizendo: Sonhei, sonhei.
text_el: ἤκουσα ἃ λαλοῦσιν οἱ προφῆται ἃ προφητεύουσιν ἐπὶ τῷ ὀνόματί μου ψευδῆ λέγοντες ἠνυπνιασάμην ἐνύπνιον

text_en: How long shall this be in the heart of the prophets that prophesy lies, and that prophesy the delusions of their own heart?
text_la: Usquequo istud est in corde prophetarum vaticinantium mendacium, et prophetantium seductiones cordis sui?
text_pt: Até quando sucederá isso no coração dos profetas que profetizam mentiras, e que só profetizam do engano do seu coração?
text_el: ἕως πότε ἔσται ἐν καρδίᾳ τῶν προφητῶν τῶν προφητευόντων ψευδῆ καὶ ἐν τῷ προφητεύειν αὐτοὺς τὰ θελήματα καρδίας αὐτῶν

text_en: Who seek to make my people forget my name through their dreams, which they tell every man to his neighbour: as their fathers forgot my name for Baal .
text_la: Qui volunt facere ut obliviscatur populus meus nominis mei, propter somnia eorum quæ narrat unusquisque ad proximum suum, sicut obliti sunt patres eorum nominis mei propter Baal?
text_pt: Os quais cuidam fazer com que o meu povo se esqueça do meu nome pelos seus sonhos que cada um conta ao seu próximo, assim como seus pais se esqueceram do meu nome por causa de Baal.
text_el: τῶν λογιζομένων τοῦ ἐπιλαθέσθαι τοῦ νόμου μου ἐν τοῖς ἐνυπνίοις αὐτῶν ἃ διηγοῦντο ἕκαστος τῷ πλησίον αὐτοῦ καθάπερ ἐπελάθοντο οἱ πατέρες αὐτῶν τοῦ ὀνόματός μου ἐν τῇ Βααλ

text_en: The prophet that has a dream, let him tell a dream: and he that has my word, let him speak my word with truth : what has the chaff to do with the wheat, says the Lord ?
text_la: Propheta qui habet somnium, narret somnium : et qui habet sermonem meum, loquatur sermonem meum vere. Quid paleis ad triticum? dicit Dominus.
text_pt: O profeta que tem um sonho conte o sonho; e aquele que tem a minha palavra, fale a minha palavra com verdade. Que tem a palha com o trigo? diz o Senhor.
text_el: ὁ προφήτης ἐν ᾧ τὸ ἐνύπνιόν ἐστιν διηγησάσθω τὸ ἐνύπνιον αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐν ᾧ ὁ λόγος μου πρὸς αὐτόν διηγησάσθω τὸν λόγον μου ἐπ' ἀληθείας τί τὸ ἄχυρον πρὸς τὸν σῖτον οὕτως οἱ λόγοι μου λέγει κύριος

text_en: Are not my words as a fire, says the Lord : and as a hammer that breaks the rock in pieces?
text_la: Numquid non verba mea sunt quasi ignis, dicit Dominus, et quasi malleus conterens petram?
text_pt: Porventura a minha palavra não é como o fogo, diz o Senhor, e como um martelo que esmiúça a pedra?
text_el: οὐχὶ οἱ λόγοι μου ὥσπερ πῦρ φλέγον λέγει κύριος καὶ ὡς πέλυξ κόπτων πέτραν

text_en: Therefore behold I am against the prophets , says the Lord : who steal my words every one from his neighbour.
text_la: Propterea ecce ego ad prophetas, ait Dominus, qui furantur verba mea unusquisque a proximo suo.
text_pt: Portanto, eis que eu sou contra os profetas, diz o Senhor, que furtam as minhas palavras, cada um ao seu próximo.
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ πρὸς τοὺς προφήτας λέγει κύριος ὁ θεός τοὺς κλέπτοντας τοὺς λόγους μου ἕκαστος παρὰ τοῦ πλησίον αὐτοῦ

text_en: Behold I am against the prophets , says the Lord : who use their tongues, and say: The Lord says it.
text_la: Ecce ego ad prophetas, ait Dominus, qui assumunt linguas suas, et aiunt : Dicit Dominus.
text_pt: Eis que eu sou contra os profetas, diz o Senhor, que usam de sua própria linguagem, e dizem: Ele disse.
text_el: ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ πρὸς τοὺς προφήτας τοὺς ἐκβάλλοντας προφητείας γλώσσης καὶ νυστάζοντας νυσταγμὸν ἑαυτῶν

text_en: Behold I am against the prophets that have lying dreams, says the Lord : and tell them, and cause my people to err by their lying, and by their wonders: when I sent them not, nor commanded them, who have not profited this people at all, says the Lord .
text_la: Ecce ego ad prophetas somniantes mendacium, ait Dominus, qui narraverunt ea, et seduxerunt populum meum in mendacio suo et in miraculis suis, cum ego non misissem eos, nec mandassem eis : qui nihil profuerunt populo huic, dicit Dominus.
text_pt: Eis que eu sou contra os que profetizam sonhos mentirosos, diz o Senhor, e os contam, e fazem errar o meu povo com as suas mentiras e com as suas leviandades; pois eu não os enviei, nem lhes dei ordem; e não trouxeram proveito algum a este povo, diz o Senhor.
text_el: ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ πρὸς τοὺς προφήτας τοὺς προφητεύοντας ἐνύπνια ψευδῆ καὶ διηγοῦντο αὐτὰ καὶ ἐπλάνησαν τὸν λαόν μου ἐν τοῖς ψεύδεσιν αὐτῶν καὶ ἐν τοῖς πλάνοις αὐτῶν καὶ ἐγὼ οὐκ ἀπέστειλα αὐτοὺς καὶ οὐκ ἐνετειλάμην αὐτοῖς καὶ ὠφέλειαν οὐκ ὠφελήσουσιν τὸν λαὸν τοῦτον

text_en: If therefore this people, or the prophet , or the priest shall ask you, saying: What is the burden of the Lord ? You shall say to them: You are the burden: for I will cast you away, says the Lord .
text_la: Si igitur interrogaverit te populus iste, vel propheta, aut sacerdos, dicens : Quod est onus Domini? dices ad eos : Vos estis onus : projiciam quippe vos, dicit Dominus.
text_pt: Quando, pois, te perguntar este povo, ou qualquer profeta, ou sacerdote, dizendo: Qual é o peso do Senhor? Então lhe dirás: Este é o peso: Que vos deixarei, diz o Senhor.
text_el: καὶ ἐὰν ἐρωτήσωσί σε ὁ λαὸς οὗτος ἢ ἱερεὺς ἢ προφήτης λέγων τί τὸ λῆμμα κυρίου καὶ ἐρεῖς αὐτοῖς ὑμεῖς ἐστε τὸ λῆμμα καὶ ῥάξω ὑμᾶς λέγει κύριος

text_en: And as for the prophet , and the priest , and the people that shall say: The burden of the Lord : I will visit upon that man , and upon his house.
text_la: Et propheta, et sacerdos, et populus qui dicit : Onus Domini : visitabo super virum illum et super domum ejus.
text_pt: E, quanto ao profeta, e ao sacerdote, e ao povo, que disser: Peso do Senhor, eu castigarei o tal homem e a sua casa.
text_el: καὶ ὁ προφήτης καὶ ὁ ἱερεὺς καὶ ὁ λαός οἳ ἂν εἴπωσιν λῆμμα κυρίου καὶ ἐκδικήσω τὸν ἄνθρωπον ἐκεῖνον καὶ τὸν οἶκον αὐτοῦ

text_en: Thus shall you say every one to his neighbour, and to his brother, What has the Lord answered? And what has the Lord spoken?
text_la: Hæc dicetis unusquisque ad proximum, et ad fratrem suum : Quid respondit Dominus? et quid locutus est Dominus?
text_pt: Assim direis, cada um ao seu próximo, e cada um ao seu irmão: Que respondeu o Senhor? e que falou o Senhor?
text_el: ὅτι οὕτως ἐρεῖτε ἕκαστος πρὸς τὸν πλησίον αὐτοῦ καὶ ἕκαστος πρὸς τὸν ἀδελφὸν αὐτοῦ τί ἀπεκρίθη κύριος καὶ τί ἐλάλησεν κύριος

text_en: And the burden of the Lord shall be mentioned no more, for every man's word shall be his burden: for you have perverted the words of the living God , of the Lord of hosts our God .
text_la: Et onus Domini ultra non memorabitur : quia onus erit unicuique sermo suus, et pervertistis verba Dei viventis, Domini exercituum, Dei nostri.
text_pt: Mas nunca mais vos lembrareis do peso do Senhor; porque a cada um lhe servirá de peso a sua própria palavra; pois torceis as palavras do Deus vivo, do Senhor dos Exércitos, o nosso Deus.
text_el: καὶ λῆμμα κυρίου μὴ ὀνομάζετε ἔτι ὅτι τὸ λῆμμα τῷ ἀνθρώπῳ ἔσται ὁ λόγος αὐτοῦ

text_en: Thus shall you say to the prophet : What has the Lord answered you? And what has the Lord spoken?
text_la: Hæc dices ad prophetam : Quid respondit tibi Dominus? et quid locutus est Dominus?
text_pt: Assim dirás ao profeta: Que te respondeu o Senhor, e que falou o Senhor?
text_el: καὶ διὰ τί ἐλάλησεν κύριος ὁ θεὸς ἡμῶν

text_en: But if you shall say: The burden of the Lord : therefore thus says the Lord : Because you have said this word: The burden of the Lord : and I have sent to you, saying: Say not, The burden of the Lord :
text_la: Si autem onus Domini dixeritis, propter hoc hæc dicit Dominus : Quia dixistis sermonem istum : Onus Domini, et misi ad vos dicens : Nolite dicere : Onus Domini :
text_pt: Mas, porque dizeis: Peso do Senhor; assim o diz o Senhor: Porque dizeis esta palavra: Peso do Senhor, havendo-vos ordenado, dizendo: Não direis: Peso do Senhor;
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο τάδε λέγει κύριος ὁ θεός ἀνθ' ὧν εἴπατε τὸν λόγον τοῦτον λῆμμα κυρίου καὶ ἀπέστειλα πρὸς ὑμᾶς λέγων οὐκ ἐρεῖτε λῆμμα κυρίου

text_en: Therefore behold I will take you away carrying you, and will forsake you, and the city which I gave to you, and to your fathers, out of my presence.
text_la: propterea ecce ego tollam vos portans, et derelinquam vos, et civitatem quam dedi vobis et patribus vestris, a facie mea :
text_pt: Por isso, eis que também eu me esquecerei totalmente de vós, e tirarei da minha presença, a vós e a cidade que vos dei a vós e a vossos pais;
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ λαμβάνω καὶ ῥάσσω ὑμᾶς καὶ τὴν πόλιν ἣν ἔδωκα ὑμῖν καὶ τοῖς πατράσιν ὑμῶν

text_en: And I will bring an everlasting reproach upon you, and a perpetual shame which shall never be forgotten.
text_la: et dabo vos in opprobrium sempiternum, et in ignominiam æternam, quæ numquam oblivione delebitur.
text_pt: E porei sobre vós perpétuo opróbrio, e eterna vergonha, que não será esquecida.
text_el: καὶ δώσω ἐφ' ὑμᾶς ὀνειδισμὸν αἰώνιον καὶ ἀτιμίαν αἰώνιον ἥτις οὐκ ἐπιλησθήσεται

text_en: The Lord showed me: and behold two baskets full of figs, set before the temple of the Lord : after that Nabuchodonosor king of Babylon had carried away Jechonias the son of Joakim the king of Juda , and his chief men , and the craftsmen, and engravers of Jerusalem , and had brought them to Babylon .
text_la: Ostendit mihi Dominus : et ecce duo calathi pleni ficis, positi ante templum Domini, postquam transtulit Nabuchodonosor rex Babylonis Jechoniam filium Joakim, regem Juda, et principes ejus, et fabrum, et inclusorem, de Jerusalem, et adduxit eos in Babylonem.
text_pt: Fez-me o SENHOR ver, e eis dois cestos de figos, postos diante do templo do SENHOR, depois que Nabucodonosor, rei de babilônia, levou em cativeiro a Jeconias, filho de Jeoiaquim, rei de Judá, e os príncipes de Judá, e os carpinteiros, e os ferreiros de Jerusalém, e os trouxe a babilônia.
text_el: ἔδειξέν μοι κύριος δύο καλάθους σύκων κειμένους κατὰ πρόσωπον ναοῦ κυρίου μετὰ τὸ ἀποικίσαι Ναβουχοδονοσορ βασιλέα Βαβυλῶνος τὸν Ιεχονιαν υἱὸν Ιωακιμ βασιλέα Ιουδα καὶ τοὺς ἄρχοντας καὶ τοὺς τεχνίτας καὶ τοὺς δεσμώτας καὶ τοὺς πλουσίους ἐξ Ιερουσαλημ καὶ ἤγαγεν αὐτοὺς εἰς Βαβυλῶνα

text_en: One basket had very good figs, like the figs of the first season: and the other basket had very bad figs, which could not be eaten, because they were bad.
text_la: Calathus unus ficus bonas habebat nimis, ut solent ficus esse primi temporis : et calathus unus ficus habebat malas nimis, quæ comedi non poterant eo quod essent malæ.
text_pt: Um cesto tinha figos muito bons, como os figos temporãos; mas o outro cesto tinha figos muito ruins, que não se podiam comer, de ruins que eram.
text_el: ὁ κάλαθος ὁ εἷς σύκων χρηστῶν σφόδρα ὡς τὰ σῦκα τὰ πρόιμα καὶ ὁ κάλαθος ὁ ἕτερος σύκων πονηρῶν σφόδρα ἃ οὐ βρωθήσεται ἀπὸ πονηρίας αὐτῶν

text_en: And the Lord said to me: What do you see, Jeremias? And I said: Figs, the good figs, very good : and the bad figs, very bad, which cannot be eaten because they are bad.
text_la: Et dixit Dominus ad me : Quid tu vides, Jeremia? Et dixi : Ficus, ficus bonas, bonas valde : et malas, malas valde, quæ comedi non possunt eo quod sint malæ.
text_pt: E disse-me o Senhor: Que vês tu, Jeremias? E eu disse: Figos: os figos bons, muito bons e os ruins, muito ruins, que não se podem comer, de ruins que são.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν κύριος πρός με τί σὺ ὁρᾷς Ιερεμια καὶ εἶπα σῦκα τὰ χρηστὰ χρηστὰ λίαν καὶ τὰ πονηρὰ πονηρὰ λίαν ἃ οὐ βρωθήσεται ἀπὸ πονηρίας αὐτῶν

text_en: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying:
text_la: Et factum est verbum Domini ad me, dicens:
text_pt: Então veio a mim a palavra do Senhor, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο λόγος κυρίου πρός με λέγων

text_en: Thus says the Lord the God of Israel : Like these good figs, so will I regard the captives of Juda , whom I have sent forth out of this place into the land of the Chaldeans, for their good .
text_la: Hæc dicit Dominus Deus Israël : Sicut ficus hæ bonæ, sic cognoscam transmigrationem Juda, quam emisi de loco isto in terram Chaldæorum, in bonum.
text_pt: Assim diz o Senhor, o Deus de Israel: Como a estes bons figos, assim também conhecerei aos de Judá, levados em cativeiro; os quais enviei deste lugar para a terra dos caldeus, para o seu bem.
text_el: τάδε λέγει κύριος ὁ θεὸς Ισραηλ ὡς τὰ σῦκα τὰ χρηστὰ ταῦτα οὕτως ἐπιγνώσομαι τοὺς ἀποικισθέντας Ιουδα οὓς ἐξαπέσταλκα ἐκ τοῦ τόπου τούτου εἰς γῆν Χαλδαίων εἰς ἀγαθά

text_en: And I will set my eyes upon them to be pacified, and I will bring them again into this land: and I will build them up, and not pull them down: and I will plant them, and not pluck them up.
text_la: Et ponam oculos meos super eos ad placandum, et reducam eos in terram hanc : et ædificabo eos, et non destruam : et plantabo eos, et non evellam.
text_pt: Porei os meus olhos sobre eles, para o seu bem, e os farei voltar a esta terra, e edificá-los-ei, e não os destruirei; e plantá-los-ei, e não os arrancarei.
text_el: καὶ στηριῶ τοὺς ὀφθαλμούς μου ἐπ' αὐτοὺς εἰς ἀγαθὰ καὶ ἀποκαταστήσω αὐτοὺς εἰς τὴν γῆν ταύτην εἰς ἀγαθὰ καὶ ἀνοικοδομήσω αὐτοὺς καὶ οὐ μὴ καθελῶ καὶ καταφυτεύσω αὐτοὺς καὶ οὐ μὴ ἐκτίλω

text_en: And I will give them a heart to know me, that I am the Lord : and they shall be my people, and I will be their God : because they shall return to me with their whole heart.
text_la: Et dabo eis cor ut sciant me, quia ego sum Dominus : et erunt mihi in populum, et ego ero eis in Deum, quia revertentur ad me in toto corde suo.
text_pt: E dar-lhes-ei coração para que me conheçam, porque eu sou o Senhor; e ser-me-ão por povo, e eu lhes serei por Deus; porque se converterão a mim de todo o seu coração.
text_el: καὶ δώσω αὐτοῖς καρδίαν τοῦ εἰδέναι αὐτοὺς ἐμὲ ὅτι ἐγώ εἰμι κύριος καὶ ἔσονταί μοι εἰς λαόν καὶ ἐγὼ ἔσομαι αὐτοῖς εἰς θεόν ὅτι ἐπιστραφήσονται ἐπ' ἐμὲ ἐξ ὅλης τῆς καρδίας αὐτῶν

text_en: And as the very bad figs, that cannot be eaten, because they are bad: thus says the Lord : So will I give Sedecias the king of Juda , and his princes, and the residue of Jerusalem , that have remained in this city, and that dwell in the land of Egypt .
text_la: Et sicut ficus pessimæ quæ comedi non possunt eo quod sint malæ, hæc dicit Dominus : Sic dabo Sedeciam regem Juda, et principes ejus, et reliquos de Jerusalem, qui remanserunt in urbe hac, et qui habitant in terra Ægypti.
text_pt: E como os figos ruins, que se não podem comer, de ruins que são (porque assim diz o Senhor), assim entregarei Zedequias, rei de Judá, e os seus príncipes, e o restante de Jerusalém, que ficou nesta terra, e os que habitam na terra do Egito.
text_el: καὶ ὡς τὰ σῦκα τὰ πονηρά ἃ οὐ βρωθήσεται ἀπὸ πονηρίας αὐτῶν τάδε λέγει κύριος οὕτως παραδώσω τὸν Σεδεκιαν βασιλέα Ιουδα καὶ τοὺς μεγιστᾶνας αὐτοῦ καὶ τὸ κατάλοιπον Ιερουσαλημ τοὺς ὑπολελειμμένους ἐν τῇ γῇ ταύτῃ καὶ τοὺς κατοικοῦντας ἐν Αἰγύπτῳ

text_en: And I will deliver them up to vexation, and affliction, to all the kingdoms of the earth: to be a reproach, and a byword, and a proverb, and to be a curse in all places, to which I have cast them out.
text_la: Et dabo eos in vexationem, afflictionemque omnibus regnis terræ, in opprobrium, et in parabolam, et in proverbium, et in maledictionem in universis locis ad quæ ejeci eos.
text_pt: E entregá-los-ei para que sejam um prejuízo, uma ofensa para todos os reinos da terra, um opróbrio e um provérbio, e um escárnio, e uma maldição em todos os lugares para onde eu os arrojar.
text_el: καὶ δώσω αὐτοὺς εἰς διασκορπισμὸν εἰς πάσας τὰς βασιλείας τῆς γῆς καὶ ἔσονται εἰς ὀνειδισμὸν καὶ εἰς παραβολὴν καὶ εἰς μῖσος καὶ εἰς κατάραν ἐν παντὶ τόπῳ οὗ ἐξῶσα αὐτοὺς ἐκεῖ

text_en: And I will send among them the sword, and the famine, and the pestilence: till they be consumed out of the land which I gave to them, and their fathers.
text_la: Et mittam in eis gladium, et famem, et pestem, donec consumantur de terra quam dedi eis et patribus eorum.
text_pt: E enviarei entre eles a espada, a fome, e a peste, até que se consumam de sobre a terra que lhes dei a eles e a seus pais.
text_el: καὶ ἀποστελῶ εἰς αὐτοὺς τὸν λιμὸν καὶ τὸν θάνατον καὶ τὴν μάχαιραν ἕως ἂν ἐκλίπωσιν ἀπὸ τῆς γῆς ἧς ἔδωκα αὐτοῖς

text_en: The word that came to Jeremias concerning all the people of Juda , in the fourth year of Joakim the son of Josias king of Juda , (the same is the first year of Nabuchodonosor king of Babylon),
text_la: Verbum quod factum est ad Jeremiam, de omni populo Juda, in anno quarto Joakim filii Josiæ regis Juda (ipse est annus primus Nabuchodonosor regis Babylonis),
text_pt: A palavra que veio a Jeremias acerca de todo o povo de Judá no quarto ano de Jeoiaquim, filho de Josias, rei de Judá (que é o primeiro ano de Nabucodonosor, rei de babilônia),
text_el: ὁ λόγος ὁ γενόμενος πρὸς Ιερεμιαν ἐπὶ πάντα τὸν λαὸν Ιουδα ἐν τῷ ἔτει τῷ τετάρτῳ τοῦ Ιωακιμ υἱοῦ Ιωσια βασιλέως Ιουδα

text_en: which Jeremiah the prophet spoke to all the people of Juda , and to all the inhabitants of Jerusalem , saying:
text_la: quod locutus est Jeremias propheta ad omnem populum Juda, et ad universos habitatores Jerusalem, dicens:
text_pt: A qual anunciou o profeta Jeremias a todo o povo de Judá, e a todos os habitantes de Jerusalém, dizendo:
text_el: ὃν ἐλάλησεν πρὸς πάντα τὸν λαὸν Ιουδα καὶ πρὸς τοὺς κατοικοῦντας Ιερουσαλημ λέγων

text_en: From the thirteenth year of Josias the son of Ammon king of Juda until this day: this is the three and twentieth year, the word of the Lord has come to me, and I have spoken to you, rising before day, and speaking, and you have not hearkened.
text_la: A tertiodecimo anno Josiæ filii Amon regis Juda, usque ad diem hanc, iste tertius et vigesimus annus, factum est verbum Domini ad me, et locutus sum ad vos, de nocte consurgens et loquens, et non audistis.
text_pt: Desde o ano treze de Josias, filho de Amom, rei de Judá, até o dia de hoje, período de vinte e três anos, tem vindo a mim a palavra do Senhor, e vo-la tenho anunciado, madrugando e falando; mas vós não escutastes.
text_el: ἐν τρισκαιδεκάτῳ ἔτει Ιωσια υἱοῦ Αμως βασιλέως Ιουδα καὶ ἕως τῆς ἡμέρας ταύτης εἴκοσι καὶ τρία ἔτη καὶ ἐλάλησα πρὸς ὑμᾶς ὀρθρίζων καὶ λέγων

text_en: And the Lord has sent to you all his servants the prophets , rising early, and sending, and you have not hearkened, nor inclined your ears to hear.
text_la: Et misit Dominus ad vos omnes servos suos prophetas, consurgens diluculo, mittensque : et non audistis, neque inclinastis aures vestras ut audiretis,
text_pt: Também vos enviou o Senhor todos os seus servos, os profetas, madrugando e enviando-os, mas vós não escutastes, nem inclinastes os vossos ouvidos para ouvir,
text_el: καὶ ἀπέστελλον πρὸς ὑμᾶς τοὺς δούλους μου τοὺς προφήτας ὄρθρου ἀποστέλλων καὶ οὐκ εἰσηκούσατε καὶ οὐ προσέσχετε τοῖς ὠσὶν ὑμῶν

text_en: When he said: Return, every one from his evil way, and from your wicked devices, and you shall dwell in the land which the Lord has given to you, and your fathers for ever and ever.
text_la: cum diceret : Revertimini unusquisque a via sua mala, et a pessimis cogitationibus vestris, et habitabitis in terra quam dedit Dominus vobis et patribus vestris, a sæculo et usque in sæculum:
text_pt: Quando diziam: Convertei-vos agora cada um do seu mau caminho, e da maldade das suas ações, e habitai na terra que o Senhor vos deu, e a vossos pais, para sempre.
text_el: λέγων ἀποστράφητε ἕκαστος ἀπὸ τῆς ὁδοῦ αὐτοῦ τῆς πονηρᾶς καὶ ἀπὸ τῶν πονηρῶν ἐπιτηδευμάτων ὑμῶν καὶ κατοικήσετε ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς ἧς ἔδωκα ὑμῖν καὶ τοῖς πατράσιν ὑμῶν ἀπ' αἰῶνος καὶ ἕως αἰῶνος

text_en: And go not after strange gods to serve them, and adore them: nor provoke me to wrath by the works of your hands, and I will not afflict you.
text_la: et nolite ire post deos alienos, ut serviatis eis, adoretisque eos : neque me ad iracundiam provocetis in operibus manuum vestrarum, et non affligam vos.
text_pt: E não andeis após outros deuses para os servirdes, e para vos inclinardes diante deles, nem me provoqueis à ira com a obra de vossas mãos, para que não vos faça mal.
text_el: μὴ πορεύεσθε ὀπίσω θεῶν ἀλλοτρίων τοῦ δουλεύειν αὐτοῖς καὶ τοῦ προσκυνεῖν αὐτοῖς ὅπως μὴ παροργίζητέ με ἐν τοῖς ἔργοις τῶν χειρῶν ὑμῶν τοῦ κακῶσαι ὑμᾶς

text_en: And you have not heard me, says the Lord , that you might provoke me to anger with the works of your hands, to your own hurt.
text_la: Et non audistis me, dicit Dominus, ut me ad iracundiam provocaretis in operibus manuum vestrarum, in malum vestrum.
text_pt: Porém não me destes ouvidos, diz o Senhor, mas me provocastes à ira com a obra de vossas mãos, para vosso mal.
text_el: καὶ οὐκ ἠκούσατέ μου

text_en: Therefore thus says the Lord of hosts : Because you have not heard my words:
text_la: Propterea hæc dicit Dominus exercituum : Pro eo quod non audistis verba mea,
text_pt: Portanto assim diz o Senhor dos Exércitos: Visto que não escutastes as minhas palavras,
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο τάδε λέγει κύριος ἐπειδὴ οὐκ ἐπιστεύσατε τοῖς λόγοις μου

text_en: Behold I will send, and take all the kindreds of the north, says the Lord , and Nabuchodonosor the king of Babylon my servant: and I will bring them against this land, and against the inhabitants thereof, and against all the nations that are round about it: and I will destroy them, and make them an astonishment and a hissing, and perpetual desolations.
text_la: ecce ego mittam et assumam universas cognationes aquilonis, ait Dominus, et Nabuchodonosor regem Babylonis servum meum, et adducam eos super terram istam, et super habitatores ejus, et super omnes nationes quæ in circuitu illius sunt : et interficiam eos, et ponam eos in stuporem et in sibilum, et in solitudines sempiternas.
text_pt: Eis que eu enviarei, e tomarei a todas as famílias do norte, diz o SENHOR, como também a Nabucodonosor, rei de babilônia, meu servo, e os trarei sobre esta terra, e sobre os seus moradores, e sobre todas estas nações em redor, e os destruirei totalmente, e farei que sejam objeto de espanto, e de assobio, e de perpétuas desolações.
text_el: ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ ἀποστέλλω καὶ λήμψομαι τὴν πατριὰν ἀπὸ βορρᾶ καὶ ἄξω αὐτοὺς ἐπὶ τὴν γῆν ταύτην καὶ ἐπὶ τοὺς κατοικοῦντας αὐτὴν καὶ ἐπὶ πάντα τὰ ἔθνη τὰ κύκλῳ αὐτῆς καὶ ἐξερημώσω αὐτοὺς καὶ δώσω αὐτοὺς εἰς ἀφανισμὸν καὶ εἰς συριγμὸν καὶ εἰς ὀνειδισμὸν αἰώνιον

text_en: And I will take away from them the voice of mirth, and the voice of gladness , the voice of the bridegroom, and the voice of the bride, the sound of the mill and the light of the lamp.
text_la: Perdamque ex eis vocem gaudii et vocem lætitiæ, vocem sponsi et vocem sponsæ, vocem molæ et lumen lucernæ.
text_pt: E farei desaparecer dentre eles a voz de gozo, e a voz de alegria, a voz do esposo, e a voz da esposa, como também o som das mós, e a luz do candeeiro.
text_el: καὶ ἀπολῶ ἀπ' αὐτῶν φωνὴν χαρᾶς καὶ φωνὴν εὐφροσύνης φωνὴν νυμφίου καὶ φωνὴν νύμφης ὀσμὴν μύρου καὶ φῶς λύχνου

text_en: And all this land shall be a desolation, and an astonishment: and all these nations shall serve the king of Babylon seventy years.
text_la: Et erit universa terra hæc in solitudinem, et in stuporem : et servient omnes gentes istæ regi Babylonis septuaginta annis.
text_pt: E toda esta terra virá a ser um deserto e um espanto; e estas nações servirão ao rei de babilônia setenta anos.
text_el: καὶ ἔσται πᾶσα ἡ γῆ εἰς ἀφανισμόν καὶ δουλεύσουσιν ἐν τοῖς ἔθνεσιν ἑβδομήκοντα ἔτη

text_en: And when the seventy years shall be expired, I will punish the king of Babylon , and that nation, says the Lord , for their iniquity , and the land of the Chaldeans: and I will make it perpetual desolations.
text_la: Cumque impleti fuerint septuaginta anni, visitabo super regem Babylonis et super gentem illam, dicit Dominus, iniquitatem eorum, et super terram Chaldæorum, et ponam illam in solitudines sempiternas.
text_pt: Acontecerá, porém, que, quando se cumprirem os setenta anos, visitarei o rei de babilônia, e esta nação, diz o SENHOR, castigando a sua iniqüidade, e a da terra dos caldeus; farei deles ruínas perpétuas.
text_el: καὶ ἐν τῷ πληρωθῆναι τὰ ἑβδομήκοντα ἔτη ἐκδικήσω τὸ ἔθνος ἐκεῖνο φησὶν κύριος καὶ θήσομαι αὐτοὺς εἰς ἀφανισμὸν αἰώνιον

text_en: And I will bring upon that land all my words, that I have spoken against it, all that is written in this book, all that Jeremias has prophesied against all nations:
text_la: Et adducam super terram illam omnia verba mea, quæ locutus sum contra eam, omne quod scriptum est in libro isto, quæcumque prophetavit Jeremias adversum omnes gentes:
text_pt: E trarei sobre aquela terra todas as minhas palavras, que disse contra ela, a saber, tudo quanto está escrito neste livro, que profetizou Jeremias contra todas estas nações.
text_el: καὶ ἐπάξω ἐπὶ τὴν γῆν ἐκείνην πάντας τοὺς λόγους μου οὓς ἐλάλησα κατ' αὐτῆς πάντα τὰ γεγραμμένα ἐν τῷ βιβλίῳ τούτῳ ὅσα ἐπροφήτευσεν Ιερεμιας ἐπὶ πάντα τὰ ἔθνη

text_en: For they have served them, whereas they were many nations, and great kings: and I will repay them according to their deeds, and according to the works of their hands.
text_la: quia servierunt eis, cum essent gentes multæ, et reges magni : et reddam eis secundum opera eorum, et secundum facta manuum suarum.
text_pt: Porque também deles se servirão muitas nações e grandes reis; assim lhes retribuirei segundo os seus feitos, e segundo as obras das suas mãos.

text_en: For thus says the Lord of hosts the God of Israel : Take the cup of wine of this fury at my hand: and you shall make all the nations to drink thereof, into which I shall send you.
text_la: Quia sic dicit Dominus exercituum, Deus Israël : Sume calicem vini furoris hujus de manu mea, et propinabis de illo cunctis gentibus ad quas ego mittam te.
text_pt: Porque assim me disse o Senhor Deus de Israel: Toma da minha mão este copo do vinho do furor, e darás a beber dele a todas as nações, às quais eu te enviarei.
text_el: οὕτως εἶπεν κύριος ὁ θεὸς Ισραηλ λαβὲ τὸ ποτήριον τοῦ οἴνου τοῦ ἀκράτου τούτου ἐκ χειρός μου καὶ ποτιεῖς πάντα τὰ ἔθνη πρὸς ἃ ἐγὼ ἀποστέλλω σε πρὸς αὐτούς

text_en: And they shall drink, and be troubled, and be mad because of the sword, which I shall send among them.
text_la: Et bibent, et turbabuntur et insanient a facie gladii quem ego mittam inter eos.
text_pt: Para que bebam e tremam, e enlouqueçam, por causa da espada, que eu enviarei entre eles.
text_el: καὶ πίονται καὶ ἐξεμοῦνται καὶ μανήσονται ἀπὸ προσώπου τῆς μαχαίρας ἧς ἐγὼ ἀποστέλλω ἀνὰ μέσον αὐτῶν

text_en: And I took the cup at the hand of the Lord , and I presented it to all the nations to drink of it, to which the Lord sent me:
text_la: Et accepi calicem de manu Domini, et propinavi cunctis gentibus ad quas misit me Dominus,
text_pt: E tomei o copo da mão do Senhor, e dei a beber a todas as nações, às quais o Senhor me enviou;
text_el: καὶ ἔλαβον τὸ ποτήριον ἐκ χειρὸς κυρίου καὶ ἐπότισα τὰ ἔθνη πρὸς ἃ ἀπέστειλέν με κύριος ἐπ' αὐτά

text_en: To wit, Jerusalem , and the cities of Juda , and the kings thereof, and the princes thereof: to make them a desolation, and an astonishment, and a hissing, and a curse , as it is at this day.
text_la: Jerusalem, et civitatibus Juda, et regibus ejus, et principibus ejus, ut darem eos in solitudinem, et in stuporem, et in sibilum, et in maledictionem, sicut est dies ista:
text_pt: A Jerusalém, e às cidades de Judá, e aos seus reis, e aos seus príncipes, para fazer deles uma desolação, um espanto, um assobio, e uma maldição, como hoje se vê;
text_el: τὴν Ιερουσαλημ καὶ τὰς πόλεις Ιουδα καὶ βασιλεῖς Ιουδα καὶ ἄρχοντας αὐτοῦ τοῦ θεῖναι αὐτὰς εἰς ἐρήμωσιν καὶ εἰς ἄβατον καὶ εἰς συριγμὸν

text_en: Pharao the king of Egypt , and his servants, and his princes, and all his people,
text_la: Pharaoni regi Ægypti, et servis ejus, et principibus ejus, et omni populo ejus:
text_pt: A Faraó, rei do Egito, e a seus servos, e a seus príncipes, e a todo o seu povo;
text_el: καὶ τὸν Φαραω βασιλέα Αἰγύπτου καὶ τοὺς παῖδας αὐτοῦ καὶ τοὺς μεγιστᾶνας αὐτοῦ καὶ πάντα τὸν λαὸν αὐτοῦ

text_en: and all in general: all the kings of the land of Ausitis, and all the kings of the land of the Philistines , and Ascalon , and Gaza , and Accaron , and the remnant of Azotus .
text_la: et universis generaliter : cunctis regibus terræ Ausitidis, et cunctis regibus terræ Philisthiim, et Ascaloni, et Gazæ, et Accaron, et reliquiis Azoti:
text_pt: E a toda a mistura de povo, e a todos os reis da terra de Uz, e a todos os reis da terra dos filisteus, e a Ascalom, e a Gaza, e a Ecrom, e ao remanescente de Asdode,
text_el: καὶ πάντας τοὺς συμμίκτους αὐτοῦ καὶ πάντας τοὺς βασιλεῖς ἀλλοφύλων τὴν Ἀσκαλῶνα καὶ τὴν Γάζαν καὶ τὴν Ακκαρων καὶ τὸ ἐπίλοιπον Ἀζώτου

text_en: And Edom , and Moab , and the children of Ammon .
text_la: et Idumææ, et Moab, et filiis Ammon:
text_pt: E a Edom, e a Moabe, e aos filhos de Amom;
text_el: καὶ τὴν Ιδουμαίαν καὶ τὴν Μωαβῖτιν καὶ τοὺς υἱοὺς Αμμων

text_en: And all the kings of Tyre , and all the kings of Sidon : and the kings of the land of the islands that are beyond the sea.
text_la: et cunctis regibus Tyri, et universis regibus Sidonis, et regibus terræ insularum qui sunt trans mare:
text_pt: E a todos os reis de Tiro, e a todos os reis de Sidom; e aos reis das ilhas que estão além do mar;
text_el: καὶ πάντας βασιλεῖς Τύρου καὶ βασιλεῖς Σιδῶνος καὶ βασιλεῖς τοὺς ἐν τῷ πέραν τῆς θαλάσσης

text_en: And Dedan, and Thema, and Buz, and all that have their hair cut round.
text_la: et Dedan, et Thema, et Buz, et universis qui attonsi sunt in comam:
text_pt: A Dedã, e a Tema, e a Buz e a todos os que estão nos lugares mais distantes.
text_el: καὶ τὴν Δαιδαν καὶ τὴν Θαιμαν καὶ τὴν Ρως καὶ πᾶν περικεκαρμένον κατὰ πρόσωπον αὐτοῦ

text_en: And all the kings of Arabia, and all the kings of the west, that dwell in the desert .
text_la: et cunctis regibus Arabiæ, et cunctis regibus occidentis, qui habitant in deserto:
text_pt: E a todos os reis da Arábia, e todos os reis do povo misto que habita no deserto;
text_el: καὶ πάντας τοὺς συμμίκτους τοὺς καταλύοντας ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ

text_en: And all the kings of Zambri, and all the kings of Elam, and all the kings of the Medes :
text_la: et cunctis regibus Zambri, et cunctis regibus Elam, et cunctis regibus Medorum:
text_pt: E a todos os reis de Zinri, e a todos os reis de Elão, e a todos os reis da Média;
text_el: καὶ πάντας βασιλεῖς Αιλαμ καὶ πάντας βασιλεῖς Περσῶν

text_en: And all the kings of the north far and near, every one against his brother: and all the kingdoms of the earth, which are upon the face thereof: and the king of Sesac shall drink after them.
text_la: cunctis quoque regibus aquilonis, de prope et de longe, unicuique contra fratrem suum : et omnibus regnis terræ quæ super faciem ejus sunt : et rex Sesach bibet post eos.
text_pt: E a todos os reis do norte, os de perto, e os de longe, tanto um como o outro, e a todos os reinos do mundo, que estão sobre a face da terra, e o rei de Sesaque beberá depois deles.
text_el: καὶ πάντας βασιλεῖς ἀπὸ ἀπηλιώτου τοὺς πόρρω καὶ τοὺς ἐγγύς ἕκαστον πρὸς τὸν ἀδελφὸν αὐτοῦ καὶ πάσας τὰς βασιλείας τὰς ἐπὶ προσώπου τῆς γῆς

text_en: And you shall say to them: Thus says the Lord of hosts the God of Israel : Drink, and be drunken, and vomit: and fall, and rise no more, because of the sword, which I shall send among you.
text_la: Et dices ad eos : Hæc dicit Dominus exercituum, Deus Israël : Bibite, et inebriamini, et vomite : et cadite, neque surgatis a facie gladii quem ego mittam inter vos.
text_pt: Pois lhes dirás: Assim diz o Senhor dos Exércitos, o Deus de Israel: Bebei, e embebedai-vos, e vomitai, e caí, e não torneis a levantar-vos, por causa da espada que eu vos enviarei.
text_el: καὶ ἐρεῖς αὐτοῖς οὕτως εἶπεν κύριος παντοκράτωρ πίετε καὶ μεθύσθητε καὶ ἐξεμέσατε καὶ πεσεῖσθε καὶ οὐ μὴ ἀναστῆτε ἀπὸ προσώπου τῆς μαχαίρας ἧς ἐγὼ ἀποστέλλω ἀνὰ μέσον ὑμῶν

text_en: And if they refuse to take the cup at your hand to drink, you shall say to them: Thus says the Lord of hosts : Drinking you shall drink:
text_la: Cumque noluerint accipere calicem de manu tua ut bibant, dices ad eos : Hæc dicit Dominus exercituum : Bibentes bibetis:
text_pt: E será que, se não quiserem tomar o copo da tua mão para beber, então lhes dirás: Assim diz o Senhor dos Exércitos: Certamente bebereis.
text_el: καὶ ἔσται ὅταν μὴ βούλωνται δέξασθαι τὸ ποτήριον ἐκ τῆς χειρός σου ὥστε πιεῖν καὶ ἐρεῖς οὕτως εἶπεν κύριος πιόντες πίεσθε

text_en: For behold I begin to bring evil on the city wherein my name is called upon: and shall you be as innocent and escape free? You shall not escape free: for I will call for the sword upon all the inhabitants of the earth, says the Lord of hosts .
text_la: quia ecce in civitate in qua invocatum est nomen meum ego incipiam affligere, et vos quasi innocentes et immunes eritis? non eritis immunes : gladium enim ego voco super omnes habitatores terræ, dicit Dominus exercituum.
text_pt: Porque, eis que na cidade que se chama pelo meu nome começo a castigar; e ficareis vós totalmente impunes? Não ficareis impunes, porque eu chamo a espada sobre todos os moradores da terra, diz o Senhor dos Exércitos.
text_el: ὅτι ἐν πόλει ἐν ᾗ ὠνομάσθη τὸ ὄνομά μου ἐπ' αὐτήν ἐγὼ ἄρχομαι κακῶσαι καὶ ὑμεῖς καθάρσει οὐ μὴ καθαρισθῆτε ὅτι μάχαιραν ἐγὼ καλῶ ἐπὶ τοὺς καθημένους ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς

text_en: And you shall prophesy unto them all these words, and you shall say to them: I The Lord shall roar from on high, and shall utter his voice from his holy habitation: roaring he shall roar upon the place of his beauty: the shout as it were of them that tread grapes shall be given out against all the inhabitants of the earth.
text_la: Et tu prophetabis ad eos omnia verba hæc, et dices ad illos : Dominus de excelso rugiet, et de habitaculo sancto suo dabit vocem suam : rugiens rugiet super decorem suum : celeuma quasi calcantium concinetur adversus omnes habitatores terræ.
text_pt: Tu, pois, lhes profetizarás todas estas palavras, e lhes dirás: O Senhor desde o alto bramirá, e fará ouvir a sua voz desde a morada da sua santidade; terrivelmente bramirá contra a sua habitação, com grito de alegria, como dos que pisam as uvas, contra todos os moradores da terra.
text_el: καὶ σὺ προφητεύσεις ἐπ' αὐτοὺς τοὺς λόγους τούτους καὶ ἐρεῖς κύριος ἀφ' ὑψηλοῦ χρηματιεῖ ἀπὸ τοῦ ἁγίου αὐτοῦ δώσει φωνὴν αὐτοῦ λόγον χρηματιεῖ ἐπὶ τοῦ τόπου αὐτοῦ καὶ αιδαδ ὥσπερ τρυγῶντες ἀποκριθήσονται καὶ ἐπὶ τοὺς καθημένους ἐπὶ τὴν γῆν

text_en: The noise has come even to the ends of the earth: for the Lord enters into judgment with the nations: he enters into judgment with all flesh; the wicked I have delivered up to the sword, says the Lord .
text_la: Pervenit sonitus usque ad extrema terræ, quia judicium Domino cum gentibus : judicatur ipse cum omni carne. Impios tradidi gladio, dicit Dominus.
text_pt: Chegará o estrondo até à extremidade da terra, porque o Senhor tem contenda com as nações, entrará em juízo com toda a carne; os ímpios entregará à espada, diz o Senhor.
text_el: ἥκει ὄλεθρος ἐπὶ μέρος τῆς γῆς ὅτι κρίσις τῷ κυρίῳ ἐν τοῖς ἔθνεσιν κρίνεται αὐτὸς πρὸς πᾶσαν σάρκα οἱ δὲ ἀσεβεῖς ἐδόθησαν εἰς μάχαιραν λέγει κύριος

text_en: Thus says the Lord of hosts : Behold evil shall go forth from nation to nation: and a great whirlwind shall go forth from the ends of the earth.
text_la: Hæc dicit Dominus exercituum : Ecce afflictio egredietur de gente in gentem, et turbo magnus egredietur a summitatibus terræ.
text_pt: Assim diz o Senhor dos Exércitos: Eis que o mal passa de nação para nação, e grande tormenta se levantará dos confins da terra.
text_el: οὕτως εἶπεν κύριος ἰδοὺ κακὰ ἔρχεται ἀπὸ ἔθνους ἐπὶ ἔθνος καὶ λαῖλαψ μεγάλη ἐκπορεύεται ἀπ' ἐσχάτου τῆς γῆς

text_en: And the slain of the Lord shall be at that day from one end of the earth even to the other end thereof: they shall not be lamented, and they shall not be gathered up, nor buried: they shall lie as dung upon the face of the earth.
text_la: Et erunt interfecti Domini in die illa, a summo terræ usque ad summum ejus : non plangentur, et non colligentur, neque sepelientur : in sterquilinium super faciem terræ jacebunt.
text_pt: E serão os mortos do Senhor, naquele dia, desde uma extremidade da terra até à outra; não serão pranteados, nem recolhidos, nem sepultados; mas serão por esterco sobre a face da terra.
text_el: καὶ ἔσονται τραυματίαι ὑπὸ κυρίου ἐν ἡμέρᾳ κυρίου ἐκ μέρους τῆς γῆς καὶ ἕως εἰς μέρος τῆς γῆς οὐ μὴ κατορυγῶσιν εἰς κόπρια ἐπὶ προσώπου τῆς γῆς ἔσονται

text_en: Howl, you shepherds, and cry: and sprinkle yourselves with ashes, you leaders of the flock: for the days of your slaughter and your dispersion are accomplished, and you shall fall like precious vessels.
text_la: Ululate, pastores, et clamate, et aspergite vos cinere, optimates gregis : quia completi sunt dies vestri ut interficiamini, et dissipationes vestræ : et cadetis quasi vasa pretiosa.
text_pt: Uivai, pastores, e clamai, e revolvei-vos na cinza, principais do rebanho, porque já se cumpriram os vossos dias para serdes mortos, e dispersos, e vós então caireis como um vaso precioso.
text_el: ἀλαλάξατε ποιμένες καὶ κεκράξατε καὶ κόπτεσθε οἱ κριοὶ τῶν προβάτων ὅτι ἐπληρώθησαν αἱ ἡμέραι ὑμῶν εἰς σφαγήν καὶ πεσεῖσθε ὥσπερ οἱ κριοὶ οἱ ἐκλεκτοί

text_en: And the shepherds shall have no way to flee, nor the leaders of the flock to save themselves.
text_la: Et peribit fuga a pastoribus, et salvatio ab optimatibus gregis.
text_pt: E não haverá refúgio para os pastores, nem salvamento para os principais do rebanho.
text_el: καὶ ἀπολεῖται φυγὴ ἀπὸ τῶν ποιμένων καὶ σωτηρία ἀπὸ τῶν κριῶν τῶν προβάτων

text_en: A voice of the cry of the shepherds, and a howling of the principal of the flock: because the Lord has wasted their pastures.
text_la: Vox clamoris pastorum, et ululatus optimatum gregis, quia vastavit Dominus pascua eorum :
text_pt: Voz de grito dos pastores, e uivos dos principais do rebanho; porque o Senhor está destruindo o pasto deles.
text_el: φωνὴ κραυγῆς τῶν ποιμένων καὶ ἀλαλαγμὸς τῶν προβάτων καὶ τῶν κριῶν ὅτι ὠλέθρευσεν κύριος τὰ βοσκήματα αὐτῶν

text_en: And the fields of peace have been silent because of the fierce anger of the Lord .
text_la: et conticuerunt arva pacis a facie iræ furoris Domini.
text_pt: Porque as suas malhadas pacíficas serão desarraigadas, por causa do furor da ira do Senhor.
text_el: καὶ παύσεται τὰ κατάλοιπα τῆς εἰρήνης ἀπὸ προσώπου ὀργῆς θυμοῦ μου

text_en: He has forsaken his covert as the lion, for the land is laid waste because of the wrath of the dove , and because of the fierce anger of the Lord .
text_la: Dereliquit quasi leo umbraculum suum, quia facta est terra eorum in desolationem a facie iræ columbæ, et a facie iræ furoris Domini.
text_pt: Deixou a sua tenda, como o filho de leão; porque a sua terra foi posta em desolação, por causa do furor do opressor, e por causa do furor da sua ira.
text_el: ἐγκατέλιπεν ὥσπερ λέων κατάλυμα αὐτοῦ ὅτι ἐγενήθη ἡ γῆ αὐτῶν εἰς ἄβατον ἀπὸ προσώπου τῆς μαχαίρας τῆς μεγάλης

text_en: In the beginning of the reign of Joakim the son of Josias king of Juda , came this word from the Lord , saying:
text_la: In principio regni Joakim filii Josiæ regis Juda, factum est verbum istud a Domino, dicens:
text_pt: No princípio do reinado de Jeoiaquim, filho de Josias, rei de Judá, veio esta palavra do SENHOR, dizendo:
text_el: ἐν ἀρχῇ βασιλέως Ιωακιμ υἱοῦ Ιωσια ἐγενήθη ὁ λόγος οὗτος παρὰ κυρίου

text_en: Thus says the Lord : stand in the court of the house of the Lord , and speak to all the cities of Juda , out of which they come, to adore in the house of the Lord , all the words which I have commanded you to speak unto them: leave not out one word.
text_la: Hæc dicit Dominus : Sta in atrio domus Domini, et loqueris ad omnes civitates Juda, de quibus veniunt ut adorent in domo Domini universos sermones quos ego mandavi tibi ut loquaris ad eos : noli subtrahere verbum,
text_pt: Assim diz o Senhor: Põe-te no átrio da casa do Senhor e dize a todas as cidades de Judá, que vêm adorar na casa do Senhor, todas as palavras que te mandei que lhes dissesses; não omitas nenhuma palavra.
text_el: οὕτως εἶπεν κύριος στῆθι ἐν αὐλῇ οἴκου κυρίου καὶ χρηματιεῖς ἅπασι τοῖς Ιουδαίοις καὶ πᾶσι τοῖς ἐρχομένοις προσκυνεῖν ἐν οἴκῳ κυρίου ἅπαντας τοὺς λόγους οὓς συνέταξά σοι αὐτοῖς χρηματίσαι μὴ ἀφέλῃς ῥῆμα

text_en: If so be they will hearken and be converted every one from his evil way; that I may repent me of the evil that I think to do unto them for the wickedness of their doings.
text_la: si forte audiant, et convertantur unusquisque a via sua mala, et pœniteat me mali quod cogito facere eis propter malitiam studiorum eorum.
text_pt: Bem pode ser que ouçam, e se convertam cada um do seu mau caminho, e eu me arrependa do mal que intento fazer-lhes por causa da maldade das suas ações.
text_el: ἴσως ἀκούσονται καὶ ἀποστραφήσονται ἕκαστος ἀπὸ τῆς ὁδοῦ αὐτοῦ τῆς πονηρᾶς καὶ παύσομαι ἀπὸ τῶν κακῶν ὧν ἐγὼ λογίζομαι τοῦ ποιῆσαι αὐτοῖς ἕνεκεν τῶν πονηρῶν ἐπιτηδευμάτων αὐτῶν

text_en: And you shall say to them: Thus says the Lord : If you will not hearken to me to walk in my law, which I have given you:
text_la: Et dices ad eos : Hæc dicit Dominus : Si non audieritis me, ut ambuletis in lege mea quam dedi vobis,
text_pt: Dize-lhes pois: Assim diz o Senhor: Se não me derdes ouvidos para andardes na minha lei, que pus diante de vós,
text_el: καὶ ἐρεῖς οὕτως εἶπεν κύριος ἐὰν μὴ ἀκούσητέ μου τοῦ πορεύεσθαι ἐν τοῖς νομίμοις μου οἷς ἔδωκα κατὰ πρόσωπον ὑμῶν

text_en: To give ear to the words of my servants the prophets , whom I sent to you rising up early: and sending, and you have not hearkened:
text_la: ut audiatis sermones servorum meorum prophetarum quos ego misi ad vos, de nocte consurgens, et dirigens, et non audistis:
text_pt: Para que ouvísseis as palavras dos meus servos, os profetas, que eu vos envio, madrugando e enviando, mas não ouvistes;
text_el: εἰσακούειν τῶν λόγων τῶν παίδων μου τῶν προφητῶν οὓς ἐγὼ ἀποστέλλω πρὸς ὑμᾶς ὄρθρου καὶ ἀπέστειλα καὶ οὐκ εἰσηκούσατέ μου

text_en: I will make this house like Silo: and I will make this city a curse to all the nations of the earth.
text_la: dabo domum istam sicut Silo, et urbem hanc dabo in maledictionem cunctis gentibus terræ.
text_pt: Então farei que esta casa seja como Siló, e farei desta cidade uma maldição para todas as nações da terra.
text_el: καὶ δώσω τὸν οἶκον τοῦτον ὥσπερ Σηλωμ καὶ τὴν πόλιν δώσω εἰς κατάραν πᾶσιν τοῖς ἔθνεσιν πάσης τῆς γῆς

text_en: And the priests , and the prophets , and all the people heard Jeremias speaking these words in the house of the Lord .
text_la: Et audierunt sacerdotes, et prophetæ, et omnis populus, Jeremiam loquentem verba hæc in domo Domini.
text_pt: Os sacerdotes, e os profetas, e todo o povo, ouviram a Jeremias, falando estas palavras na casa do Senhor.
text_el: καὶ ἤκουσαν οἱ ἱερεῖς καὶ οἱ ψευδοπροφῆται καὶ πᾶς ὁ λαὸς τοῦ Ιερεμιου λαλοῦντος τοὺς λόγους τούτους ἐν οἴκῳ κυρίου

text_en: And when Jeremias had made an end of speaking all that the Lord had commanded him to speak to all the people, the priests , and the prophets , and all the people laid hold on him, saying: Let him be put to death .
text_la: Cumque complesset Jeremias, loquens omnia quæ præceperat ei Dominus ut loqueretur ad universum populum, apprehenderunt eum sacerdotes, et prophetæ, et omnis populus, dicens : Morte moriatur.
text_pt: E sucedeu que, acabando Jeremias de dizer tudo quanto o Senhor lhe havia ordenado que dissesse a todo o povo, pegaram nele os sacerdotes, e os profetas, e todo o povo, dizendo: Certamente morrerás,
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο Ιερεμιου παυσαμένου λαλοῦντος πάντα ἃ συνέταξεν αὐτῷ κύριος λαλῆσαι παντὶ τῷ λαῷ καὶ συνελάβοσαν αὐτὸν οἱ ἱερεῖς καὶ οἱ ψευδοπροφῆται καὶ πᾶς ὁ λαὸς λέγων θανάτῳ ἀποθανῇ

text_en: Why has he prophesied in the name of the Lord , saying: This house shall be like Silo; and this city shall be made desolate, without an inhabitant? And all the people were gathered together against Jeremias in the house of the Lord .
text_la: Quare prophetavit in nomine Domini, dicens : Sicut Silo erit domus hæc, et urbs ista desolabitur eo quod non sit habitator? Et congregatus est omnis populus adversus Jeremiam in domo Domini.
text_pt: Por que profetizaste no nome do Senhor, dizendo: Como Siló será esta casa, e esta cidade será assolada, de sorte que não fique nenhum morador nela? E ajuntou-se todo o povo contra Jeremias, na casa do Senhor.
text_el: ὅτι ἐπροφήτευσας τῷ ὀνόματι κυρίου λέγων ὥσπερ Σηλωμ ἔσται ὁ οἶκος οὗτος καὶ ἡ πόλις αὕτη ἐρημωθήσεται ἀπὸ κατοικούντων καὶ ἐξεκκλησιάσθη πᾶς ὁ λαὸς ἐπὶ Ιερεμιαν ἐν οἴκῳ κυρίου

text_en: And the princes of Juda heard these words: and they went up from the king's house into the house of the Lord , and sat in the entry of the new gate of the house of the Lord .
text_la: Et audierunt principes Juda verba hæc, et ascenderunt de domo regis in domum Domini, et sederunt in introitu portæ domus Domini novæ.
text_pt: E, ouvindo os príncipes de Judá estas palavras, subiram da casa do rei à casa do Senhor, e se assentaram à entrada da porta nova do Senhor.
text_el: καὶ ἤκουσαν οἱ ἄρχοντες Ιουδα τὸν λόγον τοῦτον καὶ ἀνέβησαν ἐξ οἴκου τοῦ βασιλέως εἰς οἶκον κυρίου καὶ ἐκάθισαν ἐν προθύροις πύλης κυρίου τῆς καινῆς

text_en: And the priests and the prophets spoke to the princes, and to all the people, saying: The judgment of death is for this man : because he has prophesied against this city, as you have heard with your ears.
text_la: Et locuti sunt sacerdotes et prophetæ ad principes, et ad omnem populum, dicentes : Judicium mortis est viro huic, quia prophetavit adversus civitatem istam, sicut audistis auribus vestris.
text_pt: Então falaram os sacerdotes e os profetas aos príncipes e a todo o povo, dizendo: Este homem é réu de morte, porque profetizou contra esta cidade, como ouvistes com os vossos ouvidos.
text_el: καὶ εἶπαν οἱ ἱερεῖς καὶ οἱ ψευδοπροφῆται πρὸς τοὺς ἄρχοντας καὶ παντὶ τῷ λαῷ κρίσις θανάτου τῷ ἀνθρώπῳ τούτῳ ὅτι ἐπροφήτευσεν κατὰ τῆς πόλεως ταύτης καθὼς ἠκούσατε ἐν τοῖς ὠσὶν ὑμῶν

text_en: Then Jeremias spoke to all the princes, and to all the people, saying: The Lord sent me to prophesy concerning this house, and concerning this city all the words that you have heard.
text_la: Et ait Jeremias ad omnes principes, et ad universum populum, dicens : Dominus misit me ut prophetarem ad domum istam, et ad civitatem hanc, omnia verba quæ audistis.
text_pt: E falou Jeremias a todos os príncipes e a todo o povo, dizendo: O Senhor me enviou a profetizar contra esta casa, e contra esta cidade, todas as palavras que ouvistes.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Ιερεμιας πρὸς τοὺς ἄρχοντας καὶ παντὶ τῷ λαῷ λέγων κύριος ἀπέστειλέν με προφητεῦσαι ἐπὶ τὸν οἶκον τοῦτον καὶ ἐπὶ τὴν πόλιν ταύτην πάντας τοὺς λόγους τούτους οὓς ἠκούσατε

text_en: Now therefore amend your ways, and your doings, and hearken to the voice of the Lord your God : and the Lord will repent him of the evil that he has spoken against you.
text_la: Nunc ergo bonas facite vias vestras et studia vestra, et audite vocem Domini Dei vestri, et pœnitebit Dominum mali quod locutus est adversum vos.
text_pt: Agora, pois, melhorai os vossos caminhos e as vossas ações, e ouvi a voz do Senhor vosso Deus, e arrepender-se-á o Senhor do mal que falou contra vós.
text_el: καὶ νῦν βελτίους ποιήσατε τὰς ὁδοὺς ὑμῶν καὶ τὰ ἔργα ὑμῶν καὶ ἀκούσατε τῆς φωνῆς κυρίου καὶ παύσεται κύριος ἀπὸ τῶν κακῶν ὧν ἐλάλησεν ἐφ' ὑμᾶς

text_en: But as for me, behold I am in your hands: do with me what is good and right in your eyes:
text_la: Ego autem ecce in manibus vestris sum: facite mihi quod bonum et rectum est in oculis vestris.
text_pt: Quanto a mim, eis que estou nas vossas mãos; fazei de mim conforme o que for bom e reto aos vossos olhos.
text_el: καὶ ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ ἐν χερσὶν ὑμῶν ποιήσατέ μοι ὡς συμφέρει καὶ ὡς βέλτιον ὑμῖν

text_en: But know and understand, that if you put me to death, you will shed innocent blood against your own selves, and against this city, and the inhabitants thereof. For in truth the Lord sent me to you, to speak all these words in your hearing.
text_la: Verumtamen scitote et cognoscite quod, si occideritis me, sanguinem innocentem tradetis contra vosmetipsos, et contra civitatem istam, et habitatores ejus : in veritate enim misit me Dominus ad vos, ut loquerer in auribus vestris omnia verba hæc.
text_pt: Sabei, porém, com certeza que, se me matardes, trareis sangue inocente sobre vós, e sobre esta cidade, e sobre os seus habitantes; porque, na verdade, o Senhor me enviou a vós, para dizer aos vossos ouvidos todas estas palavras.
text_el: ἀλλ' ἢ γνόντες γνώσεσθε ὅτι εἰ ἀναιρεῖτέ με αἷμα ἀθῷον δίδοτε ἐφ' ὑμᾶς καὶ ἐπὶ τὴν πόλιν ταύτην καὶ ἐπὶ τοὺς κατοικοῦντας ἐν αὐτῇ ὅτι ἐν ἀληθείᾳ ἀπέσταλκέν με κύριος πρὸς ὑμᾶς λαλῆσαι εἰς τὰ ὦτα ὑμῶν πάντας τοὺς λόγους τούτους

text_en: Then the princes, and all the people said to the priests , and to the prophets : There is no judgment of death for this man : for he has spoken to us in the name of the Lord our God .
text_la: Et dixerunt principes et omnis populus ad sacerdotes et ad prophetas : Non est viro huic judicium mortis, quia in nomine Domini Dei nostri locutus est ad nos.
text_pt: Então disseram os príncipes, e todo o povo aos sacerdotes e aos profetas: Este homem não é réu de morte, porque em nome do Senhor, nosso Deus, nos falou.
text_el: καὶ εἶπαν οἱ ἄρχοντες καὶ πᾶς ὁ λαὸς πρὸς τοὺς ἱερεῖς καὶ πρὸς τοὺς ψευδοπροφήτας οὐκ ἔστιν τῷ ἀνθρώπῳ τούτῳ κρίσις θανάτου ὅτι ἐπὶ τῷ ὀνόματι κυρίου τοῦ θεοῦ ἡμῶν ἐλάλησεν πρὸς ἡμᾶς

text_en: And some of the ancients of the land rose up: and they spoke to all the assembly of the people, saying:
text_la: Surrexerunt ergo viri de senioribus terræ, et dixerunt ad omnem cœtum populi, loquentes:
text_pt: Também se levantaram alguns homens dentre os anciãos da terra, e falaram a toda a congregação do povo, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ ἀνέστησαν ἄνδρες τῶν πρεσβυτέρων τῆς γῆς καὶ εἶπαν πάσῃ τῇ συναγωγῇ τοῦ λαοῦ

text_en: Micheas of Morasthi was a prophet in the days of Ezechias king of Juda , and he spoke to all the people of Juda , saying: Thus says the Lord of hosts : Sion shall be ploughed like a field, and Jerusalem shall be a heap of stones: and the mountain of the house the high places of woods.
text_la: Michæas de Morasthi fuit propheta in diebus Ezechiæ regis Juda, et ait ad omnem populum Juda, dicens : Hæc dicit Dominus exercituum : Sion quasi ager arabitur, et Jerusalem in acervum lapidum erit, et mons domus in excelsa silvarum.
text_pt: Miquéias, o morastita, profetizou nos dias de Ezequias, rei de Judá, e falou a todo o povo de Judá, dizendo: Assim disse o Senhor dos Exércitos: Sião será lavrada como um campo, e Jerusalém se tornará em montões de pedras, e o monte desta casa como os altos de um bosque.
text_el: Μιχαιας ὁ Μωραθίτης ἦν ἐν ταῖς ἡμέραις Εζεκιου βασιλέως Ιουδα καὶ εἶπεν παντὶ τῷ λαῷ Ιουδα οὕτως εἶπεν κύριος Σιων ὡς ἀγρὸς ἀροτριαθήσεται καὶ Ιερουσαλημ εἰς ἄβατον ἔσται καὶ τὸ ὄρος τοῦ οἴκου εἰς ἄλσος δρυμοῦ

text_en: Did Ezechias king of Juda , and all Juda , condemn him to death? Did they not fear the Lord , and beseech the face of the Lord : and the Lord repented of the evil that he had spoken against them? Therefore we are doing a great evil against our souls .
text_la: Numquid morte condemnavit eum Ezechias rex Juda, et omnis Juda? numquid non timuerunt Dominum, et deprecati sunt faciem Domini, et pœnituit Dominum mali quod locutus fuerat adversum eos? Itaque nos facimus malum grande contra animas nostras.
text_pt: Mataram-no, porventura, Ezequias, rei de Judá, e todo o Judá? Antes não temeu ao Senhor, e não implorou o favor do Senhor? E o Senhor não se arrependeu do mal que falara contra eles? Nós fazemos um grande mal contra as nossas almas.
text_el: μὴ ἀνελὼν ἀνεῖλεν αὐτὸν Εζεκιας καὶ πᾶς Ιουδα οὐχὶ ὅτι ἐφοβήθησαν τὸν κύριον καὶ ὅτι ἐδεήθησαν τοῦ προσώπου κυρίου καὶ ἐπαύσατο κύριος ἀπὸ τῶν κακῶν ὧν ἐλάλησεν ἐπ' αὐτούς καὶ ἡμεῖς ἐποιήσαμεν κακὰ μεγάλα ἐπὶ ψυχὰς ἡμῶν

text_en: There was also a man that prophesied in the name of the Lord , Urias the son of Semei of Cariathiarim: and he prophesied against this city, and against this land, according to all the words of Jeremias.
text_la: Fuit quoque vir prophetans in nomine Domini, Urias filius Semei de Cariathiarim, et prophetavit adversus civitatem istam, et adversus terram hanc, juxta omnia verba Jeremiæ.
text_pt: Também houve outro homem que profetizava em nome do Senhor, a saber: Urias, filho de Semaías de Quiriate-Jearim, o qual profetizou contra esta cidade, e contra esta terra, conforme todas as palavras de Jeremias.
text_el: καὶ ἄνθρωπος ἦν προφητεύων τῷ ὀνόματι κυρίου Ουριας υἱὸς Σαμαιου ἐκ Καριαθιαριμ καὶ ἐπροφήτευσεν περὶ τῆς γῆς ταύτης κατὰ πάντας τοὺς λόγους Ιερεμιου

text_en: And Joakim, and all his men in power, and his princes heard these words: and the king sought to put him to death. And Urias heard it, and was afraid, and fled and went into Egypt .
text_la: Et audivit rex Joakim, et omnes potentes et principes ejus, verba hæc, et quæsivit rex interficere eum : et audivit Urias, et timuit, fugitque, et ingressus est Ægyptum.
text_pt: E, ouvindo o rei Jeoiaquim, e todos os seus poderosos e todos os príncipes, as suas palavras, procurou o rei matá-lo; mas ouvindo isto, Urias temeu e fugiu, e foi para o Egito;
text_el: καὶ ἤκουσεν ὁ βασιλεὺς Ιωακιμ καὶ πάντες οἱ ἄρχοντες πάντας τοὺς λόγους αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐζήτουν ἀποκτεῖναι αὐτόν καὶ ἤκουσεν Ουριας καὶ εἰσῆλθεν εἰς Αἴγυπτον

text_en: And king Joakim sent men into Egypt , Elnathan the son of Achobor, and men with him into Egypt .
text_la: Et misit rex Joakim viros in Ægyptum, Elnathan filium Achobor, et viros cum eo, in Ægyptum,
text_pt: Mas o rei Jeoiaquim enviou alguns homens ao Egito, a saber: Elnatã, filho de Acbor, e outros homens com ele, ao Egito.
text_el: καὶ ἐξαπέστειλεν ὁ βασιλεὺς ἄνδρας εἰς Αἴγυπτον

text_en: And they brought Urias out of Egypt : and brought him to king Joakim, and he slew him with the sword: and he cast his dead body into the graves of the common people.
text_la: et eduxerunt Uriam de Ægypto, et adduxerunt eum ad regem Joakim, et percussit eum gladio, et projecit cadaver ejus in sepulchris vulgi ignobilis.
text_pt: Os quais tiraram a Urias do Egito, e o trouxeram ao rei Jeoiaquim, que o feriu à espada, e lançou o seu cadáver nas sepulturas dos filhos do povo.
text_el: καὶ ἐξηγάγοσαν αὐτὸν ἐκεῖθεν καὶ εἰσηγάγοσαν αὐτὸν πρὸς τὸν βασιλέα καὶ ἐπάταξεν αὐτὸν ἐν μαχαίρᾳ καὶ ἔρριψεν αὐτὸν εἰς τὸ μνῆμα υἱῶν λαοῦ αὐτοῦ

text_en: So the hand of Ahicam the son of Saphan was with Jeremias, that he should not be delivered into the hands of the people, to put him to death.
text_la: Igitur manus Ahicam filii Saphan fuit cum Jeremia, ut non traderetur in manus populi, et interficerent eum.
text_pt: Porém a mão de Aicão, filho de Safã, foi com Jeremias, para que o não entregassem na mão do povo, para ser morto.
text_el: πλὴν χεὶρ Αχικαμ υἱοῦ Σαφαν ἦν μετὰ Ιερεμιου τοῦ μὴ παραδοῦναι αὐτὸν εἰς χεῖρας τοῦ λαοῦ τοῦ μὴ ἀνελεῖν αὐτόν

text_en: In the beginning of the reign of Joakim the son of Josias king of Juda , this word came to Jeremias from the Lord , saying:
text_la: In principio regni Joakim filii Josiæ regis Juda, factum est verbum istud ad Jeremiam a Domino, dicens:
text_pt: No princípio do reinado de Jeoiaquim, filho de Josias, rei de Judá, veio esta palavra a Jeremias da parte do SENHOR, dizendo:

text_en: Thus says the Lord to me: Make bands, and chains: and you shall put them on your neck.
text_la: Hæc dicit Dominus ad me : Fac tibi vincula et catenas, et pones eas in collo tuo,
text_pt: Assim me disse o Senhor: Faze uns grilhões e jugos, e põe-nos ao teu pescoço.
text_el: οὕτως εἶπεν κύριος ποίησον δεσμοὺς καὶ κλοιοὺς καὶ περίθου περὶ τὸν τράχηλόν σου

text_en: And you shall send them to the king of Edom , and to the king of Moab , and to the king of the children of Ammon , and to the king of Tyre , and to the king of Sidon : by the hand of the messengers that have come to Jerusalem to Sedecias the king of Juda .
text_la: et mittes eas ad regem Edom, et ad regem Moab, et ad regem filiorum Ammon, et ad regem Tyri, et ad regem Sidonis, in manu nuntiorum qui venerunt Jerusalem ad Sedeciam regem Juda.
text_pt: E envia-os ao rei de Edom, e ao rei de Moabe, e ao rei dos filhos de Amom, e ao rei de Tiro, e ao rei de Sidom, pela mão dos mensageiros que vêm a Jerusalém a ter com Zedequias, rei de Judá.
text_el: καὶ ἀποστελεῖς αὐτοὺς πρὸς βασιλέα Ιδουμαίας καὶ πρὸς βασιλέα Μωαβ καὶ πρὸς βασιλέα υἱῶν Αμμων καὶ πρὸς βασιλέα Τύρου καὶ πρὸς βασιλέα Σιδῶνος ἐν χερσὶν ἀγγέλων αὐτῶν τῶν ἐρχομένων εἰς ἀπάντησιν αὐτῶν εἰς Ιερουσαλημ πρὸς Σεδεκιαν βασιλέα Ιουδα

text_en: And you shall command them to speak to their masters: Thus says the Lord of hosts the God of Israel : Thus shall you say to your masters:
text_la: Et præcipies eis ut ad dominos suos loquantur : Hæc dicit Dominus exercituum, Deus Israël : Hæc dicetis ad dominos vestros:
text_pt: E lhes ordenarás, que digam aos seus senhores: Assim diz o SENHOR dos Exércitos, o Deus de Israel: Assim direis a vossos senhores:
text_el: καὶ συντάξεις αὐτοῖς πρὸς τοὺς κυρίους αὐτῶν εἰπεῖν οὕτως εἶπεν κύριος ὁ θεὸς Ισραηλ οὕτως ἐρεῖτε πρὸς τοὺς κυρίους ὑμῶν

text_en: I made the earth, and the men and the beasts that are upon the face of the earth, by my great power, and by my stretched out arm: and I have given it to whom it seemed good in my eyes.
text_la: Ego feci terram, et homines, et jumenta quæ sunt super faciem terræ, in fortitudine mea magna, et in brachio meo extento, et dedi eam ei qui placuit in oculis meis.
text_pt: Eu fiz a terra, o homem, e os animais que estão sobre a face da terra, com o meu grande poder, e com o meu braço estendido, e a dou a quem é reto aos meus olhos.
text_el: ὅτι ἐγὼ ἐποίησα τὴν γῆν ἐν τῇ ἰσχύι μου τῇ μεγάλῃ καὶ ἐν τῷ ἐπιχείρῳ μου τῷ ὑψηλῷ καὶ δώσω αὐτὴν ᾧ ἐὰν δόξῃ ἐν ὀφθαλμοῖς μου

text_en: And now I have given all these lands into the hand of Nabuchodonosor king of Babylon my servant: moreover also the beasts of the field I have given him to serve him.
text_la: Et nunc itaque ego dedi omnes terras istas in manu Nabuchodonosor regis Babylonis servi mei : insuper et bestias agri dedi ei, ut serviant illi:
text_pt: E agora eu entreguei todas estas terras na mão de Nabucodonosor, rei de babilônia, meu servo; e ainda até os animais do campo lhe dei, para que o sirvam.
