text_el: ἔδωκα τὴν γῆν τῷ Ναβουχοδονοσορ βασιλεῖ Βαβυλῶνος δουλεύειν αὐτῷ καὶ τὰ θηρία τοῦ ἀγροῦ ἐργάζεσθαι αὐτῷ

text_en: And all nations shall serve him, and his son, and his son's son: till the time come for his land and himself: and many nations and great kings shall serve him.
text_la: et servient ei omnes gentes, et filio ejus, et filio filii ejus, donec veniat tempus terræ ejus et ipsius : et servient ei gentes multæ et reges magni.
text_pt: E todas as nações servirão a ele, e a seu filho, e ao filho de seu filho, até que também venha o tempo da sua própria terra, quando muitas nações e grandes reis se servirão dele.

text_en: But the nation and kingdom that will not serve Nabuchodonosor king of Babylon , and whosoever will not bend his neck under the yoke of the king of Babylon : I will visit upon that nation with the sword, and with famine, and with pestilence, says the Lord : till I consume them by his hand.
text_la: Gens autem et regnum quod non servierit Nabuchodonosor regi Babylonis, et quicumque non curvaverit collum suum sub jugo regis Babylonis, in gladio, et in fame, et in peste visitabo super gentem illam, ait Dominus, donec consumam eos in manu ejus.
text_pt: E acontecerá que, se alguma nação e reino não servirem o mesmo Nabucodonosor, rei de babilônia, e não puserem o seu pescoço debaixo do jugo do rei de babilônia, a essa nação castigarei com espada, e com fome, e com peste, diz o SENHOR, até que a consuma pela sua mão;
text_el: καὶ τὸ ἔθνος καὶ ἡ βασιλεία ὅσοι ἐὰν μὴ ἐμβάλωσιν τὸν τράχηλον αὐτῶν ὑπὸ τὸν ζυγὸν βασιλέως Βαβυλῶνος ἐν μαχαίρᾳ καὶ ἐν λιμῷ ἐπισκέψομαι αὐτούς εἶπεν κύριος ἕως ἐκλίπωσιν ἐν χειρὶ αὐτοῦ

text_en: Therefore hearken not to your prophets , and diviners , and dreamers, and soothsayers, and sorcerers, that say to you: You shall not serve the king of Babylon .
text_la: Vos ergo nolite audire prophetas vestros, et divinos, et somniatores, et augures, et maleficos, qui dicunt vobis : Non servietis regi Babylonis:
text_pt: E vós não deis ouvidos aos vossos profetas, e aos vossos adivinhos, e aos vossos sonhos, e aos vossos agoureiros, e aos vossos encantadores, que vos falam, dizendo: Não servireis ao rei de babilônia.
text_el: καὶ ὑμεῖς μὴ ἀκούετε τῶν ψευδοπροφητῶν ὑμῶν καὶ τῶν μαντευομένων ὑμῖν καὶ τῶν ἐνυπνιαζομένων ὑμῖν καὶ τῶν οἰωνισμάτων ὑμῶν καὶ τῶν φαρμακῶν ὑμῶν τῶν λεγόντων οὐ μὴ ἐργάσησθε τῷ βασιλεῖ Βαβυλῶνος

text_en: For they prophesy lies to you: to remove you far from your country, and cast you out, and to make you perish.
text_la: quia mendacium prophetant vobis, ut longe vos faciant de terra vestra, et ejiciant vos, et pereatis.
text_pt: Porque mentiras vos profetizam, para vos mandarem para longe da vossa terra, e para que eu vos expulse dela, e pereçais.
text_el: ὅτι ψευδῆ αὐτοὶ προφητεύουσιν ὑμῖν πρὸς τὸ μακρῦναι ὑμᾶς ἀπὸ τῆς γῆς ὑμῶν

text_en: But the nation that shall bend down their neck under the yoke of the king of Babylon , and shall serve him: I will let them remain in their own land, says the Lord : and they shall till it, and dwell in it.
text_la: Porro gens quæ subjecerit cervicem suam sub jugo regis Babylonis, et servierit ei, dimittam eam in terra sua, dicit Dominus, et colet eam, et habitabit in ea.
text_pt: Mas a nação que colocar o seu pescoço sob o jugo do rei de babilônia, e o servir, eu a deixarei na sua terra, diz o SENHOR, e lavrá-la-á e habitará nela.
text_el: καὶ τὸ ἔθνος ὃ ἐὰν εἰσαγάγῃ τὸν τράχηλον αὐτοῦ ὑπὸ τὸν ζυγὸν βασιλέως Βαβυλῶνος καὶ ἐργάσηται αὐτῷ καὶ καταλείψω αὐτὸν ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐργᾶται αὐτῷ καὶ ἐνοικήσει ἐν αὐτῇ

text_en: And I spoke to Sedecias the king of Juda according to all these words, saying: Bend down your necks under the yoke of the king of Babylon , and serve him, and his people, and you shall live.
text_la: Et ad Sedeciam regem Juda locutus sum secundum omnia verba hæc, dicens : Subjicite colla vestra sub jugo regis Babylonis, et servite ei et populo ejus, et vivetis.
text_pt: E falei com Zedequias, rei de Judá, conforme todas estas palavras, dizendo: Colocai os vossos pescoços no jugo do rei de babilônia, e servi-o, a ele e ao seu povo, e vivereis.
text_el: καὶ πρὸς Σεδεκιαν βασιλέα Ιουδα ἐλάλησα κατὰ πάντας τοὺς λόγους τούτους λέγων εἰσαγάγετε τὸν τράχηλον ὑμῶν

text_en: Why will you die, you and your people by the sword, and by famine, and by the pestilence, as the Lord has spoken against the nation that will not serve the king of Babylon ?
text_la: Quare moriemini, tu et populus tuus, gladio, et fame, et peste, sicut locutus est Dominus ad gentem quæ servire noluerit regi Babylonis?
text_pt: Por que morrerias tu e o teu povo, à espada, e à fome, e de peste, como o SENHOR disse contra a nação que não servir ao rei de babilônia?

text_en: Hearken not to the words of the prophets that say to you: You shall not serve the king of Babylon : for they tell you a lie.
text_la: Nolite audire verba prophetarum dicentium vobis : Non servietis regi Babylonis : quia mendacium ipsi loquuntur vobis:
text_pt: E não deis ouvidos às palavras dos profetas, que vos falam, dizendo: Não servireis ao rei de babilônia; porque vos profetizam mentiras.
text_el: καὶ ἐργάσασθε τῷ βασιλεῖ Βαβυλῶνος ὅτι ἄδικα αὐτοὶ προφητεύουσιν ὑμῖν

text_en: For I have not sent them, says the Lord : and they prophesy in my name falsely : to drive you out, and that you may perish, both you, and the prophets that prophesy to you.
text_la: quia non misi eos, ait Dominus, et ipsi prophetant in nomine meo mendaciter, ut ejiciant vos, et pereatis, tam vos quam prophetæ qui vaticinantur vobis.
text_pt: Porque não os enviei, diz o Senhor, e profetizam falsamente em meu nome; para que eu vos lance fora, e pereçais, vós e os profetas que vos profetizam.
text_el: ὅτι οὐκ ἀπέστειλα αὐτούς φησὶν κύριος καὶ προφητεύουσιν τῷ ὀνόματί μου ἐπ' ἀδίκῳ πρὸς τὸ ἀπολέσαι ὑμᾶς καὶ ἀπολεῖσθε ὑμεῖς καὶ οἱ προφῆται ὑμῶν οἱ προφητεύοντες ὑμῖν ἐπ' ἀδίκῳ ψευδῆ

text_en: I spoke also to the priests , and to this people, saying: Thus says the Lord : Hearken not to the words of your prophets , that prophesy to you, saying: Behold the vessels of the Lord shall now in a short time be brought again from Babylon : for they prophesy a lie unto you.
text_la: Et ad sacerdotes, et ad populum istum, locutus sum, dicens : Hæc dicit Dominus : Nolite audire verba prophetarum vestrorum, qui prophetant vobis, dicentes : Ecce vasa Domini revertentur de Babylone nunc cito : mendacium enim prophetant vobis.
text_pt: Também falei aos sacerdotes, e a todo este povo, dizendo: Assim diz o SENHOR: Não deis ouvidos às palavras dos vossos profetas, que vos profetizam, dizendo: Eis que os utensílios da casa do SENHOR cedo voltarão de babilônia, porque vos profetizam mentiras.
text_el: ὑμῖν καὶ παντὶ τῷ λαῷ τούτῳ καὶ τοῖς ἱερεῦσιν ἐλάλησα λέγων οὕτως εἶπεν κύριος μὴ ἀκούετε τῶν λόγων τῶν προφητῶν τῶν προφητευόντων ὑμῖν λεγόντων ἰδοὺ σκεύη οἴκου κυρίου ἐπιστρέψει ἐκ Βαβυλῶνος ὅτι ἄδικα αὐτοὶ προφητεύουσιν ὑμῖν οὐκ ἀπέστειλα αὐτούς

text_en: Therefore hearken not to them, but serve the king of Babylon , that you may live. Why should this city be given up to desolation?
text_la: Nolite ergo audire eos : sed servite regi Babylonis, ut vivatis : quare datur hæc civitas in solitudinem?
text_pt: Não lhes deis ouvidos, servi ao rei de babilônia, e vivereis; por que se tornaria esta cidade em desolação?

text_en: But if they be prophets , and the word of the Lord be in them: let them interpose themselves before the Lord of hosts , that the vessels which were left in the house of the Lord , and in the house of the king of Juda , and in Jerusalem , may not go to Babylon .
text_la: Et si prophetæ sunt, et est verbum Domini in eis, occurrant Domino exercituum, ut non veniant vasa quæ derelicta fuerant in domo Domini, et in domo regis Juda, et in Jerusalem, in Babylonem.
text_pt: Porém, se são profetas, e se há palavras do SENHOR com eles, orem agora ao SENHOR dos Exércitos, para que os utensílios que ficaram na casa do SENHOR, e na casa do rei de Judá, e em Jerusalém, não vão para a babilônia.
text_el: εἰ προφῆταί εἰσιν καὶ εἰ ἔστιν λόγος κυρίου ἐν αὐτοῖς ἀπαντησάτωσάν μοι

text_en: For thus says the Lord of hosts to the pillars, and to the sea, and to the bases, and to the rest of the vessels that remain in this city:
text_la: Quia hæc dicit Dominus exercituum ad columnas, et ad mare, et ad bases, et ad reliqua vasorum quæ remanserunt in civitate hac,
text_pt: Porque assim diz o Senhor dos Exércitos acerca das colunas, e do mar, e das bases, e dos demais utensílios que ficaram na cidade,
text_el: ὅτι οὕτως εἶπεν κύριος καὶ τῶν ἐπιλοίπων σκευῶν

text_en: Which Nabuchodonosor the king of Babylon did not take, when he carried away Jechonias the son of Joakim the king of Juda , from Jerusalem to Babylon , and all the great men of Juda and Jerusalem .
text_la: quæ non tulit Nabuchodonosor rex Babylonis cum transferret Jechoniam filium Joakim regem Juda de Jerusalem in Babylonem, et omnes optimates Juda et Jerusalem:
text_pt: Os quais Nabucodonosor, rei de babilônia, não levou, quando transportou de Jerusalém para babilônia a Jeconias, filho de Jeoiaquim, rei de Judá, como também a todos os nobres de Judá e de Jerusalém;
text_el: ὧν οὐκ ἔλαβεν βασιλεὺς Βαβυλῶνος ὅτε ἀπῴκισεν τὸν Ιεχονιαν ἐξ Ιερουσαλημ

text_en: For thus says the Lord of hosts the God of Israel , to the vessels that are left in the house of the Lord , and in the house of the king of Juda and Jerusalem :
text_la: quia hæc dicit Dominus exercituum, Deus Israël, ad vasa quæ derelicta sunt in domo Domini, et in domo regis Juda et Jerusalem:
text_pt: Assim, pois, diz o Senhor dos Exércitos, o Deus de Israel, acerca dos utensílios que ficaram na casa do Senhor, e na casa do rei de Judá, e em Jerusalém:

text_en: They shall be carried to Babylon , and there they shall be until the day of their visitation, says the Lord : and I will cause them to be brought, and to be restored in this place.
text_la: In Babylonem transferentur, et ibi erunt usque ad diem visitationis suæ, dicit Dominus, et afferri faciam ea, et restitui in loco isto.
text_pt: À Babilônia serão levados, e ali ficarão até o dia em que eu os visitarei, diz o Senhor; então os farei subir, e os tornarei a trazer a este lugar.
text_el: εἰς Βαβυλῶνα εἰσελεύσεται λέγει κύριος

text_en: And it came to pass in that year, in the beginning of the reign of Sedecias king of Juda , in the fourth year, in the fifth month, that Hananias the son of Azur, a prophet of Gabaon spoke to me, in the house of the Lord before the priests , and all the people, saying:
text_la: Et factum est in anno illo, in principio regni Sedeciæ regis Juda, in anno quarto, in mense quinto, dixit ad me Hananias filius Azur, propheta de Gabaon, in domo Domini, coram sacerdotibus et omni populo, dicens:
text_pt: E sucedeu no mesmo ano, no princípio do reinado de Zedequias, rei de Judá, no ano quarto, no mês quinto, que Hananias, filho de Azur, o profeta que era de Gibeom, me falou na casa do SENHOR, na presença dos sacerdotes e de todo o povo, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο ἐν τῷ τετάρτῳ ἔτει Σεδεκια βασιλέως Ιουδα ἐν μηνὶ τῷ πέμπτῳ εἶπέν μοι Ανανιας υἱὸς Αζωρ ὁ ψευδοπροφήτης ὁ ἀπὸ Γαβαων ἐν οἴκῳ κυρίου κατ' ὀφθαλμοὺς τῶν ἱερέων καὶ παντὸς τοῦ λαοῦ λέγων

text_en: Thus says the Lord of hosts the God of Israel : I have broken the yoke of the king of Babylon .
text_la: Hæc dicit Dominus exercituum, Deus Israël : Contrivi jugum regis Babylonis.
text_pt: Assim fala o SENHOR dos Exércitos, o Deus de Israel, dizendo: Eu quebrei o jugo do rei de babilônia.
text_el: οὕτως εἶπεν κύριος συνέτριψα τὸν ζυγὸν τοῦ βασιλέως Βαβυλῶνος

text_en: As yet two years of days, and I will cause all the vessels of the house of the Lord to be brought back into this place, which Nabuchodonosor king of Babylon took away from this place, and carried them to Babylon .
text_la: Adhuc duo anni dierum, et ego referri faciam ad locum istum omnia vasa domus Domini, quæ tulit Nabuchodonosor rex Babylonis de loco isto, et transtulit ea in Babylonem.
text_pt: Depois de passados dois anos completos, eu tornarei a trazer a este lugar todos os utensílios da casa do SENHOR, que deste lugar tomou Nabucodonosor, rei de babilônia, levando-os a babilônia.
text_el: ἔτι δύο ἔτη ἡμερῶν ἐγὼ ἀποστρέψω εἰς τὸν τόπον τοῦτον τὰ σκεύη οἴκου κυρίου

text_en: And I will bring back to this place Jechonias the son of Joakim king of Juda , and all the captives of Juda , that have gone to Babylon , says the Lord : for I will break the yoke of the king of Babylon .
text_la: Et Jechoniam filium Joakim regem Juda, et omnem transmigrationem Juda, qui ingressi sunt in Babylonem, ego convertam ad locum istum, ait Dominus : conteram enim jugum regis Babylonis.
text_pt: Também a Jeconias, filho de Jeoiaquim, rei de Judá, e a todos os do cativeiro de Judá, que entraram em babilônia, eu tornarei a trazer a este lugar, diz o SENHOR; porque quebrarei o jugo do rei de babilônia.
text_el: καὶ Ιεχονιαν καὶ τὴν ἀποικίαν Ιουδα ὅτι συντρίψω τὸν ζυγὸν βασιλέως Βαβυλῶνος

text_en: And Jeremiah the prophet said to Hananias the prophet in the presence of the priests , and in the presence of all the people that stood in the house of the Lord :
text_la: Et dixit Jeremias propheta ad Hananiam prophetam, in oculis sacerdotum, et in oculis omnis populi qui stabat in domo Domini:
text_pt: Então falou o profeta Jeremias ao profeta Hananias, na presença dos sacerdotes, e na presença de todo o povo que estava na casa do Senhor.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Ιερεμιας πρὸς Ανανιαν κατ' ὀφθαλμοὺς παντὸς τοῦ λαοῦ καὶ κατ' ὀφθαλμοὺς τῶν ἱερέων τῶν ἑστηκότων ἐν οἴκῳ κυρίου

text_en: And Jeremiah the prophet said: Amen , the Lord do so: the Lord perform your words, which you have prophesied : that the vessels may be brought again into the house of the Lord , and all the captives may return out of Babylon to this place.
text_la: et ait Jeremias propheta : Amen! sic faciat Dominus : suscitet Dominus verba tua quæ prophetasti, ut referantur vasa in domum Domini, et omnis transmigratio de Babylone ad locum istum.
text_pt: Disse, pois, Jeremias, o profeta: Amém! Assim faça o SENHOR; confirme o SENHOR as tuas palavras, que profetizaste, e torne ele a trazer os utensílios da casa do SENHOR, e todos os do cativeiro de babilônia a este lugar.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Ιερεμιας ἀληθῶς οὕτω ποιήσαι κύριος στήσαι τὸν λόγον σου ὃν σὺ προφητεύεις τοῦ ἐπιστρέψαι τὰ σκεύη οἴκου κυρίου καὶ πᾶσαν τὴν ἀποικίαν ἐκ Βαβυλῶνος εἰς τὸν τόπον τοῦτον

text_en: Nevertheless hear this word that I speak in your ears, and in the ears of all the people:
text_la: Verumtamen audi verbum hoc quod ego loquor in auribus tuis, et in auribus universi populi:
text_pt: Mas ouve agora esta palavra, que eu falo aos teus ouvidos e aos ouvidos de todo o povo:
text_el: πλὴν ἀκούσατε τὸν λόγον κυρίου ὃν ἐγὼ λέγω εἰς τὰ ὦτα ὑμῶν καὶ εἰς τὰ ὦτα παντὸς τοῦ λαοῦ

text_en: The prophets that have been before me, and before you from the beginning, and have prophesied concerning many countries, and concerning great kingdoms, of war , and of affliction, and of famine.
text_la: prophetæ qui fuerunt ante me et ante te, ab initio, et prophetaverunt super terras multas et super regna magna de prælio, et de afflictione, et de fame:
text_pt: Os profetas que houve antes de mim e antes de ti, desde a antiguidade, profetizaram contra muitas terras, e contra grandes reinos, acerca de guerra, e de mal, e de peste.
text_el: οἱ προφῆται οἱ γεγονότες πρότεροί μου καὶ πρότεροι ὑμῶν ἀπὸ τοῦ αἰῶνος καὶ ἐπροφήτευσαν ἐπὶ γῆς πολλῆς καὶ ἐπὶ βασιλείας μεγάλας εἰς πόλεμον

text_en: The prophet that prophesied peace: when his word shall come to pass, the prophet shall be known , whom the Lord has sent in truth .
text_la: propheta qui vaticinatus est pacem, cum venerit verbum ejus, scietur propheta quem misit Dominus in veritate.
text_pt: O profeta que profetizar de paz, quando se cumprir a palavra desse profeta, será conhecido como aquele a quem o Senhor na verdade enviou.
text_el: ὁ προφήτης ὁ προφητεύσας εἰς εἰρήνην ἐλθόντος τοῦ λόγου γνώσονται τὸν προφήτην ὃν ἀπέστειλεν αὐτοῖς κύριος ἐν πίστει

text_en: And Hananias the prophet took the chain from the neck of Jeremiah the prophet , and broke it.
text_la: Et tulit Hananias propheta catenam de collo Jeremiæ prophetæ, et confregit eam.
text_pt: Então Hananias, o profeta, tomou o jugo do pescoço do profeta Jeremias, e o quebrou.
text_el: καὶ ἔλαβεν Ανανιας ἐν ὀφθαλμοῖς παντὸς τοῦ λαοῦ τοὺς κλοιοὺς ἀπὸ τοῦ τραχήλου Ιερεμιου καὶ συνέτριψεν αὐτούς

text_en: And Hananias spoke in the presence of all the people, saying: Thus says the Lord : Even so will I break the yoke of Nabuchodonosor the king of Babylon after two full years from off the neck of all the nations.
text_la: Et ait Hananias in conspectu omnis populi, dicens : Hæc dicit Dominus : Sic confringam jugum Nabuchodonosor regis Babylonis, post duos annos dierum de collo omnium gentium.
text_pt: E falou Hananias na presença de todo o povo, dizendo: Assim diz o SENHOR: Assim, passados dois anos completos, quebrarei o jugo de Nabucodonosor, rei de babilônia, de sobre o pescoço de todas as nações. E Jeremias, o profeta, seguiu o seu caminho.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Ανανιας κατ' ὀφθαλμοὺς παντὸς τοῦ λαοῦ λέγων οὕτως εἶπεν κύριος οὕτως συντρίψω τὸν ζυγὸν βασιλέως Βαβυλῶνος ἀπὸ τραχήλων πάντων τῶν ἐθνῶν καὶ ᾤχετο Ιερεμιας εἰς τὴν ὁδὸν αὐτοῦ

text_en: And Jeremiah the prophet went his way. And the word of the Lord came to Jeremias, after that Hananias the prophet had broken the chain from off the neck of Jeremiah the prophet , saying:
text_la: Et abiit Jeremias propheta in viam suam. Et factum est verbum Domini ad Jeremiam, postquam confregit Hananias propheta catenam de collo Jeremiæprophetæ, dicens:
text_pt: Mas veio a palavra do Senhor a Jeremias, depois que Hananias, o profeta, quebrou o jugo de sobre o pescoço de Jeremias, o profeta, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο λόγος κυρίου πρὸς Ιερεμιαν μετὰ τὸ συντρῖψαι Ανανιαν τοὺς κλοιοὺς ἀπὸ τοῦ τραχήλου αὐτοῦ λέγων

text_en: Go, and tell Hananias: Thus says the Lord : You have broken chains of wood, and you shall make for them chains of iron.
text_la: Vade, et dices Hananiæ : Hæc dicit Dominus : Catenas ligneas contrivisti, et facies pro eis catenas ferreas.
text_pt: Vai, e fala a Hananias, dizendo: Assim diz o Senhor: Jugos de madeira quebraste, mas em vez deles farás jugos de ferro.
text_el: βάδιζε καὶ εἰπὸν πρὸς Ανανιαν λέγων οὕτως εἶπεν κύριος κλοιοὺς ξυλίνους συνέτριψας καὶ ποιήσω ἀντ' αὐτῶν κλοιοὺς σιδηροῦς

text_en: For thus says the Lord of hosts the God of Israel : I have put a yoke of iron upon the neck of all these nations, to serve Nabuchodonosor king of Babylon , and they shall serve him: moreover also I have given him the beasts of the earth.
text_la: Quia hæc dicit Dominus exercituum, Deus Israël : Jugum ferreum posui super collum cunctarum gentium istarum, ut serviant Nabuchodonosor regi Babylonis, et servient ei : insuper et bestias terræ dedi ei.
text_pt: Porque assim diz o SENHOR dos Exércitos, o Deus de Israel: Jugo de ferro pus sobre o pescoço de todas estas nações, para servirem a Nabucodonosor, rei de babilônia, e servi-lo-ão, e até os animais do campo lhe dei.
text_el: ὅτι οὕτως εἶπεν κύριος ζυγὸν σιδηροῦν ἔθηκα ἐπὶ τὸν τράχηλον πάντων τῶν ἐθνῶν ἐργάζεσθαι τῷ βασιλεῖ Βαβυλῶνος

text_en: And Jeremiah the prophet said to Hananias the prophet : Hear now, Hananias: the Lord has not sent you, and you have made this people to trust in a lie.
text_la: Et dixit Jeremias propheta ad Hananiam prophetam : Audi, Hanania : non misit te Dominus, et tu confidere fecisti populum istum in mendacio.
text_pt: E disse o profeta Jeremias ao profeta Hananias: Ouve agora, Hananias: Não te enviou o Senhor, mas tu fizeste que este povo confiasse em mentiras.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Ιερεμιας τῷ Ανανια οὐκ ἀπέσταλκέν σε κύριος καὶ πεποιθέναι ἐποίησας τὸν λαὸν τοῦτον ἐπ' ἀδίκῳ

text_en: Therefore thus says the Lord : Behold I will send you away from off the face of the earth: this year shall you die: for you have spoken against the Lord .
text_la: Idcirco hæc dicit Dominus : Ecce ego mittam te a facie terræ : hoc anno morieris : adversum enim Dominum locutus es.
text_pt: Portanto, assim diz o Senhor: Eis que te lançarei de sobre a face da terra; este ano morrerás, porque falaste em rebeldia contra o Senhor.
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο οὕτως εἶπεν κύριος ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ ἐξαποστέλλω σε ἀπὸ προσώπου τῆς γῆς τούτῳ τῷ ἐνιαυτῷ ἀποθανῇ

text_en: And Hananias the prophet died in that year, in the seventh month.
text_la: Et mortuus est Hananias propheta in anno illo, mense septimo.
text_pt: E morreu Hananias, o profeta, no mesmo ano, no sétimo mês.
text_el: καὶ ἀπέθανεν ἐν τῷ μηνὶ τῷ ἑβδόμῳ

text_en: Now these are the words of the letter which Jeremiah the prophet sent from Jerusalem to the residue of the ancients that were carried into captivity, and to the priests , and to the prophets , and to all the people, whom Nabuchodonosor had carried away from Jerusalem to Babylon :
text_la: Et hæc sunt verba libri quem misit Jeremias propheta de Jerusalem ad reliquias seniorum transmigrationis, et ad sacerdotes, et ad prophetas, et ad omnem populum quem traduxerat Nabuchodonosor de Jerusalem in Babylonem,
text_pt: E Estas são as palavras da carta que Jeremias, o profeta, enviou de Jerusalém, aos que restaram dos anciãos do cativeiro, como também aos sacerdotes, e aos profetas, e a todo o povo que Nabucodonosor havia deportado de Jerusalém para babilônia
text_el: καὶ οὗτοι οἱ λόγοι τῆς βίβλου οὓς ἀπέστειλεν Ιερεμιας ἐξ Ιερουσαλημ πρὸς τοὺς πρεσβυτέρους τῆς ἀποικίας καὶ πρὸς τοὺς ἱερεῖς καὶ πρὸς τοὺς ψευδοπροφήτας ἐπιστολὴν εἰς Βαβυλῶνα τῇ ἀποικίᾳ καὶ πρὸς ἅπαντα τὸν λαὸν

text_en: After that Jechonias the king, and the queen, and the eunuchs, and the princes of Juda , and of Jerusalem , and the craftsmen, and the engravers were departed out of Jerusalem :
text_la: postquam egressus est Jechonias rex, et domina, et eunuchi, et principes Juda et Jerusalem, et faber et inclusor, de Jerusalem,
text_pt: (Depois que saíram de Jerusalém o rei Jeconias, e a rainha, e os eunucos, e os príncipes de Judá e Jerusalém, e os carpinteiros e ferreiros),
text_el: ὕστερον ἐξελθόντος Ιεχονιου τοῦ βασιλέως καὶ τῆς βασιλίσσης καὶ τῶν εὐνούχων καὶ παντὸς ἐλευθέρου καὶ δεσμώτου καὶ τεχνίτου ἐξ Ιερουσαλημ

text_en: By the hand of Elasa the son of Saphan, and Gamarias the son of Helcias, whom Sedecias king of Juda sent to Babylon to Nabuchodonosor king of Babylon , saying:
text_la: in manu Elasa filii Saphan, et Gamariæ filii Helciæ, quos misit Sedecias rex Juda ad Nabuchodonosor regem Babylonis in Babylonem, dicens:
text_pt: Pela mão de Elasa, filho de Safã, e de Gemarias, filho de Hilquias (os quais Zedequias, rei de Judá, tinha enviado a babilônia, a Nabucodonosor, rei de babilônia), dizendo:
text_el: ἐν χειρὶ Ελεασα υἱοῦ Σαφαν καὶ Γαμαριου υἱοῦ Χελκιου ὃν ἀπέστειλεν Σεδεκιας βασιλεὺς Ιουδα πρὸς βασιλέα Βαβυλῶνος εἰς Βαβυλῶνα λέγων

text_en: Thus says the Lord of hosts the God of Israel , to all that are carried away captives, whom I have caused to be carried away from Jerusalem to Babylon :
text_la: Hæc dicit Dominus exercituum, Deus Israël, omni transmigrationi quam transtuli de Jerusalem in Babylonem:
text_pt: Assim diz o SENHOR dos Exércitos, o Deus de Israel, a todos os do cativeiro, os quais fiz transportar de Jerusalém para babilônia:
text_el: οὕτως εἶπεν κύριος ὁ θεὸς Ισραηλ ἐπὶ τὴν ἀποικίαν ἣν ἀπῴκισα ἀπὸ Ιερουσαλημ

text_en: Build houses, and dwell in them: and plant orchards, and eat the fruit of them.
text_la: Ædificate domos, et habitate : et plantate hortos, et comedite fructum eorum.
text_pt: Edificai casas e habitai-as; e plantai jardins, e comei o seu fruto.
text_el: οἰκοδομήσατε οἴκους καὶ κατοικήσατε καὶ φυτεύσατε παραδείσους καὶ φάγετε τοὺς καρποὺς αὐτῶν

text_en: Take wives, and beget sons and daughters: and take wives for your sons, and give your daughters to husbands, and let them bear sons and daughters: and be multiplied there, and be not few in number.
text_la: Accipite uxores, et generate filios et filias : et date filiis vestris uxores, et filias vestras date viris, et pariant filios et filias : et multiplicamini ibi, et nolite esse pauci numero.
text_pt: Tomai mulheres e gerai filhos e filhas, e tomai mulheres para vossos filhos, e dai vossas filhas a maridos, para que tenham filhos e filhas; e multiplicai-vos ali, e não vos diminuais.
text_el: καὶ λάβετε γυναῖκας καὶ τεκνοποιήσατε υἱοὺς καὶ θυγατέρας καὶ λάβετε τοῖς υἱοῖς ὑμῶν γυναῖκας καὶ τὰς θυγατέρας ὑμῶν ἀνδράσιν δότε καὶ πληθύνεσθε καὶ μὴ σμικρυνθῆτε

text_en: And seek the peace of the city, to which I have caused you to be carried away captives; and pray to the Lord for it: for in the peace thereof shall be your peace.
text_la: Et quærite pacem civitatis ad quam transmigrare vos feci, et orate pro ea ad Dominum, quia in pace illius erit pax vobis.
text_pt: E procurai a paz da cidade, para onde vos fiz transportar em cativeiro, e orai por ela ao Senhor; porque na sua paz vós tereis paz.
text_el: καὶ ζητήσατε εἰς εἰρήνην τῆς γῆς εἰς ἣν ἀπῴκισα ὑμᾶς ἐκεῖ καὶ προσεύξασθε περὶ αὐτῶν πρὸς κύριον ὅτι ἐν εἰρήνῃ αὐτῆς ἔσται εἰρήνη ὑμῖν

text_en: For thus says the Lord of hosts the God of Israel : Let not your prophets that are in the midst of you, and your diviners deceive you: and give no heed to your dreams which you dream:
text_la: Hæc enim dicit Dominus exercituum, Deus Israël : Non vos seducant prophetæ vestri qui sunt in medio vestrum, et divini vestri, et ne attendatis ad somnia vestra quæ vos somniatis:
text_pt: Porque assim diz o Senhor dos Exércitos, o Deus de Israel: Não vos enganem os vossos profetas que estão no meio de vós, nem os vossos adivinhos, nem deis ouvidos aos vossos sonhos, que sonhais;
text_el: ὅτι οὕτως εἶπεν κύριος μὴ ἀναπειθέτωσαν ὑμᾶς οἱ ψευδοπροφῆται οἱ ἐν ὑμῖν καὶ μὴ ἀναπειθέτωσαν ὑμᾶς οἱ μάντεις ὑμῶν καὶ μὴ ἀκούετε εἰς τὰ ἐνύπνια ὑμῶν ἃ ὑμεῖς ἐνυπνιάζεσθε

text_en: For they prophesy falsely to you in my name : and I have not sent them, says the Lord .
text_la: quia falso ipsi prophetant vobis in nomine meo, et non misi eos, dicit Dominus.
text_pt: Porque eles vos profetizam falsamente em meu nome; não os enviei, diz o Senhor.
text_el: ὅτι ἄδικα αὐτοὶ προφητεύουσιν ὑμῖν ἐπὶ τῷ ὀνόματί μου καὶ οὐκ ἀπέστειλα αὐτούς

text_en: For thus says the Lord : When the seventy years shall begin to be accomplished in Babylon , I will visit you: and I will perform my good word in your favour, to bring you again to this place.
text_la: Quia hæc dicit Dominus : Cum cœperint impleri in Babylone septuaginta anni, visitabo vos, et suscitabo super vos verbum meum bonum, ut reducam vos ad locum istum.
text_pt: Porque assim diz o SENHOR: Certamente que passados setenta anos em babilônia, vos visitarei, e cumprirei sobre vós a minha boa palavra, tornando a trazer-vos a este lugar.
text_el: ὅτι οὕτως εἶπεν κύριος ὅταν μέλλῃ πληροῦσθαι Βαβυλῶνι ἑβδομήκοντα ἔτη ἐπισκέψομαι ὑμᾶς καὶ ἐπιστήσω τοὺς λόγους μου ἐφ' ὑμᾶς τοῦ τὸν λαὸν ὑμῶν ἀποστρέψαι εἰς τὸν τόπον τοῦτον

text_en: For I know the thoughts that I think towards you, says the Lord , thoughts of peace, and not of affliction, to give you an end and patience.
text_la: Ego enim scio cogitationes quas ego cogito super vos, ait Dominus, cogitationes pacis et non afflictionis, ut dem vobis finem et patientiam.
text_pt: Porque eu bem sei os pensamentos que tenho a vosso respeito, diz o Senhor; pensamentos de paz, e não de mal, para vos dar o fim que esperais.
text_el: καὶ λογιοῦμαι ἐφ' ὑμᾶς λογισμὸν εἰρήνης καὶ οὐ κακὰ τοῦ δοῦναι ὑμῖν ταῦτα

text_en: And you shall call upon me, and you shall go and you shall pray to me, and I will hear you.
text_la: Et invocabitis me, et ibitis : et orabitis me, et ego exaudiam vos.
text_pt: Então me invocareis, e ireis, e orareis a mim, e eu vos ouvirei.
text_el: καὶ προσεύξασθε πρός με καὶ εἰσακούσομαι ὑμῶν

text_en: You shall seek me, and shall find me: when you shall seek me with all your heart.
text_la: Quæretis me, et invenietis, cum quæsieritis me in toto corde vestro.
text_pt: E buscar-me-eis, e me achareis, quando me buscardes com todo o vosso coração.
text_el: καὶ ἐκζητήσατέ με καὶ εὑρήσετέ με ὅτι ζητήσετέ με ἐν ὅλῃ καρδίᾳ ὑμῶν

text_en: And I will be found by you, says the Lord : and I will bring back your captivity, and I will gather you out of all nations, and from all the places to which I have driven you out, says the Lord : and I will bring you back from the place to which I caused you to be carried away captive.
text_la: Et inveniar a vobis, ait Dominus : et reducam captivitatem vestram, et congregabo vos de universis gentibus et de cunctis locis ad quæ expuli vos, dicit Dominus, et reverti vos faciam de loco ad quem transmigrare vos feci.
text_pt: E serei achado de vós, diz o Senhor, e farei voltar os vossos cativos e congregar-vos-ei de todas as nações, e de todos os lugares para onde vos lancei, diz o Senhor, e tornarei a trazer-vos ao lugar de onde vos transportei.
text_el: καὶ ἐπιφανοῦμαι ὑμῖν

text_en: Because you have said: The Lord has raised us up prophets in Babylon :
text_la: Quia dixistis : Suscitavit nobis Dominus prophetas in Babylone:
text_pt: Porque dizeis: O SENHOR nos levantou profetas em babilônia.
text_el: ὅτι εἴπατε κατέστησεν ἡμῖν κύριος προφήτας ἐν Βαβυλῶνι

text_en: For thus says the Lord to the king that sits upon the throne of David , and to all the people that dwell in this city, to your brethren that are not gone forth with you into captivity.
text_la: quia hæc dicit Dominus ad regem qui sedet super solium David, et ad omnem populum habitatorem urbis hujus, ad fratres vestros qui non sunt egressi vobiscum in transmigrationem:
text_pt: Porque assim diz o Senhor acerca do rei que se assenta no trono de Davi, e de todo o povo que habita nesta cidade, vossos irmãos, que não saíram conosco para o cativeiro.

text_en: Thus says the Lord of hosts : Behold I will send upon them the sword, and the famine, and the pestilence: and I will make them like bad figs that cannot be eaten, because they are very bad.
text_la: hæc dicit Dominus exercituum : Ecce mittam in eos gladium, et famem, et pestem : et ponam eos quasi ficus malas, quæ comedi non possunt eo quod pessimæ sint:
text_pt: Assim diz o Senhor dos Exércitos: Eis que enviarei entre eles a espada, a fome e a peste, e fá-los-ei como a figos podres que não se podem comer, de ruins que são.

text_en: And I will persecute them with the sword, and with famine, and with the pestilence: and I will give them up unto affliction to all the kingdoms of the earth: to be a curse , and an astonishment, and a hissing, and a reproach to all the nations to which I have driven them out:
text_la: et persequar eos in gladio, et in fame, et in pestilentia : et dabo eos in vexationem universis regnis terræ : in maledictionem, et in stuporem, et in sibilum, et in opprobrium cunctis gentibus ad quas ego ejeci eos,
text_pt: E persegui-los-ei com a espada, com a fome, e com a peste; e dá-los-ei para deslocarem-se por todos os reinos da terra, para serem uma maldição, e um espanto, e um assobio, e um opróbrio entre todas as nações para onde os tiver lançado.

text_en: Because they have not hearkened to my words, says the Lord : which I sent to them by my servants the prophets , rising by night, and sending: and you have not heard, says the Lord .
text_la: eo quod non audierint verba mea, dicit Dominus, quæ misit ad eos per servos meos prophetas, de nocte consurgens et mittens : et non audistis, dicit Dominus.
text_pt: Porquanto não deram ouvidos às minhas palavras, diz o Senhor, mandando-lhes eu os meus servos, os profetas, madrugando e enviando; mas vós não escutastes, diz o Senhor.

text_en: Hear therefore the word of the Lord , all you of the captivity, whom I have sent out from Jerusalem to Babylon .
text_la: Vos ergo audite verbum Domini, omnis transmigratio quam emisi de Jerusalem in Babylonem.
text_pt: Vós, pois, ouvi a palavra do SENHOR, todos os do cativeiro que enviei de Jerusalém a babilônia.

text_en: Thus says the Lord of hosts the God of Israel , to Achab the son of Colias, and to Sedecias the son of Maasias, who prophesy unto you in my name falsely : Behold I will deliver them up into the hands of Nabuchodonosor the king of Babylon : and he shall kill them before your eyes.
text_la: Hæc dicit Dominus exercituum, Deus Israël, ad Achab filium Coliæ, et ad Sedeciam filium Maasiæ, qui prophetant vobis in nomine meo mendaciter : Ecce ego tradam eos in manus Nabuchodonosor regis Babylonis, et percutiet eos in oculis vestris:
text_pt: Assim diz o SENHOR dos Exércitos, o Deus de Israel, acerca de Acabe, filho de Colaías, e de Zedequias, filho de Maaséias, que vos profetizam falsamente em meu nome: Eis que os entregarei na mão de Nabucodonosor, rei de babilônia, e ele os ferirá diante dos vossos olhos.
text_el: οὕτως εἶπεν κύριος ἐπὶ Αχιαβ καὶ ἐπὶ Σεδεκιαν ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ δίδωμι αὐτοὺς εἰς χεῖρας βασιλέως Βαβυλῶνος καὶ πατάξει αὐτοὺς κατ' ὀφθαλμοὺς ὑμῶν

text_en: And of them shall be taken up a curse by all the captivity of Juda , that are in Babylon , saying: The Lord make you like Sedecias, and like Achab , whom the king of Babylon fried in the fire:
text_la: et assumetur ex eis maledictio omni transmigrationi Juda quæ est in Babylone, dicentium : Ponat te Dominus sicut Sedeciam et sicut Achab, quos frixit rex Babylonis in igne:
text_pt: E todos os transportados de Judá, que estão em babilônia, tomarão deles uma maldição, dizendo: O SENHOR te faça como Zedequias, e como Acabe, os quais o rei de babilônia assou no fogo;
text_el: καὶ λήμψονται ἀπ' αὐτῶν κατάραν ἐν πάσῃ τῇ ἀποικίᾳ Ιουδα ἐν Βαβυλῶνι λέγοντες ποιήσαι σε κύριος ὡς Σεδεκιαν ἐποίησεν καὶ ὡς Αχιαβ οὓς ἀπετηγάνισεν βασιλεὺς Βαβυλῶνος ἐν πυρὶ

text_en: Because they have acted folly in Israel , and have committed adultery with the wives of their friends, and have spoken lying words in my name , which I commanded them not: I am the judge and the witness, says the Lord .
text_la: pro eo quod fecerint stultitiam in Israël, et mœchati sunt in uxores amicorum suorum, et locuti sunt verbum in nomine meo mendaciter, quod non mandavi eis. Ego sum judex et testis, dicit Dominus.
text_pt: Porquanto fizeram loucura em Israel, e cometeram adultério com as mulheres dos seus vizinhos, e anunciaram falsamente, em meu nome uma palavra, que não lhes mandei, e eu o sei e sou testemunha disso, diz o Senhor.
text_el: δι' ἣν ἐποίησαν ἀνομίαν ἐν Ισραηλ καὶ ἐμοιχῶντο τὰς γυναῖκας τῶν πολιτῶν αὐτῶν καὶ λόγον ἐχρημάτισαν ἐν τῷ ὀνόματί μου ὃν οὐ συνέταξα αὐτοῖς καὶ ἐγὼ μάρτυς φησὶν κύριος

text_en: And to Semeias the Nehelamite you shall say:
text_la: Et ad Semeiam Nehelamiten dices:
text_pt: E a Semaías, o neelamita, falarás, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ πρὸς Σαμαιαν τὸν Νελαμίτην ἐρεῖς

text_en: Thus says the Lord of hosts the God of Israel : Because you have sent letters in your name to all the people that are in Jerusalem , and to Sophonias the son of Maasias the priest , and to all the priests , saying:
text_la: Hæc dicit Dominus exercituum, Deus Israël : Pro eo quod misisti in nomine tuo libros ad omnem populum qui est in Jerusalem, et ad Sophoniam filium Maasiæ sacerdotem, et ad universos sacerdotes, dicens:
text_pt: Assim fala o Senhor dos Exércitos, o Deus de Israel, dizendo: Porquanto tu enviaste no teu nome cartas a todo o povo que está em Jerusalém, como também a Sofonias, filho de Maaséias, o sacerdote, e a todos os sacerdotes, dizendo:
text_el: οὐκ ἀπέστειλά σε τῷ ὀνόματί μου καὶ πρὸς Σοφονιαν υἱὸν Μαασαιου τὸν ἱερέα εἰπέ

text_en: The Lord has made you priest instead of Joiada the priest , that you should be ruler in the house of the Lord , over every man that raves and prophesies , to put him in the stocks, and into prison .
text_la: Dominus dedit te sacerdotem pro Jojade sacerdote, ut sis dux in domo Domini, super omnem virum arreptitium et prophetantem, ut mittas eum in nervum et in carcerem:
text_pt: O Senhor te pôs por sacerdote em lugar de Joiada, o sacerdote, para que sejas encarregado da casa do Senhor sobre todo o homem fanático, e que profetiza, para o lançares na prisão e no tronco.
text_el: κύριος ἔδωκέν σε εἰς ἱερέα ἀντὶ Ιωδαε τοῦ ἱερέως γενέσθαι ἐπιστάτην ἐν τῷ οἴκῳ κυρίου παντὶ ἀνθρώπῳ προφητεύοντι καὶ παντὶ ἀνθρώπῳ μαινομένῳ καὶ δώσεις αὐτὸν εἰς τὸ ἀπόκλεισμα καὶ εἰς τὸν καταρράκτην

text_en: And now why have you not rebuked Jeremiah the Anathothite , who prophesies to you?
text_la: et nunc quare non increpasti Jeremiam Anathothiten, qui prophetat vobis?
text_pt: Agora, pois, por que não repreendeste a Jeremias, o anatotita, que vos profetiza?
text_el: καὶ νῦν διὰ τί συνελοιδορήσατε Ιερεμιαν τὸν ἐξ Αναθωθ τὸν προφητεύσαντα ὑμῖν

text_en: For he has also sent to us in Babylon , saying: It is a long time: build houses, and dwell in them: and plant gardens, and eat the fruits of them.
text_la: Quia super hoc misit in Babylonem ad nos, dicens : Longum est : ædificate domos, et habitate : et plantate hortos, et comedite fructus eorum.
text_pt: Porque até nos mandou dizer em babilônia: Ainda o cativeiro muito há de durar; edificai casas, e habitai nelas; e plantai pomares, e comei o seu fruto.
text_el: οὐ διὰ τοῦτο ἀπέστειλεν πρὸς ὑμᾶς εἰς Βαβυλῶνα λέγων μακράν ἐστιν οἰκοδομήσατε οἰκίας καὶ κατοικήσατε καὶ φυτεύσατε κήπους καὶ φάγεσθε τὸν καρπὸν αὐτῶν

text_en: So Sophonias the priest read this letter , in the hearing of Jeremiah the prophet .
text_la: Legit ergo Sophonias sacerdos librum istum in auribus Jeremiæ prophetæ.
text_pt: E leu Sofonias, o sacerdote, esta carta aos ouvidos de Jeremias, o profeta.
text_el: καὶ ἀνέγνω Σοφονιας τὸ βιβλίον εἰς τὰ ὦτα Ιερεμιου

text_en: And the word of the Lord came to Jeremias, saying:
text_la: Et factum est verbum Domini ad Jeremiam, dicens:
text_pt: E veio a palavra do Senhor a Jeremias, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο λόγος κυρίου πρὸς Ιερεμιαν λέγων

text_en: Send to all them of the captivity, saying: Thus says the Lord to Semeias the Nehelamite: Because Semeias has prophesied to you, and I sent him not: and has caused you to trust in a lie:
text_la: Mitte ad omnem transmigrationem, dicens : Hæc dicit Dominus ad Semeiam Nehelamiten : Pro eo quod prophetavit vobis Semeias, et ego non misi eum, et fecit vos confidere in mendacio,
text_pt: Manda a todos os do cativeiro, dizendo: Assim diz o Senhor acerca de Semaías, o neelamita: Porquanto Semaías vos profetizou, e eu não o enviei, e vos fez confiar em mentiras,
text_el: ἀπόστειλον πρὸς τὴν ἀποικίαν λέγων οὕτως εἶπεν κύριος ἐπὶ Σαμαιαν τὸν Νελαμίτην ἐπειδὴ ἐπροφήτευσεν ὑμῖν Σαμαιας καὶ ἐγὼ οὐκ ἀπέστειλα αὐτόν καὶ πεποιθέναι ἐποίησεν ὑμᾶς ἐπ' ἀδίκοις

text_en: Therefore thus says the Lord : behold I will visit upon Semeias the Nehelamite, and upon his seed: he shall not have a man to sit in the midst of this people, and he shall not see the good that I will do to my people, says the Lord : because he has spoken treason against the Lord .
text_la: idcirco hæc dicit Dominus : Ecce ego visitabo super Semeiam Nehelamiten, et super semen ejus : non erit ei vir sedens in medio populi hujus, et non videbit bonum quod ego faciam populo meo, ait Dominus, quia prævaricationem locutus est adversus Dominum.
text_pt: Portanto assim diz o Senhor: Eis que castigarei a Semaías, o neelamita, e a sua descendência; ele não terá ninguém que habite entre este povo, e não verá o bem que hei de fazer ao meu povo, diz o Senhor, porque falou em rebeldia contra o Senhor.
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο οὕτως εἶπεν κύριος ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ ἐπισκέψομαι ἐπὶ Σαμαιαν καὶ ἐπὶ τὸ γένος αὐτοῦ καὶ οὐκ ἔσται αὐτῶν ἄνθρωπος ἐν μέσῳ ὑμῶν τοῦ ἰδεῖν τὰ ἀγαθά ἃ ἐγὼ ποιήσω ὑμῖν οὐκ ὄψονται

text_en: This is the word that came to Jeremias from the Lord , saying:
text_la: Hoc verbum quod factum est ad Jeremiam a Domino, dicens:
text_pt: A palavra que do SENHOR veio a Jeremias, dizendo:
text_el: ὁ λόγος ὁ γενόμενος πρὸς Ιερεμιαν παρὰ κυρίου εἰπεῖν

text_en: Thus says the Lord , the God of Israel , saying: Write you all the words that I have spoken to you, in a book.
text_la: Hæc dicit Dominus Deus Israël, dicens : Scribe tibi omnia verba quæ locutus sum ad te, in libro.
text_pt: Assim diz o Senhor Deus de Israel: Escreve num livro todas as palavras que te tenho falado.
text_el: οὕτως εἶπεν κύριος ὁ θεὸς Ισραηλ λέγων γράψον πάντας τοὺς λόγους οὓς ἐχρημάτισα πρὸς σέ ἐπὶ βιβλίου

text_en: For behold the days come, says the Lord , and I will bring again the captivity of my people Israel and Juda , says the Lord : and I will cause them to return to the land which I gave to their fathers, and they shall possess it.
text_la: Ecce enim dies veniunt, dicit Dominus, et convertam conversionem populi mei Israël et Juda, ait Dominus : et convertam eos ad terram quam dedi patribus eorum, et possidebunt eam.
text_pt: Porque eis que vêm dias, diz o Senhor, em que farei voltar do cativeiro o meu povo Israel, e de Judá, diz o Senhor; e tornarei a trazê-los à terra que dei a seus pais, e a possuirão.
text_el: ὅτι ἰδοὺ ἡμέραι ἔρχονται φησὶν κύριος καὶ ἀποστρέψω τὴν ἀποικίαν λαοῦ μου Ισραηλ καὶ Ιουδα εἶπεν κύριος καὶ ἀποστρέψω αὐτοὺς εἰς τὴν γῆν ἣν ἔδωκα τοῖς πατράσιν αὐτῶν καὶ κυριεύσουσιν αὐτῆς

text_en: And these are the words that the Lord has spoken to Israel and to Juda :
text_la: Et hæc verba quæ locutus est Dominus ad Israël et ad Judam:
text_pt: E estas são as palavras que disse o Senhor, acerca de Israel e de Judá.
text_el: καὶ οὗτοι οἱ λόγοι οὓς ἐλάλησεν κύριος ἐπὶ Ισραηλ καὶ Ιουδα

text_en: For thus says the Lord : We have heard a voice of terror: there is fear and no peace.
text_la: Quoniam hæc dicit Dominus : Vocem terroris audivimus : formido, et non est pax.
text_pt: Porque assim diz o Senhor: Ouvimos uma voz de tremor, de temor mas não de paz.
text_el: οὕτως εἶπεν κύριος φωνὴν φόβου ἀκούσεσθε φόβος καὶ οὐκ ἔστιν εἰρήνη

text_en: Ask and see if a man bear children? Why then have I seen every man with his hands on his loins, like a woman in labour, and all faces are turned yellow?
text_la: Interrogate, et videte si generat masculus : quare ergo vidi omnis viri manum super lumbum suum, quasi parturientis, et conversæ sunt universæ facies in auruginem?
text_pt: Perguntai, pois, e vede, se um homem pode dar à luz. Por que, pois, vejo a cada homem com as mãos sobre os lombos como a que está dando à luz? e por que se tornaram pálidos todos os rostos?
text_el: ἐρωτήσατε καὶ ἴδετε εἰ ἔτεκεν ἄρσεν καὶ περὶ φόβου ἐν ᾧ καθέξουσιν ὀσφὺν καὶ σωτηρίαν διότι ἑώρακα πάντα ἄνθρωπον καὶ αἱ χεῖρες αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ τῆς ὀσφύος αὐτοῦ ἐστράφησαν πρόσωπα εἰς ἴκτερον

text_en: Alas, for that day is great, neither is there the like to it; and it is the time of tribulation to Jacob , but he shall be saved out of it.
text_la: Væ! quia magna dies illa, nec est similis ejus : tempusque tribulationis est Jacob, et ex ipso salvabitur.
text_pt: Ah! porque aquele dia é tão grande, que não houve outro semelhante; e é tempo de angústia para Jacó; ele, porém, será salvo dela.
text_el: ἐγενήθη ὅτι μεγάλη ἡ ἡμέρα ἐκείνη καὶ οὐκ ἔστιν τοιαύτη καὶ χρόνος στενός ἐστιν τῷ Ιακωβ καὶ ἀπὸ τούτου σωθήσεται

text_en: And it shall come to pass in that day, says the Lord of hosts , that I will break his yoke from off your neck, and will burst his bands: and strangers shall no more rule over him:
text_la: Et erit in die illa, ait Dominus exercituum : conteram jugum ejus de collo tuo, et vincula ejus dirumpam, et non dominabuntur ei amplius alieni :
text_pt: Porque será naquele dia, diz o Senhor dos Exércitos, que eu quebrarei o seu jugo de sobre o teu pescoço, e quebrarei os teus grilhões; e nunca mais se servirão dele os estrangeiros.
text_el: ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐκείνῃ εἶπεν κύριος συντρίψω τὸν ζυγὸν ἀπὸ τοῦ τραχήλου αὐτῶν καὶ τοὺς δεσμοὺς αὐτῶν διαρρήξω καὶ οὐκ ἐργῶνται αὐτοὶ ἔτι ἀλλοτρίοις

text_en: But they shall serve the Lord their God , and David their king , whom I will raise up to them.
text_la: sed servient Domino Deo suo, et David regi suo, quem suscitabo eis.
text_pt: Mas servirão ao Senhor, seu Deus, como também a Davi, seu rei, que lhes levantarei.
text_el: καὶ ἐργῶνται τῷ κυρίῳ θεῷ αὐτῶν καὶ τὸν Δαυιδ βασιλέα αὐτῶν ἀναστήσω αὐτοῖς

text_en: Therefore fear not, my servant Jacob , says the Lord , neither be dismayed, O Israel : for behold, I will save you from a country afar off, and your seed from the land of their captivity: and Jacob shall return, and be at rest, and abound with all good things, and there shall be none whom he may fear:
text_la: Tu ergo ne timeas, serve meus Jacob, ait Dominus, neque paveas, Israël : quia ecce ego salvabo te de terra longinqua, et semen tuum de terra captivitatis eorum : et revertetur Jacob, et quiescet, et cunctis affluet bonis, et non erit quem formidet :
text_pt: Não temas, pois, tu, ó meu servo Jacó, diz o Senhor, nem te espantes, ó Israel; porque eis que te livrarei de terras de longe, e à tua descendência da terra do seu cativeiro; e Jacó voltará, e descansará, e ficará em sossego, e não haverá quem o atemorize.

text_en: For I am with you, says the Lord , to save you: for I will utterly consume all the nations, among which I have scattered you: but I will not utterly consume you: but I will chastise you in judgment, that you may not seem to yourself innocent.
text_la: quoniam tecum ego sum, ait Dominus, ut salvem te. Faciam enim consummationem in cunctis gentibus in quibus dispersi te : te autem non faciam in consummationem : sed castigabo te in judicio, ut non videaris tibi innoxius.
text_pt: Porque eu sou contigo, diz o Senhor, para te salvar; porquanto darei fim a todas as nações entre as quais te espalhei; a ti, porém, não darei fim, mas castigar-te-ei com medida, e de todo não te terei por inocente.

text_en: For thus says the Lord : Your bruise is incurable, your wound is very grievous.
text_la: Quia hæc dicit Dominus : Insanabilis fractura tua; pessima plaga tua :
text_pt: Porque assim diz o Senhor: A tua ferida é incurável; a tua chaga é dolorosa.
text_el: οὕτως εἶπεν κύριος ἀνέστησα σύντριμμα ἀλγηρὰ ἡ πληγή σου

text_en: There is none to judge your judgment to bind it up: you have no healing medicines.
text_la: non est qui judicet judicium tuum ad alligandum : curationum utilitas non est tibi.
text_pt: Não há quem defenda a tua causa para te aplicar curativo; não tens remédios que possam curar.
text_el: οὐκ ἔστιν κρίνων κρίσιν σου εἰς ἀλγηρὸν ἰατρεύθης ὠφέλεια οὐκ ἔστιν σοι

text_en: All your lovers have forgotten you, and will not seek after you: for I have wounded you with the wound of an enemy, with cruel chastisement: by reason of the multitude of your iniquities , your sins are hardened.
text_la: Omnes amatores tui obliti sunt tui, teque non quærent : plaga enim inimici percussi te castigatione crudeli : propter multitudinem iniquitatis tuæ dura facta sunt peccata tua.
text_pt: Todos os teus amantes se esqueceram de ti, e não perguntam por ti; porque te feri com ferida de inimigo, e com castigo de quem é cruel, pela grandeza da tua maldade e multidão de teus pecados.
text_el: πάντες οἱ φίλοι σου ἐπελάθοντό σου οὐ μὴ ἐπερωτήσουσιν ὅτι πληγὴν ἐχθροῦ ἔπαισά σε παιδείαν στερεάν ἐπὶ πᾶσαν ἀδικίαν σου ἐπλήθυναν αἱ ἁμαρτίαι σου

text_en: Why do you cry for your affliction? Your sorrow is incurable: for the multitude of your iniquity , and for your hardened sins I have done these things to you.
text_la: Quid clamas super contritione tua? insanabilis est dolor tuus : propter multitudinem iniquitatis tuæ, et propter dura peccata tua, feci hæc tibi.
text_pt: Por que gritas por causa da tua ferida? Tua dor é incurável. Pela grandeza de tua maldade, e multidão de teus pecados, eu fiz estas coisas.

text_en: Therefore all they that devour you, shall be devoured: and all your enemies shall be carried into captivity: and they that waste you shall be wasted, and all that prey upon you will I give for a prey.
text_la: Propterea omnes qui comedunt te devorabuntur, et universi hostes tui in captivitatem ducentur : et qui te vastant vastabuntur, cunctosque prædatores tuos dabo in prædam.
text_pt: Por isso todos os que te devoram serão devorados; e todos os teus adversários irão, todos eles, para o cativeiro; e os que te roubam serão roubados, e a todos os que te despojam entregarei ao saque.
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο πάντες οἱ ἔσθοντές σε βρωθήσονται καὶ πάντες οἱ ἐχθροί σου κρέας αὐτῶν πᾶν ἔδονται ἐπὶ πλῆθος ἀδικιῶν σου ἐπληθύνθησαν αἱ ἁμαρτίαι σου ἐποίησαν ταῦτά σοι καὶ ἔσονται οἱ διαφοροῦντές σε εἰς διαφόρημα καὶ πάντας τοὺς προνομεύοντάς σε δώσω εἰς προνομήν

text_en: For I will close up your scar, and will heal you of your wounds, says the Lord . Because they have called you, O Sion, an outcast: This is she that has none to seek after her.
text_la: Obducam enim cicatricem tibi, et a vulneribus tuis sanabo te, dicit Dominus. Quia ejectam vocaverunt te, Sion : hæc est, quæ non habebat requirentem.
text_pt: Porque te restaurarei a saúde, e te curarei as tuas chagas, diz o Senhor; porquanto te chamaram a repudiada, dizendo: É Sião, já ninguém pergunta por ela.
text_el: ὅτι ἀνάξω τὸ ἴαμά σου ἀπὸ πληγῆς ὀδυνηρᾶς ἰατρεύσω σε φησὶν κύριος ὅτι ἐσπαρμένη ἐκλήθης θήρευμα ὑμῶν ἐστιν ὅτι ζητῶν οὐκ ἔστιν αὐτήν

text_en: Thus says the Lord : Behold I will bring back the captivity of the pavilions of Jacob , and will have pity on his houses, and the city shall be built in her high place, and the temple shall be founded according to the order thereof.
text_la: Hæc dicit Dominus : Ecce ego convertam conversionem tabernaculorum Jacob, et tectis ejus miserebor : et ædificabitur civitas in excelso suo, et templum juxta ordinem suum fundabitur :
text_pt: Assim diz o Senhor: Eis que farei voltar do cativeiro as tendas de Jacó, e apiedar-me-ei das suas moradas; e a cidade será reedificada sobre o seu montão, e o palácio permanecerá como habitualmente.
text_el: οὕτως εἶπεν κύριος ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ ἀποστρέψω τὴν ἀποικίαν Ιακωβ καὶ αἰχμαλωσίαν αὐτοῦ ἐλεήσω καὶ οἰκοδομηθήσεται πόλις ἐπὶ τὸ ὕψος αὐτῆς καὶ ὁ ναὸς κατὰ τὸ κρίμα αὐτοῦ καθεδεῖται

text_en: And out of them shall come forth praise, and the voice of them that play: and I will multiply them, and they shall not be made few: and I will glorify them, and they shall not be lessened.
text_la: et egredietur de eis laus, voxque ludentium. Et multiplicabo eos, et non minuentur : et glorificabo eos, et non attenuabuntur.
text_pt: E sairá deles o louvor e a voz de júbilo; e multiplicá-los-ei, e não serão diminuídos, e glorificá-los-ei, e não serão apoucados.
text_el: καὶ ἐξελεύσονται ἀπ' αὐτῶν ᾄδοντες καὶ φωνὴ παιζόντων καὶ πλεονάσω αὐτούς καὶ οὐ μὴ ἐλαττωθῶσιν

text_en: And their children shall be as from the beginning, and their assembly shall be permanent before me: and I will visit against all that afflict them.
text_la: Et erunt filii ejus sicut a principio, et cœtus ejus coram me permanebit, et visitabo adversum omnes qui tribulant eum.
text_pt: E seus filhos serão como na antiguidade, e a sua congregação será confirmada diante de mim; e castigarei todos os seus opressores.
text_el: καὶ εἰσελεύσονται οἱ υἱοὶ αὐτῶν ὡς τὸ πρότερον καὶ τὰ μαρτύρια αὐτῶν κατὰ πρόσωπόν μου ὀρθωθήσεται καὶ ἐπισκέψομαι τοὺς θλίβοντας αὐτούς

text_en: And their leader shall be of themselves: and their prince shall come forth from the midst of them: and I will bring him near, and he shall come to me: for who is this that sets his heart to approach to me, says the Lord ?
text_la: Et erit dux ejus ex eo, et princeps de medio ejus producetur : et applicabo eum, et accedet ad me. Quis enim iste est qui applicet cor suum ut appropinquet mihi? ait Dominus :
text_pt: E os seus nobres serão deles; e o seu governador sairá do meio deles, e o farei aproximar, e ele se chegará a mim; pois, quem de si mesmo se empenharia para chegar-se a mim? diz o Senhor.
text_el: καὶ ἔσονται ἰσχυρότεροι αὐτοῦ ἐπ' αὐτούς καὶ ὁ ἄρχων αὐτοῦ ἐξ αὐτοῦ ἐξελεύσεται καὶ συνάξω αὐτούς καὶ ἀποστρέψουσιν πρός με ὅτι τίς ἐστιν οὗτος ὃς ἔδωκεν τὴν καρδίαν αὐτοῦ ἀποστρέψαι πρός με φησὶν κύριος

text_en: And you shall be my people: and I will be your God .
text_la: et eritis mihi in populum, et ego ero vobis in Deum.
text_pt: E ser-me-eis por povo, e eu vos serei por Deus.

text_en: Behold the whirlwind of the Lord , his fury going forth, a violent storm, it shall rest upon the head of the wicked .
text_la: Ecce turbo Domini, furor egrediens, procella ruens : in capite impiorum conquiescet.
text_pt: Eis que a tempestade do Senhor, a sua indignação, já saiu; uma tempestade varredora, cairá cruelmente sobre a cabeça dos ímpios.
text_el: ὅτι ὀργὴ κυρίου ἐξῆλθεν θυμώδης ἐξῆλθεν ὀργὴ στρεφομένη ἐπ' ἀσεβεῖς ἥξει

text_en: The Lord will not turn away the wrath of his indignation, till he have executed and performed the thought of his heart: in the latter days you shall understand these things.
text_la: Non avertet iram indignationis Dominus, donec faciat et compleat cogitationem cordis sui : in novissimo dierum intelligetis ea.
text_pt: Não voltará atrás o furor da ira do Senhor, até que tenha executado e até que tenha cumprido os desígnios do seu coração; no fim dos dias entendereis isto.
text_el: οὐ μὴ ἀποστραφῇ ὀργὴ θυμοῦ κυρίου ἕως ποιήσῃ καὶ ἕως καταστήσῃ ἐγχείρημα καρδίας αὐτοῦ ἐπ' ἐσχάτων τῶν ἡμερῶν γνώσεσθε αὐτά

text_en: At that time, says the Lord , I will be the God of all the families of Israel , and they shall be my people.
text_la: In tempore illo, dicit Dominus, ero Deus universis cognationibus Israël, et ipsi erunt mihi in populum.
text_pt: Naquele tempo, diz o SENHOR, serei o Deus de todas as famílias de Israel, e elas serão o meu povo.
text_el: ἐν τῷ χρόνῳ ἐκείνῳ εἶπεν κύριος ἔσομαι εἰς θεὸν τῷ γένει Ισραηλ καὶ αὐτοὶ ἔσονταί μοι εἰς λαόν

text_en: Thus says the Lord : The people that were left and escaped from the sword, found grace in the desert : Israel shall go to his rest.
text_la: Hæc dicit Dominus : Invenit gratiam in deserto populus qui remanserat a gladio : vadet ad requiem suam Israël.
text_pt: Assim diz o Senhor: O povo dos que escaparam da espada achou graça no deserto. Israel mesmo, quando eu o fizer descansar.
text_el: οὕτως εἶπεν κύριος εὗρον θερμὸν ἐν ἐρήμῳ μετὰ ὀλωλότων ἐν μαχαίρᾳ βαδίσατε καὶ μὴ ὀλέσητε τὸν Ισραηλ

text_en: The Lord has appeared from afar to me. Yea I have loved you with an everlasting love , therefore have I drawn you, taking pity on you.
text_la: Longe Dominus apparuit mihi. Et in caritate perpetua dilexi te : ideo attraxi te, miserans.
text_pt: Há muito que o Senhor me apareceu, dizendo: Porquanto com amor eterno te amei, por isso com benignidade te atraí.
text_el: κύριος πόρρωθεν ὤφθη αὐτῷ ἀγάπησιν αἰωνίαν ἠγάπησά σε διὰ τοῦτο εἵλκυσά σε εἰς οἰκτίρημα

text_en: And I will build you again, and you shall be built, O virgin of Israel : you shall again be adorned with your timbrels, and shall go forth in the dances of them that make merry.
text_la: Rursumque ædificabo te, et ædificaberis, virgo Israël : adhuc ornaberis tympanis tuis, et egredieris in choro ludentium.
text_pt: Ainda te edificarei, e serás edificada, ó virgem de Israel! Ainda serás adornada com os teus tamboris, e sairás nas danças dos que se alegram.
text_el: ἔτι οἰκοδομήσω σε καὶ οἰκοδομηθήσῃ παρθένος Ισραηλ ἔτι λήμψῃ τύμπανόν σου καὶ ἐξελεύσῃ μετὰ συναγωγῆς παιζόντων

text_en: You shall yet plant vineyards in the mountains of Samaria : the planters shall plant, and they shall not gather the vintage before the time.
text_la: Adhuc plantabis vineas in montibus Samariæ : plantabunt plantantes, et donec tempus veniat, non vindemiabunt.
text_pt: Ainda plantarás vinhas nos montes de Samaria; os plantadores as plantarão e comerão como coisas comuns.
text_el: ἔτι φυτεύσατε ἀμπελῶνας ἐν ὄρεσιν Σαμαρείας φυτεύσατε καὶ αἰνέσατε

text_en: For there shall be a day, in which the watchmen on mount Ephraim, shall cry: Arise, and let us go up to Sion to the Lord our God .
text_la: Quia erit dies in qua clamabunt custodes in monte Ephraim : Surgite, et ascendamus in Sion ad Dominum Deum nostrum.
text_pt: Porque haverá um dia em que gritarão os vigias sobre o monte de Efraim: Levantai-vos, e subamos a Sião, ao Senhor nosso Deus.
text_el: ὅτι ἔστιν ἡμέρα κλήσεως ἀπολογουμένων ἐν ὄρεσιν Εφραιμ ἀνάστητε καὶ ἀνάβητε εἰς Σιων πρὸς κύριον τὸν θεὸν ἡμῶν

text_en: For thus says the Lord : Rejoice in the joy of Jacob , and neigh before the head of the Gentiles : shout, and sing, and say: Save, O Lord , your people, the remnant of Israel .
text_la: Quia hæc dicit Dominus : Exsultate in lætitia, Jacob, et hinnite contra caput gentium : personate, et canite, et dicite : Salva, Domine, populum tuum, reliquias Israël.
text_pt: Porque assim diz o Senhor: Cantai sobre Jacó com alegria, e exultai por causa do chefe das nações; proclamai, cantai louvores, e dizei: Salva, Senhor, ao teu povo, o restante de Israel.
text_el: ὅτι οὕτως εἶπεν κύριος τῷ Ιακωβ εὐφράνθητε καὶ χρεμετίσατε ἐπὶ κεφαλὴν ἐθνῶν ἀκουστὰ ποιήσατε καὶ αἰνέσατε εἴπατε ἔσωσεν κύριος τὸν λαὸν αὐτοῦ τὸ κατάλοιπον τοῦ Ισραηλ

text_en: Behold I will bring them from the north country, and will gather them from the ends of the earth and among them shall be the blind, and the lame, the woman with child, and she that is bringing forth, together, a great company of them returning hither.
text_la: Ecce ego adducam eos de terra aquilonis, et congregabo eos ab extremis terræ : inter quos erunt cæcus et claudus, prægnans et pariens simul, cœtus magnus revertentium huc.
text_pt: Eis que os trarei da terra do norte, e os congregarei das extremidades da terra; entre os quais haverá cegos e aleijados, grávidas e as de parto juntamente; em grande congregação voltarão para aqui.
text_el: ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ ἄγω αὐτοὺς ἀπὸ βορρᾶ καὶ συνάξω αὐτοὺς ἀπ' ἐσχάτου τῆς γῆς ἐν ἑορτῇ φασεκ καὶ τεκνοποιήσῃ ὄχλον πολύν καὶ ἀποστρέψουσιν ὧδε

text_en: They shall come with weeping: and I will bring them back in mercy: and I will bring them through the torrents of waters in a right way, and they shall not stumble in it: for I am a father to Israel , and Ephraim is my firstborn .
text_la: In fletu venient, et in misericordia reducam eos : et adducam eos per torrentes aquarum in via recta, et non impingent in ea, quia factus sum Israëli pater, et Ephraim primogenitus meus est.
text_pt: Virão com choro, e com súplicas os levarei; guiá-los-ei aos ribeiros de águas, por caminho direito, no qual não tropeçarão, porque sou um pai para Israel, e Efraim é o meu primogênito.
text_el: ἐν κλαυθμῷ ἐξῆλθον καὶ ἐν παρακλήσει ἀνάξω αὐτοὺς αὐλίζων ἐπὶ διώρυγας ὑδάτων ἐν ὁδῷ ὀρθῇ καὶ οὐ μὴ πλανηθῶσιν ἐν αὐτῇ ὅτι ἐγενόμην τῷ Ισραηλ εἰς πατέρα καὶ Εφραιμ πρωτότοκός μού ἐστιν

text_en: Hear the word of the Lord , O you nations, and declare it in the islands that are afar off, and say: He that scattered Israel will gather him: and he will keep him as the shepherd does his flock.
text_la: Audite verbum Domini, gentes, et annuntiate in insulis quæ procul sunt, et dicite : Qui dispersit Israël congregabit eum, et custodiet eum sicut pastor gregem suum.
text_pt: Ouvi a palavra do Senhor, ó nações, e anunciai-a nas ilhas longínquas, e dizei: Aquele que espalhou a Israel o congregará e o guardará, como o pastor ao seu rebanho.
text_el: ἀκούσατε λόγον κυρίου ἔθνη καὶ ἀναγγείλατε εἰς νήσους τὰς μακρότερον εἴπατε ὁ λικμήσας τὸν Ισραηλ συνάξει αὐτὸν καὶ φυλάξει αὐτὸν ὡς ὁ βόσκων τὸ ποίμνιον αὐτοῦ

text_en: For the Lord has redeemed Jacob , and delivered him out of the hand of one that was mightier than he.
text_la: Redemit enim Dominus Jacob, et liberavit eum de manu potentioris.
text_pt: Porque o Senhor resgatou a Jacó, e o livrou da mão do que era mais forte do que ele.
text_el: ὅτι ἐλυτρώσατο κύριος τὸν Ιακωβ ἐξείλατο αὐτὸν ἐκ χειρὸς στερεωτέρων αὐτοῦ

text_en: And they shall come, and shall give praise in mount Sion: and they shall flow together to the good things of the Lord , for the corn, and wine, and oil, and the increase of cattle and herds, and their soul shall be as a watered garden, and they shall be hungry no more.
text_la: Et venient, et laudabunt in monte Sion : et confluent ad bona Domini, super frumento, et vino, et oleo, et fœtu pecorum et armentorum : eritque anima eorum quasi hortus irriguus, et ultra non esurient.
text_pt: Assim que virão, e exultarão no alto de Sião, e correrão aos bens do Senhor, ao trigo, e ao mosto, e ao azeite, e aos cordeiros e bezerros; e a sua alma será como um jardim regado, e nunca mais andarão tristes.
text_el: καὶ ἥξουσιν καὶ εὐφρανθήσονται ἐν τῷ ὄρει Σιων καὶ ἥξουσιν ἐπ' ἀγαθὰ κυρίου ἐπὶ γῆν σίτου καὶ οἴνου καὶ καρπῶν καὶ κτηνῶν καὶ προβάτων καὶ ἔσται ἡ ψυχὴ αὐτῶν ὥσπερ ξύλον ἔγκαρπον καὶ οὐ πεινάσουσιν ἔτι

text_en: Then shall the virgin rejoice in the dance , the young men and old men together: and I will turn their mourning into joy , and will comfort them, and make them joyful after their sorrow.
text_la: Tunc lætabitur virgo in choro, juvenes et senes simul : et convertam luctum eorum in gaudium, et consolabor eos, et lætificabo a dolore suo.
text_pt: Então a virgem se alegrará na dança, como também os jovens e os velhos juntamente; e tornarei o seu pranto em alegria, e os consolarei, e lhes darei alegria em lugar de tristeza.
text_el: τότε χαρήσονται παρθένοι ἐν συναγωγῇ νεανίσκων καὶ πρεσβῦται χαρήσονται καὶ στρέψω τὸ πένθος αὐτῶν εἰς χαρμονὴν καὶ ποιήσω αὐτοὺς εὐφραινομένους

text_en: And I will fill the soul of the priests with fatness: and my people shall be filled with my good things, says the Lord .
text_la: Et inebriabo animam sacerdotum pinguedine, et populus meus bonis meis adimplebitur, ait Dominus.
text_pt: E saciarei a alma dos sacerdotes com gordura, e o meu povo se fartará dos meus bens, diz o Senhor.
text_el: μεγαλυνῶ καὶ μεθύσω τὴν ψυχὴν τῶν ἱερέων υἱῶν Λευι καὶ ὁ λαός μου τῶν ἀγαθῶν μου ἐμπλησθήσεται

text_en: Thus says the Lord : A voice was heard on high of lamentation, of mourning, and weeping, of Rachel weeping for her children and refusing to be comforted for them, because they are not.
text_la: Hæc dicit Dominus : Vox in excelso audita est lamentationis : luctus, et fletus Rachel plorantis filios suos, et nolentis consolari super eis, quia non sunt.
text_pt: Assim diz o Senhor: Uma voz se ouviu em Ramá, lamentação, choro amargo; Raquel chora seus filhos; não quer ser consolada quanto a seus filhos, porque já não existem.
text_el: οὕτως εἶπεν κύριος φωνὴ ἐν Ραμα ἠκούσθη θρήνου καὶ κλαυθμοῦ καὶ ὀδυρμοῦ Ραχηλ ἀποκλαιομένη οὐκ ἤθελεν παύσασθαι ἐπὶ τοῖς υἱοῖς αὐτῆς ὅτι οὐκ εἰσίν

text_en: Thus says the Lord : Let your voice cease from weeping, and your eyes tears: for there is a reward for your work, says the Lord : and they shall return out of the land of the enemy.
text_la: Hæc dicit Dominus : Quiescat vox tua a ploratu, et oculi tui a lacrimis, quia est merces operi tuo, ait Dominus, et revertentur de terra inimici :
text_pt: Assim diz o Senhor: Reprime a tua voz de choro, e as lágrimas de teus olhos; porque há galardão para o teu trabalho, diz o Senhor, pois eles voltarão da terra do inimigo.
text_el: οὕτως εἶπεν κύριος διαλιπέτω ἡ φωνή σου ἀπὸ κλαυθμοῦ καὶ οἱ ὀφθαλμοί σου ἀπὸ δακρύων σου ὅτι ἔστιν μισθὸς τοῖς σοῖς ἔργοις καὶ ἐπιστρέψουσιν ἐκ γῆς ἐχθρῶν

text_en: And there is hope for your last end, says the Lord : and the children shall return to their own borders.
text_la: et est spes novissimis tuis, ait Dominus, et revertentur filii ad terminos suos.
text_pt: E há esperança quanto ao teu futuro, diz o Senhor, porque teus filhos voltarão para os seus termos.
text_el: μόνιμον τοῖς σοῖς τέκνοις

text_en: Hearing I heard Ephraim when he went into captivity: you have chastised me, and I was instructed, as a young bullock unaccustomed to the yoke. Convert me, and I shall be converted , for you are the Lord my God .
text_la: Audiens audivi Ephraim transmigrantem : Castigasti me, et eruditus sum, quasi juvenculus indomitus : converte me, et convertar, quia tu Dominus Deus meus.
text_pt: Bem ouvi eu que Efraim se queixava, dizendo: Castigaste-me e fui castigado, como novilho ainda não domado; converte-me, e converter-me-ei, porque tu és o Senhor meu Deus.
text_el: ἀκοὴν ἤκουσα Εφραιμ ὀδυρομένου ἐπαίδευσάς με καὶ ἐπαιδεύθην ἐγώ ὥσπερ μόσχος οὐκ ἐδιδάχθην ἐπίστρεψόν με καὶ ἐπιστρέψω ὅτι σὺ κύριος ὁ θεός μου

text_en: For after you converted me, I did penance : and after you showed unto me, I struck my thigh: I am confounded and ashamed, because I have borne the reproach of my youth.
text_la: Postquam enim convertisti me, egi pœnitentiam : et postquam ostendisti mihi, percussi femur meum. Confusus sum, et erubui, quoniam sustinui opprobrium adolescentiæ meæ.
text_pt: Na verdade que, depois que me converti, tive arrependimento; e depois que fui instruído, bati na minha coxa; fiquei confuso, e também me envergonhei; porque suportei o opróbrio da minha mocidade.
text_el: ὅτι ὕστερον αἰχμαλωσίας μου μετενόησα καὶ ὕστερον τοῦ γνῶναί με ἐστέναξα ἐφ' ἡμέρας αἰσχύνης καὶ ὑπέδειξά σοι ὅτι ἔλαβον ὀνειδισμὸν ἐκ νεότητός μου

text_en: Surely Ephraim is an honourable son to me, surely he is a tender child: for since I spoke of him, I will still remember him. Therefore are my bowels troubled for him: pitying I will pity him, says the Lord .
text_la: Si filius honorabilis mihi Ephraim, si puer delicatus! quia ex quo locutus sum de eo, adhuc recordabor ejus. Idcirco conturbata sunt viscera mea super eum : miserans miserebor ejus, ait Dominus.
text_pt: Não é Efraim para mim um filho precioso, criança das minhas delícias? Porque depois que falo contra ele, ainda me lembro dele solicitamente; por isso se comovem por ele as minhas entranhas; deveras me compadecerei dele, diz o Senhor.
text_el: υἱὸς ἀγαπητὸς Εφραιμ ἐμοί παιδίον ἐντρυφῶν ὅτι ἀνθ' ὧν οἱ λόγοι μου ἐν αὐτῷ μνείᾳ μνησθήσομαι αὐτοῦ διὰ τοῦτο ἔσπευσα ἐπ' αὐτῷ ἐλεῶν ἐλεήσω αὐτόν φησὶν κύριος

text_en: Set you up a watchtower, make to you bitterness: direct your heart into the right way, wherein you have walked: return, O virgin of Israel , return to these your cities.
text_la: Statue tibi speculam; pone tibi amaritudines; dirige cor tuum in viam rectam in qua ambulasti : revertere, virgo Israël, revertere ad civitates tuas istas.
text_pt: Levanta para ti sinais, faze para ti altos marcos, aplica o teu coração à vereda, ao caminho por onde andaste; volta, pois, ó virgem de Israel, regressa a estas tuas cidades.
text_el: στῆσον σεαυτήν Σιων ποίησον τιμωρίαν δὸς καρδίαν σου εἰς τοὺς ὤμους ὁδὸν ἣν ἐπορεύθης ἀποστράφητι παρθένος Ισραηλ ἀποστράφητι εἰς τὰς πόλεις σου πενθοῦσα

text_en: How long will you be dissolute in deliciousness, O wandering daughter? For the Lord has created a new thing upon the earth: A WOMAN SHALL COMPASS A MAN.
text_la: Usquequo deliciis dissolveris, filia vaga? quia creavit Dominus novum super terram : femina circumdabit virum.
text_pt: Até quando andarás errante, ó filha rebelde? Porque o Senhor criou uma coisa nova sobre a terra; uma mulher cercará a um homem.
text_el: ἕως πότε ἀποστρέψεις θυγάτηρ ἠτιμωμένη ὅτι ἔκτισεν κύριος σωτηρίαν εἰς καταφύτευσιν καινήν ἐν σωτηρίᾳ περιελεύσονται ἄνθρωποι

text_en: Thus says the Lord of hosts , the God of Israel : As yet shall they say this word in the land of Juda , and in the cities thereof, when I shall bring back their captivity: The Lord bless you, the beauty of justice , the holy mountain.
text_la: Hæc dicit Dominus exercituum, Deus Israël : Adhuc dicent verbum istud in terra Juda et in urbibus ejus, cum convertero captivitatem eorum : Benedicat tibi Dominus, pulchritudo justitiæ, mons sanctus :
text_pt: Assim diz o Senhor dos Exércitos, o Deus de Israel: Ainda dirão esta palavra na terra de Judá, e nas suas cidades, quando eu vos restaurar do seu cativeiro: O Senhor te abençoe, ó morada de justiça, ó monte de santidade!
text_el: οὕτως εἶπεν κύριος ἔτι ἐροῦσιν τὸν λόγον τοῦτον ἐν γῇ Ιουδα καὶ ἐν πόλεσιν αὐτοῦ ὅταν ἀποστρέψω τὴν αἰχμαλωσίαν αὐτοῦ εὐλογημένος κύριος ἐπὶ δίκαιον ὄρος τὸ ἅγιον αὐτοῦ

text_en: And Juda and all his cities shall dwell therein together: the husbandman and they that drive the flocks.
text_la: et habitabunt in eo Judas et omnes civitates ejus simul, agricolæ et minantes greges.
text_pt: E nela habitarão Judá, e todas as suas cidades juntamente; como também os lavradores e os que pastoreiam o rebanho.
text_el: καὶ ἐνοικοῦντες ἐν ταῖς πόλεσιν Ιουδα καὶ ἐν πάσῃ τῇ γῇ αὐτοῦ ἅμα γεωργῷ καὶ ἀρθήσεται ἐν ποιμνίῳ

text_en: For I have inebriated the weary soul : and I have filled every hungry soul .
text_la: Quia inebriavi animam lassam, et omnem animam esurientem saturavi.
text_pt: Porque satisfiz a alma cansada, e toda a alma entristecida saciei.
text_el: ὅτι ἐμέθυσα πᾶσαν ψυχὴν διψῶσαν καὶ πᾶσαν ψυχὴν πεινῶσαν ἐνέπλησα

text_en: Upon this I was as it were awaked out of a sleep, and I saw, and my sleep was sweet to me.
text_la: Ideo quasi de somno suscitatus sum : et vidi, et somnus meus dulcis mihi.
text_pt: Nisto despertei, e olhei, e o meu sono foi doce para mim.
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο ἐξηγέρθην καὶ εἶδον καὶ ὁ ὕπνος μου ἡδύς μοι ἐγενήθη

text_en: Behold the days come, says the Lord : and I will sow the house of Israel and the house of Juda with the seed of men , and with the seed of beasts.
text_la: Ecce dies veniunt, dicit Dominus, et seminabo domum Israël et domum Juda semine hominum et semine jumentorum.
text_pt: Eis que dias vêm, diz o Senhor, em que semearei a casa de Israel, e a casa de Judá, com a semente de homens, e com a semente de animais.
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο ἰδοὺ ἡμέραι ἔρχονται φησὶν κύριος καὶ σπερῶ τὸν Ισραηλ καὶ τὸν Ιουδαν σπέρμα ἀνθρώπου καὶ σπέρμα κτήνους

text_en: And as I have watched over them, to pluck up, and to throw down, and to scatter, and destroy, and afflict: so will I watch over them, to build up, and to plant them, says the Lord .
text_la: Et sicut vigilavi super eos ut evellerem, et demolirer, et dissiparem, et disperderem, et affligerem, sic vigilabo super eos ut ædificem et plantem, ait Dominus.
text_pt: E será que, como velei sobre eles, para arrancar, e para derrubar, e para transtornar, e para destruir, e para afligir, assim velarei sobre eles, para edificar e para plantar, diz o Senhor.
text_el: καὶ ἔσται ὥσπερ ἐγρηγόρουν ἐπ' αὐτοὺς καθαιρεῖν καὶ κακοῦν οὕτως γρηγορήσω ἐπ' αὐτοὺς τοῦ οἰκοδομεῖν καὶ καταφυτεύειν φησὶν κύριος

text_en: In those days they shall say no more: The fathers have eaten a sour grape, and the teeth of the children are set on edge.
text_la: In diebus illis non dicent ultra : Patres comederunt uvam acerbam, et dentes filiorum obstupuerunt.
text_pt: Naqueles dias nunca mais dirão: Os pais comeram uvas verdes, e os dentes dos filhos se embotaram.
text_el: ἐν ταῖς ἡμέραις ἐκείναις οὐ μὴ εἴπωσιν οἱ πατέρες ἔφαγον ὄμφακα καὶ οἱ ὀδόντες τῶν τέκνων ᾑμωδίασαν

text_en: But every one shall die for his own iniquity : every man that shall eat the sour grape, his teeth shall be set on edge.
text_la: Sed unusquisque in iniquitate sua morietur : omnis homo qui comederit uvam acerbam, obstupescent dentes ejus.
text_pt: Mas cada um morrerá pela sua iniqüidade; de todo o homem que comer as uvas verdes os dentes se embotarão.
text_el: ἀλλ' ἢ ἕκαστος ἐν τῇ ἑαυτοῦ ἁμαρτίᾳ ἀποθανεῖται καὶ τοῦ φαγόντος τὸν ὄμφακα αἱμωδιάσουσιν οἱ ὀδόντες αὐτοῦ

text_en: Behold the days shall come, says the Lord , and I will make a new covenant with the house of Israel , and with the house of Juda :
text_la: Ecce dies venient, dicit Dominus, et feriam domui Israël et domui Juda fœdus novum,
text_pt: Eis que dias vêm, diz o Senhor, em que farei uma aliança nova com a casa de Israel e com a casa de Judá.
text_el: ἰδοὺ ἡμέραι ἔρχονται φησὶν κύριος καὶ διαθήσομαι τῷ οἴκῳ Ισραηλ καὶ τῷ οἴκῳ Ιουδα διαθήκην καινήν

text_en: Not according to the covenant which I made with their fathers, in the day that I took them by the hand to bring them out of the land of Egypt , the covenant which they made void, and I had dominion over them, says the Lord .
text_la: non secundum pactum quod pepigi cum patribus eorum in die qua apprehendi manum eorum ut educerem eos de terra Ægypti, pactum quod irritum fecerunt : et ego dominatus sum eorum, dicit Dominus.
text_pt: Não conforme a aliança que fiz com seus pais, no dia em que os tomei pela mão, para os tirar da terra do Egito; porque eles invalidaram a minha aliança apesar de eu os haver desposado, diz o Senhor.
text_el: οὐ κατὰ τὴν διαθήκην ἣν διεθέμην τοῖς πατράσιν αὐτῶν ἐν ἡμέρᾳ ἐπιλαβομένου μου τῆς χειρὸς αὐτῶν ἐξαγαγεῖν αὐτοὺς ἐκ γῆς Αἰγύπτου ὅτι αὐτοὶ οὐκ ἐνέμειναν ἐν τῇ διαθήκῃ μου καὶ ἐγὼ ἠμέλησα αὐτῶν φησὶν κύριος

text_en: But this shall be the covenant that I will make with the house of Israel , after those days, says the Lord : I will give my law in their bowels, and I will write it in their heart: and I will be their God , and they shall be my people.
text_la: Sed hoc erit pactum quod feriam cum domo Israël post dies illos, dicit Dominus : dabo legem meam in visceribus eorum, et in corde eorum scribam eam, et ero eis in Deum, et ipsi erunt mihi in populum :
text_pt: Mas esta é a aliança que farei com a casa de Israel depois daqueles dias, diz o Senhor: Porei a minha lei no seu interior, e a escreverei no seu coração; e eu serei o seu Deus e eles serão o meu povo.
text_el: ὅτι αὕτη ἡ διαθήκη ἣν διαθήσομαι τῷ οἴκῳ Ισραηλ μετὰ τὰς ἡμέρας ἐκείνας φησὶν κύριος διδοὺς δώσω νόμους μου εἰς τὴν διάνοιαν αὐτῶν καὶ ἐπὶ καρδίας αὐτῶν γράψω αὐτούς καὶ ἔσομαι αὐτοῖς εἰς θεόν καὶ αὐτοὶ ἔσονταί μοι εἰς λαόν

text_en: And they shall teach no more every man his neighbour, and every man his brother, saying: Know the Lord : for all shall know me from the least of them even to the greatest, says the Lord : for I will forgive their iniquity , and I will remember their sin no more.
text_la: et non docebit ultra vir proximum suum et vir fratrem suum, dicens : Cognosce Dominum : omnes enim cognoscent me, a minimo eorum usque ad maximum, ait Dominus : quia propitiabor iniquitati eorum, et peccati eorum non memorabor amplius.
text_pt: E não ensinará mais cada um a seu próximo, nem cada um a seu irmão, dizendo: Conhecei ao Senhor; porque todos me conhecerão, desde o menor até ao maior deles, diz o Senhor; porque lhes perdoarei a sua maldade, e nunca mais me lembrarei dos seus pecados.
text_el: καὶ οὐ μὴ διδάξωσιν ἕκαστος τὸν πολίτην αὐτοῦ καὶ ἕκαστος τὸν ἀδελφὸν αὐτοῦ λέγων γνῶθι τὸν κύριον ὅτι πάντες εἰδήσουσίν με ἀπὸ μικροῦ αὐτῶν καὶ ἕως μεγάλου αὐτῶν ὅτι ἵλεως ἔσομαι ταῖς ἀδικίαις αὐτῶν καὶ τῶν ἁμαρτιῶν αὐτῶν οὐ μὴ μνησθῶ ἔτι

text_en: Thus says the Lord , who gives the sun for the light of the day, the order of the moon and of the stars, for the light of the night: who stirs up the sea, and the waves thereof roar, the Lord of hosts is his name .
text_la: Hæc dicit Dominus qui dat solem in lumine diei, ordinem lunæ et stellarum in lumine noctis : qui turbat mare, et sonant fluctus ejus : Dominus exercituum nomen illi :
text_pt: Assim diz o Senhor, que dá o sol para luz do dia, e as ordenanças da lua e das estrelas para luz da noite, que agita o mar, bramando as suas ondas; o Senhor dos Exércitos é o seu nome.
text_el: ἐὰν ὑψωθῇ ὁ οὐρανὸς εἰς τὸ μετέωρον φησὶν κύριος καὶ ἐὰν ταπεινωθῇ τὸ ἔδαφος τῆς γῆς κάτω καὶ ἐγὼ οὐκ ἀποδοκιμῶ τὸ γένος Ισραηλ φησὶν κύριος περὶ πάντων ὧν ἐποίησαν

text_en: If these ordinances shall fail before me, says the Lord : then also the seed of Israel shall fail, so as not to be a nation before me for ever.
text_la: Si defecerint leges istæ coram me, dicit Dominus, tunc et semen Israël deficiet, ut non sit gens coram me cunctis diebus.
text_pt: Se falharem estas ordenanças de diante de mim, diz o Senhor, deixará também a descendência de Israel de ser uma nação diante de mim para sempre.
text_el: οὕτως εἶπεν κύριος ὁ δοὺς τὸν ἥλιον εἰς φῶς τῆς ἡμέρας σελήνην καὶ ἀστέρας εἰς φῶς τῆς νυκτός καὶ κραυγὴν ἐν θαλάσσῃ καὶ ἐβόμβησεν τὰ κύματα αὐτῆς κύριος παντοκράτωρ ὄνομα αὐτῷ

text_en: Thus says the Lord : If the heavens above can be measured, and the foundations of the earth searched out beneath, I also will cast away all the seed of Israel , for all that they have done, says the Lord .
text_la: Hæc dicit Dominus : Si mensurari potuerint cæli sursum, et investigari fundamenta terræ deorsum, et ego abjiciam universum semen Israël, propter omnia quæ fecerunt, dicit Dominus.
text_pt: Assim disse o Senhor: Se puderem ser medidos os céus lá em cima, e sondados os fundamentos da terra cá em baixo, também eu rejeitarei toda a descendência de Israel, por tudo quanto fizeram, diz o Senhor.
text_el: ἐὰν παύσωνται οἱ νόμοι οὗτοι ἀπὸ προσώπου μου φησὶν κύριος καὶ τὸ γένος Ισραηλ παύσεται γενέσθαι ἔθνος κατὰ πρόσωπόν μου πάσας τὰς ἡμέρας

text_en: Behold the days come, says the Lord , that the city shall be built to the Lord from the tower of Hanameel even to the gate of the corner.
text_la: Ecce dies veniunt, dicit Dominus, et ædificabitur civitas Domino, a turre Hananeel usque ad portam anguli.
text_pt: Eis que vêm dias, diz o Senhor, em que esta cidade será reedificada para o Senhor, desde a torre de Hananeel até à porta da esquina.
text_el: ἰδοὺ ἡμέραι ἔρχονται φησὶν κύριος καὶ οἰκοδομηθήσεται πόλις τῷ κυρίῳ ἀπὸ πύργου Αναμεηλ ἕως πύλης τῆς γωνίας

text_en: And the measuring line shall go out farther in his sight upon the hill Gareb: and it shall compass Goatha,
text_la: Et exibit ultra norma mensuræ in conspectu ejus super collem Gareb, et circuibit Goatha,
text_pt: E a linha de medir estender-se-á para diante dela, até ao outeiro de Garebe, e virar-se-á para Goa.
text_el: καὶ ἐξελεύσεται ἡ διαμέτρησις αὐτῆς ἀπέναντι αὐτῶν ἕως βουνῶν Γαρηβ καὶ περικυκλωθήσεται κύκλῳ ἐξ ἐκλεκτῶν λίθων

text_en: and the whole valley of dead bodies, and of ashes, and all the country of death, even to the torrent Cedron , and to the corner of the horse gate towards the east, the Holy of the Lord : it shall not be plucked up, and it shall not be destroyed any more for ever.
text_la: et omnem vallem cadaverum, et cineris, et universam regionem mortis usque ad torrentem Cedron, et usque ad angulum portæ equorum orientalis, Sanctum Domini : non evelletur, et non destruetur ultra in perpetuum.
text_pt: E todo o vale dos cadáveres e da cinza, e todos os campos até ao ribeiro de Cedrom, até à esquina da porta dos cavalos para o oriente, serão consagrados ao Senhor; não se arrancará nem se derrubará mais eternamente.
text_el: καὶ πάντες ασαρημωθ ἕως ναχαλ Κεδρων ἕως γωνίας πύλης ἵππων ἀνατολῆς ἁγίασμα τῷ κυρίῳ καὶ οὐκέτι οὐ μὴ ἐκλίπῃ καὶ οὐ μὴ καθαιρεθῇ ἕως τοῦ αἰῶνος

text_en: The word that came to Jeremias from the Lord in the tenth year of Sedecias king of Juda : the same is the eighteenth year of Nabuchodonosor .
text_la: Verbum quod factum est ad Jeremiam a Domino, in anno decimo Sedeciæ regis Juda, ipse est annus decimusoctavus Nabuchodonosor.
text_pt: A palavra que veio a Jeremias da parte do SENHOR, no ano décimo de Zedequias, rei de Judá, o qual foi o décimo oitavo de Nabucodonosor.
text_el: ὁ λόγος ὁ γενόμενος παρὰ κυρίου πρὸς Ιερεμιαν ἐν τῷ ἐνιαυτῷ τῷ δεκάτῳ τῷ βασιλεῖ Σεδεκια οὗτος ἐνιαυτὸς ὀκτωκαιδέκατος τῷ βασιλεῖ Ναβουχοδονοσορ βασιλεῖ Βαβυλῶνος

text_en: At that time the army of the king of Babylon besieged Jerusalem : and Jeremiah the prophet was shut up in the court of the prison , which was in the house of the king of Juda .
text_la: Tunc exercitus regis Babylonis obsidebat Jerusalem, et Jeremias propheta erat clausus in atrio carceris qui erat in domo regis Juda.
text_pt: Ora, nesse tempo o exército do rei de babilônia cercava Jerusalém; e Jeremias, o profeta, estava encerrado no pátio da guarda que estava na casa do rei de Judá;
text_el: καὶ δύναμις βασιλέως Βαβυλῶνος ἐχαράκωσεν ἐπὶ Ιερουσαλημ καὶ Ιερεμιας ἐφυλάσσετο ἐν αὐλῇ τῆς φυλακῆς ἥ ἐστιν ἐν οἴκῳ τοῦ βασιλέως

text_en: For Sedecias king of Juda had shut him up, saying: Why do you prophesy , saying: Thus says the Lord : Behold I will give this city into the hand of the king of Babylon , and he shall take it?
text_la: Clauserat enim eum Sedecias rex Juda, dicens : Quare vaticinaris, dicens : Hæc dicit Dominus : Ecce ego dabo civitatem istam in manus regis Babylonis, et capiet eam:
