text_en: And Micheas told them all the words that he had heard when Baruch read out of the volume in the hearing of the people.
text_la: et nuntiavit eis Michæas omnia verba quæ audivit, legente Baruch ex volumine in auribus populi.
text_pt: E Micaías anunciou-lhes todas as palavras que ouvira, quando Baruque leu o livro, aos ouvidos do povo.
text_el: καὶ ἀνήγγειλεν αὐτοῖς Μιχαιας πάντας τοὺς λόγους οὓς ἤκουσεν ἀναγινώσκοντος τοῦ Βαρουχ εἰς τὰ ὦτα τοῦ λαοῦ

text_en: Therefore all the princes sent Judi the son of Nathanias, the son of Selemias, the son of Chusi, to Baruch, saying: Take in your hand the volume in which you have read in the hearing of the people, and come. So Baruch the son of Nerias took the volume in his hand, and came to them.
text_la: Miserunt itaque omnes principes ad Baruch Judi filium Nathaniæ filii Selemiæ filii Chusi, dicentes : Volumen ex quo legisti, audiente populo, sume in manu tua, et veni. Tulit ergo Baruch filius Neriæ volumen in manu sua, et venit ad eos:
text_pt: Então todos os príncipes mandaram Jeudi, filho de Netanias, filho de Selemias, filho de Cusi, a Baruque, para lhe dizer: O rolo que leste aos ouvidos do povo, toma-o na tua mão, e vem. E Baruque, filho de Nerias, tomou o rolo na sua mão, e foi ter com eles.
text_el: καὶ ἀπέστειλαν πάντες οἱ ἄρχοντες πρὸς Βαρουχ υἱὸν Νηριου τὸν Ιουδιν υἱὸν Ναθανιου υἱοῦ Σελεμιου υἱοῦ Χουσι λέγοντες τὸ χαρτίον ἐν ᾧ σὺ ἀναγινώσκεις ἐν αὐτῷ ἐν ὠσὶ τοῦ λαοῦ λαβὲ αὐτὸ εἰς τὴν χεῖρά σου καὶ ἧκε καὶ ἔλαβεν Βαρουχ τὸ χαρτίον καὶ κατέβη πρὸς αὐτούς

text_en: And they said to him: Sit down and read these things in our hearing. And Baruch read in their hearing.
text_la: et dixerunt ad eum : Sede, et lege hæc in auribus nostris. Et legit Baruch in auribus eorum.
text_pt: E disseram-lhe: Assenta-te agora, e lê-o aos nossos ouvidos. E leu Baruque aos ouvidos deles.
text_el: καὶ εἶπαν αὐτῷ πάλιν ἀνάγνωθι εἰς τὰ ὦτα ἡμῶν καὶ ἀνέγνω Βαρουχ

text_en: And when they had heard all the words, they looked upon one another with astonishment, and they said to Baruch: We must tell the king all these words.
text_la: Igitur cum audissent omnia verba, obstupuerunt unusquisque ad proximum suum, et dixerunt ad Baruch : Nuntiare debemus regi omnes sermones istos.
text_pt: E sucedeu que, ouvindo eles todas aquelas palavras, voltaram-se temerosos uns para os outros, e disseram a Baruque: Sem dúvida alguma anunciaremos ao rei todas estas palavras.
text_el: καὶ ἐγενήθη ὡς ἤκουσαν πάντας τοὺς λόγους συνεβουλεύσαντο ἕκαστος πρὸς τὸν πλησίον αὐτοῦ καὶ εἶπαν ἀναγγέλλοντες ἀναγγείλωμεν τῷ βασιλεῖ ἅπαντας τοὺς λόγους τούτους

text_en: And they asked him, saying: Tell us how you wrote all these words from his mouth.
text_la: Et interrogaverunt eum, dicentes : Indica nobis quomodo scripsisti omnes sermones istos ex ore ejus.
text_pt: E perguntaram a Baruque, dizendo: Declara-nos agora como escreveste da sua boca todas estas palavras.
text_el: καὶ τὸν Βαρουχ ἠρώτησαν λέγοντες πόθεν ἔγραψας πάντας τοὺς λόγους τούτους

text_en: And Baruch said to them: With his mouth he pronounced all these words as if he were reading to me: and I wrote in a volume with ink.
text_la: Dixit autem eis Baruch : Ex ore suo loquebatur quasi legens ad me omnes sermones istos, et ego scribebam in volumine atramento.
text_pt: E disse-lhes Baruque: Da sua boca ele me ditava todas estas palavras, e eu com tinta as escrevia no livro.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Βαρουχ ἀπὸ στόματος αὐτοῦ ἀνήγγειλέν μοι Ιερεμιας πάντας τοὺς λόγους τούτους καὶ ἔγραφον ἐν βιβλίῳ

text_en: And the princes said to Baruch: Go and hide, both you and Jeremias, and let no man know where you are.
text_la: Et dixerunt principes ad Baruch : Vade, et abscondere, tu et Jeremias, et nemo sciat ubi sitis.
text_pt: Então disseram os príncipes a Baruque: Vai, esconde-te, tu e Jeremias, e ninguém saiba onde estais.
text_el: καὶ εἶπαν τῷ Βαρουχ βάδισον κατακρύβηθι σὺ καὶ Ιερεμιας ἄνθρωπος μὴ γνώτω ποῦ ὑμεῖς

text_en: And they went in to the king into the court : but they laid up the volume in the chamber of Elisama the scribe : and they told all the words in the hearing of the king.
text_la: Et ingressi sunt ad regem in atrium : porro volumen commendaverunt in gazophylacio Elisamæ scribæ, et nuntiaverunt, audiente rege, omnes sermones.
text_pt: E foram ter com o rei ao átrio: mas depositaram o rolo na câmara de Elisama, o escriba, e anunciaram aos ouvidos do rei todas aquelas palavras.
text_el: καὶ εἰσῆλθον πρὸς τὸν βασιλέα εἰς τὴν αὐλήν καὶ τὸ χαρτίον ἔδωκαν φυλάσσειν ἐν οἴκῳ Ελισαμα καὶ ἀνήγγειλαν τῷ βασιλεῖ πάντας τοὺς λόγους

text_en: And the king sent Judi that he should take the volume: who bringing it out of the chamber of Elisama the scribe , read it in the hearing of the king, and of all the princes that stood about the king.
text_la: Misitque rex Judi ut sumeret volumen : qui tollens illud de gazophylacio Elisamæ scribæ, legit, audiente rege et universis principibus qui stabant circa regem.
text_pt: Então enviou o rei a Jeudi, para que tomasse o rolo; e Jeudi tomou-o da câmara de Elisama, o escriba, e leu-o aos ouvidos do rei e aos ouvidos de todos os príncipes que estavam em torno do rei.
text_el: καὶ ἀπέστειλεν ὁ βασιλεὺς τὸν Ιουδιν λαβεῖν τὸ χαρτίον καὶ ἔλαβεν αὐτὸ ἐξ οἴκου Ελισαμα καὶ ἀνέγνω Ιουδιν εἰς τὰ ὦτα τοῦ βασιλέως καὶ εἰς τὰ ὦτα πάντων τῶν ἀρχόντων τῶν ἑστηκότων περὶ τὸν βασιλέα

text_en: Now the king sat in the winter house, in the ninth month: and there was a hearth before him full of burning coals.
text_la: Rex autem sedebat in domo hiemali, in mense nono, et posita erat arula coram eo plena prunis.
text_pt: Ora, o rei estava assentado na casa de inverno, pelo nono mês; e diante dele estava um braseiro aceso.
text_el: καὶ ὁ βασιλεὺς ἐκάθητο ἐν οἴκῳ χειμερινῷ καὶ ἐσχάρα πυρὸς κατὰ πρόσωπον αὐτοῦ

text_en: And when Judi had read three or four pages, he cut it with the penknife, and he cast it into the fire, that was upon the hearth, till all the volume was consumed with the fire that was on the hearth.
text_la: Cumque legisset Judi tres pagellas vel quatuor, scidit illud scalpello scribæ, et projecit in ignem qui erat super arulam, donec consumeretur omne volumen igni qui erat in arula.
text_pt: E sucedeu que, tendo Jeudi lido três ou quatro folhas, cortou-as com um canivete de escrivão, e lançou-as no fogo que havia no braseiro, até que todo o rolo se consumiu no fogo que estava sobre o braseiro.
text_el: καὶ ἐγενήθη ἀναγινώσκοντος Ιουδιν τρεῖς σελίδας καὶ τέσσαρας ἀπέτεμνεν αὐτὰς τῷ ξυρῷ τοῦ γραμματέως καὶ ἔρριπτεν εἰς τὸ πῦρ τὸ ἐπὶ τῆς ἐσχάρας ἕως ἐξέλιπεν πᾶς ὁ χάρτης εἰς τὸ πῦρ τὸ ἐπὶ τῆς ἐσχάρας

text_en: And the king and all his servants that heard all these words were not afraid, nor did they rend their garments.
text_la: Et non timuerunt, neque sciderunt vestimenta sua, rex et omnes servi ejus qui audierunt universos sermones istos.
text_pt: E não temeram, nem rasgaram as suas vestes, nem o rei, nem nenhum dos seus servos que ouviram todas aquelas palavras.
text_el: καὶ οὐκ ἐζήτησαν καὶ οὐ διέρρηξαν τὰ ἱμάτια αὐτῶν ὁ βασιλεὺς καὶ οἱ παῖδες αὐτοῦ οἱ ἀκούοντες πάντας τοὺς λόγους τούτους

text_en: But yet Elnathan, and Dalaias, and Gamarias spoke to the king, not to burn the book: and he heard them not.
text_la: Verumtamen Elnathan, et Dalaias, et Gamarias, contradixerunt regi, ne combureret librum : et non audivit eos.
text_pt: E, posto que Elnatã, e Delaías, e Gemarias tivessem rogado ao rei que não queimasse o rolo, ele não lhes deu ouvidos.
text_el: καὶ Ελναθαν καὶ Γοδολιας καὶ Γαμαριας ὑπέθεντο τῷ βασιλεῖ πρὸς τὸ μὴ κατακαῦσαι τὸ χαρτίον

text_en: And the king commanded Jeremiel the son of Amelech, and Saraias the son of Ezriel, and Selemias the son of Abdeel, to take up Baruch the scribe , and Jeremiah the prophet : but the Lord hid them.
text_la: Et præcepit rex Jeremiel filio Amelech, et Saraiæ filio Ezriel, et Selemiæ filio Abdeel, ut comprehenderent Baruch scribam, et Jeremiam prophetam : abscondit autem eos Dominus.
text_pt: Antes deu ordem o rei a Jerameel, filho de Hamaleque, e a Seraías, filho de Azriel, e a Selemias, filho de Abdeel, que prendessem a Baruque, o escrivão, e a Jeremias, o profeta; mas o Senhor os escondera.
text_el: καὶ ἐνετείλατο ὁ βασιλεὺς τῷ Ιερεμεηλ υἱῷ τοῦ βασιλέως καὶ τῷ Σαραια υἱῷ Εσριηλ συλλαβεῖν τὸν Βαρουχ καὶ τὸν Ιερεμιαν καὶ κατεκρύβησαν

text_en: And the word of the Lord came to Jeremiah the prophet , after that the king had burnt the volume, and the words that Baruch had written from the mouth of Jeremias, saying:
text_la: Et factum est verbum Domini ad Jeremiam prophetam, postquam combusserat rex volumen et sermones quos scripserat Baruch ex ore Jeremiæ, dicens:
text_pt: Então veio a Jeremias a palavra do Senhor, depois que o rei queimara o rolo, com as palavras que Baruque escrevera da boca de Jeremias, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο λόγος κυρίου πρὸς Ιερεμιαν μετὰ τὸ κατακαῦσαι τὸν βασιλέα τὸ χαρτίον πάντας τοὺς λόγους οὓς ἔγραψεν Βαρουχ ἀπὸ στόματος Ιερεμιου λέγων

text_en: Take you again another volume: and write in it all the former words that were in the first volume which Joakim the king of Juda both burnt.
text_la: Rursum tolle volumen aliud, et scribe in eo omnes sermones priores qui erant in primo volumine, quod combussit Joakim rex Juda.
text_pt: Toma ainda outro rolo, e escreve nele todas aquelas palavras que estavam no primeiro rolo, que queimou Jeoiaquim, rei de Judá.
text_el: πάλιν λαβὲ σὺ χαρτίον ἕτερον καὶ γράψον πάντας τοὺς λόγους τοὺς ὄντας ἐπὶ τοῦ χαρτίου οὓς κατέκαυσεν ὁ βασιλεὺς Ιωακιμ

text_en: And you shall say to Joakim the king of Juda : Thus says the Lord : You have burnt that volume, saying: Why have you written therein, and said: The king of Babylon shall come speedily, and shall lay waste this land: and shall cause to cease from thence man and beast?
text_la: Et ad Joakim regem Juda dices : Hæc dicit Dominus : Tu combussisti volumen illud, dicens : Quare scripsisti in eo annuntians : Festinus veniet rex Babylonis, et vastabit terram hanc, et cessare faciet ex illa hominem et jumentum?
text_pt: E a Jeoiaquim, rei de Judá, dirás: Assim diz o SENHOR: Tu queimaste este rolo, dizendo: Por que escreveste nele, dizendo: Certamente virá o rei de babilônia, e destruirá esta terra e fará cessar nela homens e animais?
text_el: καὶ ἐρεῖς οὕτως εἶπεν κύριος σὺ κατέκαυσας τὸ χαρτίον τοῦτο λέγων διὰ τί ἔγραψας ἐπ' αὐτῷ λέγων εἰσπορευόμενος εἰσπορεύσεται ὁ βασιλεὺς Βαβυλῶνος καὶ ἐξολεθρεύσει τὴν γῆν ταύτην καὶ ἐκλείψει ἀπ' αὐτῆς ἄνθρωπος καὶ κτήνη

text_en: Therefore thus says the Lord against Joakim the king of Juda : He shall have none to sit upon the throne of David : and his dead body shall be cast out to the heat by day, and to the frost by night.
text_la: Propterea hæc dicit Dominus contra Joakim regem Juda : Non erit ex eo qui sedeat super solium David : et cadaver ejus projicietur ad æstum per diem, et ad gelu per noctem.
text_pt: Portanto assim diz o Senhor, acerca de Jeoiaquim, rei de Judá: Não terá quem se assente sobre o trono de Davi, e será lançado o seu cadáver ao calor do dia, e à geada da noite.
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο οὕτως εἶπεν κύριος ἐπὶ Ιωακιμ βασιλέα Ιουδα οὐκ ἔσται αὐτῷ καθήμενος ἐπὶ θρόνου Δαυιδ καὶ τὸ θνησιμαῖον αὐτοῦ ἔσται ἐρριμμένον ἐν τῷ καύματι τῆς ἡμέρας καὶ ἐν τῷ παγετῷ τῆς νυκτός

text_en: And I will punish him, and his seed and his servants, for their iniquities , and I will bring upon them, and upon the inhabitants of Jerusalem , and upon the men of Juda all the evil that I have pronounced against them, but they have not heard.
text_la: Et visitabo contra eum, et contra semen ejus, et contra servos ejus, iniquitates suas : et adducam super eos, et super habitatores Jerusalem, et super viros Juda, omne malum quod locutus sum ad eos, et non audierunt.
text_pt: E castigarei a sua iniqüidade nele, e na sua descendência, e nos seus servos; e trarei sobre ele e sobre os moradores de Jerusalém, e sobre os homens de Judá, todo aquele mal que lhes tenho falado, e não ouviram.
text_el: καὶ ἐπισκέψομαι ἐπ' αὐτὸν καὶ ἐπὶ τὸ γένος αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐπὶ τοὺς παῖδας αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐπάξω ἐπ' αὐτοὺς καὶ ἐπὶ τοὺς κατοικοῦντας Ιερουσαλημ καὶ ἐπὶ γῆν Ιουδα πάντα τὰ κακά ἃ ἐλάλησα πρὸς αὐτοὺς καὶ οὐκ ἤκουσαν

text_en: And Jeremias took another volume, and gave it to Baruch the son of Nerias the scribe : who wrote in it from the mouth of Jeremias all the words of the book which Joakim the king of Juda had burnt with fire: and there were added besides many more words than had been before.
text_la: Jeremias autem tulit volumen aliud, et dedit illud Baruch filio Neriæ scribæ : qui scripsit in eo ex ore Jeremiæ omnes sermones libri quem combusserat Joakim rex Juda igni : et insuper additi sunt sermones multo plures quam antea fuerant.
text_pt: Tomou, pois, Jeremias outro rolo, e deu-o a Baruque, filho de Nerias, o escrivão, o qual escreveu nele, da boca de Jeremias, todas as palavras do livro que Jeoiaquim, rei de Judá, tinha queimado no fogo; e ainda se lhes acrescentaram muitas palavras semelhantes.
text_el: καὶ ἔλαβεν Βαρουχ χαρτίον ἕτερον καὶ ἔγραψεν ἐπ' αὐτῷ ἀπὸ στόματος Ιερεμιου ἅπαντας τοὺς λόγους τοῦ βιβλίου οὗ κατέκαυσεν Ιωακιμ καὶ ἔτι προσετέθησαν αὐτῷ λόγοι πλείονες ὡς οὗτοι

text_en: Now King Sedecias the son of Josias reigned instead of Jechonias the son of Joakim: whom Nabuchodonosor king of Babylon made king in the land of Juda .
text_la: Et regnavit rex Sedecias filius Josiæ pro Jechonia filio Joakim, quem constituit regem Nabuchodonosor rex Babylonis in terra Juda:
text_pt: E Zedequias, filho de Josias, a quem Nabucodonosor, rei de babilônia, constituiu rei na terra de Judá, reinou em lugar de Conias, filho de Jeoiaquim.
text_el: καὶ ἐβασίλευσεν Σεδεκιας υἱὸς Ιωσια ἀντὶ Ιωακιμ ὃν ἐβασίλευσεν Ναβουχοδονοσορ βασιλεύειν τοῦ Ιουδα

text_en: But neither he, nor his servants, nor the people of the land did obey the words of the Lord , that he spoke in the hand of Jeremiah the prophet .
text_la: et non obedivit ipse, et servi ejus, et populus terræ, verbis Domini, quæ locutus est in manu Jeremiæ prophetæ.
text_pt: Mas nem ele, nem os seus servos, nem o povo da terra deram ouvidos às palavras do Senhor que falou pelo ministério de Jeremias, o profeta.
text_el: καὶ οὐκ ἤκουσεν αὐτὸς καὶ οἱ παῖδες αὐτοῦ καὶ ὁ λαὸς τῆς γῆς τοὺς λόγους κυρίου οὓς ἐλάλησεν ἐν χειρὶ Ιερεμιου

text_en: And King Sedecias sent Juchal the son of Selemias, and Sophonias the son of Maasias the priest to Jeremiah the prophet , saying: Pray to the Lord our God for us.
text_la: Et misit rex Sedecias Juchal filium Selemiæ, et Sophoniam filium Maasiæ, sacerdotem, ad Jeremiam prophetam, dicens : Ora pro nobis Dominum Deum nostrum.
text_pt: Contudo mandou o rei Zedequias a Jucal, filho de Selemias, e a Sofonias, filho de Maaséias, o sacerdote, ao profeta Jeremias, para lhe dizer: Roga agora por nós ao Senhor nosso Deus.
text_el: καὶ ἀπέστειλεν ὁ βασιλεὺς Σεδεκιας τὸν Ιωαχαλ υἱὸν Σελεμιου καὶ τὸν Σοφονιαν υἱὸν Μαασαιου τὸν ἱερέα πρὸς Ιερεμιαν λέγων πρόσευξαι δὴ περὶ ἡμῶν πρὸς κύριον

text_en: Now Jeremias walked freely in the midst of the people: for they had not as yet cast him into prison .
text_la: Jeremias autem libere ambulabat in medio populi : non enim miserant eum in custodiam carceris.
text_pt: E entrava e saía Jeremias entre o povo, porque não o tinham posto na prisão.
text_el: καὶ Ιερεμιας ἦλθεν καὶ διῆλθεν διὰ μέσου τῆς πόλεως καὶ οὐκ ἔδωκαν αὐτὸν εἰς οἶκον τῆς φυλακῆς

text_en: And the army of Pharao had come out of Egypt : and the Chaldeans that besieged Jerusalem , hearing these tidings, departed from Jerusalem .
text_la: Igitur exercitus Pharaonis egressus est de Ægypto, et audientes Chaldæi qui obsidebant Jerusalem, hujuscemodi nuntium, recesserunt ab Jerusalem.
text_pt: E o exército de Faraó saíra do Egito; e quando os caldeus, que tinham sitiado Jerusalém, ouviram esta notícia, retiraram-se de Jerusalém.
text_el: καὶ δύναμις Φαραω ἐξῆλθεν ἐξ Αἰγύπτου καὶ ἤκουσαν οἱ Χαλδαῖοι τὴν ἀκοὴν αὐτῶν καὶ ἀνέβησαν ἀπὸ Ιερουσαλημ

text_en: And the word of the Lord came to Jeremiah the prophet , saying:
text_la: Et factum est verbum Domini ad Jeremiam prophetam, dicens:
text_pt: Então veio a Jeremias, o profeta, a palavra do Senhor, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο λόγος κυρίου πρὸς Ιερεμιαν λέγων

text_en: Thus says the Lord the God of Israel : Thus shall you say to the king of Juda , who sent you to inquire of me: Behold the army of Pharao , which has come forth to help you, shall return into their own land, into Egypt .
text_la: Hæc dicit Dominus Deus Israël : Sic dicetis regi Juda, qui misit vos ad me interrogandum : Ecce exercitus Pharaonis, qui egressus est vobis in auxilium, revertetur in terram suam in Ægyptum:
text_pt: Assim diz o Senhor, Deus de Israel: Assim direis ao rei de Judá, que vos enviou a mim para me consultar: Eis que o exército de Faraó, que saiu em vosso socorro, voltará para a sua terra no Egito.
text_el: οὕτως εἶπεν κύριος οὕτως ἐρεῖς πρὸς βασιλέα Ιουδα τὸν ἀποστείλαντα πρὸς σὲ τοῦ ἐκζητῆσαί με ἰδοὺ δύναμις Φαραω ἡ ἐξελθοῦσα ὑμῖν εἰς βοήθειαν ἀποστρέψουσιν εἰς γῆν Αἰγύπτου

text_en: And the Chaldeans shall come again, and fight against this city, and take it, and burn it with fire.
text_la: et redient Chaldæi, et bellabunt contra civitatem hanc, et capient eam, et succendent eam igni.
text_pt: E voltarão os caldeus, e pelejarão contra esta cidade, e a tomarão, e a queimarão a fogo.
text_el: καὶ ἀναστρέψουσιν αὐτοὶ οἱ Χαλδαῖοι καὶ πολεμήσουσιν ἐπὶ τὴν πόλιν ταύτην καὶ συλλήμψονται αὐτὴν καὶ καύσουσιν αὐτὴν ἐν πυρί

text_en: Thus says the Lord : Deceive not your souls , saying: The Chaldeans shall surely depart and go away from us: for they shall not go away.
text_la: Hæc dicit Dominus : Nolite decipere animas vestras, dicentes : Euntes abibunt, et recedent a nobis Chaldæi : quia non abibunt.
text_pt: Assim diz o Senhor: Não enganeis as vossas almas, dizendo: Sem dúvida se retirarão os caldeus de nós, pois não se retirarão.
text_el: ὅτι οὕτως εἶπεν κύριος μὴ ὑπολάβητε ταῖς ψυχαῖς ὑμῶν λέγοντες ἀποτρέχοντες ἀπελεύσονται ἀφ' ἡμῶν οἱ Χαλδαῖοι ὅτι οὐ μὴ ἀπέλθωσιν

text_en: But if you should even beat all the army of the Chaldeans that fight against you, and there should be left of them some wounded men : they shall rise up, every man from his tent, and burn this city with fire.
text_la: Sed etsi percusseritis omnem exercitum Chaldæorum qui præliantur adversum vos, et derelicti fuerint ex eis aliqui vulnerati, singuli de tentorio suo consurgent, et incendent civitatem hanc igni.
text_pt: Porque ainda que ferísseis a todo o exército dos caldeus, que peleja contra vós, e só ficassem deles homens feridos, cada um levantar-se-ia na sua tenda, e queimaria a fogo esta cidade.
text_el: καὶ ἐὰν πατάξητε πᾶσαν δύναμιν τῶν Χαλδαίων τοὺς πολεμοῦντας ὑμᾶς καὶ καταλειφθῶσίν τινες ἐκκεκεντημένοι ἕκαστος ἐν τῷ τόπῳ αὐτοῦ οὗτοι ἀναστήσονται καὶ καύσουσιν τὴν πόλιν ταύτην ἐν πυρί

text_en: Now when the army of the Chaldeans had gone away from Jerusalem , because of Pharao's army,
text_la: Ergo cum recessisset exercitus Chaldæorum ab Jerusalem, propter exercitum Pharaonis,
text_pt: E sucedeu que, subindo de Jerusalém o exército dos caldeus, por causa do exército de Faraó,
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο ὅτε ἀνέβη ἡ δύναμις τῶν Χαλδαίων ἀπὸ Ιερουσαλημ ἀπὸ προσώπου τῆς δυνάμεως Φαραω

text_en: Jeremias went forth out of Jerusalem to go into the land of Benjamin : and to divide a possession there in the presence of the citizens,
text_la: egressus est Jeremias de Jerusalem ut iret in terram Benjamin, et divideret ibi possessionem in conspectu civium.
text_pt: Saiu Jeremias de Jerusalém, a fim de ir à terra de Benjamim, para dali se separar no meio do povo.
text_el: ἐξῆλθεν Ιερεμιας ἀπὸ Ιερουσαλημ τοῦ πορευθῆναι εἰς γῆν Βενιαμιν τοῦ ἀγοράσαι ἐκεῖθεν ἐν μέσῳ τοῦ λαοῦ

text_en: and when he had come to the gate of Benjamin , the captain of the gate, who was there in his turn, was one named Jerias, the son of Selemias, the son of Hananias: and he took hold of Jeremiah the prophet , saying: You are fleeing to the Chaldeans.
text_la: Cumque pervenisset ad portam Benjamin, erat ibi custos portæ per vices, nomine Jerias filius Selemiæ filii Hananiæ : et apprehendit Jeremiam prophetam, dicens : Ad Chaldæos profugis.
text_pt: Mas, estando ele à porta de Benjamim, achava-se ali um capitão da guarda, cujo nome era Jerias, filho de Selemias, filho de Hananias, o qual prendeu a Jeremias, o profeta, dizendo: Tu foges para os caldeus.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο αὐτὸς ἐν πύλῃ Βενιαμιν καὶ ἐκεῖ ἄνθρωπος παρ' ᾧ κατέλυεν Σαρουιας υἱὸς Σελεμιου υἱοῦ Ανανιου καὶ συνέλαβεν τὸν Ιερεμιαν λέγων πρὸς τοὺς Χαλδαίους σὺ φεύγεις

text_en: And Jeremias answered: It is not so, I am not fleeing to the Chaldeans. But he hearkened not to him: so Jerias took Jeremias and brought him to the princes.
text_la: Et respondit Jeremias : Falsum est : non fugio ad Chaldæos. Et non audivit eum, sed comprehendit Jerias Jeremiam, et adduxit eum ad principes:
text_pt: E Jeremias disse: Isso é falso, não fujo para os caldeus. Mas ele não lhe deu ouvidos; e assim Jerias prendeu a Jeremias, e o levou aos príncipes.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν ψεῦδος οὐκ εἰς τοὺς Χαλδαίους ἐγὼ φεύγω καὶ οὐκ ἤκουσεν αὐτοῦ καὶ συνέλαβεν Σαρουιας τὸν Ιερεμιαν καὶ εἰσήγαγεν αὐτὸν πρὸς τοὺς ἄρχοντας

text_en: Wherefore the princes were angry with Jeremias, and they beat him, and cast him into the prison that was in the house of Jonathan the scribe : for he was chief over the prison .
text_la: quam ob rem irati principes contra Jeremiam, cæsum eum miserunt in carcerem qui erat in domo Jonathan scribæ : ipse enim præpositus erat super carcerem.
text_pt: E os príncipes se iraram muito contra Jeremias, e o feriram; e puseram-no na prisão, na casa de Jônatas, o escrivão; porque a tinham transformado em cárcere.
text_el: καὶ ἐπικράνθησαν οἱ ἄρχοντες ἐπὶ Ιερεμιαν καὶ ἐπάταξαν αὐτὸν καὶ ἀπέστειλαν αὐτὸν εἰς τὴν οἰκίαν Ιωναθαν τοῦ γραμματέως ὅτι ταύτην ἐποίησαν εἰς οἰκίαν φυλακῆς

text_en: So Jeremias went into the house of the prison , and into the dungeon: and Jeremias remained there many days.
text_la: Itaque ingressus est Jeremias in domum laci et in ergastulum: et sedit ibi Jeremias diebus multis.
text_pt: Entrando, pois, Jeremias nas celas do calabouço, ali ficou muitos dias.
text_el: καὶ ἦλθεν Ιερεμιας εἰς οἰκίαν τοῦ λάκκου καὶ εἰς τὴν χερεθ καὶ ἐκάθισεν ἐκεῖ ἡμέρας πολλάς

text_en: Then Sedecias the king, sending, took him: and asked him secretly in his house, and said: Is there, do you think, any word from the Lord ? And Jeremias said. There is. And he said: You shall be delivered into the hands of the king of Babylon .
text_la: Mittens autem Sedecias rex, tulit eum : et interrogavit eum in domo sua abscondite, et dixit : Putasne est sermo a Domino? Et dixit Jeremias : Est : et ait : In manus regis Babylonis traderis.
text_pt: E mandou o rei Zedequias soltá-lo; e o rei lhe perguntou em sua casa, em segredo: Há porventura alguma palavra do SENHOR? E disse Jeremias: Há. E disse ainda: Na mão do rei de babilônia serás entregue.
text_el: καὶ ἀπέστειλεν Σεδεκιας καὶ ἐκάλεσεν αὐτόν καὶ ἠρώτα αὐτὸν ὁ βασιλεὺς κρυφαίως εἰπεῖν εἰ ἔστιν λόγος παρὰ κυρίου καὶ εἶπεν ἔστιν εἰς χεῖρας βασιλέως Βαβυλῶνος παραδοθήσῃ

text_en: And Jeremias said to King Sedecias: In what have I offended against you, or your servants, or your people, that you have cast me into prison ?
text_la: Et dixit Jeremias ad regem Sedeciam : Quid peccavi tibi, et servis tuis, et populo tuo, quia misisti me in domum carceris?
text_pt: Disse mais Jeremias ao rei Zedequias: Em que tenho pecado contra ti, e contra os teus servos, e contra este povo, para que me pusésseis na prisão?
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Ιερεμιας τῷ βασιλεῖ τί ἠδίκησά σε καὶ τοὺς παῖδάς σου καὶ τὸν λαὸν τοῦτον ὅτι σὺ δίδως με εἰς οἰκίαν φυλακῆς

text_en: Where are your prophets that prophesied to you, and said: The king of Babylon shall not come against you, and against this land?
text_la: ubi sunt prophetæ vestri, qui prophetabant vobis, et dicebant : Non veniet rex Babylonis super vos, et super terram hanc?
text_pt: Onde estão agora os vossos profetas, que vos profetizavam, dizendo: O rei de babilônia não virá contra vós nem contra esta terra?
text_el: καὶ ποῦ εἰσιν οἱ προφῆται ὑμῶν οἱ προφητεύσαντες ὑμῖν λέγοντες ὅτι οὐ μὴ ἔλθῃ βασιλεὺς Βαβυλῶνος ἐπὶ τὴν γῆν ταύτην

text_en: Now therefore hear, I beseech you, my lord the king: let my petition be accepted in your sight: and send me not back into the house of Jonathan the scribe , lest I die there.
text_la: Nunc ergo audi, obsecro, domine mi rex : valeat deprecatio mea in conspectu tuo, et ne me remittas in domum Jonathan scribæ, ne moriar ibi.
text_pt: Ora, pois, ouve agora, ó rei meu senhor: Seja aceita agora a minha súplica diante de ti, e não me deixes tornar à casa de Jônatas, o escriba, para que eu não venha a morrer ali.
text_el: καὶ νῦν κύριε βασιλεῦ πεσέτω τὸ ἔλεός μου κατὰ πρόσωπόν σου καὶ τί ἀποστρέφεις με εἰς οἰκίαν Ιωναθαν τοῦ γραμματέως καὶ οὐ μὴ ἀποθάνω ἐκεῖ

text_en: Then King Sedecias commanded that Jeremias should be committed into the entry of the prison : and that they should give him daily a piece of bread, beside broth, till all the bread in the city were spent: and Jeremias remained in the entry of the prison .
text_la: Præcepit ergo rex Sedecias ut traderetur Jeremias in vestibulo carceris, et daretur ei torta panis quotidie, excepto pulmento, donec consumerentur omnes panes de civitate : et mansit Jeremias in vestibulo carceris.
text_pt: Então ordenou o rei Zedequias que pusessem a Jeremias no átrio da guarda; e deram-lhe um pão cada dia, da rua dos padeiros, até que se acabou todo o pão da cidade; assim ficou Jeremias no átrio da guarda.
text_el: καὶ συνέταξεν ὁ βασιλεὺς καὶ ἐνεβάλοσαν αὐτὸν εἰς οἰκίαν τῆς φυλακῆς καὶ ἐδίδοσαν αὐτῷ ἄρτον ἕνα τῆς ἡμέρας ἔξωθεν οὗ πέσσουσιν ἕως ἐξέλιπον οἱ ἄρτοι ἐκ τῆς πόλεως καὶ ἐκάθισεν Ιερεμιας ἐν τῇ αὐλῇ τῆς φυλακῆς

text_en: Now Saphatias the son of Mathan, and Gedelias the son of Phassur, and Juchal the son of Selemias, and Phassur the son of Melchias heard the words that Jeremias spoke to all the people, saying:
text_la: Audivit autem Saphatias filius Mathan, et Gedelias filius Phassur, et Juchal filius Selemiæ, et Phassur filius Melchiæ, sermones quos Jeremias loquebatur ad omnem populum, dicens:
text_pt: Ouviram, pois, Sefatias, filho de Matã, e Gedalias, filho de Pasur, e Jucal, filho de Selemias, e Pasur, filho de Malquias, as palavras que anunciava Jeremias a todo o povo, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ ἤκουσεν Σαφατιας υἱὸς Μαθαν καὶ Γοδολιας υἱὸς Πασχωρ καὶ Ιωαχαλ υἱὸς Σελεμιου τοὺς λόγους οὓς ἐλάλει Ιερεμιας ἐπὶ τὸν λαὸν λέγων

text_en: Thus says the Lord : Whosoever shall remain in this city, shall die by the sword, and by famine, and by pestilence: but he that shall go forth to the Chaldeans, shall live, and his life shall be safe, and he shall live.
text_la: Hæc dicit Dominus : Quicumque manserit in civitate hac, morietur gladio, et fame, et peste : qui autem profugerit ad Chaldæos, vivet, et erit anima ejus sospes et vivens.
text_pt: Assim diz o Senhor: O que ficar nesta cidade morrerá à espada, de fome e de pestilência; mas o que sair aos caldeus viverá; porque a sua alma lhe será por despojo, e viverá.
text_el: οὕτως εἶπεν κύριος ὁ κατοικῶν ἐν τῇ πόλει ταύτῃ ἀποθανεῖται ἐν ῥομφαίᾳ καὶ ἐν λιμῷ καὶ ὁ ἐκπορευόμενος πρὸς τοὺς Χαλδαίους ζήσεται καὶ ἔσται ἡ ψυχὴ αὐτοῦ εἰς εὕρεμα καὶ ζήσεται

text_en: Thus says the Lord : This city shall surely be delivered into the hand of the army of the king of Babylon , and he shall take it.
text_la: Hæc dicit Dominus : Tradendo tradetur civitas hæc in manu exercitus regis Babylonis, et capiet eam.
text_pt: Assim diz o SENHOR: Esta cidade infalivelmente será entregue na mão do exército do rei de babilônia, e ele a tomará.
text_el: ὅτι οὕτως εἶπεν κύριος παραδιδομένη παραδοθήσεται ἡ πόλις αὕτη εἰς χεῖρας δυνάμεως βασιλέως Βαβυλῶνος καὶ συλλήμψεται αὐτήν

text_en: And the princes said to the king. We beseech you that this man may be put to death : for on purpose he weakens the hands of the men of war , that remain in this city, and the hands of the people, speaking to them according to these words: for this man seeks not peace to this people, but evil .
text_la: Et dixerunt principes regi : Rogamus ut occidatur homo iste : de industria enim dissolvit manus virorum bellantium qui remanserunt in civitate hac, et manus universi populi, loquens ad eos juxta verba hæc : siquidem homo iste non quærit pacem populo huic, sed malum.
text_pt: E disseram os príncipes ao rei: Morra este homem, visto que ele assim enfraquece as mãos dos homens de guerra que restam nesta cidade, e as mãos de todo o povo, dizendo-lhes tais palavras; porque este homem não busca a paz para este povo, porém o mal.
text_el: καὶ εἶπαν τῷ βασιλεῖ ἀναιρεθήτω δὴ ὁ ἄνθρωπος ἐκεῖνος ὅτι αὐτὸς ἐκλύει τὰς χεῖρας τῶν ἀνθρώπων τῶν πολεμούντων τῶν καταλειπομένων ἐν τῇ πόλει καὶ τὰς χεῖρας παντὸς τοῦ λαοῦ λαλῶν πρὸς αὐτοὺς κατὰ τοὺς λόγους τούτους ὅτι ὁ ἄνθρωπος οὗτος οὐ χρησμολογεῖ εἰρήνην τῷ λαῷ τούτῳ ἀλλ' ἢ πονηρά

text_en: And King Sedecias said: Behold he is in your hands: for it is not lawful for the king to deny you anything.
text_la: Et dixit rex Sedecias : Ecce ipse in manibus vestris est : nec enim fas est regem vobis quidquam negare.
text_pt: E disse o rei Zedequias: Eis que ele está na vossa mão; porque o rei nada pode fazer contra vós.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν ὁ βασιλεύς ἰδοὺ αὐτὸς ἐν χερσὶν ὑμῶν ὅτι οὐκ ἠδύνατο ὁ βασιλεὺς πρὸς αὐτούς

text_en: Then they took Jeremias and cast him into the dungeon of Melchias the son of Amelech, which was in the entry of the prison : and they let down Jeremias by ropes into the dungeon, wherein there was no water, but mire. And Jeremias sunk into the mire.
text_la: Tulerunt ergo Jeremiam, et projecerunt eum in lacum Melchiæ filii Amelech, qui erat in vestibulo carceris : et submiserunt Jeremiam funibus in lacum, in quo non erat aqua, sed lutum : descendit itaque Jeremias in cœnum.
text_pt: Então tomaram a Jeremias, e o lançaram na cisterna de Malquias, filho do rei, que estava no átrio da guarda; e desceram a Jeremias com cordas; mas na cisterna não havia água, senão lama; e atolou-se Jeremias na lama.
text_el: καὶ ἔρριψαν αὐτὸν εἰς τὸν λάκκον Μελχιου υἱοῦ τοῦ βασιλέως ὃς ἦν ἐν τῇ αὐλῇ τῆς φυλακῆς καὶ ἐχάλασαν αὐτὸν εἰς τὸν λάκκον καὶ ἐν τῷ λάκκῳ οὐκ ἦν ὕδωρ ἀλλ' ἢ βόρβορος καὶ ἦν ἐν τῷ βορβόρῳ

text_en: Now Abdemelech the Ethiopian , an eunuch that was in the king's house, heard that they had put Jeremias in the dungeon: but the king was sitting in the gate of Benjamin .
text_la: Audivit autem Abdemelech Æthiops, vir eunuchus, qui erat in domo regis, quod misissent Jeremiam in lacum. Porro rex sedebat in porta Benjamin:
text_pt: E, ouvindo Ebede-Meleque, o etíope, um eunuco que então estava na casa do rei, que tinham posto a Jeremias na cisterna (estava, porém, o rei assentado à porta de Benjamim),
text_el: καὶ ἤκουσεν Αβδεμελεχ ὁ Αἰθίοψ καὶ αὐτὸς ἐν οἰκίᾳ τοῦ βασιλέως ὅτι ἔδωκαν Ιερεμιαν εἰς τὸν λάκκον καὶ ὁ βασιλεὺς ἦν ἐν τῇ πύλῃ Βενιαμιν

text_en: And Abdemelech went out of the king's house, and spoke to the king, saying:
text_la: et egressus est Abdemelech de domo regis, et locutus est ad regem, dicens:
text_pt: Logo Ebede-Meleque saiu da casa do rei, e falou ao rei, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ ἐξῆλθεν πρὸς αὐτὸν καὶ ἐλάλησεν πρὸς τὸν βασιλέα καὶ εἶπεν

text_en: My lord the king, these men have done evil in all that they have done against Jeremiah the prophet , casting him into the dungeon to die there with hunger, for there is no more bread in the city.
text_la: Domine mi rex, male fecerunt viri isti omnia quæcumque perpetrarunt contra Jeremiam prophetam, mittentes eum in lacum, ut moriatur ibi fame : non sunt enim panes ultra in civitate.
text_pt: Ó rei, senhor meu, estes homens agiram mal em tudo quanto fizeram a Jeremias, o profeta, lançando-o na cisterna; de certo morrerá de fome no lugar onde se acha, pois não há mais pão na cidade.
text_el: ἐπονηρεύσω ἃ ἐποίησας τοῦ ἀποκτεῖναι τὸν ἄνθρωπον τοῦτον ἀπὸ προσώπου τοῦ λιμοῦ ὅτι οὐκ εἰσὶν ἔτι ἄρτοι ἐν τῇ πόλει

text_en: Then the king commanded Abdemelech the Ethiopian , saying: Take from hence thirty men with you, and draw up Jeremiah the prophet out of the dungeon, before he die.
text_la: Præcepit itaque rex Abdemelech Æthiopi, dicens : Tolle tecum hinc triginta viros, et leva Jeremiam prophetam de lacu, antequam moriatur.
text_pt: Então deu ordem o rei a Ebede-Meleque, o etíope, dizendo: Toma contigo daqui trinta homens, e tira a Jeremias, o profeta, da cisterna, antes que morra.
text_el: καὶ ἐνετείλατο ὁ βασιλεὺς τῷ Αβδεμελεχ λέγων λαβὲ εἰς τὰς χεῖράς σου ἐντεῦθεν τριάκοντα ἀνθρώπους καὶ ἀνάγαγε αὐτὸν ἐκ τοῦ λάκκου ἵνα μὴ ἀποθάνῃ

text_en: So Abdemelech taking the men with him, went into the king's house that was under the storehouse: and he took from thence old rags, and old rotten things, and he let them down by cords to Jeremias into the dungeon.
text_la: Assumptis ergo Abdemelech secum viris, ingressus est domum regis, quæ erat sub cellario, et tulit inde veteres pannos, et antiqua quæ computruerant, et submisit ea ad Jeremiam in lacum per funiculos.
text_pt: E tomou Ebede-Meleque os homens consigo, e foi à casa do rei, por debaixo da tesouraria, e tomou dali uns trapos velhos e rotos, e roupas velhas, e desceu-os a Jeremias na cisterna por meio de cordas.
text_el: καὶ ἔλαβεν Αβδεμελεχ τοὺς ἀνθρώπους καὶ εἰσῆλθεν εἰς τὴν οἰκίαν τοῦ βασιλέως τὴν ὑπόγειον καὶ ἔλαβεν ἐκεῖθεν παλαιὰ ῥάκη καὶ παλαιὰ σχοινία καὶ ἔρριψεν αὐτὰ πρὸς Ιερεμιαν εἰς τὸν λάκκον

text_en: And Abdemelech the Ethiopian said to Jeremias: Put these old rags and these rent and rotten things under your arms, and upon the cords: and Jeremias did so.
text_la: Dixitque Abdemelech Æthiops ad Jeremiam : Pone veteres pannos, et hæc scissa et putrida, sub cubito manuum tuarum, et super funes. Fecit ergo Jeremias sic,
text_pt: E disse Ebede-Meleque, o etíope, a Jeremias: Põe agora estes trapos velhos e rotos, já apodrecidos, nas axilas, calçando as cordas. E Jeremias assim o fez.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν ταῦτα θὲς ὑποκάτω τῶν σχοινίων καὶ ἐποίησεν Ιερεμιας οὕτως

text_en: And they drew up Jeremias with the cords, and brought him forth out of the dungeon. And Jeremias remained in the entry of the prison .
text_la: et extraxerunt Jeremiam funibus, et eduxerunt eum de lacu : mansit autem Jeremias in vestibulo carceris.
text_pt: E puxaram a Jeremias com as cordas, e o alçaram da cisterna; e ficou Jeremias no átrio da guarda.
text_el: καὶ εἵλκυσαν αὐτὸν τοῖς σχοινίοις καὶ ἀνήγαγον αὐτὸν ἐκ τοῦ λάκκου καὶ ἐκάθισεν Ιερεμιας ἐν τῇ αὐλῇ τῆς φυλακῆς

text_en: And King Sedecias sent, and took Jeremiah the prophet to him to the third gate, that was in the house of the Lord : and the king said to Jeremias: I will ask you a thing, hide nothing from me.
text_la: Et misit rex Sedecias, et tulit ad se Jeremiam prophetam ad ostium tertium quod erat in domo Domini : et dixit rex ad Jeremiam : Interrogo ego te sermonem, ne abscondas a me aliquid.
text_pt: Então o rei Zedequias mandou trazer à sua presença Jeremias, o profeta, à terceira entrada da casa do Senhor; e disse o rei a Jeremias: Pergunto-te uma coisa, não me encubras nada.
text_el: καὶ ἀπέστειλεν ὁ βασιλεὺς καὶ ἐκάλεσεν αὐτὸν πρὸς ἑαυτὸν εἰς οἰκίαν ασελισι τὴν ἐν οἴκῳ κυρίου καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ ὁ βασιλεύς ἐρωτήσω σε λόγον καὶ μὴ δὴ κρύψῃς ἀπ' ἐμοῦ ῥῆμα

text_en: Then Jeremias said to Sedecias: If I shall declare it to you, will you not put me to death? And if I give you counsel, you will not hearken to me.
text_la: Dixit autem Jeremias ad Sedeciam : Si annuntiavero tibi, numquid non interficies me? et si consilium dedero tibi, non me audies.
text_pt: E disse Jeremias a Zedequias: Se eu te declarar, porventura não me matarás? E se eu te aconselhar, não me ouvirás?
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Ιερεμιας τῷ βασιλεῖ ἐὰν ἀναγγείλω σοι οὐχὶ θανάτῳ με θανατώσεις καὶ ἐὰν συμβουλεύσω σοι οὐ μὴ ἀκούσῃς μου

text_en: Then King Sedecias swore to Jeremias, in private, saying: As the Lord lives, that, made us this soul , I will not put you to death, nor will I deliver you into the hands of these men that seek your life.
text_la: Juravit ergo rex Sedecias Jeremiæ clam, dicens : Vivit Dominus, qui fecit nobis animam hanc, si occidero te, et si tradidero te in manus virorum istorum qui quærunt animam tuam.
text_pt: Então jurou o rei Zedequias a Jeremias, em segredo, dizendo: Vive o Senhor, que nos fez esta alma, que não te matarei nem te entregarei na mão destes homens que procuram a tua morte.
text_el: καὶ ὤμοσεν αὐτῷ ὁ βασιλεὺς λέγων ζῇ κύριος ὃς ἐποίησεν ἡμῖν τὴν ψυχὴν ταύτην εἰ ἀποκτενῶ σε καὶ εἰ δώσω σε εἰς χεῖρας τῶν ἀνθρώπων τούτων

text_en: And Jeremias said to Sedecias: Thus says the Lord of hosts the God of Israel : If you will take a resolution and go out to the princes of the king of Babylon , your soul shall live, and this city shall not be burnt with fire: and you shall be safe, and your house.
text_la: Et dixit Jeremias ad Sedeciam : Hæc dicit Dominus exercituum, Deus Israël : Si profectus exieris ad principes regis Babylonis, vivet anima tua, et civitas hæc non succendetur igni : et salvus eris tu, et domus tua.
text_pt: Então Jeremias disse a Zedequias: Assim diz o SENHOR, Deus dos Exércitos, Deus de Israel: Se voluntariamente saíres aos príncipes do rei de babilônia, então viverá a tua alma, e esta cidade não se queimará a fogo, e viverás tu e a tua casa.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ Ιερεμιας οὕτως εἶπεν κύριος ἐὰν ἐξελθὼν ἐξέλθῃς πρὸς ἡγεμόνας βασιλέως Βαβυλῶνος καὶ ζήσεται ἡ ψυχή σου καὶ ἡ πόλις αὕτη οὐ μὴ κατακαυθῇ ἐν πυρί καὶ ζήσῃ σὺ καὶ ἡ οἰκία σου

text_en: But if you will not go out to the princes of the king of Babylon , this city shall be delivered into the hands of the Chaldeans, and they shall burn it with fire: and you shall not escape out of their hand.
text_la: Si autem non exieris ad principes regis Babylonis, tradetur civitas hæc in manus Chaldæorum, et succendent eam igni : et tu non effugies de manu eorum.
text_pt: Mas, se não saíres aos príncipes do rei de babilônia, então será entregue esta cidade na mão dos caldeus, e queimá-la-ão a fogo, e tu não escaparás da mão deles.
text_el: καὶ ἐὰν μὴ ἐξέλθῃς δοθήσεται ἡ πόλις αὕτη εἰς χεῖρας τῶν Χαλδαίων καὶ καύσουσιν αὐτὴν ἐν πυρί καὶ σὺ οὐ μὴ σωθῇς

text_en: And King Sedecias said to Jeremias: I am afraid because of the Jews that are fled over to the Chaldeans: lest I should be delivered into their hands, and they should abuse me.
text_la: Et dixit rex Sedecias ad Jeremiam : Sollicitus sum propter Judæos qui transfugerunt ad Chaldæos, ne forte tradar in manus eorum, et illudant mihi.
text_pt: E disse o rei Zedequias a Jeremias: Receio-me dos judeus, que se passaram para os caldeus; que estes me entreguem na mão deles, e escarneçam de mim.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν ὁ βασιλεὺς τῷ Ιερεμια ἐγὼ λόγον ἔχω τῶν Ιουδαίων τῶν πεφευγότων πρὸς τοὺς Χαλδαίους μὴ δώσειν με εἰς χεῖρας αὐτῶν καὶ καταμωκήσονταί μου

text_en: But Jeremias answered: They shall not deliver you: hearken, I beseech you, to the word of the Lord , which I speak to you, and it shall be well with you, and your soul shall live.
text_la: Respondit autem Jeremias : Non te tradent. Audi, quæso, vocem Domini, quam ego loquor ad te, et bene tibi erit, et vivet anima tua.
text_pt: E disse Jeremias: Não te entregarão; ouve, peço-te, a voz do Senhor, conforme a qual eu te falo; e bem te irá, e viverá a tua alma.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Ιερεμιας οὐ μὴ παραδῶσίν σε ἄκουσον τὸν λόγον κυρίου ὃν ἐγὼ λέγω πρὸς σέ καὶ βέλτιον ἔσται σοι καὶ ζήσεται ἡ ψυχή σου

text_en: But if you will not go forth, this is the word which the Lord has shown me:
text_la: Quod si nolueris egredi, iste est sermo quem ostendit mihi Dominus:
text_pt: Mas, se tu não quiseres sair, esta é a palavra que me mostrou o Senhor:
text_el: καὶ εἰ μὴ θέλεις σὺ ἐξελθεῖν οὗτος ὁ λόγος ὃν ἔδειξέν μοι κύριος

text_en: Behold all the women that are left in the house of the king of Juda , shall be brought out to the princes of the king of Babylon : and they shall say: Your men of peace have deceived you, and have prevailed against you, they have plunged your feet in the mire, and in a slippery place and they have departed from you.
text_la: ecce omnes mulieres quæ remanserunt in domo regis Juda educentur ad principes regis Babylonis, et ipsæ dicent : Seduxerunt te, et prævaluerunt adversum te, viri pacifici tui : demerserunt in cœno et in lubrico pedes tuos, et recesserunt a te.
text_pt: Eis que todas as mulheres que ficaram na casa do rei de Judá serão levadas aos príncipes do rei de babilônia, e elas mesmas dirão: Teus pacificadores te incitaram e prevaleceram contra ti, mas agora que se atolaram os teus pés na lama, voltaram atrás.
text_el: καὶ ἰδοὺ πᾶσαι αἱ γυναῖκες αἱ καταλειφθεῖσαι ἐν οἰκίᾳ βασιλέως Ιουδα ἐξήγοντο πρὸς ἄρχοντας βασιλέως Βαβυλῶνος καὶ αὗται ἔλεγον ἠπάτησάν σε καὶ δυνήσονταί σοι ἄνδρες εἰρηνικοί σου καὶ καταλύσουσιν ἐν ὀλισθήμασιν πόδας σου ἀπέστρεψαν ἀπὸ σοῦ

text_en: And all your wives, and your children shall be brought out to the Chaldeans, and you shall not escape their hands, but you shall be taken by the hand of the king of Babylon : and he shall burn this city with fire.
text_la: Et omnes uxores tuæ et filii tui educentur ad Chaldæos : et non effugies manus eorum, sed in manu regis Babylonis capieris, et civitatem hanc comburet igni.
text_pt: Assim que a todas as tuas mulheres e a teus filhos levarão aos caldeus, e nem tu escaparás da sua mão, antes pela mão do rei de babilônia serás preso, e esta cidade será queimada a fogo.
text_el: καὶ τὰς γυναῖκάς σου καὶ τὰ τέκνα σου ἐξάξουσιν πρὸς τοὺς Χαλδαίους καὶ σὺ οὐ μὴ σωθῇς ὅτι ἐν χειρὶ βασιλέως Βαβυλῶνος συλλημφθήσῃ καὶ ἡ πόλις αὕτη κατακαυθήσεται

text_en: Then Sedecias said to Jeremias: Let no man know these words, and you shall not die.
text_la: Dixit ergo Sedecias ad Jeremiam : Nullus sciat verba hæc, et non morieris.
text_pt: Então disse Zedequias a Jeremias: Ninguém saiba estas palavras, e não morrerás.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ ὁ βασιλεύς ἄνθρωπος μὴ γνώτω ἐκ τῶν λόγων τούτων καὶ σὺ οὐ μὴ ἀποθάνῃς

text_en: But if the princes shall hear that I have spoken with you, and shall come to you, and say to you: Tell us what you have said to the king, hide it not from us, and we will not kill you: and also what the king said to you:
text_la: Si autem audierint principes quia locutus sum tecum, et venerint ad te, et dixerint tibi : Indica nobis quid locutus sis cum rege : ne celes nos, et non te interficiemus : et quid locutus est tecum rex:
text_pt: E quando os príncipes, ouvindo que falei contigo, vierem a ti, e te disserem: Declara-nos agora o que disseste ao rei e o que ele te disse, não no-lo encubras, e não te mataremos;
text_el: καὶ ἐὰν ἀκούσωσιν οἱ ἄρχοντες ὅτι ἐλάλησά σοι καὶ ἔλθωσιν πρὸς σὲ καὶ εἴπωσίν σοι ἀνάγγειλον ἡμῖν τί ἐλάλησέν σοι ὁ βασιλεύς μὴ κρύψῃς ἀφ' ἡμῶν καὶ οὐ μὴ ἀνέλωμέν σε καὶ τί ἐλάλησεν πρὸς σὲ ὁ βασιλεύς

text_en: You shall say to them: I presented my supplication before the king, that he would not command me to be carried back into the house of Jonathan , to die there.
text_la: dices ad eos : Prostravi ego preces meas coram rege, ne me reduci juberet in domum Jonathan, et ibi morerer.
text_pt: Então lhes dirás: Eu lancei a minha súplica diante do rei, que não me fizesse tornar à casa de Jônatas, para morrer ali.
text_el: καὶ ἐρεῖς αὐτοῖς ῥίπτω ἐγὼ τὸ ἔλεός μου κατ' ὀφθαλμοὺς τοῦ βασιλέως πρὸς τὸ μὴ ἀποστρέψαι με εἰς οἰκίαν Ιωναθαν ἀποθανεῖν ἐκεῖ

text_en: So all the princes came to Jeremias, and asked him: and he spoke to them according to all the words that the king had commanded him: and they left him: for nothing had been heard.
text_la: Venerunt ergo omnes principes ad Jeremiam, et interrogaverunt eum, et locutus est eis juxta omnia verba quæ præceperat ei rex : et cessaverunt ab eo : nihil enim fuerat auditum.
text_pt: Vindo, pois, todos os príncipes a Jeremias, e interrogando-o, declarou-lhes todas as palavras que o rei lhe havia ordenado; e calados o deixaram, porque o assunto não foi revelado.
text_el: καὶ ἤλθοσαν πάντες οἱ ἄρχοντες πρὸς Ιερεμιαν καὶ ἠρώτησαν αὐτόν καὶ ἀνήγγειλεν αὐτοῖς κατὰ πάντας τοὺς λόγους τούτους οὓς ἐνετείλατο αὐτῷ ὁ βασιλεύς καὶ ἀπεσιώπησαν ὅτι οὐκ ἠκούσθη λόγος κυρίου

text_en: But Jeremias remained in the entry of the prison , until the day that Jerusalem was taken: and it came to pass that Jerusalem was taken.
text_la: Mansit vero Jeremias in vestibulo carceris usque ad diem quo capta est Jerusalem: et factum est ut caperetur Jerusalem.
text_pt: E ficou Jeremias no átrio da guarda, até o dia em que Jerusalém foi tomada, e ainda ali estava quando Jerusalém foi tomada.
text_el: καὶ ἐκάθισεν Ιερεμιας ἐν τῇ αὐλῇ τῆς φυλακῆς ἕως χρόνου οὗ συνελήμφθη Ιερουσαλημ

text_en: In the ninth year of Sedecias king of Juda , in the tenth month, came Nabuchodonosor king of Babylon , and all his army to Jerusalem , and they besieged it.
text_la: Anno nono Sedeciæ regis Juda, mense decimo, venit Nabuchodonosor rex Babylonis, et omnis exercitus ejus, ad Jerusalem, et obsidebant eam.
text_pt: No ano nono de Zedequias, rei de Judá, no décimo mês, veio Nabucodonosor, rei de babilônia, e todo o seu exército, contra Jerusalém, e a cercaram.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο ἐν τῷ ἔτει τῷ ἐνάτῳ τοῦ Σεδεκια βασιλέως Ιουδα ἐν τῷ μηνὶ τῷ δεκάτῳ παρεγένετο Ναβουχοδονοσορ βασιλεὺς Βαβυλῶνος καὶ πᾶσα ἡ δύναμις αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ Ιερουσαλημ καὶ ἐπολιόρκουν αὐτήν

text_en: And in the eleventh year of Sedecias, in the fourth month, the fifth day of the month, the city was opened.
text_la: Undecimo autem anno Sedeciæ, mense quarto, quinta mensis, aperta est civitas:
text_pt: No ano undécimo de Zedequias, no quarto mês, aos nove do mês, fez-se uma brecha na cidade.
text_el: καὶ ἐν τῷ ἑνδεκάτῳ ἔτει τοῦ Σεδεκια ἐν τῷ μηνὶ τῷ τετάρτῳ ἐνάτῃ τοῦ μηνὸς ἐρράγη ἡ πόλις

text_en: And all the princes of the king of Babylon came in, and sat in the middle gate: Neregel, Sereser, Semegarnabu, Sarsachim, Rabsares, Neregel, Serezer, Rebmag, and all the rest of the princes of the king of Babylon .
text_la: et ingressi sunt omnes principes regis Babylonis, et sederunt in porta media : Neregel, Sereser, Semegarnabu, Sarsachim, Rabsares, Neregel, Sereser, Rebmag, et omnes reliqui principes regis Babylonis.
text_pt: Entraram nela todos os príncipes do rei de babilônia, e pararam na porta do meio, a saber: Nergal-Sarezer, Sangar-Nebo, Sarsequim, Rabe-Saris, Nergal-Sarezer, Rabe-Mague, e todos os outros príncipes do rei de babilônia.
text_el: καὶ εἰσῆλθον πάντες οἱ ἡγεμόνες βασιλέως Βαβυλῶνος καὶ ἐκάθισαν ἐν πύλῃ τῇ μέσῃ Ναργαλασαρ καὶ Σαμαγωθ καὶ Ναβουσαχαρ καὶ Ναβουσαρις καὶ Ναγαργασνασερ Ραβαμαγ καὶ οἱ κατάλοιποι ἡγεμόνες βασιλέως Βαβυλῶνος

text_en: And when Sedecias the king of Juda and all the men of war saw them, they fled: and they went forth in the night out of the city by the way of the king's garden, and by the gate that was between the two walls, and they went out to the way of the desert .
text_la: Cumque vidisset eos Sedecias rex Juda, et omnes viri bellatores, fugerunt : et egressi sunt nocte de civitate per viam horti regis, et per portam quæ erat inter duos muros, et egressi sunt ad viam deserti.
text_pt: E sucedeu que, vendo-os Zedequias, rei de Judá, e todos os homens de guerra, fugiram, saindo de noite da cidade, pelo caminho do jardim do rei, pela porta que está entre os dois muros; e seguiram pelo caminho da campina.

text_en: But the army of the Chaldeans pursued after them: and they took Sedecias in the plain of the desert of Jericho , and when they had taken him, they brought him to Nabuchodonosor king of Babylon to Reblatha, which is in the land of Emath: and he gave judgment upon him.
text_la: Persecutus est autem eos exercitus Chaldæorum, et comprehenderunt Sedeciam in campo solitudinis Jerichontinæ, et captum adduxerunt ad Nabuchodonosor regem Babylonis, in Reblatha, quæ est in terra Emath : et locutus est ad eum judicia.
text_pt: Mas o exército dos caldeus os perseguiu, e alcançou a Zedequias nas campinas de Jericó; e eles o prenderam, e fizeram-no subir a Nabucodonosor, rei de babilônia, a Ribla, na terra de Hamate, e o rei o sentenciou.

text_en: And the king of Babylon slew the sons of Sedecias, in Reblatha, before his eyes: and the king of Babylon slew all the nobles of Juda .
text_la: Et occidit rex Babylonis filios Sedeciæ in Reblatha, in oculis ejus : et omnes nobiles Juda occidit rex Babylonis.
text_pt: E o rei de babilônia matou em Ribla os filhos de Zedequias, diante dos seus olhos; também matou o rei de babilônia a todos os nobres de Judá.

text_en: He also put out the eyes of Sedecias: and bound him with fetters, to be carried to Babylon .
text_la: Oculos quoque Sedeciæ eruit, et vinxit eum compedibus ut duceretur in Babylonem.
text_pt: E cegou os olhos de Zedequias, e o atou com duas cadeias de bronze, para levá-lo a babilônia.

text_en: And the Chaldeans burnt the king's house, and the houses of the people with fire, and they threw down the wall of Jerusalem .
text_la: Domum quoque regis et domum vulgi succenderunt Chaldæi igni, et murum Jerusalem subverterunt.
text_pt: E os caldeus incendiaram a casa do rei e as casas do povo, e derrubaram os muros de Jerusalém.

text_en: And Nabuzardan the general of the army carried away captive to Babylon the remnant of the people that remained in the city, and the fugitives that had gone over to him, and the rest of the people that remained.
text_la: Et reliquias populi qui remanserant in civitate, et perfugas qui transfugerant ad eum, et superfluos vulgi qui remanserant, transtulit Nabuzardan, magister militum, in Babylonem.
text_pt: E o restante do povo, que ficou na cidade, e os desertores que se tinham passado para ele, e o restante do povo que ficou, Nebuzaradã, capitão da guarda, levou cativo para a babilônia.

text_en: But Nabuzardan the general left some of the poor people that had nothing at all, in the land of Juda , and he gave them vineyards, and cisterns at that time.
text_la: Et de plebe pauperum, qui nihil penitus habebant, dimisit Nabuzardan magister militum in terra Juda, et dedit eis vineas et cisternas in die illa.
text_pt: Porém os pobres dentre o povo, que não tinham nada, Nebuzaradã, capitão da guarda, deixou na terra de Judá; e deu-lhes vinhas e campos naquele dia.

text_en: Now Nabuchodonosor king of Babylon had given charge to Nabuzardan the general concerning Jeremias, saying:
text_la: Præceperat autem Nabuchodonosor rex Babylonis de Jeremia Nabuzardan magistro militum, dicens:
text_pt: Mas Nabucodonosor, rei de babilônia, havia ordenado acerca de Jeremias, a Nebuzaradã, capitão da guarda, dizendo:

text_en: Take him, and set your eyes upon him, and do him no harm: but as he has a mind, so do with him.
text_la: Tolle illum, et pone super eum oculos tuos, nihilque ei mali facias : sed ut voluerit, sic facias ei.
text_pt: Toma-o, e põe sobre ele os teus olhos, e não lhe faças nenhum mal; antes como ele te disser, assim procederás com ele.

text_en: Therefore Nabuzardan the general sent, and Nabuzardan, and Rabsares, and Neregel, and Sereser, and Rebmag, and all the nobles of the king of Babylon ,
text_la: Misit ergo Nabuzardan princeps militiæ, et Nabusezban, et Rabsares, et Neregel, et Sereser, et Rebmag, et omnes optimates regis Babylonis,
text_pt: Por isso mandou Nebuzaradã, capitão da guarda, e Nebusazbã, Rabe-Saris, Nergal-Sarezer, Rabe-Mague, e todos os príncipes do rei de babilônia,

text_en: sent and took Jeremias out of the court of the prison , and committed him to Godolias the son of Ahicam the son of Saphan , that he might go home, and dwell among the people.
text_la: miserunt, et tulerunt Jeremiam de vestibulo carceris, et tradiderunt eum Godoliæ filio Ahicam filii Saphan, ut intraret in domum, et habitaret in populo.
text_pt: Mandaram retirar a Jeremias do átrio da guarda, e o entregaram a Gedalias, filho de Aicão, filho de Safã, para que o levassem à casa; e ele habitou entre o povo.
text_el: καὶ ἀπέστειλαν καὶ ἔλαβον τὸν Ιερεμιαν ἐξ αὐλῆς τῆς φυλακῆς καὶ ἔδωκαν αὐτὸν πρὸς τὸν Γοδολιαν υἱὸν Αχικαμ υἱοῦ Σαφαν καὶ ἐξήγαγον αὐτόν καὶ ἐκάθισεν ἐν μέσῳ τοῦ λαοῦ

text_en: But the word of the Lord came to Jeremias, when he was yet shut up in the court of the prison , saying: Go, and tell Abdemelech the Ethiopian , saying:
text_la: Ad Jeremiam autem factus fuerat sermo Domini, cum clausus esset in vestibulo carceris, dicens:
text_pt: Ora, tinha vindo a Jeremias a palavra do Senhor, estando ele ainda encarcerado no átrio da guarda, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ πρὸς Ιερεμιαν ἐγένετο λόγος κυρίου ἐν τῇ αὐλῇ τῆς φυλακῆς λέγων

text_en: Thus says the Lord of hosts the God of Israel : Behold I will bring my words upon this city unto evil , and not unto good : and they shall be accomplished in your sight in that day.
text_la: Vade, et dic Abdemelech Æthiopi, dicens : Hæc dicit Dominus exercituum, Deus Israël : Ecce ego inducam sermones meos super civitatem hanc in malum, et non in bonum, et erunt in conspectu tuo in die illa.
text_pt: Vai, e fala a Ebede-Meleque, o etíope, dizendo: Assim diz o Senhor dos Exércitos, Deus de Israel: Eis que eu trarei as minhas palavras sobre esta cidade para mal e não para bem; e cumprir-se-ão diante de ti naquele dia.
text_el: πορεύου καὶ εἰπὸν πρὸς Αβδεμελεχ τὸν Αἰθίοπα οὕτως εἶπεν κύριος ὁ θεὸς Ισραηλ ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ φέρω τοὺς λόγους μου ἐπὶ τὴν πόλιν ταύτην εἰς κακὰ καὶ οὐκ εἰς ἀγαθά

text_en: And I will deliver you in that day, says the Lord : and you shall not be given into the hands of the men whom you fear:
text_la: Et liberabo te in die illa, ait Dominus, et non traderis in manus virorum quos tu formidas:
text_pt: A ti, porém, eu livrarei naquele dia, diz o Senhor, e não serás entregue na mão dos homens, a quem temes.
text_el: καὶ σώσω σε ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐκείνῃ καὶ οὐ μὴ δώσω σε εἰς χεῖρας τῶν ἀνθρώπων ὧν σὺ φοβῇ ἀπὸ προσώπου αὐτῶν

text_en: But delivering, I will deliver you, and you shall not fall by the sword: but your life shall be saved for you, because you have put your trust in me, says the Lord .
text_la: sed eruens liberabo te, et gladio non cades, sed erit tibi anima tua in salutem, quia in me habuisti fiduciam, ait Dominus.
text_pt: Porque certamente te livrarei, e não cairás à espada; mas a tua alma terás por despojo, porquanto confiaste em mim, diz o Senhor.
text_el: ὅτι σῴζων σώσω σε καὶ ἐν ῥομφαίᾳ οὐ μὴ πέσῃς καὶ ἔσται ἡ ψυχή σου εἰς εὕρεμα ὅτι ἐπεποίθεις ἐπ' ἐμοί φησὶν κύριος

text_en: The word that came to Jeremias from the Lord , after that Nabuzardan the general had let him go from Rama, when he had taken him, being bound with chains, among all them that were carried away from Jerusalem and Juda , and were carried to Babylon .
text_la: Sermo qui factus est ad Jeremiam a Domino, postquam dimissus est a Nabuzardan magistro militiæ de Rama, quando tulit eum vinctum catenis in medio omnium qui migrabant de Jerusalem et Juda, et ducebantur in Babylonem.
text_pt: A palavra que veio a Jeremias da parte do SENHOR, depois que Nebuzaradã, capitão da guarda, o deixara ir de Ramá, quando o tomou, estando ele atado com cadeias no meio de todos os do cativeiro de Jerusalém e de Judá, que foram levados cativos para babilônia.
text_el: ὁ λόγος ὁ γενόμενος παρὰ κυρίου πρὸς Ιερεμιαν ὕστερον μετὰ τὸ ἀποστεῖλαι αὐτὸν Ναβουζαρδαν τὸν ἀρχιμάγειρον τὸν ἐκ Δαμαν ἐν τῷ λαβεῖν αὐτὸν ἐν χειροπέδαις ἐν μέσῳ ἀποικίας Ιουδα τῶν ἠγμένων εἰς Βαβυλῶνα

text_en: And the general of the army taking Jeremias, said to him: The Lord your God has pronounced this evil upon this place,
text_la: Tollens ergo princeps militiæ Jeremiam, dixit ad eum : Dominus Deus tuus locutus est malum hoc super locum istum:
text_pt: Tomou o capitão da guarda a Jeremias, e disse-lhe: O Senhor teu Deus pronunciou este mal, contra este lugar.
text_el: καὶ ἔλαβεν αὐτὸν ὁ ἀρχιμάγειρος καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ κύριος ὁ θεός σου ἐλάλησεν τὰ κακὰ ταῦτα ἐπὶ τὸν τόπον τοῦτον

text_en: and he has brought it: and the Lord has done as he has said: because you have sinned against the Lord , and have not hearkened to his voice, and this word has come upon you.
text_la: et adduxit, et fecit Dominus sicut locutus est, quia peccastis Domino, et non audistis vocem ejus : et factus est vobis sermo hic.
text_pt: E o Senhor o trouxe, e fez como havia falado; porque pecastes contra o Senhor, e não obedecestes à sua voz, portanto vos sucedeu isto.
text_el: καὶ ἐποίησεν κύριος ὅτι ἡμάρτετε αὐτῷ καὶ οὐκ ἠκούσατε αὐτοῦ τῆς φωνῆς

text_en: Now then behold I have loosed you this day from the chains which were upon your hands: if it please you to come with me to Babylon , come: and I will set my eyes upon you: but if it do not please you to come with me to Babylon , stay here: behold all the land is before you, as you shall choose, and whither it shall please you to go, thither go.
text_la: Nunc ergo ecce solvi te hodie de catenis quæ sunt in manibus tuis : si placet tibi ut venias mecum in Babylonem, veni, et ponam oculos meos super te : si autem displicet tibi venire mecum in Babylonem, reside : ecce omnis terra in conspectu tuo est : quod elegeris, et quo placuerit tibi ut vadas, illuc perge:
text_pt: Agora, pois, eis que te soltei hoje das cadeias que estavam sobre as tuas mãos. Se te apraz vir comigo para babilônia, vem, e eu cuidarei de ti, mas se não te apraz vir comigo para babilônia, deixa de vir. Olha, toda a terra está diante de ti; para onde parecer bom e reto aos teus olhos ir, para ali vai.
text_el: ἰδοὺ ἔλυσά σε ἀπὸ τῶν χειροπέδων τῶν ἐπὶ τὰς χεῖράς σου εἰ καλὸν ἐναντίον σου ἐλθεῖν μετ' ἐμοῦ εἰς Βαβυλῶνα ἧκε καὶ θήσω τοὺς ὀφθαλμούς μου ἐπὶ σέ

text_en: And come not with me: but dwell with Godolias the son of Ahicam the son of Saphan , whom the king of Babylon has made governor over the cities of Juda : dwell therefore with him in the midst of the people: or wherever it shall please you to go, go. And the general of the army gave him victuals and presents, and let him go.
text_la: et mecum noli venire, sed habita apud Godoliam filium Ahicam filii Saphan, quem præposuit rex Babylonis civitatibus Juda : habita ergo cum eo in medio populi : vel quocumque placuerit tibi ut vadas, vade. Dedit quoque ei magister militiæ cibaria et munuscula, et dimisit eum.
text_pt: Mas, como ele ainda não tinha voltado, disse-lhe: Volta a Gedalias, filho de Aicão, filho de Safã, a quem o rei de babilônia pôs sobre as cidades de Judá, e habita com ele no meio do povo; ou se para qualquer outra parte te aprouver ir, vai. E deu-lhe o capitão da guarda sustento para o caminho, e um presente, e o deixou ir.
text_el: εἰ δὲ μή ἀπότρεχε καὶ ἀνάστρεψον πρὸς Γοδολιαν υἱὸν Αχικαμ υἱοῦ Σαφαν ὃν κατέστησεν βασιλεὺς Βαβυλῶνος ἐν γῇ Ιουδα καὶ οἴκησον μετ' αὐτοῦ ἐν μέσῳ τοῦ λαοῦ ἐν γῇ Ιουδα εἰς ἅπαντα τὰ ἀγαθὰ ἐν ὀφθαλμοῖς σου τοῦ πορευθῆναι πορεύου καὶ ἔδωκεν αὐτῷ ὁ ἀρχιμάγειρος δῶρα καὶ ἀπέστειλεν αὐτόν

text_en: And Jeremias went to Godolias the son of Ahicam to Masphath : and dwelt with him in the midst of the people that were left in the land.
text_la: Venit autem Jeremias ad Godoliam filium Ahicam in Masphath, et habitavit cum eo in medio populi qui relictus fuerat in terra.
text_pt: Assim veio Jeremias a Gedalias, filho de Aicão, a Mizpá; e habitou com ele no meio do povo que havia ficado na terra.
text_el: καὶ ἦλθεν πρὸς Γοδολιαν εἰς Μασσηφα καὶ ἐκάθισεν ἐν μέσῳ τοῦ λαοῦ τοῦ καταλειφθέντος ἐν τῇ γῇ

text_en: And when all the captains of the army that were scattered through the countries, they and their companions, had heard that the king of Babylon had made Godolias the son of Ahicam governor of the country, and that he had committed unto him men and women , and children, and of the poor of the land, them that had not been carried away captive to Babylon :
text_la: Cumque audissent omnes principes exercitus, qui dispersi fuerant per regiones, ipsi et socii eorum, quod præfecisset rex Babylonis Godoliam filium Ahicam terræ, et quod commendasset ei viros, et mulieres, et parvulos, et de pauperibus terræ, qui non fuerant translati in Babylonem,
text_pt: Ouvindo, pois, todos os capitães dos exércitos, que estavam no campo, eles e os seus homens, que o rei de babilônia tinha nomeado a Gedalias, filho de Aicão, governador da terra, e que lhe havia confiado os homens, e as mulheres, e os meninos, e os mais pobres da terra, que não foram levados cativos a babilônia,
text_el: καὶ ἤκουσαν πάντες οἱ ἡγεμόνες τῆς δυνάμεως τῆς ἐν ἀγρῷ αὐτοὶ καὶ οἱ ἄνδρες αὐτῶν ὅτι κατέστησεν βασιλεὺς Βαβυλῶνος τὸν Γοδολιαν ἐν τῇ γῇ καὶ παρεκατέθετο αὐτῷ ἄνδρας καὶ γυναῖκας αὐτῶν οὓς οὐκ ἀπῴκισεν εἰς Βαβυλῶνα

text_en: They came to Godolias to Masphath : and Ismahel the son of Nathanias, and Johanan, and Jonathan , the sons of Caree, and Sareas the son of Thanehumeth, and the children of Ophi, that were of Netophathi, and Jezonias the son of Maachati, they and their men .
text_la: venerunt ad Godoliam in Masphath, et Ismahel filius Nathaniæ, et Johanan et Jonathan filii Caree, et Sareas filius Thanehumeth, et filii Ophi, qui erant de Netophathi, et Jezonias filius Maachathi, ipsi et viri eorum.
text_pt: Vieram ter com Gedalias, a Mizpá; a saber: Ismael, filho de Netanias, e Joanã e Jônatas, filhos de Careá, e Seraías, filho de Tanumete, e os filhos de Efai, o netofatita, e Jezanias, filho de um maacatita, eles e os seus homens.
text_el: καὶ ἦλθεν πρὸς Γοδολιαν εἰς Μασσηφα Ισμαηλ υἱὸς Ναθανιου καὶ Ιωαναν υἱὸς Καρηε καὶ Σαραιας υἱὸς Θαναεμεθ καὶ υἱοὶ Ωφε τοῦ Νετωφατι καὶ Ιεζονιας υἱὸς τοῦ Μοχατι αὐτοὶ καὶ οἱ ἄνδρες αὐτῶν

text_en: And Godolias the son of Ahicam the son of Saphan swore to them and to their companions, saying: Fear not to serve the Chaldeans: dwell in the land, and serve the king of Babylon , and it shall be well with you.
text_la: Et juravit eis Godolias filius Ahicam filii Saphan, et comitibus eorum, dicens : Nolite timere servire Chaldæis : habitate in terra, et servite regi Babylonis, et bene erit vobis.
text_pt: E jurou Gedalias, filho de Aicão, filho de Safã, a eles e aos seus homens, dizendo: Não temais servir aos caldeus; ficai na terra, e servi o rei de babilônia, e bem vos irá.
text_el: καὶ ὤμοσεν αὐτοῖς Γοδολιας καὶ τοῖς ἀνδράσιν αὐτῶν λέγων μὴ φοβηθῆτε ἀπὸ προσώπου τῶν παίδων τῶν Χαλδαίων κατοικήσατε ἐν τῇ γῇ καὶ ἐργάσασθε τῷ βασιλεῖ Βαβυλῶνος καὶ βέλτιον ἔσται ὑμῖν

text_en: Behold I dwell in Masphath , that I may answer the commandment of the Chaldeans that are sent to us: but as for you, gather the vintage, and the harvest, and the oil, and lay it up in your vessels, and abide in your cities which you hold.
text_la: Ecce ego habito in Masphath, ut respondeam præcepto Chaldæorum qui mittuntur ad nos : vos autem colligite vindemiam, et messem, et oleum, et condite in vasis vestris, et manete in urbibus vestris quas tenetis.
text_pt: Quanto a mim, eis que habito em Mizpá, para estar às ordens dos caldeus que vierem a nós; e vós recolhei o vinho, e as frutas de verão, e o azeite, e colocai-os nos vossos vasos, e habitai nas vossas cidades, que tomastes.
text_el: καὶ ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ κάθημαι ἐναντίον ὑμῶν εἰς Μασσηφα στῆναι κατὰ πρόσωπον τῶν Χαλδαίων οἳ ἂν ἔλθωσιν ἐφ' ὑμᾶς καὶ ὑμεῖς συναγάγετε οἶνον καὶ ὀπώραν καὶ συναγάγετε ἔλαιον καὶ βάλετε εἰς τὰ ἀγγεῖα ὑμῶν καὶ οἰκήσατε ἐν ταῖς πόλεσιν αἷς κατεκρατήσατε

text_en: Moreover all the Jews that were in Moab , and among the children of Ammon , and in Edom , and in all the countries, when they heard that the king of Babylon had left a remnant in Judea , and that he had made Godolias the son of Ahicam the son of Saphan ruler over them:
text_la: Sed et omnes Judæi qui erant in Moab, et in filiis Ammon, et in Idumæa, et in universis regionibus, audito quod dedisset rex Babylonis reliquias in Judæa, et quod præposuisset super eos Godoliam filium Ahicam filii Saphan,
text_pt: Do mesmo modo todos os judeus que estavam em Moabe, e entre os filhos de Amom, e em Edom, e os que havia em todas aquelas terras, ouviram que o rei de babilônia havia deixado alguns em Judá, e que havia posto sobre eles a Gedalias, filho de Aicão, filho de Safã,
text_el: καὶ πάντες οἱ Ιουδαῖοι οἱ ἐν γῇ Μωαβ καὶ ἐν υἱοῖς Αμμων καὶ οἱ ἐν τῇ Ιδουμαίᾳ καὶ οἱ ἐν πάσῃ τῇ γῇ ἤκουσαν ὅτι ἔδωκεν βασιλεὺς Βαβυλῶνος κατάλειμμα τῷ Ιουδα καὶ ὅτι κατέστησεν ἐπ' αὐτοὺς τὸν Γοδολιαν υἱὸν Αχικαμ

text_en: All the Jews , I say, returned out of all the places to which they had fled, and they came into the land of Juda to Godolias to Masphath : and they gathered wine, and a very great harvest.
text_la: reversi sunt, inquam, omnes Judæi de universis locis ad quæ profugerant, et venerunt in terram Juda ad Godoliam in Masphath, et collegerunt vinum et messem multam nimis.
text_pt: Então voltaram todos os judeus de todos os lugares, para onde foram lançados, e vieram à terra de Judá, a Gedalias, a Mizpá; e recolheram vinho e frutas do verão com muita abundância.
text_el: καὶ ἦλθον πρὸς Γοδολιαν εἰς γῆν Ιουδα εἰς Μασσηφα καὶ συνήγαγον οἶνον καὶ ὀπώραν πολλὴν σφόδρα καὶ ἔλαιον

text_en: Then Johanan the son of Caree, and all the captains of the army, that had been scattered about in the countries, came to Godolias to Masphath .
text_la: Johanan autem filius Caree, et omnes principes exercitus qui dispersi fuerant in regionibus, venerunt ad Godoliam in Masphath,
text_pt: Joanã, filho de Careá, e todos os capitães dos exércitos, que estavam no campo, vieram a Gedalias, a Mizpá.
text_el: καὶ Ιωαναν υἱὸς Καρηε καὶ πάντες οἱ ἡγεμόνες τῆς δυνάμεως οἱ ἐν τοῖς ἀγροῖς ἦλθον πρὸς Γοδολιαν εἰς Μασσηφα

text_en: And they said to him: Know that Baalis the king of the children of Ammon has sent Ismahel the son of Nathanias to kill you. And Godolias the son of Ahicam believed them not.
text_la: et dixerunt ei : Scito quod Baalis, rex filiorum Ammon, misit Ismahel filium Nathaniæ percutere animam tuam. Et non credidit eis Godolias filius Ahicam.
text_pt: E disseram-lhe: Bem sabes que Baalis, rei dos filhos de Amom, enviou a Ismael, filho de Netanias, para tirar-te a vida. Mas, Gedalias, filho de Aicão, não lhes deu crédito.
text_el: καὶ εἶπαν αὐτῷ εἰ γνώσει γινώσκεις ὅτι Βελισα βασιλεὺς υἱῶν Αμμων ἀπέστειλεν πρὸς σὲ τὸν Ισμαηλ πατάξαι σου ψυχήν καὶ οὐκ ἐπίστευσεν αὐτοῖς Γοδολιας

text_en: But Johanan the son of Caree, spoke to Godolias privately in Masphath , saying: I will go, and I will kill Ismahel the son of Nathanias, and no man shall know it, lest he kill you, and all the Jews be scattered , that are gathered unto you, and the remnant of Juda perish.
text_la: Johanan autem filius Caree dixit ad Godoliam seorsum in Masphath, loquens : Ibo, et percutiam Ismahel filium Nathaniæ, nullo sciente, ne interficiat animam tuam, et dissipentur omnes Judæi qui congregati sunt ad te, et peribunt reliquiæ Juda.
text_pt: Todavia Joanã, filho de Careá, falou a Gedalias em segredo, em Mizpá, dizendo: Irei agora, e ferirei a Ismael, filho de Netanias, sem que ninguém o saiba; por que razão te tiraria ele a vida, de modo que todos os judeus, que se têm congregado a ti, fossem dispersos, e perecesse o restante de Judá?
text_el: καὶ Ιωαναν εἶπεν τῷ Γοδολια κρυφαίως ἐν Μασσηφα πορεύσομαι δὴ καὶ πατάξω τὸν Ισμαηλ καὶ μηθεὶς γνώτω μὴ πατάξῃ σου ψυχὴν καὶ διασπαρῇ πᾶς Ιουδα οἱ συνηγμένοι πρὸς σὲ καὶ ἀπολοῦνται οἱ κατάλοιποι Ιουδα

text_en: And Godolias the son of Ahicam said to Johanan the son of Caree: Do not this thing: for what you say of Ismahel is false .
text_la: Et ait Godolias filius Ahicam ad Johanan filium Caree : Noli facere verbum hoc : falsum enim tu loqueris de Ismahel.
text_pt: Mas disse Gedalias, filho de Aicão, a Joanã, filho de Careá: Não faças tal coisa; porque falas falsamente contra Ismael.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Γοδολιας πρὸς Ιωαναν μὴ ποιήσῃς τὸ πρᾶγμα τοῦτο ὅτι ψευδῆ σὺ λέγεις περὶ Ισμαηλ

text_en: And it came to pass in the seventh month, that Ismahel the son of Nathanias, the son of Elisama of the royal blood, and the nobles of the king, and ten men with him, came to Godolias the son of Ahicam into Masphath : and they ate bread there together in Masphath .
text_la: Et factum est in mense septimo, venit Ismahel filius Nathaniæ filii Elisama, de semine regali, et optimates regis, et decem viri cum eo, ad Godoliam filium Ahicam, in Masphath, et comederunt ibi panes simul in Masphath.
text_pt: Sucedeu, porém, no mês sétimo, que veio Ismael, filho de Netanias, filho de Elisama, de sangue real, e com ele dez homens, príncipes do rei, a Gedalias, filho de Aicão, a Mizpá; e comeram pão juntos ali em Mizpá.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο τῷ μηνὶ τῷ ἑβδόμῳ ἦλθεν Ισμαηλ υἱὸς Ναθανιου υἱοῦ Ελασα ἀπὸ γένους τοῦ βασιλέως καὶ δέκα ἄνδρες μετ' αὐτοῦ πρὸς Γοδολιαν εἰς Μασσηφα καὶ ἔφαγον ἐκεῖ ἄρτον ἅμα

text_en: And Ismahel the son of Nathanias arose, and the ten men that were with him, and they struck Godolias the son of Ahicam, the son of Saphan with the sword, and slew him whom the king of Babylon had made governor over the land.
text_la: Surrexit autem Ismahel filius Nathaniæ, et decem viri qui cum eo erant, et percusserunt Godoliam filium Ahicam filii Saphan gladio, et interfecerunt eum quem præfecerat rex Babylonis terræ.
text_pt: E levantou-se Ismael, filho de Netanias, com os dez homens que estavam com ele, e feriram à espada a Gedalias, filho de Aicão, filho de Safã, matando assim aquele que o rei de babilônia havia posto por governador sobre a terra.
text_el: καὶ ἀνέστη Ισμαηλ καὶ οἱ δέκα ἄνδρες οἳ ἦσαν μετ' αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐπάταξαν τὸν Γοδολιαν ὃν κατέστησεν βασιλεὺς Βαβυλῶνος ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς

text_en: Ismahel slew also all the Jews that were with Godolias in Masphath , and the Chaldeans that were found there, and the soldiers.
text_la: Omnes quoque Judæos qui erant cum Godolia in Masphath, et Chaldæos qui reperti sunt ibi, et viros bellatores, percussit Ismahel.
text_pt: Também matou Ismael a todos os judeus que com ele, com Gedalias, estavam em Mizpá, como também aos caldeus, homens de guerra, que se achavam ali.
text_el: καὶ πάντας τοὺς Ιουδαίους τοὺς ὄντας μετ' αὐτοῦ ἐν Μασσηφα καὶ πάντας τοὺς Χαλδαίους τοὺς εὑρεθέντας ἐκεῖ

text_en: And on the second day after he had killed Godolias, no man yet knowing it,
text_la: Secundo autem die postquam occiderat Godoliam, nullo adhuc sciente,
text_pt: Sucedeu, pois, no dia seguinte, depois que ele matara a Gedalias, sem ninguém o saber,
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τῇ δευτέρᾳ πατάξαντος αὐτοῦ τὸν Γοδολιαν καὶ ἄνθρωπος οὐκ ἔγνω

text_en: there came some from Sichem , and from Silo, and from Samaria , fourscore men , with their beards shaven, and their clothes rent, and mourning: and they had offerings and incense in their hand, to offer in the house of the Lord .
text_la: venerunt viri de Sichem, et de Silo, et de Samaria, octoginta viri, rasi barba, et scissis vestibus, et squallentes : et munera et thus habebant in manu, ut offerrent in domo Domini.
text_pt: Que vieram homens de Siquém, de Siló, e de Samaria; oitenta homens, com a barba rapada, e as vestes rasgadas, e retalhando-se; e trazendo nas suas mãos ofertas e incenso, para levarem à casa do Senhor.
text_el: καὶ ἤλθοσαν ἄνδρες ἀπὸ Συχεμ καὶ ἀπὸ Σαλημ καὶ ἀπὸ Σαμαρείας ὀγδοήκοντα ἄνδρες ἐξυρημένοι πώγωνας καὶ διερρηγμένοι τὰ ἱμάτια καὶ κοπτόμενοι καὶ μαναα καὶ λίβανος ἐν χερσὶν αὐτῶν τοῦ εἰσενεγκεῖν εἰς οἶκον κυρίου

text_en: And Ismahel the son of Nathanias went forth from Masphath to meet them, weeping all along as he went: and when he had met them, he said to them: Come to Godolias, the son of Ahicam .
text_la: Egressus ergo Ismahel filius Nathaniæ in occursum eorum de Masphath, incedens et plorans ibat : cum autem occurrisset eis, dixit ad eos : Venite ad Godoliam filium Ahicam.
text_pt: E, saindo-lhes ao encontro Ismael, filho de Netanias, desde Mizpá, ia chorando; e sucedeu que, encontrando-os lhes disse: Vinde a Gedalias, filho de Aicão.
text_el: καὶ ἐξῆλθεν εἰς ἀπάντησιν αὐτοῖς Ισμαηλ αὐτοὶ ἐπορεύοντο καὶ ἔκλαιον καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς εἰσέλθετε πρὸς Γοδολιαν

text_en: And when they had come to the midst of the city, Ismahel the son of Nathanias, slew them, and cast them into the midst of the pit, he and the men that were with him.
text_la: Qui cum venissent ad medium civitatis, interfecit eos Ismahel filius Nathaniæ circa medium laci, ipse et viri qui erant cum eo.
text_pt: Sucedeu, porém, que, entrando eles até ao meio da cidade, matou-os Ismael, filho de Netanias, e os lançou num poço, ele e os homens que estavam com ele.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο εἰσελθόντων αὐτῶν εἰς τὸ μέσον τῆς πόλεως ἔσφαξεν αὐτοὺς εἰς τὸ φρέαρ

text_en: But ten men were found among them, that said to Ismahel: Kill us not: for we have stores in the field, of wheat, and barley, and oil, and honey. And he forbore, and slew them not with their brethren.
text_la: Decem autem viri reperti sunt inter eos, qui dixerunt ad Ismahel : Noli occidere nos, quia habemus thesauros in agro, frumenti, et hordei, et olei, et mellis : et cessavit, et non interfecit eos cum fratribus suis.
text_pt: Mas houve entre eles dez homens que disseram a Ismael: Não nos mates, porque temos, no campo, tesouros, trigo, cevada, azeite e mel. E ele por isso os deixou, e não os matou entre seus irmãos.
text_el: καὶ δέκα ἄνδρες εὑρέθησαν ἐκεῖ καὶ εἶπαν τῷ Ισμαηλ μὴ ἀνέλῃς ἡμᾶς ὅτι εἰσὶν ἡμῖν θησαυροὶ ἐν ἀγρῷ πυροὶ καὶ κριθαί μέλι καὶ ἔλαιον καὶ παρῆλθεν καὶ οὐκ ἀνεῖλεν αὐτοὺς ἐν μέσῳ τῶν ἀδελφῶν αὐτῶν

text_en: And the pit into which Ismahel cast all the dead bodies of the men whom he slew because of Godolias, is the same that King Asa made, for fear of Baasa the king of Israel : the same did Ismahel the son of Nathanias fill with them that were slain.
text_la: Lacus autem in quem projecerat Ismahel omnia cadavera virorum quos percussit propter Godoliam, ipse est quem fecit rex Asa propter Baasa regem Israël : ipsum replevit Ismahel filius Nathaniæ occisis.
text_pt: E o poço em que Ismael lançou todos os cadáveres dos homens que matou por causa de Gedalias é o mesmo que fez o rei Asa, por causa de Baasa, rei de Israel; foi esse mesmo que Ismael, filho de Netanias, encheu de mortos.
text_el: καὶ τὸ φρέαρ εἰς ὃ ἔρριψεν ἐκεῖ Ισμαηλ πάντας οὓς ἐπάταξεν φρέαρ μέγα τοῦτό ἐστιν ὃ ἐποίησεν ὁ βασιλεὺς Ασα ἀπὸ προσώπου Βαασα βασιλέως Ισραηλ τοῦτο ἐνέπλησεν Ισμαηλ τραυματιῶν

text_en: Then Ismahel carried away captive all the remnant of the people that were in Masphath : the king's daughters, and all the people that remained in Masphath : whom Nabuzardan the general of the army had committed to Godolias the son of Ahicam . And Ismahel the son of Nathanias took them, and he departed, to go over to the children of Ammon .
text_la: Et captivas duxit Ismahel omnes reliquias populi qui erant in Masphath, filias regis, et universum populum qui remanserat in Masphath, quos commendaverat Nabuzardan princeps militiæ, Godoliæ filio Ahicam : et cepit eos Ismahel filius Nathaniæ, et abiit ut transiret ad filios Ammon.
text_pt: E Ismael levou cativo a todo o restante do povo que estava em Mizpá, isto é, as filhas do rei, e todo o povo que ficara em Mizpá, que Nebuzaradã, capitão da guarda, havia confiado a Gedalias, filho de Aicão; e levou-os cativos Ismael, filho de Netanias, e se foi para passar aos filhos de Amom.
text_el: καὶ ἀπέστρεψεν Ισμαηλ πάντα τὸν λαὸν τὸν καταλειφθέντα εἰς Μασσηφα καὶ τὰς θυγατέρας τοῦ βασιλέως ἃς παρεκατέθετο ὁ ἀρχιμάγειρος τῷ Γοδολια υἱῷ Αχικαμ καὶ ᾤχετο εἰς τὸ πέραν υἱῶν Αμμων

text_en: But Johanan the son of Caree, and all the captains of the fighting men that were with him, heard of the evil that Ismahel the son of Nathanias had done.
text_la: Audivit autem Johanan filius Caree, et omnes principes bellatorum qui erant cum eo, omne malum quod fecerat Ismahel filius Nathaniæ,
text_pt: Ouvindo, pois, Joanã, filho de Careá, e todos os capitães dos exércitos que estavam com ele, todo o mal que havia feito Ismael, filho de Netanias,
text_el: καὶ ἤκουσεν Ιωαναν υἱὸς Καρηε καὶ πάντες οἱ ἡγεμόνες τῆς δυνάμεως οἱ μετ' αὐτοῦ πάντα τὰ κακά ἃ ἐποίησεν Ισμαηλ

text_en: And taking all the men , they went out to fight against Ismahel the son of Nathanias, and they found him by the great waters that are in Gabaon.
text_la: et assumptis universis viris, profecti sunt ut bellarent adversum Ismahel filium Nathaniæ : et invenerunt eum ad aquas multas quæ sunt in Gabaon.
text_pt: Tomaram todos os seus homens, e foram pelejar contra Ismael, filho de Netanias; e acharam-no ao pé das grandes águas que há em Gibeom.
text_el: καὶ ἤγαγον ἅπαν τὸ στρατόπεδον αὐτῶν καὶ ᾤχοντο πολεμεῖν αὐτὸν καὶ εὗρον αὐτὸν ἐπὶ ὕδατος πολλοῦ ἐν Γαβαων

text_en: And when all the people that were with Ismahel, had seen Johanan the son of Caree, and all the captains of the fighting men that were with him, they rejoiced.
text_la: Cumque vidisset omnis populus qui erat cum Ismahel Johanan filium Caree, et universos principes bellatorum qui erant cum eo, lætati sunt:
text_pt: E aconteceu que, vendo todo o povo, que estava com Ismael, a Joanã, filho de Careá, e a todos os capitães dos exércitos, que vinham com ele, se alegrou.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο ὅτε εἶδον πᾶς ὁ λαὸς ὁ μετὰ Ισμαηλ τὸν Ιωαναν καὶ τοὺς ἡγεμόνας τῆς δυνάμεως τῆς μετ' αὐτοῦ

text_en: And all the people whom Ismahel had taken, went back to Masphath : and they returned and went to Johanan the son of Caree.
text_la: et reversus est omnis populus quem ceperat Ismahel, in Masphath, reversusque abiit ad Johanan filium Caree.
text_pt: E todo o povo que Ismael levara cativo de Mizpá virou as costas, e voltou, e foi para Joanã, filho de Careá.
text_el: καὶ ἀνέστρεψαν πρὸς Ιωαναν

text_en: But Ismahel the son of Nathanias fled with eight men , from the face of Johanan, and went to the children of Ammon .
text_la: Ismahel autem filius Nathaniæ fugit cum octo viris a facie Johanan, et abiit ad filios Ammon.
text_pt: Mas Ismael, filho de Netanias, escapou com oito homens de diante de Joanã, e se foi para os filhos de Amom.
text_el: καὶ Ισμαηλ ἐσώθη σὺν ὀκτὼ ἀνθρώποις καὶ ᾤχετο πρὸς τοὺς υἱοὺς Αμμων

text_en: Then Johanan the son of Caree, and all the captains of the soldiers that were with him, took all the remnant of the people whom they had recovered from Ismahel the son of Nathanias, from Masphath , after that he had slain Godolias the son of Ahicam : valiant men for war , and the women , and the children, and the eunuchs whom he had brought back from Gabaon.
text_la: Tulit ergo Johanan filius Caree, et omnes principes bellatorum qui erant cum eo, universas reliquias vulgi quas reduxerat ab Ismahel filio Nathaniæ de Masphath, postquam percussit Godoliam filium Ahicam : fortes viros ad prælium, et mulieres, et pueros, et eunuchos, quos reduxerat de Gabaon.
text_pt: Então tomou Joanã, filho de Careá, e todos os capitães dos exércitos que estavam com ele, a todo o restante do povo que ele havia recobrado de Ismael, filho de Netanias, desde Mizpá, depois de haver matado a Gedalias, filho de Aicão, isto é, aos homens poderosos de guerra, e às mulheres, e aos meninos, e aos eunucos que havia recobrado de Gibeom.
text_el: καὶ ἔλαβεν Ιωαναν καὶ πάντες οἱ ἡγεμόνες τῆς δυνάμεως οἱ μετ' αὐτοῦ πάντας τοὺς καταλοίπους τοῦ λαοῦ οὕς ἀπέστρεψεν ἀπὸ Ισμαηλ δυνατοὺς ἄνδρας ἐν πολέμῳ καὶ τὰς γυναῖκας καὶ τὰ λοιπὰ καὶ τοὺς εὐνούχους οὓς ἀπέστρεψεν ἀπὸ Γαβαων

text_en: And they departed, and sat as sojourners in Chamaam, which is near Bethlehem : in order to go forward, and enter into Egypt ,
text_la: Et abierunt, et sederunt peregrinantes in Chamaam, quæ est juxta Bethlehem, ut pergerent, et introirent Ægyptum,
text_pt: E partiram, indo habitar em Gerute-Quimã, que está perto de Belém, para dali irem e entrarem no Egito,
text_el: καὶ ᾤχοντο καὶ ἐκάθισαν ἐν Γαβηρωθ-χαμααμ τὴν πρὸς Βηθλεεμ τοῦ πορευθῆναι εἰσελθεῖν εἰς Αἴγυπτον

text_en: from the face of the Chaldeans: for they were afraid of them, because Ismahel the son of Nathanias had slain Godolias the son of Ahicam , whom the king of Babylon had made governor in the land of Juda .
text_la: a facie Chaldæorum : timebant enim eos, quia percusserat Ismahel filius Nathaniæ Godoliam filium Ahicam, quem præposuerat rex Babylonis in terra Juda.
