text_en: Come down from your glory , and sit in thirst, O dwelling of the daughter of Dibon : because the spoiler of Moab has come up to you, he has destroyed your bulwarks.
text_la: Descende de gloria, et sede in siti, habitatio filiæ Dibon, quoniam vastator Moab ascendit ad te : dissipavit munitiones tuas.
text_pt: Desce da tua glória, e assenta-te em terra seca, ó moradora, filha de Dibom; porque o destruidor de Moabe subiu contra ti, e desfez as tuas fortalezas.
text_el: κατάβηθι ἀπὸ δόξης καὶ κάθισον ἐν ὑγρασίᾳ καθημένη Δαιβων ἐκτρίβητε ὅτι ὤλετο Μωαβ ἀνέβη εἰς σὲ λυμαινόμενος ὀχύρωμά σου

text_en: Stand in the way, and look out, O habitation of Aroer: inquire of him that flees: and say to him that has escaped: What is done?
text_la: In via sta, et prospice, habitatio Aroër : interroga fugientem, et ei qui evasit dic : Quid accidit?
text_pt: Põe-te no caminho, e espia, ó moradora de Aroer; pergunta ao que vai fugindo; e à que escapou dize: Que sucedeu?
text_el: ἐφ' ὁδοῦ στῆθι καὶ ἔπιδε καθημένη ἐν Αροηρ καὶ ἐρώτησον φεύγοντα καὶ σῳζόμενον καὶ εἰπόν τί ἐγένετο

text_en: Moab is confounded, because he is overthrown: howl, and cry, tell it in Arnon, that Moab is wasted.
text_la: Confusus est Moab, quoniam victus est. Ululate, et clamate : annuntiate in Arnon, quoniam vastata est Moab,
text_pt: Moabe está envergonhado, porque foi quebrantado; lamentai e gritai; anunciai em Arnom que Moabe está destruído.
text_el: κατῃσχύνθη Μωαβ ὅτι συνετρίβη ὀλόλυξον καὶ κέκραξον ἀνάγγειλον ἐν Αρνων ὅτι ὤλετο Μωαβ

text_en: And judgment has come upon the plain country: upon Helon, and upon Jasa, and upon Mephaath.
text_la: et judicium venit ad terram campestrem, super Helon, et super Jasa, et super Mephaath,
text_pt: Também o julgamento veio sobre a terra da campina; sobre Holom, sobre Jaza, sobre Mefaate,
text_el: καὶ κρίσις ἔρχεται εἰς γῆν τοῦ Μισωρ ἐπὶ Χαιλων καὶ ἐπὶ Ιασσα καὶ ἐπὶ Μωφαθ

text_en: And upon Dibon , and upon Nabo , and upon the house of Deblathaim,
text_la: et super Dibon, et super Nabo, et super domum Deblathaim,
text_pt: Sobre Dibom, sobre Nebo, sobre Bete-Diblataim,
text_el: καὶ ἐπὶ Δαιβων καὶ ἐπὶ Ναβαυ καὶ ἐπ' οἶκον Δεβλαθαιμ

text_en: and upon Cariathaim, and upon Bethgamul, and upon Bethmaon,
text_la: et super Cariathaim, et super Bethgamul, et super Bethmaon,
text_pt: Sobre Quiriataim, sobre Bete-Gamul, sobre Bete-Meom,
text_el: καὶ ἐπὶ Καριαθαιμ καὶ ἐπ' οἶκον Γαμωλ καὶ ἐπ' οἶκον Μαων

text_en: and upon Carioth, and upon Bosra: and upon all the cities of the land of Moab , far or near.
text_la: et super Carioth, et super Bosra, et super omnes civitates terræ Moab, quæ longe et quæ prope sunt.
text_pt: Sobre Queriote, e sobre Bozra; e até sobre todas as cidades da terra de Moabe, as de longe e as de perto.
text_el: καὶ ἐπὶ Καριωθ καὶ ἐπὶ Βοσορ καὶ ἐπὶ πάσας τὰς πόλεις Μωαβ τὰς πόρρω καὶ τὰς ἐγγύς

text_en: The horn of Moab is cut off, and his arm is broken, says the Lord .
text_la: Abscissum est cornu Moab, et brachium ejus contritum est, ait Dominus.
text_pt: Já é cortado o poder de Moabe, e é quebrantado o seu braço, diz o Senhor.
text_el: κατεάχθη κέρας Μωαβ καὶ τὸ ἐπίχειρον αὐτοῦ συνετρίβη

text_en: Make him drunk, because he lifted up himself against the Lord : and Moab shall dash his hand in his own vomit, and he also shall be in derision.
text_la: Inebriate eum, quoniam contra Dominum erectus est : et allidet manum Moab in vomitu suo, et erit in derisum etiam ipse.
text_pt: Embriagai-o, porque contra o Senhor se engrandeceu; e Moabe se revolverá no seu vômito, e ele também se tornará objeto de escárnio.
text_el: μεθύσατε αὐτόν ὅτι ἐπὶ κύριον ἐμεγαλύνθη καὶ ἐπικρούσει Μωαβ ἐν χειρὶ αὐτοῦ καὶ ἔσται εἰς γέλωτα καὶ αὐτός

text_en: For Israel has been a derision unto you: as though you had found him amongst thieves : for your words therefore, which you have spoken against him, you shall be led away captive.
text_la: Fuit enim in derisum tibi Israël : quasi inter fures reperisses eum : propter verba ergo tua quæ adversum illum locutus es, captivus duceris.
text_pt: Pois não foi também Israel objeto de escárnio? Porventura foi achado entre ladrões, para que sempre que fales dele, saltes de alegria?
text_el: καὶ εἰ μὴ εἰς γελοιασμὸν ἦν σοι Ισραηλ εἰ ἐν κλοπαῖς σου εὑρέθη ὅτι ἐπολέμεις αὐτόν

text_en: Leave the cities, and dwell in the rock, you that dwell in Moab : and be like the dove that makes her nest in the mouth of the hole in the highest place.
text_la: Relinquite civitates, et habitate in petra, habitatores Moab : et estote quasi columba nidificans in summo ore foraminis.
text_pt: Deixai as cidades, e habitai no rochedo, ó moradores de Moabe; e sede como a pomba que se aninha nos lados da boca da caverna.
text_el: κατέλιπον τὰς πόλεις καὶ ᾤκησαν ἐν πέτραις οἱ κατοικοῦντες Μωαβ ἐγενήθησαν ὡς περιστεραὶ νοσσεύουσαι ἐν πέτραις στόματι βοθύνου

text_en: We have heard the pride of Moab , he is exceeding proud : his haughtiness, and his arrogancy, and his pride , and the loftiness of his heart.
text_la: Audivimus superbiam Moab : superbus est valde : sublimitatem ejus, et arrogantiam, et superbiam, et altitudinem cordis ejus.
text_pt: Ouvimos da soberba de Moabe, que é soberbíssimo, como também da sua arrogância, e da sua vaidade, e da sua altivez e do seu orgulhoso coração.
text_el: ἤκουσα ὕβριν Μωαβ ὕβρισεν λίαν ὕβριν αὐτοῦ καὶ ὑπερηφανίαν αὐτοῦ καὶ ὑψώθη ἡ καρδία αὐτοῦ

text_en: I know , says the Lord , his boasting, and that the strength thereof is not according to it, neither has it endeavoured to do according as it was able.
text_la: Ego scio, ait Dominus, jactantiam ejus, et quod non sit juxta eam virtus ejus, nec juxta quod poterat conata sit facere.
text_pt: Eu conheço, diz o Senhor, a sua indignação, mas isso nada é; as suas mentiras nada farão.
text_el: ἐγὼ δὲ ἔγνων ἔργα αὐτοῦ οὐχὶ τὸ ἱκανὸν αὐτοῦ οὐχ οὕτως ἐποίησεν

text_en: Therefore will I lament for Moab , and I will cry out to all Moab , for the men of the brick wall that mourn.
text_la: Ideo super Moab ejulabo, et ad Moab universam clamabo, ad viros muri fictilis lamentantes :
text_pt: Por isso gemerei por Moabe, sim, gritarei por todo o Moabe; pelos homens de Quir-Heres lamentarei;
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο ἐπὶ Μωαβ ὀλολύζετε πάντοθεν βοήσατε ἐπ' ἄνδρας Κιραδας αὐχμοῦ

text_en: O vineyard of Sabama, I will weep for you, with the mourning of Jazer: your branches have gone over the sea, they have come even to the sea of Jazer: the robber has rushed in upon your harvest and your vintage.
text_la: de planctu Jazer plorabo tibi, vinea Sabama. Propagines tuæ transierunt mare; usque ad mare Jazer pervenerunt : super messem tuam et vindemiam tuam prædo irruit.
text_pt: Com o choro de Jazer chorar-te-ei, ó vide de Sibma; os teus ramos passaram o mar, chegaram até ao mar de Jazer; porém o destruidor caiu sobre os teus frutos do verão, e sobre a tua vindima.
text_el: ὡς κλαυθμὸν Ιαζηρ ἀποκλαύσομαί σοι ἄμπελος Σεβημα κλήματά σου διῆλθεν θάλασσαν Ιαζηρ ἥψαντο ἐπὶ ὀπώραν σου ἐπὶ τρυγηταῖς σου ὄλεθρος ἐπέπεσεν

text_en: Joy and gladness is taken away from Carmel , and from the land of Moab , and I have taken away the wine out of the presses: the treader of the grapes shall not sing the accustomed cheerful tune.
text_la: Ablata est lætitia et exsultatio de Carmelo et de terra Moab, et vinum de torcularibus sustuli : nequaquam calcator uvæ solitum celeuma cantabit.
text_pt: Tirou-se, pois, o folguedo e a alegria do campo fértil e da terra de Moabe; porque fiz cessar o vinho nos lagares; já não pisarão uvas com júbilo; o júbilo não será júbilo.
text_el: συνεψήσθη χαρμοσύνη καὶ εὐφροσύνη ἐκ τῆς Μωαβίτιδος καὶ οἶνος ἦν ἐπὶ ληνοῖς σου πρωὶ οὐκ ἐπάτησαν οὐδὲ δείλης οὐκ ἐποίησαν αιδαδ

text_en: From the cry of Hesebon even to Eleale, and to Jasa, they have uttered their voice: from Segor to Oronaim, as a heifer of three years old: the waters also of Nemrim shall be very bad.
text_la: De clamore Hesebon usque Eleale et Jasa, dederunt vocem suam; a Segor usque ad Oronaim, vitula conternante : aquæ quoque Nemrim pessimæ erunt.
text_pt: Por causa do grito de Hesbom até Eleale e até Jaaz, se ouviu a sua voz desde Zoar até Horonaim, como bezerra de três anos; porque até as águas do Ninrim se tornarão em assolação.
text_el: ἀπὸ κραυγῆς Εσεβων ἕως Ελεαλη αἱ πόλεις αὐτῶν ἔδωκαν φωνὴν αὐτῶν ἀπὸ Ζογορ ἕως Ωρωναιμ καὶ Αγλαθ-σαλισια ὅτι καὶ τὸ ὕδωρ Νεβριμ εἰς κατάκαυμα ἔσται

text_en: And I will take away from Moab , says the Lord , him that offers in the high places, and that sacrifices to his gods.
text_la: Et auferam de Moab, ait Dominus, offerentem in excelsis, et sacrificantem diis ejus.
text_pt: E farei cessar em Moabe, diz o Senhor, quem sacrifique nos altos, e queime incenso aos seus deuses.
text_el: καὶ ἀπολῶ τὸν Μωαβ φησὶν κύριος ἀναβαίνοντα ἐπὶ βωμὸν καὶ θυμιῶντα θεοῖς αὐτοῦ

text_en: Therefore my heart shall sound for Moab like pipes and my heart shall sound like pipes for the men of the brick wall: because he has done more than he could, therefore they have perished.
text_la: Propterea cor meum ad Moab quasi tibiæ resonabit, et cor meum ad viros muri fictilis dabit sonitum tibiarum : quia plus fecit quam potuit, idcirco perierunt.
text_pt: Por isso ressoará como flauta o meu coração por Moabe, também ressoará como flauta o meu coração pelos homens de Quir-Heres; porquanto a abundância que ajuntou se perdeu.
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο καρδία μου Μωαβ ὥσπερ αὐλοὶ βομβήσουσιν καρδία μου ἐπ' ἀνθρώπους Κιραδας ὥσπερ αὐλὸς βομβήσει διὰ τοῦτο ἃ περιεποιήσατο ἀπώλετο ἀπὸ ἀνθρώπου

text_en: For every head shall be bald, and every beard shall be shaven: all hands shall be tied together, and upon every back there shall be haircloth.
text_la: Omne enim caput calvitium, et omnis barba rasa erit : in cunctis manibus colligatio, et super omne dorsum cilicium :
text_pt: Porque toda a cabeça será tosquiada, e toda a barba será diminuída; sobre todas as mãos haverá sarjaduras, e sobre os lombos, sacos.
text_el: πᾶσαν κεφαλὴν ἐν παντὶ τόπῳ ξυρήσονται καὶ πᾶς πώγων ξυρηθήσεται καὶ πᾶσαι χεῖρες κόψονται καὶ ἐπὶ πάσης ὀσφύος σάκκος

text_en: Upon all the housetops of Moab , and in the streets thereof general mourning: because I have broken Moab as an useless vessel, says the Lord .
text_la: super omnia tecta Moab, et in plateis ejus, omnis planctus : quoniam contrivi Moab sicut vas inutile, ait Dominus.
text_pt: Sobre todos os telhados de Moabe e nas suas ruas haverá um pranto geral; porque quebrei a Moabe, como a um vaso que não agrada, diz o Senhor.
text_el: καὶ ἐπὶ πάντων τῶν δωμάτων Μωαβ καὶ ἐπὶ πλατείαις αὐτῆς ὅτι συνέτριψα τὸν Μωαβ φησὶν κύριος ὡς ἀγγεῖον οὗ οὐκ ἔστιν χρεία αὐτοῦ

text_en: How is it overthrown, and they have howled! How has Moab bowed down the neck, and is confounded! And Moab shall be a derision, and an example to all round about him.
text_la: Quomodo victa est, et ululaverunt? quomodo dejecit cervicem Moab, et confusus est? eritque Moab in derisum, et in exemplum omnibus in circuitu suo.
text_pt: Como está quebrantado! Como gritam! Como virou Moabe a cerviz envergonhado! Assim será Moabe objeto de escárnio e de desmaio, para todos que estão em redor dele.
text_el: πῶς κατήλλαξεν πῶς ἔστρεψεν νῶτον Μωαβ ᾐσχύνθη καὶ ἐγένετο Μωαβ εἰς γέλωτα καὶ ἐγκότημα πᾶσιν τοῖς κύκλῳ αὐτῆς

text_en: Thus says the Lord : Behold he shall fly as an eagle, and shall stretch forth his wings to Moab .
text_la: Hæc dicit Dominus : Ecce quasi aquila volabit, et extendet alas suas ad Moab.
text_pt: Porque assim diz o Senhor: Eis que voará como a águia, e estenderá as suas asas sobre Moabe.
text_el: ὅτι οὕτως εἶπεν κύριος

text_en: Carioth is taken, and the strongholds are won: and the heart of the valiant men of Moab in that day shall be as the heart of a woman in labour.
text_la: Capta est Carioth, et munitiones comprehensæ sunt : et erit cor fortium Moab in die illa sicut cor mulieris parturientis,
text_pt: São tomadas as cidades, e ocupadas as fortalezas; e naquele dia será o coração dos valentes de Moabe como o coração da mulher que está com dores de parto.
text_el: ἐλήμφθη Ακκαριωθ καὶ τὰ ὀχυρώματα συνελήμφθη

text_en: And Moab shall cease to be a people: because he has gloried against the Lord .
text_la: et cessabit Moab esse populus, quoniam contra Dominum gloriatus est.
text_pt: E Moabe será destruído, para que não seja povo; porque se engrandeceu contra o Senhor.
text_el: καὶ ἀπολεῖται Μωαβ ἀπὸ ὄχλου ὅτι ἐπὶ τὸν κύριον ἐμεγαλύνθη

text_en: Fear, and the pit, and the snare come upon you, O inhabitant of Moab , says the Lord .
text_la: Pavor, et fovea, et laqueus super te, o habitator Moab, dicit Dominus.
text_pt: Temor, e cova, e laço, vêm sobre ti, ó morador de Moabe, diz o Senhor.
text_el: παγὶς καὶ φόβος καὶ βόθυνος ἐπὶ σοί καθήμενος Μωαβ

text_en: He that shall flee from the fear, shall fall into the pit: and he that shall get up out of the pit, shall be taken in the snare: for I will bring upon Moab the year of their visitation, says the Lord .
text_la: Qui fugerit a facie pavoris cadet in foveam, et qui conscenderit de fovea capietur laqueo : adducam enim super Moab annum visitationis eorum, ait Dominus.
text_pt: O que fugir do temor cairá na cova, e o que subir da cova ficará preso no laço; porque trarei sobre ele, sobre Moabe, o ano do seu castigo, diz o Senhor.
text_el: ὁ φεύγων ἀπὸ προσώπου τοῦ φόβου ἐμπεσεῖται εἰς τὸν βόθυνον καὶ ὁ ἀναβαίνων ἐκ τοῦ βοθύνου συλλημφθήσεται ἐν τῇ παγίδι ὅτι ἐπάξω ταῦτα ἐπὶ Μωαβ ἐν ἐνιαυτῷ ἐπισκέψεως αὐτῆς

text_en: They that fled from the snare stood in the shadow of Hesebon : but there came a fire out of Hesebon , and a flame out of the midst of Seon, and it shall devour part of Moab , and the crown of the head of the children of tumult.
text_la: In umbra Hesebon steterunt de laqueo fugientes, quia ignis egressus est de Hesebon, et flamma de medio Seon : et devorabit partem Moab, et verticem filiorum tumultus.
text_pt: Os que fugiam sem força pararam à sombra de Hesbom; pois saiu fogo de Hesbom, e a labareda do meio de Siom, e devorou o canto de Moabe e o alto da cabeça dos turbulentos.

text_en: Woe to you, Moab , you have perished, O people of Chamos: for your sons, and your daughters are taken captives.
text_la: Væ tibi, Moab : periisti, popule Chamos, quia comprehensi sunt filii tui et filiæ tuæ in captivitatem.
text_pt: Ai de ti, Moabe! Pereceu o povo de Quemós; porque teus filhos ficaram cativos, e tuas filhas em cativeiro.

text_en: And I will bring back the captivity of Moab in the last days, says the Lord . Hitherto the judgments of Moab .
text_la: Et convertam captivitatem Moab in novissimis diebus, ait Dominus. Hucusque judicia Moab.
text_pt: Mas nos últimos dias farei voltar os cativos de Moabe, diz o Senhor. Até aqui o juízo de Moabe.

text_en: Against the children of Ammon . Thus says the Lord : Hath Israel no sons? Or has he no heir? Why then has Melchom inherited Gad : and his people dwelt in his cities?
text_la: Ad filios Ammon. Hæc dicit Dominus : Numquid non filii sunt Israël, aut hæres non est ei? cur igitur hæreditate possedit Melchom Gad, et populus ejus in urbibus ejus habitavit?
text_pt: Contra os filhos de Amom. Assim diz o SENHOR: Acaso Israel não tem filhos, nem tem herdeiro? Por que, pois, herdou Malcã a Gade e o seu povo habitou nas suas cidades?
text_el: τοῖς υἱοῖς Αμμων οὕτως εἶπεν κύριος μὴ υἱοὶ οὔκ εἰσιν ἐν Ισραηλ ἢ παραλημψόμενος οὐκ ἔστιν αὐτοῖς διὰ τί παρέλαβεν Μελχομ τὸν Γαδ καὶ ὁ λαὸς αὐτῶν ἐν πόλεσιν αὐτῶν ἐνοικήσει

text_en: Therefore behold the days come, says the Lord , and I will cause the noise of war to be heard in Rabbath of the children of Ammon , and it shall be destroyed into a heap, and her daughters shall be burnt with fire, and Israel shall possess them that have possessed him, says the Lord .
text_la: Ideo ecce dies veniunt, dicit Dominus, et auditum faciam super Rabbath filiorum Ammon fremitum prælii, et erit in tumultum dissipata, filiæque ejus igni succendentur, et possidebit Israël possessores suos, ait Dominus.
text_pt: Portanto, eis que vêm dias, diz o Senhor, em que farei ouvir em Rabá dos filhos de Amom o alarido de guerra, e tornar-se-á num montão de ruínas, e os lugares da sua jurisdição serão queimados a fogo; e Israel herdará aos que o herdaram, diz o Senhor.
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο ἰδοὺ ἡμέραι ἔρχονται φησὶν κύριος καὶ ἀκουτιῶ ἐπὶ Ραββαθ θόρυβον πολέμων καὶ ἔσονται εἰς ἄβατον καὶ εἰς ἀπώλειαν καὶ βωμοὶ αὐτῆς ἐν πυρὶ κατακαυθήσονται καὶ παραλήμψεται Ισραηλ τὴν ἀρχὴν αὐτοῦ

text_en: Howl, O Hesebon , for Hai is wasted. Cry, you daughters of Rabbath, gird yourselves with haircloth: mourn and go about by the hedges: for Melchom shall be carried into captivity, his priests , and his princes together.
text_la: Ulula, Hesebon, quoniam vastata est Hai; clamate, filiæ Rabbath : accingite vos ciliciis, plangite et circuite per sepes, quoniam Melchom in transmigrationem ducetur, sacerdotes ejus et principes ejus simul.
text_pt: Lamenta, ó Hesbom, porque é destruída Ai; clamai, ó filhas de Rabá, cingi-vos de sacos, lamentai, e dai voltas pelos valados; porque Malcã irá em cativeiro, juntamente com seus sacerdotes e os seus príncipes.
text_el: ἀλάλαξον Εσεβων ὅτι ὤλετο Γαι κεκράξατε θυγατέρες Ραββαθ περιζώσασθε σάκκους καὶ ἐπιλημπτεύσασθε καὶ κόψασθε ἐπὶ Μελχομ ὅτι ἐν ἀποικίᾳ βαδιεῖται οἱ ἱερεῖς αὐτοῦ καὶ οἱ ἄρχοντες αὐτοῦ ἅμα

text_en: Why do you glory in the valleys? Your valley has flowed away, O delicate daughter, that have trusted in your treasures, and have said: Who shall come to me?
text_la: Quid gloriaris in vallibus? defluxit vallis tua, filia delicata, quæ confidebas in thesauris tuis, et dicebas : Quis veniet ad me?
text_pt: Por que te glorias nos vales, teus luxuriantes vales, ó filha rebelde, que confias nos teus tesouros, dizendo: Quem virá contra mim?
text_el: τί ἀγαλλιάσῃ ἐν τοῖς πεδίοις Ενακιμ θύγατερ ἰταμίας ἡ πεποιθυῖα ἐπὶ θησαυροῖς αὐτῆς ἡ λέγουσα τίς εἰσελεύσεται ἐπ' ἐμέ

text_en: Behold I will bring a fear upon you, says the Lord God of hosts , from all that are round about you: and you shall be scattered every one out of one another's sight, neither shall there be any to gather together them that flee.
text_la: Ecce ego inducam super te terrorem, ait Dominus Deus exercituum, ab omnibus qui sunt in circuitu tuo : et dispergemini singuli a conspectu vestro, nec erit qui congreget fugientes.
text_pt: Eis que eu trarei temor sobre ti, diz o Senhor DEUS dos Exércitos, de todos os que estão ao redor de ti; e sereis lançados fora cada um diante de si, e ninguém recolherá o desgarrado.
text_el: ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ φέρω φόβον ἐπὶ σέ εἶπεν κύριος ἀπὸ πάσης τῆς περιοίκου σου καὶ διασπαρήσεσθε ἕκαστος εἰς πρόσωπον αὐτοῦ καὶ οὐκ ἔσται ὁ συνάγων

text_en: And afterwards I will cause the captives of the children of Ammon to return, says the Lord .
text_la: Et post hæc reverti faciam captivos filiorum Ammon, ait Dominus.
text_pt: Mas depois disto farei voltar os cativos dos filhos de Amom, diz o Senhor.

text_en: Against Edom . Thus says the Lord of hosts : Is wisdom no more in Theman? counsel is perished from her children: their wisdom has become unprofitable.
text_la: Ad Idumæam. Hæc dicit Dominus exercituum : Numquid non ultra est sapientia in Theman? periit consilium a filiis; inutilis facta est sapientia eorum.
text_pt: Acerca de Edom. Assim diz o Senhor dos Exércitos: Acaso não há mais sabedoria em Temã? Pereceu o conselho dos entendidos? Corrompeu-se a sua sabedoria?
text_el: τῇ Ιδουμαίᾳ τάδε λέγει κύριος οὐκ ἔστιν ἔτι σοφία ἐν Θαιμαν ἀπώλετο βουλὴ ἐκ συνετῶν ὤχετο σοφία αὐτῶν

text_en: Flee and turn your backs, go down into the deep hole, you inhabitants of Dedan: for I have brought the destruction of Esau upon him, the time of his visitation.
text_la: Fugite, et terga vertite; descendite in voraginem, habitatores Dedan : quoniam perditionem Esau adduxi super eum, tempus visitationis ejus.
text_pt: Fugi, voltai-vos, buscai profundezas para habitar, ó moradores de Dedã, porque eu trarei sobre ele a ruína de Esaú, no tempo em que o castiguei.
text_el: ἠπατήθη ὁ τόπος αὐτῶν βαθύνατε εἰς κάθισιν οἱ κατοικοῦντες ἐν Δαιδαν ὅτι δύσκολα ἐποίησεν ἤγαγον ἐπ' αὐτὸν ἐν χρόνῳ ᾧ ἐπεσκεψάμην ἐπ' αὐτόν

text_en: If grapegatherers had come to you, would they not have left a bunch? If thieves in the night, they would have taken what was enough for them.
text_la: Si vindemiatores venissent super te, non reliquissent racemum : si fures in nocte rapuissent quod sufficeret sibi.
text_pt: Se vindimadores viessem a ti, não deixariam rabiscos? Se ladrões de noite viessem, não te danificariam quanto lhes bastasse?
text_el: ὅτι τρυγηταὶ ἦλθόν σοι οὐ καταλείψουσίν σοι καταλείμματα ὡς κλέπται ἐν νυκτὶ ἐπιθήσουσιν χεῖρα αὐτῶν

text_en: But I have made Esau bare, I have revealed his secrets, and he cannot be hid: his seed is laid waste, and his brethren, and his neighbours, and he shall not be.
text_la: Ego vero discooperui Esau : revelavi abscondita ejus, et celari non poterit : vastatum est semen ejus, et fratres ejus, et vicini ejus, et non erit.
text_pt: Mas eu despi a Esaú, descobri os seus esconderijos, e não se poderá esconder; foi destruída a sua descendência, como também seus irmãos e seus vizinhos, e ele já não existe.
text_el: ὅτι ἐγὼ κατέσυρα τὸν Ησαυ ἀνεκάλυψα τὰ κρυπτὰ αὐτῶν κρυβῆναι οὐ μὴ δύνωνται ὤλοντο διὰ χεῖρα ἀδελφοῦ αὐτοῦ καὶ γείτονος αὐτοῦ καὶ οὐκ ἔστιν

text_en: Leave your fatherless children: I will make them live: and your widows shall hope in me.
text_la: Relinque pupillos tuos : ego faciam eos vivere : et viduæ tuæ in me sperabunt.
text_pt: Deixa os teus órfãos, eu os guardarei em vida; e as tuas viúvas confiem em mim.
text_el: ὑπολείπεσθαι ὀρφανόν σου ἵνα ζήσηται καὶ ἐγὼ ζήσομαι καὶ χῆραι ἐπ' ἐμὲ πεποίθασιν

text_en: For thus says the Lord : Behold they whose judgment was not to drink of the cup, shall certainly drink: and shall you come off as innocent? You shall not come off as innocent, but drinking you shall drink.
text_la: Quia hæc dicit Dominus : Ecce quibus non erat judicium ut biberent calicem, bibentes bibent : et tu, quasi innocens relinqueris? non eris innocens, sed bibens bibes.
text_pt: Porque assim diz o Senhor: Eis que os que não estavam condenados a beber do copo, totalmente o beberão; e tu ficarias inteiramente impune? Não ficarás impune, mas certamente o beberás.
text_el: ὅτι τάδε εἶπεν κύριος οἷς οὐκ ἦν νόμος πιεῖν τὸ ποτήριον ἔπιον καὶ σὺ ἀθῳωμένη οὐ μὴ ἀθῳωθῇς ὅτι πίνων πίεσαι

text_en: For I have sworn by myself, says the Lord , that Bosra shall become a desolation, and a reproach, and a desert , and a curse : and all her cities shall be everlasting wastes.
text_la: Quia per memetipsum juravi, dicit Dominus, quod in solitudinem, et in opprobrium, et in desertum, et in maledictionem erit Bosra, et omnes civitates ejus erunt in solitudines sempiternas.
text_pt: Porque por mim mesmo jurei, diz o Senhor, que Bozra servirá de espanto, de opróbrio, de assolação, e de maldição; e todas as suas cidades se tornarão em desolações perpétuas.
text_el: ὅτι κατ' ἐμαυτοῦ ὤμοσα λέγει κύριος ὅτι εἰς ἄβατον καὶ εἰς ὀνειδισμὸν καὶ εἰς κατάρασιν ἔσῃ ἐν μέσῳ αὐτῆς καὶ πᾶσαι αἱ πόλεις αὐτῆς ἔσονται ἔρημοι εἰς αἰῶνα

text_en: I have heard a rumour from the Lord , and an ambassador is sent to the nations: Gather yourselves together, and come against her, and let us rise up to battle.
text_la: Auditum audivi a Domino, et legatus ad gentes missus est : Congregamini, et venite contra eam, et consurgamus in prælium.
text_pt: Ouvi novas vindas do Senhor, que um embaixador é enviado aos gentios, para lhes dizer: Ajuntai-vos, e vinde contra ela, e levantai-vos para a guerra.
text_el: ἀκοὴν ἤκουσα παρὰ κυρίου καὶ ἀγγέλους εἰς ἔθνη ἀπέστειλεν συνάχθητε καὶ παραγένεσθε εἰς αὐτήν ἀνάστητε εἰς πόλεμον

text_en: For behold I have made you a little one among the nations, despicable among men .
text_la: Ecce enim parvulum dedi te in gentibus, contemptibilem inter homines.
text_pt: Porque eis que te fiz pequeno entre os gentios, desprezado entre os homens.
text_el: μικρὸν ἔδωκά σε ἐν ἔθνεσιν εὐκαταφρόνητον ἐν ἀνθρώποις

text_en: Your arrogancy has deceived you, and the pride of your heart: O you that dwell in the clefts of the rock, and endeavour to lay hold on the height of the hill: but though you should make your nest as high as an eagle, I will bring you down from thence, says the Lord .
text_la: Arrogantia tua decepit te, et superbia cordis tui, qui habitas in cavernis petræ, et apprehendere niteris altitudinem collis : cum exaltaveris quasi aquila nidum tuum, inde detraham te, dicit Dominus.
text_pt: Quanto à tua terribilidade, enganou-te a arrogância do teu coração, tu que habitas nas cavernas das rochas, que ocupas as alturas dos outeiros; ainda que eleves o teu ninho como a águia, de lá te derrubarei, diz o Senhor.
text_el: ἡ παιγνία σου ἐνεχείρησέν σοι ἰταμία καρδίας σου κατέλυσεν τρυμαλιὰς πετρῶν συνέλαβεν ἰσχὺν βουνοῦ ὑψηλοῦ ὅτι ὕψωσεν ὥσπερ ἀετὸς νοσσιὰν αὐτοῦ ἐκεῖθεν καθελῶ σε

text_en: And Edom shall be desolate: every one that shall pass by it, shall be astonished, and shall hiss at all its plagues.
text_la: Et erit Idumæa deserta : omnis qui transibit per eam stupebit, et sibilabit super omnes plagas ejus.
text_pt: Assim servirá Edom de desolação; todo aquele que passar por ela se espantará, e assobiará por causa de todas as suas pragas.
text_el: καὶ ἔσται ἡ Ιδουμαία εἰς ἄβατον πᾶς ὁ παραπορευόμενος ἐπ' αὐτὴν συριεῖ

text_en: As Sodom was overthrown and Gomorrha , and the neighbours thereof, says the Lord : there shall not a man dwell there, and there shall no son of man inhabit it.
text_la: Sicut subversa est Sodoma et Gomorrha, et vicinæ ejus, ait Dominus : non habitabit ibi vir, et non incolet eam filius hominis.
text_pt: Será como a destruição de Sodoma e Gomorra, e dos seus vizinhos, diz o Senhor; não habitará ninguém ali, nem morará nela filho de homem.
text_el: ὥσπερ κατεστράφη Σοδομα καὶ Γομορρα καὶ αἱ πάροικοι αὐτῆς εἶπεν κύριος παντοκράτωρ οὐ μὴ καθίσῃ ἐκεῖ ἄνθρωπος καὶ οὐ μὴ ἐνοικήσῃ ἐκεῖ υἱὸς ἀνθρώπου

text_en: Behold one shall come up as a lion from the swelling of the Jordan , against the strong and beautiful: for I will make him run suddenly upon her: and who shall be the chosen one whom I may appoint over her? For who is like to me? And who shall abide me? And who is that shepherd that can withstand my countenance?
text_la: Ecce quasi leo ascendet de superbia Jordanis ad pulchritudinem robustam, quia subito currere faciam eum ad illam. Et quis erit electus, quem præponam ei? quis enim similis mei? et quis sustinebit me? et quis est iste pastor, qui resistat vultui meo?
text_pt: Eis que ele como leão subirá da enchente do Jordão contra a morada do forte; porque num momento o farei correr dali; e quem é o escolhido que porei sobre ela? Pois quem é semelhante a mim? e quem me fixará o tempo? e quem é o pastor que subsistirá perante mim?
text_el: ἰδοὺ ὥσπερ λέων ἀναβήσεται ἐκ μέσου τοῦ Ιορδάνου εἰς τόπον Αιθαμ ὅτι ταχὺ ἐκδιώξω αὐτοὺς ἀπ' αὐτῆς καὶ τοὺς νεανίσκους ἐπ' αὐτὴν ἐπιστήσατε ὅτι τίς ὥσπερ ἐγώ καὶ τίς ἀντιστήσεταί μοι καὶ τίς οὗτος ποιμήν ὃς στήσεται κατὰ πρόσωπόν μου

text_en: Therefore hear the counsel of the Lord , which he has taken concerning Edom : and his thoughts which he has thought concerning the inhabitants of Theman: surely the little ones of the flock shall cast them down, of a truth they shall destroy them with their habitation.
text_la: Propterea audite consilium Domini quod iniit de Edom, et cogitationes ejus quas cogitavit de habitatoribus Theman : si non dejecerint eos parvuli gregis, nisi dissipaverint cum eis habitaculum eorum.
text_pt: Portanto ouvi o conselho do Senhor, que ele decretou contra Edom, e os seus desígnios que ele intentou entre os moradores de Temã: Certamente os menores do rebanho serão arrastados; certamente ele assolará as suas moradas com eles.
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο ἀκούσατε βουλὴν κυρίου ἣν ἐβουλεύσατο ἐπὶ τὴν Ιδουμαίαν καὶ λογισμὸν αὐτοῦ ὃν ἐλογίσατο ἐπὶ τοὺς κατοικοῦντας Θαιμαν ἐὰν μὴ συμψησθῶσιν τὰ ἐλάχιστα τῶν προβάτων ἐὰν μὴ ἀβατωθῇ ἐπ' αὐτὴν κατάλυσις αὐτῶν

text_en: The earth is moved at the noise of their fall: the cry of their voice is heard in the Red Sea .
text_la: A voce ruinæ eorum commota est terra; clamor in mari Rubro auditus est vocis ejus.
text_pt: A terra estremeceu com o estrondo da sua queda; e do seu grito, até ao Mar Vermelho se ouviu o som.
text_el: ὅτι ἀπὸ φωνῆς πτώσεως αὐτῶν ἐσείσθη ἡ γῆ καὶ κραυγή σου ἐν θαλάσσῃ ἠκούσθη

text_en: Behold he shall come up as an eagle, and fly: and he shall spread his wings over Bosra: and in that day the heart of the valiant ones of Edom shall be as the heart of a woman in labour.
text_la: Ecce quasi aquila ascendet, et avolabit, et expandet alas suas super Bosran : et erit cor fortium Idumææ in die illa quasi cor mulieris parturientis.
text_pt: Eis que ele como águia subirá, e voará, e estenderá as suas asas contra Bozra; e o coração dos valentes de Edom naquele dia será como o coração da mulher que está com dores de parto.
text_el: ἰδοὺ ὥσπερ ἀετὸς ὄψεται καὶ ἐκτενεῖ τὰς πτέρυγας ἐπ' ὀχυρώματα αὐτῆς καὶ ἔσται ἡ καρδία τῶν ἰσχυρῶν τῆς Ιδουμαίας ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐκείνῃ ὡς καρδία γυναικὸς ὠδινούσης

text_en: Against Damascus . Emath is confounded and Arphad: for they have heard very bad tidings, they are troubled as in the sea: through care they could not rest.
text_la: Ad Damascum. Confusa est Emath et Arphad, quia auditum pessimum audierunt : turbati sunt in mari; præ sollicitudine quiescere non potuit.
text_pt: Acerca de Damasco. Envergonhou-se Hamate e Arpade, porquanto ouviram más novas, desmaiaram; no mar há angústia, não se pode sossegar.
text_el: τῇ Δαμασκῷ κατῃσχύνθη Ημαθ καὶ Αρφαδ ὅτι ἤκουσαν ἀκοὴν πονηράν ἐξέστησαν ἐθυμώθησαν ἀναπαύσασθαι οὐ μὴ δύνωνται

text_en: Damascus is undone, she is put to flight, trembling has seized on her: anguish and sorrows have taken her as a woman in labour.
text_la: Dissoluta est Damascus, versa est in fugam : tremor apprehendit eam, angustia et dolores tenuerunt eam quasi parturientem.
text_pt: Enfraquecida está Damasco; virou as costas para fugir, e o tremor a tomou; angústia e dores a tomaram como da que está de parto.
text_el: ἐξελύθη Δαμασκός ἀπεστράφη εἰς φυγήν τρόμος ἐπελάβετο αὐτῆς

text_en: How have they forsaken the city of renown, the city of joy !
text_la: Quomodo dereliquerunt civitatem laudabilem, urbem lætitiæ?
text_pt: Como está abandonada a cidade do louvor, a cidade da minha alegria!
text_el: πῶς οὐχὶ ἐγκατέλιπεν πόλιν ἐμήν κώμην ἠγάπησαν

text_en: Therefore her young men shall fall in her streets: and all the men of war shall be silent in that day, says the Lord of hosts .
text_la: Ideo cadent juvenes ejus in plateis ejus, et omnes viri prælii conticescent in die illa, ait Dominus exercituum.
text_pt: Portanto cairão os seus jovens nas suas ruas; e todos os homens de guerra serão consumidos naquele dia, diz o Senhor dos Exércitos.
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο πεσοῦνται νεανίσκοι ἐν πλατείαις σου καὶ πάντες οἱ ἄνδρες οἱ πολεμισταί σου πεσοῦνται φησὶν κύριος

text_en: And I will kindle a fire in the wall of Damascus , and it shall devour the strong holds of Benadad.
text_la: Et succendam ignem in muro Damasci, et devorabit mœnia Benadad.
text_pt: E acenderei fogo no muro de Damasco, e consumirá os palácios de Bene-Hadade.
text_el: καὶ καύσω πῦρ ἐν τείχει Δαμασκοῦ καὶ καταφάγεται ἄμφοδα υἱοῦ Αδερ

text_en: Against Cedar and against the kingdoms of Asor, which Nabuchodonosor king of Babylon destroyed. Thus says the Lord : Arise, and go up to Cedar , and waste the children of the east.
text_la: Ad Cedar, et ad regna Asor, quæ percussit Nabuchodonosor rex Babylonis. Hæc dicit Dominus : Surgite, et ascendite ad Cedar, et vastate filios orientis.
text_pt: Acerca de Quedar, e dos reinos de Hazor, que Nabucodonosor, rei de babilônia, feriu. Assim diz o SENHOR: Levantai-vos, subi contra Quedar, e destruí os filhos do oriente.
text_el: τῇ Κηδαρ βασιλίσσῃ τῆς αὐλῆς ἣν ἐπάταξεν Ναβουχοδονοσορ βασιλεὺς Βαβυλῶνος οὕτως εἶπεν κύριος ἀνάστητε καὶ ἀνάβητε ἐπὶ Κηδαρ καὶ πλήσατε τοὺς υἱοὺς Κεδεμ

text_en: They shall take their tents, and their flocks: and shall carry off for themselves their curtains, and all their vessels, and their camels: and they shall call fear upon them round about.
text_la: Tabernacula eorum, et greges eorum capient : pelles eorum, et omnia vasa eorum, et camelos eorum tollent sibi, et vocabunt super eos formidinem in circuitu.
text_pt: Tomarão as suas tendas, os seus gados, as suas cortinas e todos os seus utensílios, e os seus camelos levarão para si; e lhes clamarão: Há medo por todos os lados.
text_el: σκηνὰς αὐτῶν καὶ πρόβατα αὐτῶν λήμψονται ἱμάτια αὐτῶν καὶ πάντα τὰ σκεύη αὐτῶν καὶ καμήλους αὐτῶν λήμψονται ἑαυτοῖς καὶ καλέσατε ἐπ' αὐτοὺς ἀπώλειαν κυκλόθεν

text_en: Flee, get away speedily, sit in deep holes, you that inhabit Asor, says the Lord : for Nabuchodonosor king of Babylon has taken counsel against you, and has conceived designs against you.
text_la: Fugite, abite vehementer, in voraginibus sedete, qui habitatis Asor, ait Dominus : iniit enim contra vos Nabuchodonosor rex Babylonis consilium, et cogitavit adversum vos cogitationes.
text_pt: Fugi, desviai-vos para muito longe, buscai profundezas para habitar, ó moradores de Hazor, diz o SENHOR; porque Nabucodonosor, rei de babilônia, tomou conselho contra vós, e formou um desígnio contra vós.
text_el: φεύγετε λίαν βαθύνατε εἰς κάθισιν καθήμενοι ἐν τῇ αὐλῇ ὅτι ἐβουλεύσατο ἐφ' ὑμᾶς βασιλεὺς Βαβυλῶνος βουλὴν καὶ ἐλογίσατο ἐφ' ὑμᾶς λογισμόν

text_en: Arise, and go up to a nation that is at ease, and that dwells securely, says the Lord : they have neither gates, nor bars: they dwell alone.
text_la: Consurgite, et ascendite ad gentem quietam, et habitantem confidenter, ait Dominus : non ostia, nec vectes eis : soli habitant.
text_pt: Levantai-vos, subi contra uma nação tranqüila, que habita confiadamente, diz o Senhor, que não tem portas, nem ferrolhos; habitam sós.
text_el: ἀνάστηθι καὶ ἀνάβηθι ἐπ' ἔθνος εὐσταθοῦν καθήμενον εἰς ἀναψυχήν οἷς οὔκ εἰσιν θύραι οὐ βάλανοι οὐ μοχλοί μόνοι καταλύουσιν

text_en: And their camels shall be for a spoil and the multitude of their cattle for a booty, and I will scatter into every wind them that have their hair cut round, and I will bring destruction upon them from all their confines, says the Lord .
text_la: Et erunt cameli eorum in direptionem, et multitudo jumentorum in prædam : et dispergam eos in omnem ventum, qui sunt attonsi in comam, et ex omni confinio eorum adducam interitum super eos, ait Dominus.
text_pt: E os seus camelos serão para presa, e a multidão dos seus gados para despojo; e os espalharei a todo o vento, àqueles que estão nos lugares mais distantes, e de todos os seus lados lhes trarei a sua ruína, diz o Senhor.
text_el: καὶ ἔσονται κάμηλοι αὐτῶν εἰς προνομὴν καὶ πλῆθος κτηνῶν αὐτῶν εἰς ἀπώλειαν καὶ λικμήσω αὐτοὺς παντὶ πνεύματι κεκαρμένους πρὸ προσώπου αὐτῶν ἐκ παντὸς πέραν αὐτῶν οἴσω τὴν τροπὴν αὐτῶν εἶπεν κύριος

text_en: And Asor shall be a habitation for dragons, desolate for ever: no man shall abide there, nor son of man inhabit it.
text_la: Et erit Asor in habitaculum draconum, deserta usque in æternum : non manebit ibi vir, nec incolet eam filius hominis.
text_pt: E Hazor se tornará em morada de chacais, em assolação para sempre; ninguém habitará ali, nem morará nela filho de homem.
text_el: καὶ ἔσται ἡ αὐλὴ διατριβὴ στρουθῶν καὶ ἄβατος ἕως αἰῶνος οὐ μὴ καθίσῃ ἐκεῖ ἄνθρωπος καὶ οὐ μὴ κατοικήσῃ ἐκεῖ υἱὸς ἀνθρώπου

text_en: The word of the Lord that came to Jeremiah the prophet against Elam, in the beginning of the reign of Sedecias king of Juda , saying:
text_la: Quod facum est verbum Domini ad Jeremiam prophetam adversus Ælam, in principio regni Sedeciæ regis Juda, dicens:
text_pt: A palavra do Senhor, que veio a Jeremias, o profeta, contra Elão, no princípio do reinado de Zedequias, rei de Judá, dizendo:
text_el: ἐν ἀρχῇ βασιλεύοντος Σεδεκιου τοῦ βασιλέως ἐγένετο ὁ λόγος οὗτος περὶ Αιλαμ

text_en: Thus says the Lord of hosts : Behold I will break the bow of Elam, and their chief strength.
text_la: Hæc dicit Dominus exercituum : Ecce ego confringam arcum Ælam, et summam fortitudinem eorum :
text_pt: Assim diz o Senhor dos Exércitos: Eis que eu quebrarei o arco de Elão, o principal do seu poder.
text_el: τάδε λέγει κύριος συντριβήτω τὸ τόξον Αιλαμ ἀρχὴ δυναστείας αὐτῶν

text_en: And I will bring upon Elam the four winds from the four quarters of heaven : and I will scatter them into all these winds: and there shall be no nation, to which the fugitives of Elam shall not come.
text_la: et inducam super Ælam quatuor ventos a quatuor plagis cæli, et ventilabo eos in omnes ventos istos, et non erit gens ad quam non perveniant profugi Ælam.
text_pt: E trarei sobre Elão os quatro ventos dos quatro cantos dos céus, e os espalharei na direção de todos estes ventos; e não haverá nação aonde não cheguem os fugitivos de Elão.
text_el: καὶ ἐπάξω ἐπὶ Αιλαμ τέσσαρας ἀνέμους ἐκ τῶν τεσσάρων ἄκρων τοῦ οὐρανοῦ καὶ διασπερῶ αὐτοὺς ἐν πᾶσιν τοῖς ἀνέμοις τούτοις καὶ οὐκ ἔσται ἔθνος ὃ οὐχ ἥξει ἐκεῖ οἱ ἐξωσμένοι Αιλαμ

text_en: And I will cause Elam to be afraid before their enemies, and in the sight of them that seek their life: and I will bring evil upon them, my fierce wrath , says the Lord : and I will send the sword after them, till I consume them.
text_la: Et pavere faciam Ælam coram inimicis suis, et in conspectu quærentium animam eorum : et adducam super eos malum, iram furoris mei, dicit Dominus, et mittam post eos gladium donec consumam eos.
text_pt: E farei que Elão tema diante de seus inimigos e diante dos que procuram a sua morte; e farei vir sobre eles o mal, o furor da minha ira, diz o Senhor; e enviarei após eles a espada, até que venha a consumi-los.
text_el: καὶ πτοήσω αὐτοὺς ἐναντίον τῶν ἐχθρῶν αὐτῶν τῶν ζητούντων τὴν ψυχὴν αὐτῶν καὶ ἐπάξω ἐπ' αὐτοὺς κακὰ κατὰ τὴν ὀργὴν τοῦ θυμοῦ μου καὶ ἐπαποστελῶ ὀπίσω αὐτῶν τὴν μάχαιράν μου ἕως τοῦ ἐξαναλῶσαι αὐτούς

text_en: And I will set my throne in Elam, and destroy kings and princes from thence, says the Lord .
text_la: Et ponam solium meum in Ælam, et perdam inde reges et principes, ait Dominus.
text_pt: E porei o meu trono em Elão; e destruirei dali o rei e os príncipes, diz o Senhor.
text_el: καὶ θήσω τὸν θρόνον μου ἐν Αιλαμ καὶ ἐξαποστελῶ ἐκεῖθεν βασιλέα καὶ μεγιστᾶνας

text_en: But in the latter days I will cause the captives of Elam, to return, says the Lord .
text_la: In novissimis autem diebus reverti faciam captivos Ælam, dicit Dominus.
text_pt: Acontecerá, porém, nos últimos dias, que farei voltar os cativos de Elão, diz o Senhor.
text_el: καὶ ἔσται ἐπ' ἐσχάτου τῶν ἡμερῶν ἀποστρέψω τὴν αἰχμαλωσίαν Αιλαμ λέγει κύριος

text_en: The word that the Lord has spoken against Babylon , and against the land of the Chaldeans in the hand of Jeremiah the prophet .
text_la: Verbum quod locutus est Dominus de Babylone et de terra Chaldæorum, in manu Jeremiæ prophetæ.
text_pt: A palavra que falou o SENHOR contra a babilônia, contra a terra dos caldeus, por intermédio de Jeremias, o profeta.
text_el: λόγος κυρίου ὃν ἐλάλησεν ἐπὶ Βαβυλῶνα

text_en: Declare among the nations, and publish it, lift up a standard: proclaim, and conceal it not: say: Babylon is taken, Bel is confounded, Merodach is overthrown, their graven things are confounded, their idols are overthrown.
text_la: Annuntiate in gentibus, et auditum facite : levate signum, prædicate, et nolite celare : dicite : Capta est Babylon, confusus est Bel, victus est Merodach, confusa sunt sculptilia ejus, superata sunt idola eorum.
text_pt: Anunciai entre as nações; e fazei ouvir, e arvorai um estandarte, fazei ouvir, não encubrais; dizei: Tomada está babilônia, confundido está Bel, espatifado está Merodaque, confundidos estão os seus ídolos, e quebradas estão as suas imagens.
text_el: ἀναγγείλατε ἐν τοῖς ἔθνεσιν καὶ ἀκουστὰ ποιήσατε καὶ μὴ κρύψητε εἴπατε ἑάλωκεν Βαβυλών κατῃσχύνθη Βῆλος ἡ ἀπτόητος ἡ τρυφερὰ παρεδόθη Μαρωδαχ

text_en: For a nation has come up against her out of the north, which shall make her land desolate: and there shall be none to dwell therein, from man even to beast: yea they are removed, and gone away.
text_la: Quoniam ascendit contra eam gens ab aquilone, quæ ponet terram ejus in solitudinem, et non erit qui habitet in ea ab homine usque ad pecus : et moti sunt, et abierunt.
text_pt: Porque subiu contra ela uma nação do norte, que fará da sua terra uma solidão, e não haverá quem nela habite; tanto os homens como os animais fugiram, e se foram.
text_el: ὅτι ἀνέβη ἐπ' αὐτὴν ἔθνος ἀπὸ βορρᾶ οὗτος θήσει τὴν γῆν αὐτῆς εἰς ἀφανισμόν καὶ οὐκ ἔσται ὁ κατοικῶν ἐν αὐτῇ ἀπὸ ἀνθρώπου καὶ ἕως κτήνους

text_en: In those days, and at that time, says the Lord , the children of Israel shall come, they and the children of Juda together: going and weeping they shall make haste, and shall seek the Lord their God .
text_la: In diebus illis, et in tempore illo, ait Dominus, venient filii Israël ipsi et filii Juda simul : ambulantes et flentes properabunt, et Dominum Deum suum quærent :
text_pt: Naqueles dias, e naquele tempo, diz o Senhor, os filhos de Israel virão, eles e os filhos de Judá juntamente; andando e chorando virão, e buscarão ao Senhor seu Deus.
text_el: ἐν ταῖς ἡμέραις ἐκείναις καὶ ἐν τῷ καιρῷ ἐκείνῳ ἥξουσιν οἱ υἱοὶ Ισραηλ αὐτοὶ καὶ οἱ υἱοὶ Ιουδα ἐπὶ τὸ αὐτό βαδίζοντες καὶ κλαίοντες πορεύσονται τὸν κύριον θεὸν αὐτῶν ζητοῦντες

text_en: They shall ask the way to Sion, their faces are hitherward. They shall come, and shall be joined to the Lord by an everlasting covenant, which shall never be forgotten.
text_la: in Sion interrogabunt viam, huc facies eorum : venient, et apponentur ad Dominum fœdere sempiterno, quod nulla oblivione delebitur.
text_pt: Pelo caminho de Sião perguntarão, para ali voltarão os seus rostos, dizendo: Vinde, e unamo-nos ao Senhor, numa aliança eterna que nunca será esquecida.
text_el: ἕως Σιων ἐρωτήσουσιν τὴν ὁδόν ὧδε γὰρ τὸ πρόσωπον αὐτῶν δώσουσιν καὶ ἥξουσιν καὶ καταφεύξονται πρὸς κύριον τὸν θεόν διαθήκη γὰρ αἰώνιος οὐκ ἐπιλησθήσεται

text_en: My people have been a lost flock, their shepherds have caused them to go astray, and have made them wander in the mountains: they have gone from mountain to hill, they have forgotten their resting place.
text_la: Grex perditus factus est populus meus : pastores eorum seduxerunt eos, feceruntque vagari in montibus : de monte in collem transierunt; obliti sunt cubilis sui.
text_pt: Ovelhas perdidas têm sido o meu povo, os seus pastores as fizeram errar, para os montes as desviaram; de monte para outeiro andaram, esqueceram-se do lugar do seu repouso.
text_el: πρόβατα ἀπολωλότα ἐγενήθη ὁ λαός μου οἱ ποιμένες αὐτῶν ἐξῶσαν αὐτούς ἐπὶ τὰ ὄρη ἀπεπλάνησαν αὐτούς ἐξ ὄρους ἐπὶ βουνὸν ᾤχοντο ἐπελάθοντο κοίτης αὐτῶν

text_en: All that found them, have devoured them: and their enemies said: We have not sinned in so doing: because they have sinned against the Lord the beauty of justice , and against the Lord the hope of their fathers.
text_la: Omnes qui invenerunt comederunt eos, et hostes eorum dixerunt : Non peccavimus : pro eo quod peccaverunt Domino decori justitiæ, et exspectationi patrum eorum Domino.
text_pt: Todos os que as achavam as devoravam, e os seus adversários diziam: Culpa nenhuma teremos; porque pecaram contra o Senhor, a morada da justiça, sim, o Senhor, a esperança de seus pais.
text_el: πάντες οἱ εὑρίσκοντες αὐτοὺς κατανάλισκον αὐτούς οἱ ἐχθροὶ αὐτῶν εἶπαν μὴ ἀνῶμεν αὐτούς ἀνθ' ὧν ἥμαρτον τῷ κυρίῳ νομῇ δικαιοσύνης τῷ συναγαγόντι τοὺς πατέρας αὐτῶν

text_en: Remove out of the midst of Babylon , and go forth out of the land of the Chaldeans: and be as kids at the head of the flock.
text_la: Recedite de medio Babylonis, et de terra Chaldæorum egredimini, et estote quasi hædi ante gregem.
text_pt: Fugi do meio de babilônia, e saí da terra dos caldeus, e sede como os bodes diante do rebanho.
text_el: ἀπαλλοτριώθητε ἐκ μέσου Βαβυλῶνος καὶ ἀπὸ γῆς Χαλδαίων καὶ ἐξέλθατε καὶ γένεσθε ὥσπερ δράκοντες κατὰ πρόσωπον προβάτων

text_en: For behold I raise up, and will bring against Babylon an assembly of great nations from the land of the north: and they shall be prepared against her, and from thence she shall be taken: their arrows, like those of a mighty man , a destroyer, shall not return in vain.
text_la: Quoniam ecce ego suscito, et adducam in Babylonem congregationem gentium magnarum de terra aquilonis, et præparabuntur adversus eam, et inde capietur : sagitta ejus quasi viri fortis interfectoris : non revertetur vacua.
text_pt: Porque eis que eu suscitarei e farei subir contra a babilônia uma congregação de grandes nações da terra do norte, e se prepararão contra ela; dali será tomada; as suas flechas serão como as de valente herói, nenhuma tornará sem efeito.
text_el: ὅτι ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ ἐγείρω ἐπὶ Βαβυλῶνα συναγωγὰς ἐθνῶν ἐκ γῆς βορρᾶ καὶ παρατάξονται αὐτῇ ἐκεῖθεν ἁλώσεται ὡς βολὶς μαχητοῦ συνετοῦ οὐκ ἐπιστρέψει κενή

text_en: And Chaldea shall be made a prey: all that waste her shall be filled, says the Lord .
text_la: Et erit Chaldæa in prædam : omnes vastantes eam replebuntur, ait Dominus.
text_pt: A Caldéia servirá de presa; todos os que a saquearam serão fartos, diz o Senhor.
text_el: καὶ ἔσται ἡ Χαλδαία εἰς προνομήν πάντες οἱ προνομεύοντες αὐτὴν ἐμπλησθήσονται

text_en: Because you rejoice, and speak great things, pillaging my inheritance: because you are spread abroad as calves upon the grass, and have bellowed as bulls.
text_la: Quoniam exsultatis, et magna loquimini, diripientes hæreditatem meam : quoniam effusi estis sicut vituli super herbam, et mugistis sicut tauri :
text_pt: Porquanto vos alegrastes, e vos regozijastes, ó saqueadores da minha herança, porquanto vos engordastes como novilha no pasto, e mugistes como touros.
text_el: ὅτι ηὐφραίνεσθε καὶ κατεκαυχᾶσθε διαρπάζοντες τὴν κληρονομίαν μου διότι ἐσκιρτᾶτε ὡς βοΐδια ἐν βοτάνῃ καὶ ἐκερατίζετε ὡς ταῦροι

text_en: Your mother is confounded exceedingly, and she that bore you is made even with the dust: behold she shall be the last among the nations, a wilderness unpassable, and dry.
text_la: confusa est mater vestra nimis, et adæquata pulveri, quæ genuit vos : ecce novissima erit in gentibus, deserta, invia, et arens.
text_pt: Será mui confundida vossa mãe, ficará envergonhada a que vos deu à luz; eis que ela será a última das nações, um deserto, uma terra seca e uma solidão.
text_el: ᾐσχύνθη ἡ μήτηρ ὑμῶν σφόδρα μήτηρ ἐπ' ἀγαθὰ ἐσχάτη ἐθνῶν ἔρημος

text_en: Because of the wrath of the Lord it shall not be inhabited, but shall be wholly desolate: every one that shall pass by Babylon , shall be astonished, and shall hiss at all her plagues.
text_la: Ab ira Domini non habitabitur, sed redigetur tota in solitudinem : omnis qui transibit per Babylonem stupebit, et sibilabit super universis plagis ejus.
text_pt: Por causa do furor do SENHOR não será habitada, antes se tornará em total assolação; qualquer que passar por babilônia se espantará, assobiará por todas as suas pragas.
text_el: ἀπὸ ὀργῆς κυρίου οὐ κατοικηθήσεται καὶ ἔσται εἰς ἀφανισμὸν πᾶσα καὶ πᾶς ὁ διοδεύων διὰ Βαβυλῶνος σκυθρωπάσει καὶ συριοῦσιν ἐπὶ πᾶσαν τὴν πληγὴν αὐτῆς

text_en: Prepare yourselves against Babylon round about, all you that bend the bow: fight against her, spare not arrows: because she has sinned against the Lord .
text_la: Præparamini contra Babylonem per circuitum, omnes qui tenditis arcum : debellate eam, non parcatis jaculis, quia Domino peccavit.
text_pt: Ordenai-vos contra babilônia ao redor, todos os que armais arcos; atirai-lhe, não poupeis as flechas, porque pecou contra o SENHOR.
text_el: παρατάξασθε ἐπὶ Βαβυλῶνα κύκλῳ πάντες τείνοντες τόξον τοξεύσατε ἐπ' αὐτήν μὴ φείσησθε ἐπὶ τοῖς τοξεύμασιν ὑμῶν

text_en: Shout against her, she has every where given her hand, her foundations are fallen, her walls are thrown down, for it is the vengeance of the Lord . Take vengeance upon her: as she has done, so do to her.
text_la: Clamate adversus eam, ubique dedit manum : ceciderunt fundamenta ejus, destructi sunt muri ejus, quoniam ultio Domini est : ultionem accipite de ea : sicut fecit, facite ei.
text_pt: Gritai contra ela ao redor, ela já se submeteu; caíram seus fundamentos, estão derrubados os seus muros; porque esta é a vingança do Senhor; vingai-vos dela; como ela fez, assim lhe fazei.
text_el: κατακροτήσατε ἐπ' αὐτήν παρελύθησαν αἱ χεῖρες αὐτῆς ἔπεσαν αἱ ἐπάλξεις αὐτῆς καὶ κατεσκάφη τὸ τεῖχος αὐτῆς ὅτι ἐκδίκησις παρὰ θεοῦ ἐστιν ἐκδικεῖτε ἐπ' αὐτήν καθὼς ἐποίησεν ποιήσατε αὐτῇ

text_en: Destroy the sower out of Babylon , and him that holds the sickle in the time of harvest: for fear of the sword of the dove every man shall return to his people, and every one shall flee to his own land.
text_la: Disperdite satorem de Babylone, et tenentem falcem in tempore messis : a facie gladii columbæ unusquisque ad populum suum convertetur, et singuli ad terram suam fugient.
text_pt: Arrancai de babilônia o que semeia, e o que leva a foice no tempo da sega; por causa da espada aflitiva virar-se-á cada um para o seu povo, e fugirá cada um para a sua terra.
text_el: ἐξολεθρεύσατε σπέρμα ἐκ Βαβυλῶνος κατέχοντα δρέπανον ἐν καιρῷ θερισμοῦ ἀπὸ προσώπου μαχαίρας Ἑλληνικῆς ἕκαστος εἰς τὸν λαὸν αὐτοῦ ἀποστρέψουσιν καὶ ἕκαστος εἰς τὴν γῆν αὐτοῦ φεύξεται

text_en: Israel is a scattered flock, the lions have driven him away: first the king of Assyria devoured him: and last this Nabuchodonosor king of Babylon has broken his bones.
text_la: Grex dispersus Israël : leones ejecerunt eum. Primus comedit eum rex Assur : iste novissimus exossavit eum Nabuchodonosor rex Babylonis.
text_pt: Cordeiro desgarrado é Israel; os leões o afugentaram; o primeiro a devorá-lo foi o rei da Assíria; e, por último Nabucodonosor, rei de babilônia, lhe quebrou os ossos.
text_el: πρόβατον πλανώμενον Ισραηλ λέοντες ἐξῶσαν αὐτόν ὁ πρῶτος ἔφαγεν αὐτὸν βασιλεὺς Ασσουρ καὶ οὗτος ὕστερον τὰ ὀστᾶ αὐτοῦ βασιλεὺς Βαβυλῶνος

text_en: Therefore thus says the Lord of hosts the God of Israel : Behold I will visit the king of Babylon and his land, as I have visited the king of Assyria .
text_la: Propterea hæc dicit Dominus exercituum, Deus Israël : Ecce ego visitabo regem Babylonis et terram ejus, sicut visitavi regem Assur :
text_pt: Portanto, assim diz o SENHOR dos Exércitos, Deus de Israel: Eis que castigarei o rei de babilônia, e a sua terra, como castiguei o rei da Assíria.
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο τάδε λέγει κύριος ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ ἐκδικῶ ἐπὶ τὸν βασιλέα Βαβυλῶνος καὶ ἐπὶ τὴν γῆν αὐτοῦ καθὼς ἐξεδίκησα ἐπὶ τὸν βασιλέα Ασσουρ

text_en: And I will bring Israel again to his habitation: and he shall feed on Carmel , and Bason, and his soul shall be satisfied in mount Ephraim, and Galaad.
text_la: et reducam Israël ad habitaculum suum : et pascetur Carmelum et Basan, et in monte Ephraim et Galaad saturabitur anima ejus.
text_pt: E farei tornar Israel para a sua morada, e ele pastará no Carmelo e em Basã; e fartar-se-á a sua alma no monte de Efraim e em Gileade.
text_el: καὶ ἀποκαταστήσω τὸν Ισραηλ εἰς τὴν νομὴν αὐτοῦ καὶ νεμήσεται ἐν τῷ Καρμήλῳ καὶ ἐν ὄρει Εφραιμ καὶ ἐν τῷ Γαλααδ καὶ πλησθήσεται ἡ ψυχὴ αὐτοῦ

text_en: In those days, and at that time, says the Lord , the iniquity of Israel shall be sought for, and there shall be none: and the sin of Juda , and there shall none be found: for I will be merciful to them, whom I shall leave.
text_la: In diebus illis, et in tempore illo, ait Dominus, quæretur iniquitas Israël, et non erit, et peccatum Juda, et non invenietur : quoniam propitius ero eis quos reliquero.
text_pt: Naqueles dias, e naquele tempo, diz o Senhor, buscar-se-á a maldade de Israel, e não será achada; e os pecados de Judá, mas não se acharão; porque perdoarei os remanescentes que eu deixar.
text_el: ἐν ταῖς ἡμέραις ἐκείναις καὶ ἐν τῷ καιρῷ ἐκείνῳ ζητήσουσιν τὴν ἀδικίαν Ισραηλ καὶ οὐχ ὑπάρξει καὶ τὰς ἁμαρτίας Ιουδα καὶ οὐ μὴ εὑρεθῶσιν ὅτι ἵλεως ἔσομαι τοῖς ὑπολελειμμένοις ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς λέγει κύριος

text_en: Go up against the land of the rulers, and punish the inhabitants thereof, waste, and destroy all behind them, says the Lord : and do according to all that I have commanded you.
text_la: Super terram dominantium ascende, et super habitatores ejus visita : dissipa, et interfice quæ post eos sunt, ait Dominus, et fac juxta omnia quæ præcepi tibi.
text_pt: Sobe contra a terra de Merataim, sim, contra ela, e contra os moradores de Pecode; assola e inteiramente destrói tudo após eles, diz o Senhor, e faze conforme tudo o que te mandei.
text_el: πικρῶς ἐπίβηθι ἐπ' αὐτὴν καὶ ἐπὶ τοὺς κατοικοῦντας ἐπ' αὐτήν ἐκδίκησον μάχαιρα καὶ ἀφάνισον λέγει κύριος καὶ ποίει κατὰ πάντα ὅσα ἐντέλλομαί σοι

text_en: A noise of war in the land, and a great destruction.
text_la: Vox belli in terra, et contritio magna.
text_pt: Estrondo de batalha há na terra, e de grande destruição.
text_el: φωνὴ πολέμου καὶ συντριβὴ μεγάλη ἐν γῇ Χαλδαίων

text_en: How is the hammer of the whole earth broken, and destroyed! how is Babylon turned into a desert among the nations!
text_la: Quomodo confractus est et contritus malleus universæ terræ? quomodo versa est in desertum Babylon in gentibus?
text_pt: Como foi cortado e quebrado o martelo de toda a terra! Como se tornou babilônia objeto de espanto entre as nações!
text_el: πῶς συνεκλάσθη καὶ συνετρίβη ἡ σφῦρα πάσης τῆς γῆς πῶς ἐγενήθη εἰς ἀφανισμὸν Βαβυλὼν ἐν ἔθνεσιν

text_en: I have caused you to fall into a snare, and you are taken, O Babylon , and you were not aware of it: you are found and caught, because you have provoked the Lord .
text_la: Illaqueavi te, et capta es, Babylon, et nesciebas : inventa es et apprehensa, quoniam Dominum provocasti.
text_pt: Laços te armei, e também foste presa, ó babilônia, e tu não o soubeste; foste achada, e também apanhada; porque contra o SENHOR te entremeteste.
text_el: ἐπιθήσονταί σοι καὶ ἁλώσῃ ὦ Βαβυλών καὶ οὐ γνώσῃ εὑρέθης καὶ ἐλήμφθης ὅτι τῷ κυρίῳ ἀντέστης

text_en: The Lord has opened his armoury, and has brought forth the weapons of his wrath : for the Lord the God of hosts has a work to be done in the land of the Chaldeans.
text_la: Aperuit Dominus thesaurum suum, et protulit vasa iræ suæ, quoniam opus est Domino Deo exercituum, in terra Chaldæorum.
text_pt: O SENHOR abriu o seu depósito, e tirou os instrumentos da sua indignação; porque o Senhor DEUS dos Exércitos, tem uma obra a realizar na terra dos caldeus.
text_el: ἤνοιξεν κύριος τὸν θησαυρὸν αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐξήνεγκεν τὰ σκεύη ὀργῆς αὐτοῦ ὅτι ἔργον τῷ κυρίῳ θεῷ ἐν γῇ Χαλδαίων

text_en: Come against her from the uttermost borders: open that they may go forth that shall tread her down: take the stones out of the way, and make heaps, and destroy her: and let nothing of her be left.
text_la: Venite ad eam ab extremis finibus; aperite ut exeant qui conculcent eam : tollite de via lapides, et redigite in acervos : et interficite eam, nec sit quidquam reliquum.
text_pt: Vinde contra ela dos confins da terra, abri os seus celeiros; fazei dela montões de ruínas, e destruí-a de todo; nada lhe fique de sobra.
text_el: ὅτι ἐληλύθασιν οἱ καιροὶ αὐτῆς ἀνοίξατε τὰς ἀποθήκας αὐτῆς ἐρευνήσατε αὐτὴν ὡς σπήλαιον καὶ ἐξολεθρεύσατε αὐτήν μὴ γενέσθω αὐτῆς κατάλειμμα

text_en: Destroy all her valiant men , let them go down to the slaughter: woe to them, for their day has come, the time of their visitation.
text_la: Dissipate universos fortes ejus : descendant in occisionem : væ eis, quia venit dies eorum, tempus visitationis eorum!
text_pt: Matai a todos os seus novilhos, desçam a matança. Ai deles, porque veio o seu dia, o tempo do seu castigo!
text_el: ἀναξηράνατε αὐτῆς πάντας τοὺς καρπούς καὶ καταβήτωσαν εἰς σφαγήν οὐαὶ αὐτοῖς ὅτι ἥκει ἡ ἡμέρα αὐτῶν καὶ καιρὸς ἐκδικήσεως αὐτῶν

text_en: The voice of them that flee, and of them that have escaped out of the land of Babylon : to declare in Sion the revenge of the Lord our God , the revenge of his temple .
text_la: Vox fugientium, et eorum qui evaserunt de terra Babylonis, ut annuntient in Sion ultionem Domini Dei nostri, ultionem templi ejus.
text_pt: Eis a voz dos que fugiram e escaparam da terra de babilônia, para anunciarem em Sião a vingança do SENHOR nosso Deus, a vingança do seu templo.
text_el: φωνὴ φευγόντων καὶ ἀνασῳζομένων ἐκ γῆς Βαβυλῶνος τοῦ ἀναγγεῖλαι εἰς Σιων τὴν ἐκδίκησιν παρὰ κυρίου θεοῦ ἡμῶν

text_en: Declare to many against Babylon , to all that bend the bow: stand together against her round about, and let none escape; pay her according to her work: according to all that she has done, do to her: for she has lifted up herself against the Lord , against the Holy One of Israel .
text_la: Annuntiate in Babylonem plurimis, omnibus qui tendunt arcum : consistite adversus eam per gyrum, et nullus evadat : reddite ei secundum opus suum : juxta omnia quæ fecit, facite illi, quia contra Dominum erecta est, adversum Sanctum Israël.
text_pt: Convocai contra babilônia os flecheiros, a todos os que armam arcos; acampai-vos contra ela em redor, ninguém escape dela; pagai-lhe conforme a sua obra, conforme tudo o que fez, fazei-lhe; porque se houve arrogantemente contra o SENHOR, contra o Santo de Israel.
text_el: παραγγείλατε ἐπὶ Βαβυλῶνα πολλοῖς παντὶ ἐντείνοντι τόξον παρεμβάλετε ἐπ' αὐτὴν κυκλόθεν μὴ ἔστω αὐτῆς ἀνασῳζόμενος ἀνταπόδοτε αὐτῇ κατὰ τὰ ἔργα αὐτῆς κατὰ πάντα ὅσα ἐποίησεν ποιήσατε αὐτῇ ὅτι πρὸς τὸν κύριον ἀντέστη θεὸν ἅγιον τοῦ Ισραηλ

text_en: Therefore shall her young men fall in her streets: and all her men of war shall hold their peace in that day, says the Lord .
text_la: Idcirco cadent juvenes ejus in plateis ejus, et omnes viri bellatores ejus conticescent in die illa, ait Dominus.
text_pt: Portanto, cairão os seus jovens nas suas ruas; e todos os seus homens de guerra serão desarraigados naquele dia, diz o Senhor.
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο πεσοῦνται οἱ νεανίσκοι αὐτῆς ἐν ταῖς πλατείαις αὐτῆς καὶ πάντες οἱ ἄνδρες οἱ πολεμισταὶ αὐτῆς ῥιφήσονται εἶπεν κύριος

text_en: Behold I come against you, O proud one, says the Lord the God of hosts : for your day has come, the time of your visitation.
text_la: Ecce ego ad te, superbe! dicit Dominus Deus exercituum : quia venit dies tuus, tempus visitationis tuæ.
text_pt: Eis que eu sou contra ti, ó soberbo, diz o Senhor DEUS dos Exércitos; porque veio o teu dia, o tempo em que te hei de castigar.
text_el: ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ ἐπὶ σὲ τὴν ὑβρίστριαν λέγει κύριος ὅτι ἥκει ἡ ἡμέρα σου καὶ ὁ καιρὸς ἐκδικήσεώς σου

text_en: And the proud one shall fall, he shall fall down, and there shall be none to lift him up: and I will kindle a fire in his cities, and it shall devour all round about him.
text_la: Et cadet superbus, et corruet, et non erit qui suscitet eum : et succendam ignem in urbibus ejus, et devorabit omnia in circuitu ejus.
text_pt: Então tropeçará o soberbo, e cairá, e ninguém haverá que o levante; e porei fogo nas suas cidades, o qual consumirá todos os seus arredores.
text_el: καὶ ἀσθενήσει ἡ ὕβρις σου καὶ πεσεῖται καὶ οὐκ ἔσται ὁ ἀνιστῶν αὐτήν καὶ ἀνάψω πῦρ ἐν τῷ δρυμῷ αὐτῆς καὶ καταφάγεται πάντα τὰ κύκλῳ αὐτῆς

text_en: Thus says the Lord of hosts : The children of Israel , and the children of Juda are oppressed together: all that have taken them captives, hold them fast, they will not let them go.
text_la: Hæc dicit Dominus exercituum : Calumniam sustinent filii Israël, et filii Juda simul : omnes qui ceperunt eos, tenent : nolunt dimittere eos.
text_pt: Assim diz o Senhor dos Exércitos: Os filhos de Israel e os filhos de Judá foram oprimidos juntamente; e todos os que os levaram cativos os retiveram, não os quiseram soltar.
text_el: τάδε λέγει κύριος καταδεδυνάστευνται οἱ υἱοὶ Ισραηλ καὶ οἱ υἱοὶ Ιουδα ἅμα πάντες οἱ αἰχμαλωτεύσαντες αὐτοὺς κατεδυνάστευσαν αὐτούς ὅτι οὐκ ἠθέλησαν ἐξαποστεῖλαι αὐτούς

text_en: Their redeemer is strong, the Lord of hosts is his name : he will defend their cause in judgment, to terrify the land, and to disquiet the inhabitants of Babylon .
text_la: Redemptor eorum fortis, Dominus exercituum nomen ejus : judicio defendet causam eorum, ut exterreat terram, et commoveat habitatores Babylonis.
text_pt: Mas o seu Redentor é forte, o SENHOR dos Exércitos é o seu nome; certamente pleiteará a causa deles, para dar descanso à terra, e inquietar os moradores de babilônia.
text_el: καὶ ὁ λυτρούμενος αὐτοὺς ἰσχυρός κύριος παντοκράτωρ ὄνομα αὐτῷ κρίσιν κρινεῖ πρὸς τοὺς ἀντιδίκους αὐτοῦ ὅπως ἐξάρῃ τὴν γῆν καὶ παροξυνεῖ τοῖς κατοικοῦσι Βαβυλῶνα

text_en: A sword is upon the Chaldeans, says the Lord , and upon the inhabitants of Babylon , and upon her princes, and upon her wise men .
text_la: Gladius ad Chaldæos, ait Dominus, et ad habitatores Babylonis, et ad principes, et ad sapientes ejus.
text_pt: A espada virá sobre os caldeus, diz o SENHOR, e sobre os moradores de babilônia, e sobre os seus príncipes, e sobre os seus sábios.
text_el: μάχαιραν ἐπὶ τοὺς Χαλδαίους καὶ ἐπὶ τοὺς κατοικοῦντας Βαβυλῶνα καὶ ἐπὶ τοὺς μεγιστᾶνας αὐτῆς καὶ ἐπὶ τοὺς συνετοὺς αὐτῆς

text_en: A sword upon her diviners , and they shall be foolish: a sword upon her valiant ones, and they shall be dismayed.
text_la: Gladius ad divinos ejus, qui stulti erunt : gladius ad fortes illius, qui timebunt.
text_pt: A espada virá sobre os mentirosos, e ficarão insensatos; a espada virá sobre os seus poderosos, e desfalecerão.
text_el: μάχαιραν ἐπὶ τοὺς μαχητὰς αὐτῆς καὶ παραλυθήσονται

text_en: A sword upon their horses, and upon their chariots, and upon all the people that are in the midst of her: and they shall become as women : a sword upon her treasures, and they shall be made a spoil.
text_la: Gladius ad equos ejus, et ad currus ejus, et ad omne vulgus quod est in medio ejus : et erunt quasi mulieres : gladius ad thesauros ejus, qui diripientur.
text_pt: A espada virá sobre os seus cavalos, e sobre os seus carros, e sobre toda a mistura de povos, que está no meio dela; e tornar-se-ão como mulheres; a espada virá sobre os seus tesouros, e serão saqueados.
text_el: μάχαιραν ἐπὶ τοὺς ἵππους αὐτῶν καὶ ἐπὶ τὰ ἅρματα αὐτῶν μάχαιραν ἐπὶ τοὺς μαχητὰς αὐτῶν καὶ ἐπὶ τὸν σύμμικτον τὸν ἐν μέσῳ αὐτῆς καὶ ἔσονται ὡσεὶ γυναῖκες μάχαιραν ἐπὶ τοὺς θησαυροὺς αὐτῆς καὶ διασκορπισθήσονται

text_en: A drought upon her waters, and they shall be dried up: because it is a land of idols , and they glory in monstrous things.
text_la: Siccitas super aquas ejus erit, et arescent, quia terra sculptilium est, et in portentis gloriantur.
text_pt: Cairá a seca sobre as suas águas, e secarão; porque é uma terra de imagens esculpidas, e pelos seus ídolos andam enfurecidos.
text_el: ἐπὶ τῷ ὕδατι αὐτῆς ἐπεποίθει καὶ καταισχυνθήσονται ὅτι γῆ τῶν γλυπτῶν ἐστιν καὶ ἐν ταῖς νήσοις οὗ κατεκαυχῶντο

text_en: Therefore shall dragons dwell there with the fig fauns: and ostriches shall dwell therein, and it shall be no more inhabited for ever, neither shall it be built up from generation to generation .
text_la: Propterea habitabunt dracones cum faunis ficariis, et habitabunt in ea struthiones : et non inhabitabitur ultra usque in sempiternum, nec exstruetur usque ad generationem et generationem.
text_pt: Por isso habitarão nela as feras do deserto, com os animais selvagens das ilhas; também habitarão nela as avestruzes; e nunca mais será povoada, nem será habitada de geração em geração.
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο κατοικήσουσιν ἰνδάλματα ἐν ταῖς νήσοις καὶ κατοικήσουσιν ἐν αὐτῇ θυγατέρες σειρήνων οὐ μὴ κατοικηθῇ οὐκέτι εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα

text_en: As the Lord overthrew Sodom and Gomorrha , and their neighbour cities, says the Lord : no man shall dwell there, neither shall the son of man inhabit it.
text_la: Sicut subvertit Dominus Sodomam et Gomorrham, et vicinas ejus, ait Dominus, non habitabit ibi vir, et non incolet eam filius hominis.
text_pt: Como quando Deus subverteu a Sodoma e a Gomorra, e as suas cidades vizinhas, diz o Senhor, assim ninguém habitará ali, nem morará nela filho de homem.
text_el: καθὼς κατέστρεψεν ὁ θεὸς Σοδομα καὶ Γομορρα καὶ τὰς ὁμορούσας αὐταῖς εἶπεν κύριος οὐ μὴ κατοικήσῃ ἐκεῖ ἄνθρωπος καὶ οὐ μὴ παροικήσῃ ἐκεῖ υἱὸς ἀνθρώπου

text_en: Behold a people comes from the north, and a great nation, and many kings shall rise from the ends of the earth.
text_la: Ecce populus venit ab aquilone, et gens magna, et reges multi consurgent a finibus terræ.
text_pt: Eis que um povo vem do norte; uma grande nação e muitos reis se levantarão dos extremos da terra.
text_el: ἰδοὺ λαὸς ἔρχεται ἀπὸ βορρᾶ καὶ ἔθνος μέγα καὶ βασιλεῖς πολλοὶ ἐξεγερθήσονται ἀπ' ἐσχάτου τῆς γῆς

text_en: They shall take the bow and the shield: they are cruel and unmerciful: their voice shall roar like the sea, and they shall ride upon horses: like a man prepared for battle against you, O daughter of Babylon .
text_la: Arcum et scutum apprehendent : crudeles sunt, et immisericordes : vox eorum quasi mare sonabit, et super equos ascendent, sicut vir paratus ad prælium contra te, filia Babylon.
text_pt: Armam-se de arco e lança; eles são cruéis, e não têm piedade; a sua voz bramará como o mar, e sobre cavalos cavalgarão, todos postos em ordem como um homem para a batalha, contra ti, ó filha de babilônia.
text_el: τόξον καὶ ἐγχειρίδιον ἔχοντες ἰταμός ἐστιν καὶ οὐ μὴ ἐλεήσῃ φωνὴ αὐτῶν ὡς θάλασσα ἠχήσει ἐφ' ἵπποις ἱππάσονται παρεσκευασμένοι ὥσπερ πῦρ εἰς πόλεμον πρὸς σέ θύγατερ Βαβυλῶνος

text_en: The king of Babylon has heard the report of them, and his hands are grown feeble: anguish has taken hold of him, pangs as a woman in labour.
text_la: Audivit rex Babylonis famam eorum, et dissolutæ sunt manus ejus : angustia apprehendit eum, dolor quasi parturientem.
text_pt: O rei de babilônia ouviu a sua fama, e desfaleceram as suas mãos; a angústia se apoderou dele, como da que está de parto.
text_el: ἤκουσεν βασιλεὺς Βαβυλῶνος τὴν ἀκοὴν αὐτῶν καὶ παρελύθησαν αἱ χεῖρες αὐτοῦ θλῖψις κατεκράτησεν αὐτοῦ ὠδῖνες ὡς τικτούσης

text_en: Behold he shall come up like a lion from the swelling of the Jordan to the strong and beautiful: for I will make him run suddenly upon her: and who shall be the chosen one whom I may appoint over her? For who is like to me? And who shall bear up against me? And who is that shepherd that can withstand my countenance?
text_la: Ecce quasi leo ascendet, de superbia Jordanis ad pulchritudinem robustam, quia subito currere faciam eum ad illam. Et quis erit electus, quem præponam ei? quis est enim similis mei? et quis sustinebit me? et quis est iste pastor, qui resistat vultui meo?
text_pt: Eis que ele como leão subirá da enchente do Jordão, contra a morada forte, porque num momento o farei correr dali; e quem é o escolhido que porei sobre ela? porque quem é semelhante a mim, e quem me fixará o tempo? E quem é o pastor que poderá permanecer perante mim?
text_el: ἰδοὺ ὥσπερ λέων ἀναβήσεται ἀπὸ τοῦ Ιορδάνου εἰς τόπον Αιθαμ ὅτι ταχέως ἐκδιώξω αὐτοὺς ἀπ' αὐτῆς καὶ πάντα νεανίσκον ἐπ' αὐτὴν ἐπιστήσω ὅτι τίς ὥσπερ ἐγώ καὶ τίς ἀντιστήσεταί μοι καὶ τίς οὗτος ποιμήν ὃς στήσεται κατὰ πρόσωπόν μου

text_en: Therefore hear the counsel of the Lord , which he has taken against Babylon : and his thoughts which he has thought against the land of the Chaldeans: surely the little ones of the flocks shall pull them down, of a truth their habitation shall be destroyed with them.
text_la: Propterea audite consilium Domini quod mente concepit adversum Babylonem, et cogitationes ejus quas cogitavit super terram Chaldæorum : nisi detraxerint eos parvuli gregum, nisi dissipatum fuerit cum ipsis habitaculum eorum.
text_pt: Portanto ouvi o conselho do SENHOR, que ele decretou contra babilônia, e os seus desígnios que intentou contra a terra dos caldeus: certamente os pequenos do rebanho serão arrastados; certamente ele assolará as suas moradas sobre eles.
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο ἀκούσατε τὴν βουλὴν κυρίου ἣν βεβούλευται ἐπὶ Βαβυλῶνα καὶ λογισμοὺς αὐτοῦ οὓς ἐλογίσατο ἐπὶ τοὺς κατοικοῦντας Χαλδαίους ἐὰν μὴ διαφθαρῇ τὰ ἀρνία τῶν προβάτων αὐτῶν ἐὰν μὴ ἀφανισθῇ νομὴ ἀπ' αὐτῶν

text_en: At the noise of the taking of Babylon the earth is moved, and the cry is heard amongst the nations.
text_la: A voce captivitatis Babylonis commota est terra, et clamor inter gentes auditus est.
text_pt: Ao estrondo da tomada de babilônia estremeceu a terra; e o grito se ouviu entre as nações.
text_el: ὅτι ἀπὸ φωνῆς ἁλώσεως Βαβυλῶνος σεισθήσεται ἡ γῆ καὶ κραυγὴ ἐν ἔθνεσιν ἀκουσθήσεται

text_en: Thus says the Lord : Behold I will raise up as it were a pestilential wind against Babylon and against the inhabitants thereof, who have lifted up their heart against me.
text_la: Hæc dicit Dominus : Ecce ego suscitabo super Babylonem et super habitatores ejus, qui cor suum levaverunt contra me, quasi ventum pestilentem :
text_pt: Assim diz o SENHOR: Eis que levantarei um vento destruidor contra babilônia, e contra os que habitam no meio dos que se levantam contra mim.
text_el: τάδε λέγει κύριος ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ ἐξεγείρω ἐπὶ Βαβυλῶνα καὶ ἐπὶ τοὺς κατοικοῦντας Χαλδαίους ἄνεμον καύσωνα διαφθείροντα

text_en: And I will send to Babylon fanners, and they shall fan her, and shall destroy her land: for they have come upon her on every side in the day of her affliction.
text_la: et mittam in Babylonem ventilatores, et ventilabunt eam et demolientur terram ejus, quoniam venerunt super eam undique in die afflictionis ejus.
text_pt: E enviarei padejadores contra babilônia, que a padejarão, e despejarão a sua terra; porque virão contra ela em redor no dia da calamidade.
text_el: καὶ ἐξαποστελῶ εἰς Βαβυλῶνα ὑβριστάς καὶ καθυβρίσουσιν αὐτὴν καὶ λυμανοῦνται τὴν γῆν αὐτῆς οὐαὶ ἐπὶ Βαβυλῶνα κυκλόθεν ἐν ἡμέρᾳ κακώσεως αὐτῆς

text_en: Let not him that bends, bend his bow, and let not him go up that is armed with a coat of mail: spare not her young men, destroy all her army.
text_la: Non tendat qui tendit arcum suum, et non ascendat loricatus : nolite parcere juvenibus ejus; interficite omnem militiam ejus.
text_pt: O flecheiro arme o seu arco contra o que arma o seu arco, e contra o que se exalta na sua couraça; e não perdoeis aos seus jovens; destruí a todo o seu exército.
text_el: ἐπ' αὐτὴν τεινέτω ὁ τείνων τὸ τόξον αὐτοῦ καὶ περιθέσθω ᾧ ἐστιν ὅπλα αὐτῷ καὶ μὴ φείσησθε ἐπὶ νεανίσκους αὐτῆς καὶ ἀφανίσατε πᾶσαν τὴν δύναμιν αὐτῆς

text_en: And the slain shall fall in the land of the Chaldeans, and the wounded in the regions thereof.
text_la: Et cadent interfecti in terra Chaldæorum, et vulnerati in regionibus ejus.
text_pt: E os mortos cairão na terra dos caldeus, e atravessados nas suas ruas.
text_el: καὶ πεσοῦνται τραυματίαι ἐν γῇ Χαλδαίων καὶ κατακεκεντημένοι ἔξωθεν αὐτῆς

text_en: For Israel and Juda have not been forsaken by their God the Lord of hosts : but their land has been filled with sin against the Holy One of Israel .
text_la: Quoniam non fuit viduatus Israël et Juda a Deo suo, Domino exercituum, terra autem eorum repleta est delicto a Sancto Israël.
text_pt: Porque Israel e Judá não foram abandonados do seu Deus, do Senhor dos Exércitos, ainda que a sua terra esteja cheia de culpas contra o Santo de Israel.
text_el: διότι οὐκ ἐχήρευσεν Ισραηλ καὶ Ιουδας ἀπὸ θεοῦ αὐτῶν ἀπὸ κυρίου παντοκράτορος ὅτι ἡ γῆ αὐτῶν ἐπλήσθη ἀδικίας ἀπὸ τῶν ἁγίων Ισραηλ

text_en: Flee from the midst of Babylon , and let every one save his own life: be not silent upon her iniquity : for it is the time of revenge from the Lord , he will render unto her what she has deserved.
text_la: Fugite de medio Babylonis, et salvet unusquisque animam suam : nolite tacere super iniquitatem ejus, quoniam tempus ultionis est a Domino : vicissitudinem ipse retribuet ei.
text_pt: Fugi do meio de babilônia, e livrai cada um a sua alma, e não vos destruais na sua maldade; porque este é o tempo da vingança do SENHOR; que lhe dará a sua recompensa.
text_el: φεύγετε ἐκ μέσου Βαβυλῶνος καὶ ἀνασῴζετε ἕκαστος τὴν ψυχὴν αὐτοῦ καὶ μὴ ἀπορριφῆτε ἐν τῇ ἀδικίᾳ αὐτῆς ὅτι καιρὸς ἐκδικήσεως αὐτῆς ἐστιν παρὰ κυρίου ἀνταπόδομα αὐτὸς ἀνταποδίδωσιν αὐτῇ

text_en: Babylon has been a golden cup in the hand of the Lord , that made all the earth drunk: the nations have drunk of her wine, and therefore they have staggered.
text_la: Calix aureus Babylon in manu Domini, inebrians omnem terram : de vino ejus biberunt gentes, et ideo commotæ sunt.
text_pt: babilônia era um copo de ouro na mão do SENHOR, o qual embriagava a toda a terra; do seu vinho beberam as nações; por isso as nações enlouqueceram.
text_el: ποτήριον χρυσοῦν Βαβυλὼν ἐν χειρὶ κυρίου μεθύσκον πᾶσαν τὴν γῆν ἀπὸ τοῦ οἴνου αὐτῆς ἐπίοσαν ἔθνη διὰ τοῦτο ἐσαλεύθησαν

text_en: Babylon is suddenly fallen, and destroyed: howl for her, take balm for her pain, if so she may be healed.
text_la: Subito cecidit Babylon, et contrita est. Ululate super eam : tollite resinam ad dolorem ejus, si forte sanetur.
text_pt: Num momento caiu babilônia, e ficou arruinada; lamentai por ela, tomai bálsamo para a sua dor, porventura sarará.
text_el: καὶ ἄφνω ἔπεσεν Βαβυλὼν καὶ συνετρίβη θρηνεῖτε αὐτήν λάβετε ῥητίνην τῇ διαφθορᾷ αὐτῆς εἴ πως ἰαθήσεται

text_en: We would have cured Babylon , but she is not healed: let us forsake her, and let us go every man to his own land: because her judgment has reached even to the heavens , and is lifted up to the clouds.
text_la: Curavimus Babylonem, et non est sanata : derelinquamus eam, et eamus unusquisque in terram suam : quoniam pervenit usque ad cælos judicium ejus, et elevatum est usque ad nubes.
text_pt: Queríamos curar babilônia, porém ela não sarou; deixai-a, e vamo-nos cada um para a sua terra; porque o seu juízo chegou até ao céu, e se elevou até às mais altas nuvens.
text_el: ἰατρεύσαμεν τὴν Βαβυλῶνα καὶ οὐκ ἰάθη ἐγκαταλίπωμεν αὐτὴν καὶ ἀπέλθωμεν ἕκαστος εἰς τὴν γῆν αὐτοῦ ὅτι ἤγγισεν εἰς οὐρανὸν τὸ κρίμα αὐτῆς ἐξῆρεν ἕως τῶν ἄστρων

text_en: The Lord has brought forth our justices: Come, and let us declare in Sion the work of the Lord our God .
text_la: Protulit Dominus justitias nostras : venite, et narremus in Sion opus Domini Dei nostri.
text_pt: O Senhor trouxe a nossa justiça à luz; vinde e contemos em Sião a obra do Senhor, nosso Deus.
text_el: ἐξήνεγκεν κύριος τὸ κρίμα αὐτοῦ δεῦτε καὶ ἀναγγείλωμεν εἰς Σιων τὰ ἔργα κυρίου θεοῦ ἡμῶν

text_en: Sharpen the arrows, fill the quivers, the Lord has raised up the spirit of the kings of the Medes : and his mind is against Babylon to destroy it, because it is the vengeance of the Lord , the vengeance of his temple .
text_la: Acuite sagittas, implete pharetras : suscitavit Dominus spiritum regum Medorum : et contra Babylonem mens ejus est ut perdat eam, quoniam ultio Domini est, ultio templi sui.
text_pt: Aguçai as flechas, preparai os escudos; o SENHOR despertou o espírito dos reis da Média; porque o seu intento é contra babilônia para a destruir; porque esta é a vingança do SENHOR, a vingança do seu templo.
text_el: παρασκευάζετε τὰ τοξεύματα πληροῦτε τὰς φαρέτρας ἤγειρεν κύριος τὸ πνεῦμα βασιλέως Μήδων ὅτι εἰς Βαβυλῶνα ἡ ὀργὴ αὐτοῦ τοῦ ἐξολεθρεῦσαι αὐτήν ὅτι ἐκδίκησις κυρίου ἐστίν ἐκδίκησις λαοῦ αὐτοῦ ἐστιν

text_en: Upon the walls of Babylon set up the standard, strengthen the watch: set up the watchmen, prepare the ambushes: for the Lord has both purposed, and done all that he spoke against the inhabitants of Babylon .
text_la: Super muros Babylonis levate signum, augete custodiam, levate custodes, præparate insidias : quia cogitavit Dominus, et fecit quæcumque locutus est contra habitatores Babylonis.
text_pt: Arvorai um estandarte sobre os muros de babilônia, reforçai a guarda, colocai sentinelas, preparai as ciladas; porque como o SENHOR intentou, assim fez o que tinha falado contra os moradores de babilônia.
text_el: ἐπὶ τειχέων Βαβυλῶνος ἄρατε σημεῖον ἐπιστήσατε φαρέτρας ἐγείρατε φυλακάς ἑτοιμάσατε ὅπλα ὅτι ἐνεχείρησεν καὶ ποιήσει κύριος ἃ ἐλάλησεν ἐπὶ τοὺς κατοικοῦντας Βαβυλῶνα

text_en: O you that dwell upon many waters, rich in treasures, your end has come for your entire destruction.
text_la: Quæ habitas super aquas multas, locuples in thesauris : venit finis tuus, pedalis præcisionis tuæ.
text_pt: Ó tu, que habitas sobre muitas águas, rica de tesouros, é chegado o teu fim, a medida da tua avareza.
text_el: κατασκηνοῦντας ἐφ' ὕδασι πολλοῖς καὶ ἐπὶ πλήθει θησαυρῶν αὐτῆς ἥκει τὸ πέρας σου ἀληθῶς εἰς τὰ σπλάγχα σου

text_en: The Lord of hosts has sworn by himself, saying: I will fill you with men as with locusts, and they shall lift up a joyful shout against you.
text_la: Juravit Dominus exercituum per animam suam : Quoniam replebo te hominibus quasi brucho, et super te celeuma cantabitur.
text_pt: Jurou o Senhor dos Exércitos por si mesmo, dizendo: Ainda que te enchi de homens, como de lagarta, contudo levantarão gritaria contra ti.
text_el: ὅτι ὤμοσεν κύριος κατὰ τοῦ βραχίονος αὐτοῦ διότι πληρώσω σε ἀνθρώπων ὡσεὶ ἀκρίδων καὶ φθέγξονται ἐπὶ σὲ οἱ καταβαίνοντες

text_en: He that made the earth by his power, that has prepared the world by his wisdom, and stretched out the heavens by his understanding.
text_la: Qui fecit terram in fortitudine sua, præparavit orbem in sapientia sua, et prudentia sua extendit cælos.
text_pt: Ele fez a terra com o seu poder, e ordenou o mundo com a sua sabedoria, e estendeu os céus com o seu entendimento.
text_el: ποιῶν γῆν ἐν τῇ ἰσχύι αὐτοῦ ἑτοιμάζων οἰκουμένην ἐν τῇ σοφίᾳ αὐτοῦ ἐν τῇ συνέσει αὐτοῦ ἐξέτεινεν τὸν οὐρανόν

text_en: When he utters his voice the waters are multiplied in heaven : he lifts up the clouds from the ends of the earth, he has turned lightning into rain: and has brought forth the wind out of his treasures.
text_la: Dante eo vocem, multiplicantur aquæ in cælo : qui levat nubes ab extremo terræ, fulgura in pluviam fecit, et produxit ventum de thesauris suis.
text_pt: Fazendo ele ouvir a sua voz, grande estrondo de águas há nos céus, e faz subir os vapores desde o fim da terra; faz os relâmpagos com a chuva, e tira o vento dos seus tesouros,
text_el: εἰς φωνὴν ἔθετο ἦχος ὕδατος ἐν τῷ οὐρανῷ καὶ ἀνήγαγεν νεφέλας ἀπ' ἐσχάτου τῆς γῆς ἀστραπὰς εἰς ὑετὸν ἐποίησεν καὶ ἐξήγαγεν φῶς ἐκ θησαυρῶν αὐτοῦ

text_en: Every man has become foolish by his knowledge : every founder is confounded by his idol , for what he has cast is a lie, and there is no breath in them.
text_la: Stultus factus est omnis homo a scientia; confusus est omnis conflator in sculptili : quia mendax est conflatio eorum, nec est spiritus in eis.
text_pt: Embrutecido é todo o homem, no seu conhecimento; envergonha-se todo o artífice da imagem de escultura; porque a sua imagem de fundição é mentira, e nelas não há espírito.
text_el: ἐμωράνθη πᾶς ἄνθρωπος ἀπὸ γνώσεως κατῃσχύνθη πᾶς χρυσοχόος ἀπὸ τῶν γλυπτῶν αὐτοῦ ὅτι ψευδῆ ἐχώνευσαν οὐκ ἔστιν πνεῦμα ἐν αὐτοῖς

text_en: They are vain works, and worthy to be laughed at, in the time of their visitation they shall perish.
text_la: Vana sunt opera, et risu digna : in tempore visitationis suæ peribunt.
text_pt: Vaidade são, obra de enganos; no tempo da sua visitação perecerão.
text_el: μάταιά ἐστιν ἔργα μεμωκημένα ἐν καιρῷ ἐπισκέψεως αὐτῶν ἀπολοῦνται

text_en: The portion of Jacob is not like them: for he that made all things he it is, and Israel is the sceptre of his inheritance: the Lord of hosts is his name .
text_la: Non sicut hæc, pars Jacob, quia qui fecit omnia ipse est : et Israël sceptrum hæreditatis ejus : Dominus exercituum nomen ejus.
text_pt: Não é semelhante a estes a porção de Jacó; porque ele é o que formou tudo; e Israel é a tribo da sua herança; o Senhor dos Exércitos é o seu nome.
text_el: οὐ τοιαύτη μερὶς τῷ Ιακωβ ὅτι ὁ πλάσας τὰ πάντα αὐτός ἐστιν κληρονομία αὐτοῦ κύριος ὄνομα αὐτῷ

text_en: You dash together for me the weapons of war , and with you I will dash nations together, and with you I will destroy kingdoms:
text_la: Collidis tu mihi vasa belli : et ego collidam in te gentes, et disperdam in te regna :
text_pt: Tu és meu machado de batalha e minhas armas de guerra, e por meio de ti despedaçarei as nações e por ti destruirei os reis;
text_el: διασκορπίζεις σύ μοι σκεύη πολέμου καὶ διασκορπιῶ ἐν σοὶ ἔθνη καὶ ἐξαρῶ ἐκ σοῦ βασιλεῖς

text_en: And with you I will break in pieces the horse, and his rider, and with you I will break in pieces the chariot, and him that gets up into it:
text_la: et collidam in te equum et equitem ejus : et collidam in te currum et ascensorem ejus :
