text_pt: E por meio de ti despedaçarei o cavalo e o seu cavaleiro; e por meio de ti despedaçarei o carro e o que nele vai;
text_el: καὶ διασκορπιῶ ἐν σοὶ ἵππον καὶ ἀναβάτην αὐτοῦ καὶ διασκορπιῶ ἐν σοὶ ἅρματα καὶ ἀναβάτας αὐτῶν

text_en: And with you I will break in pieces man and woman , and with you I will break in pieces the old man and the child, and with you I will break in pieces the young man and the virgin :
text_la: et collidam in te virum et mulierem : et collidam in te senem et puerum : et collidam in te juvenem et virginem :
text_pt: E por meio de ti despedaçarei o homem e a mulher, e por meio de ti despedaçarei o velho e o moço, e por meio de ti despedaçarei o jovem e a virgem;
text_el: καὶ διασκορπιῶ ἐν σοὶ νεανίσκον καὶ παρθένον καὶ διασκορπιῶ ἐν σοὶ ἄνδρα καὶ γυναῖκα

text_en: And with you I will break in pieces the shepherd and his flock, and with you I will break in pieces the husbandman and his yoke of oxen, and with you I will break in pieces captains and rulers.
text_la: et collidam in te pastorem et gregem ejus : et collidam in te agricolam et jugales ejus : et collidam in te duces et magistratus :
text_pt: E por meio de ti despedaçarei o pastor e o seu rebanho, e por meio de ti despedaçarei o lavrador e a sua junta de bois, e por meio de ti despedaçarei os capitães e os magistrados.
text_el: καὶ διασκορπιῶ ἐν σοὶ ποιμένα καὶ τὸ ποίμνιον αὐτοῦ καὶ διασκορπιῶ ἐν σοὶ γεωργὸν καὶ τὸ γεώργιον αὐτοῦ καὶ διασκορπιῶ ἐν σοὶ ἡγεμόνας καὶ στρατηγούς σου

text_en: And I will render to Babylon , and to all the inhabitants of Chaldea all their evil , that they have done in Sion, before your eyes, says the Lord .
text_la: et reddam Babyloni, et cunctis habitatoribus Chaldææ, omne malum suum quod fecerunt in Sion, in oculis vestris, ait Dominus.
text_pt: E pagarei a babilônia, e a todos os moradores da Caldéia, toda a maldade que fizeram em Sião, aos vossos olhos, diz o SENHOR.
text_el: καὶ ἀνταποδώσω τῇ Βαβυλῶνι καὶ πᾶσι τοῖς κατοικοῦσι Χαλδαίοις πάσας τὰς κακίας αὐτῶν ἃς ἐποίησαν ἐπὶ Σιων κατ' ὀφθαλμοὺς ὑμῶν λέγει κύριος

text_en: Behold I come against you, you destroying mountain, says the Lord , which corrupts the whole earth: and I will stretch out my hand upon you, and will roll you down from the rocks, and will make you a burnt mountain.
text_la: Ecce ego ad te, mons pestifer, ait Dominus, qui corrumpis universam terram : et extendam manum meam super te, et evolvam te de petris, et dabo te in montem combustionis :
text_pt: Eis-me aqui contra ti, ó monte destruidor, diz o Senhor, que destróis toda a terra; e estenderei a minha mão contra ti, e te revolverei das rochas, e farei de ti um monte de queima.
text_el: ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ πρὸς σέ τὸ ὄρος τὸ διεφθαρμένον τὸ διαφθεῖρον πᾶσαν τὴν γῆν καὶ ἐκτενῶ τὴν χεῖρά μου ἐπὶ σὲ καὶ κατακυλιῶ σε ἀπὸ τῶν πετρῶν καὶ δώσω σε ὡς ὄρος ἐμπεπυρισμένον

text_en: And they shall not take of you a stone for the corner, nor a stone for foundations, but you shall be destroyed for ever, says the Lord .
text_la: et non tollent de te lapidem in angulum, et lapidem in fundamenta : sed perditus in æternum eris, ait Dominus.
text_pt: E não tomarão de ti pedra para esquina, nem pedra para fundamentos, porque te tornarás em assolação perpétua, diz o Senhor.
text_el: καὶ οὐ μὴ λάβωσιν ἀπὸ σοῦ λίθον εἰς γωνίαν καὶ λίθον εἰς θεμέλιον ὅτι εἰς ἀφανισμὸν εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα ἔσῃ λέγει κύριος

text_en: Set up a standard in the land: sound with the trumpet among the nations: prepare the nations against her: call together against her the kings of Ararat, Menni, and Ascenez: number Taphsar against her, bring the horse as the stinging locust.
text_la: Levate signum in terra, clangite buccina in gentibus, sanctificate super eam gentes, annuntiate contra illam regibus Ararat, Menni, et Ascenez : numerate contra eam Taphsar, adducite equum quasi bruchum aculeatum.
text_pt: Arvorai um estandarte na terra, tocai a buzina entre as nações, preparai as nações contra ela, convocai contra ela os reinos de Ararate, Mini, e Asquenaz; ordenai contra ela um capitão, fazei subir cavalos, como lagartas eriçadas.
text_el: ἄρατε σημεῖον ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς σαλπίσατε ἐν ἔθνεσιν σάλπιγγι ἁγιάσατε ἐπ' αὐτὴν ἔθνη παραγγείλατε ἐπ' αὐτὴν βασιλείαις Αραρατ παρ' ἐμοῦ καὶ τοῖς Ασχαναζαίοις ἐπιστήσατε ἐπ' αὐτὴν βελοστάσεις ἀναβιβάσατε ἐπ' αὐτὴν ἵππον ὡς ἀκρίδων πλῆθος

text_en: Prepare the nations against her, the kings of Media , their captains , and all their rulers, and all the land of their dominion.
text_la: Sanctificate contra eam gentes, reges Mediæ, duces ejus, et universos magistratus ejus, cunctamque terram potestatis ejus.
text_pt: Preparai contra ela as nações, os reis da Média, os seus capitães, e todos os seus magistrados, e toda a terra do seu domínio.
text_el: ἁγιάσατε ἐπ' αὐτὴν ἔθνη τὸν βασιλέα τῶν Μήδων καὶ πάσης τῆς γῆς τοὺς ἡγουμένους αὐτοῦ καὶ πάντας τοὺς στρατηγοὺς αὐτοῦ

text_en: And the land shall be in a commotion, and shall be troubled: for the design of the Lord against Babylon shall awake, to make the land of Babylon desert and uninhabitable.
text_la: Et commovebitur terra et conturbabitur, quia evigilabit contra Babylonem cogitatio Domini, ut ponat terram Babylonis desertam et inhabitabilem.
text_pt: Então tremerá a terra, e doer-se-á, porque cada um dos desígnios do SENHOR está firme contra babilônia, para fazer da terra de babilônia uma desolação, sem habitantes.
text_el: ἐσείσθη ἡ γῆ καὶ ἐπόνεσεν διότι ἐξανέστη ἐπὶ Βαβυλῶνα λογισμὸς κυρίου τοῦ θεῖναι τὴν γῆν Βαβυλῶνος εἰς ἀφανισμὸν καὶ μὴ κατοικεῖσθαι αὐτήν

text_en: The valiant men of Babylon have forborne to fight, they have dwelt in holds: their strength has failed, and they have become as women : her dwelling places are burnt, her bars are broken.
text_la: Cessaverunt fortes Babylonis a prælio; habitaverunt in præsidiis : devoratum est robur eorum, et facti sunt quasi mulieres : incensa sunt tabernacula ejus, contriti sunt vectes ejus.
text_pt: Os poderosos de babilônia cessaram de pelejar, ficaram nas fortalezas, desfaleceu a sua força, tornaram-se como mulheres; incendiaram as suas moradas, quebrados foram os seus ferrolhos.
text_el: ἐξέλιπεν μαχητὴς Βαβυλῶνος τοῦ πολεμεῖν καθήσονται ἐκεῖ ἐν περιοχῇ ἐθραύσθη ἡ δυναστεία αὐτῶν ἐγενήθησαν ὡσεὶ γυναῖκες ἐνεπυρίσθη τὰ σκηνώματα αὐτῆς συνετρίβησαν οἱ μοχλοὶ αὐτῆς

text_en: One running post shall meet another, and messenger shall meet messenger: to tell the king of Babylon that his city is taken from one end to the other:
text_la: Currens obviam currenti veniet, et nuntius obvius nuntianti, ut annuntiet regi Babylonis quia capta est civitas ejus a summo usque ad summum.
text_pt: Um correio correrá ao encontro de outro correio, e um mensageiro ao encontro de outro mensageiro, para anunciar ao rei de babilônia que a sua cidade está tomada de todos os lados.
text_el: διώκων εἰς ἀπάντησιν διώκοντος διώξεται καὶ ἀναγγέλλων εἰς ἀπάντησιν ἀναγγέλλοντος τοῦ ἀναγγεῖλαι τῷ βασιλεῖ Βαβυλῶνος ὅτι ἑάλωκεν ἡ πόλις αὐτοῦ

text_en: And that the fords are taken, and the marshes are burnt with fire, and the men of war are affrighted.
text_la: Et vada præoccupata sunt, et paludes incensæ sunt igni, et viri bellatores conturbati sunt.
text_pt: E os vaus estão ocupados, e os canaviais queimados a fogo; e os homens de guerra ficaram assombrados.
text_el: ἀπ' ἐσχάτου τῶν διαβάσεων αὐτοῦ ἐλήμφθησαν καὶ τὰ συστέματα αὐτῶν ἐνέπρησαν ἐν πυρί καὶ ἄνδρες αὐτοῦ οἱ πολεμισταὶ ἐξέρχονται

text_en: For thus says the Lord of hosts the God of Israel : The daughter of Babylon is like a thrashingfloor, this is the time of her thrashing: yet a little while, and the time of her harvest shall come.
text_la: Quia hæc dicit Dominus exercituum, Deus Israël : Filia Babylonis quasi area, tempus trituræ ejus : adhuc modicum, et veniet tempus messionis ejus.
text_pt: Porque assim diz o SENHOR dos Exércitos, o Deus de Israel: A filha de babilônia é como uma eira, no tempo da debulha; ainda um pouco, e o tempo da sega lhe virá.
text_el: διότι τάδε λέγει κύριος οἶκοι βασιλέως Βαβυλῶνος ὡς ἅλων ὥριμος ἀλοηθήσονται ἔτι μικρὸν καὶ ἥξει ὁ ἄμητος αὐτῆς

text_en: Nabuchodonosor king of Babylon has eaten me up, he has devoured me: he has made me as an empty vessel: he has swallowed me up like a dragon, he has filled his belly with my delicate meats, and he has cast me out.
text_la: Comedit me, devoravit me Nabuchodonosor rex Babylonis : reddidit me quasi vas inane, absorbuit me quasi draco, replevit ventrem suum teneritudine mea, et ejecit me.
text_pt: Nabucodonosor, rei de babilônia, devorou-me, colocou-me de lado, fez de mim um vaso vazio, como chacal me tragou, encheu o seu ventre das minhas delicadezas; lançou-me fora.
text_el: κατέφαγέν με ἐμερίσατό με κατέλαβέν με σκεῦος λεπτὸν Ναβουχοδονοσορ βασιλεὺς Βαβυλῶνος κατέπιέν με ὡς δράκων ἔπλησεν τὴν κοιλίαν αὐτοῦ ἀπὸ τῆς τρυφῆς μου ἐξῶσέν με

text_en: The wrong done to me, and my flesh be upon Babylon , says the habitation of Sion: and my blood upon the inhabitants of Chaldea, says Jerusalem .
text_la: Iniquitas adversum me et caro mea super Babylonem, dicit habitatio Sion : et sanguis meus super habitatores Chaldææ, dicit Jerusalem.
text_pt: A violência que se fez a mim e à minha carne venha sobre babilônia, dirá a moradora de Sião; e o meu sangue caia sobre os moradores da Caldéia, dirá Jerusalém.
text_el: οἱ μόχθοι μου καὶ αἱ ταλαιπωρίαι μου εἰς Βαβυλῶνα ἐρεῖ κατοικοῦσα Σιων καὶ τὸ αἷμά μου ἐπὶ τοὺς κατοικοῦντας Χαλδαίους ἐρεῖ Ιερουσαλημ

text_en: Therefore thus says the Lord : Behold I will judge your cause, and will take vengeance for you, and I will make her sea desolate, and will dry up her spring.
text_la: Propterea hæc dicit Dominus : Ecce ego judicabo causam tuam, et ulciscar ultionem tuam : et desertum faciam mare ejus, et siccabo venam ejus.
text_pt: Portanto, assim diz o Senhor: Eis que pleitearei a tua causa, e tomarei vingança por ti; e secarei o seu mar, e farei que se esgote o seu manancial.
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο τάδε λέγει κύριος ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ κρινῶ τὴν ἀντίδικόν σου καὶ ἐκδικήσω τὴν ἐκδίκησίν σου καὶ ἐρημώσω τὴν θάλασσαν αὐτῆς καὶ ξηρανῶ τὴν πηγὴν αὐτῆς

text_en: And Babylon shall be reduced to heaps, a dwelling place for dragons, an astonishment and a hissing, because there is no inhabitant.
text_la: Et erit Babylon in tumulos, habitatio draconum, stupor et sibilus, eo quod non sit habitator.
text_pt: E babilônia se tornará em montões, morada de chacais, espanto e assobio, sem que haja quem nela habite.
text_el: καὶ ἔσται Βαβυλὼν εἰς ἀφανισμὸν καὶ οὐ κατοικηθήσεται

text_en: They shall roar together like lions, they shall shake their manes like young lions.
text_la: Simul ut leones rugient; excutient comas veluti catuli leonum.
text_pt: Juntamente rugirão como filhos dos leões; bramarão como filhotes de leões.
text_el: ἅμα ὡς λέοντες ἐξηγέρθησαν καὶ ὡς σκύμνοι λεόντων

text_en: In their heat I will set them drink: and I will make them drunk, that they may slumber, and sleep an everlasting sleep, and awake no more, says the Lord .
text_la: In calore eorum ponam potus eorum, et inebriabo eos ut sopiantur, et dormiant somnum sempiternum, et non consurgant, dicit Dominus.
text_pt: Estando eles excitados, lhes darei a sua bebida, e os embriagarei, para que andem saltando; porém dormirão um perpétuo sono, e não acordarão, diz o Senhor.
text_el: ἐν τῇ θερμασίᾳ αὐτῶν δώσω πότημα αὐτοῖς καὶ μεθύσω αὐτούς ὅπως καρωθῶσιν καὶ ὑπνώσωσιν ὕπνον αἰώνιον καὶ οὐ μὴ ἐγερθῶσι λέγει κύριος

text_en: I will bring them down like lambs to the slaughter, and like rams with kids.
text_la: Deducam eos quasi agnos ad victimam, et quasi arietes cum hædis.
text_pt: Fá-los-ei descer como cordeiros à matança, como carneiros e bodes.
text_el: καταβιβάσω αὐτοὺς ὡς ἄρνας εἰς σφαγὴν καὶ ὡς κριοὺς μετ' ἐρίφων

text_en: How is Sesach taken, and the renowned one of all the earth surprised? How is Babylon become an astonishment among the nations?
text_la: Quomodo capta est Sesach, et comprehensa est inclyta universæ terræ! quomodo facta est in stuporem Babylon inter gentes!
text_pt: Como foi tomada Sesaque, e apanhada de surpresa a glória de toda a terra! Como se tornou babilônia objeto de espanto entre as nações!
text_el: πῶς ἑάλω καὶ ἐθηρεύθη τὸ καύχημα πάσης τῆς γῆς πῶς ἐγένετο Βαβυλὼν εἰς ἀφανισμὸν ἐν τοῖς ἔθνεσιν

text_en: The sea has come up over Babylon : she is covered with the multitude of the waves thereof.
text_la: Ascendit super Babylonem mare : multitudine fluctuum ejus operta est.
text_pt: O mar subiu sobre babilônia; com a multidão das suas ondas se cobriu.
text_el: ἀνέβη ἐπὶ Βαβυλῶνα ἡ θάλασσα ἐν ἤχῳ κυμάτων αὐτῆς καὶ κατεκαλύφθη

text_en: Her cities have become an astonishment, a land uninhabited and desolate, a land wherein none can dwell, nor son of man pass through it.
text_la: Factæ sunt civitates ejus in stuporem, terra inhabitabilis et deserta, terra in qua nullus habitet, nec transeat per eam filius hominis.
text_pt: Tornaram-se as suas cidades em desolação, terra seca e deserta, terra em que ninguém habita, nem passa por ela filho de homem.
text_el: ἐγενήθησαν αἱ πόλεις αὐτῆς γῆ ἄνυδρος καὶ ἄβατος οὐ κατοικήσει ἐν αὐτῇ οὐδὲ εἷς οὐδὲ μὴ καταλύσῃ ἐν αὐτῇ υἱὸς ἀνθρώπου

text_en: And I will visit against Bel in Babylon , and I will bring forth out of his mouth that which he had swallowed down: and the nations shall no more flow together to him, for the wall also of Babylon shall fall.
text_la: Et visitabo super Bel in Babylone, et ejiciam quod absorbuerat de ore ejus : et non confluent ad eum ultra gentes, siquidem et murus Babylonis corruet.
text_pt: E castigarei a Bel em babilônia, e tirarei da sua boca o que tragou, e nunca mais concorrerão a ele as nações; também o muro de babilônia caiu.
text_el: καὶ ἐκδικήσω ἐπὶ Βαβυλῶνα καὶ ἐξοίσω ἃ κατέπιεν ἐκ τοῦ στόματος αὐτῆς καὶ οὐ μὴ συναχθῶσιν πρὸς αὐτὴν ἔτι τὰ ἔθνη

text_en: Go out of the midst of her, my people: that every man may save his life from the fierce wrath of the Lord .
text_la: Egredimini de medio ejus, populus meus, ut salvet unusquisque animam suam ab ira furoris Domini,
text_pt: Saí do meio dela, ó povo meu, e livrai cada um a sua alma do ardor da ira do Senhor.

text_en: And lest your hearts faint, and you fear for the rumour that shall be heard in the land: and a rumour shall come in one year, and after this year another rumour: and iniquity in the land, and ruler upon ruler.
text_la: et ne forte mollescat cor vestrum, et timeatis auditum qui audietur in terra : et veniet in anno auditio, et post hunc annum auditio, et iniquitas in terra, et dominator super dominatorem.
text_pt: E para que porventura não se enterneça o vosso coração, e não temais pelo rumor que se ouvir na terra; porque virá num ano um rumor, e depois noutro ano outro rumor; e haverá violência na terra, dominador contra dominador.

text_en: Therefore behold the days come, and I will visit the idols of Babylon : and her whole land shall be confounded, and all her slain shall fall in the midst of her.
text_la: Propterea ecce dies veniunt, et visitabo super sculptilia Babylonis, et omnis terra ejus confundetur, et universi interfecti ejus cadent in medio ejus.
text_pt: Portanto, eis que vêm dias, em que farei juízo sobre as imagens de escultura de babilônia, e toda a sua terra será envergonhada, e todos os seus mortos cairão no meio dela.

text_en: And the heavens and the earth, and all things that are in them shall give praise for Babylon : for spoilers shall come to her from the north, says the Lord .
text_la: Et laudabunt super Babylonem cæli et terra, et omnia quæ in eis sunt : quia ab aquilone venient ei prædones, ait Dominus.
text_pt: E os céus e a terra, com tudo quanto neles há, jubilarão sobre babilônia; porque do norte lhe virão os destruidores, diz o SENHOR.

text_en: And as Babylon caused that there should fall slain in Israel : so of Babylon there shall fall slain in all the earth.
text_la: Et quomodo fecit Babylon, ut caderent occisi in Israël, sic de Babylone cadent occisi in universa terra.
text_pt: Como babilônia fez cair mortos os de Israel, assim em babilônia cairão os mortos de toda a terra.
text_el: καὶ ἐν Βαβυλῶνι πεσοῦνται τραυματίαι πάσης τῆς γῆς

text_en: You that have escaped the sword, come away, stand not still: remember the Lord afar off, and let Jerusalem come into your mind.
text_la: Qui fugistis gladium, venite, nolite stare : recordamini procul Domini, et Jerusalem ascendat super cor vestrum.
text_pt: Vós, que escapastes da espada, ide-vos, não pareis; de longe lembrai-vos do Senhor, e suba Jerusalém a vossa mente.
text_el: ἀνασῳζόμενοι ἐκ γῆς πορεύεσθε καὶ μὴ ἵστασθε οἱ μακρόθεν μνήσθητε τοῦ κυρίου καὶ Ιερουσαλημ ἀναβήτω ἐπὶ τὴν καρδίαν ὑμῶν

text_en: We are confounded, because we have heard reproach: shame has covered our faces: because strangers have come upon the sanctuaries of the house of the Lord .
text_la: Confusi sumus, quoniam audivimus opprobrium : operuit ignominia facies nostras, quia venerunt alieni super sanctificationem domus Domini.
text_pt: Direis: Envergonhados estamos, porque ouvimos opróbrio; vergonha cobriu o nosso rosto, porquanto vieram estrangeiros contra os santuários da casa do Senhor.
text_el: ᾐσχύνθημεν ὅτι ἠκούσαμεν ὀνειδισμὸν ἡμῶν κατεκάλυψεν ἀτιμία τὸ πρόσωπον ἡμῶν εἰσῆλθον ἀλλογενεῖς εἰς τὰ ἅγια ἡμῶν εἰς οἶκον κυρίου

text_en: Therefore behold the days come, says the Lord , and I will visit her graven things, and in all her land the wounded shall groan:
text_la: Propterea ecce dies veniunt, ait Dominus, et visitabo super sculptilia ejus, et in omni terra ejus mugiet vulneratus.
text_pt: Portanto, eis que vêm dias, diz o Senhor, em que farei juízo sobre as suas imagens de escultura; e gemerão os feridos em toda a sua terra.
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο ἰδοὺ ἡμέραι ἔρχονται λέγει κύριος καὶ ἐκδικήσω ἐπὶ τὰ γλυπτὰ αὐτῆς καὶ ἐν πάσῃ τῇ γῇ αὐτῆς πεσοῦνται τραυματίαι

text_en: If Babylon should mount up to heaven , and establish her strength on high: from me there should come spoilers upon her, says the Lord .
text_la: Si ascenderit Babylon in cælum, et firmaverit in excelso robur suum, a me venient vastatores ejus, ait Dominus.
text_pt: Ainda que babilônia subisse aos céus, e ainda que fortificasse a altura da sua fortaleza, todavia de mim virão destruidores sobre ela, diz o SENHOR.
text_el: ὅτι ἐὰν ἀναβῇ Βαβυλὼν ὡς ὁ οὐρανὸς καὶ ὅτι ἐὰν ὀχυρώσῃ ὕψος ἰσχύος αὐτῆς παρ' ἐμοῦ ἥξουσιν ἐξολεθρεύοντες αὐτήν λέγει κύριος

text_en: The noise of a cry from Babylon , and great destruction from the land of the Chaldeans:
text_la: Vox clamoris de Babylone, et contritio magna de terra Chaldæorum :
text_pt: De babilônia se ouve clamor de grande destruição da terra dos caldeus;
text_el: φωνὴ κραυγῆς ἐν Βαβυλῶνι καὶ συντριβὴ μεγάλη ἐν γῇ Χαλδαίων

text_en: Because the Lord has laid Babylon waste, and destroyed out of her the great voice: and their wave shall roar like many waters: their voice has made a noise:
text_la: quoniam vastavit Dominus Babylonem, et perdidit ex ea vocem magnam : et sonabunt fluctus eorum quasi aquæ multæ; dedit sonitum vox eorum :
text_pt: Porque o SENHOR tem destruído babilônia, e tem feito perecer nela a sua grande voz; quando as suas ondas bramam como muitas águas, é emitido o ruído da sua voz.
text_el: ὅτι ἐξωλέθρευσεν κύριος τὴν Βαβυλῶνα καὶ ἀπώλεσεν ἀπ' αὐτῆς φωνὴν μεγάλην ἠχοῦσαν ὡς ὕδατα πολλά ἔδωκεν εἰς ὄλεθρον φωνὴν αὐτῆς

text_en: Because the spoiler has come upon her, that is, upon Babylon , and her valiant men are taken, and their bow is weakened, because the Lord , who is a strong revenger, will surely repay.
text_la: quia venit super eam, id est super Babylonem, prædo, et apprehensi sunt fortes ejus, et emarcuit arcus eorum, quia fortis ultor Dominus reddens retribuet.
text_pt: Porque o destruidor vem sobre ela, sobre babilônia, e os seus poderosos serão presos, já estão quebrados os seus arcos; porque o SENHOR, Deus das recompensas, certamente lhe retribuirá.
text_el: ὅτι ἦλθεν ἐπὶ Βαβυλῶνα ταλαιπωρία ἑάλωσαν οἱ μαχηταὶ αὐτῆς ἐπτόηται τὸ τόξον αὐτῶν ὅτι θεὸς ἀνταποδίδωσιν αὐτοῖς κύριος ἀνταποδίδωσιν αὐτῇ τὴν ἀνταπόδοσιν

text_en: And I will make her princes drunk, and her wise men , and her captains , and her rulers, and her valiant men : and they shall sleep an everlasting sleep, and shall awake no more, says the king whose name is Lord of hosts .
text_la: Et inebriabo principes ejus, et sapientes ejus, et duces ejus, et magistratus ejus, et fortes ejus : et dormient somnum sempiternum, et non expergiscentur, ait Rex (Dominus exercituum nomen ejus).
text_pt: E embriagarei os seus príncipes, e os seus sábios e os seus capitães, e os seus magistrados, e os seus poderosos; e dormirão um sono eterno, e não acordarão, diz o Rei, cujo nome é o Senhor dos Exércitos.
text_el: καὶ μεθύσει μέθῃ τοὺς ἡγεμόνας αὐτῆς καὶ τοὺς σοφοὺς αὐτῆς καὶ τοὺς στρατηγοὺς αὐτῆς λέγει ὁ βασιλεύς κύριος παντοκράτωρ ὄνομα αὐτῷ

text_en: Thus says the Lord of hosts : That broad wall of Babylon shall be utterly broken down, and her high gates shall be burnt with fire, and the labours of the people shall come to nothing, and of the nations shall go to the fire, and shall perish.
text_la: Hæc dicit Dominus exercituum : Murus Babylonis ille latissimus suffossione suffodietur, et portæ ejus excelsæ igni comburentur, et labores populorum ad nihilum, et gentium in ignem erunt, et disperibunt.
text_pt: Assim diz o SENHOR dos Exércitos: Os largos muros de babilônia serão totalmente derrubados, e as suas altas portas serão abrasadas pelo fogo; e trabalharão os povos em vão, e as nações no fogo, e eles se cansarão.
text_el: τάδε λέγει κύριος τεῖχος Βαβυλῶνος ἐπλατύνθη κατασκαπτόμενον κατασκαφήσεται καὶ αἱ πύλαι αὐτῆς αἱ ὑψηλαὶ ἐμπυρισθήσονται καὶ οὐ κοπιάσουσιν λαοὶ εἰς κενόν καὶ ἔθνη ἐν ἀρχῇ ἐκλείψουσιν

text_en: The word that Jeremiah the prophet commanded Saraias the son of Nerias, the son of Maasias, when he went with King Sedecias to Babylon , in the fourth year of his reign: now Saraias was chief over the prophecy .
text_la: Verbum quod præcepit Jeremias propheta Saraiæ filio Neriæ filii Maasiæ, cum pergeret cum Sedecia rege in Babylonem, in anno quarto regni ejus : Saraias autem erat princeps prophetiæ.
text_pt: A palavra que Jeremias, o profeta, mandou a Seraías, filho de Nerias, filho de Maaséias, indo ele com Zedequias, rei de Judá, a babilônia, no quarto ano do seu reinado. E Seraías era o camareiro-mor.
text_el: ὁ λόγος ὃν ἐνετείλατο κύριος Ιερεμια τῷ προφήτῃ εἰπεῖν τῷ Σαραια υἱῷ Νηριου υἱοῦ Μαασαιου ὅτε ἐπορεύετο παρὰ Σεδεκιου βασιλέως Ιουδα εἰς Βαβυλῶνα ἐν τῷ ἔτει τῷ τετάρτῳ τῆς βασιλείας αὐτοῦ καὶ Σαραιας ἄρχων δώρων

text_en: And Jeremias wrote in one book all the evil that was to come upon Babylon : all these words that are written against Babylon .
text_la: Et scripsit Jeremias omne malum quod venturum erat super Babylonem, in libro uno : omnia verba hæc quæ scripta sunt contra Babylonem.
text_pt: Escreveu, pois, Jeremias num livro todo o mal que havia de vir sobre babilônia, a saber, todas estas palavras que estavam escritas contra babilônia.
text_el: καὶ ἔγραψεν Ιερεμιας πάντα τὰ κακά ἃ ἥξει ἐπὶ Βαβυλῶνα ἐν βιβλίῳ ἑνί πάντας τοὺς λόγους τούτους τοὺς γεγραμμένους ἐπὶ Βαβυλῶνα

text_en: And Jeremias said to Saraias: When you shall come into Babylon , and shall see, and shall read all these words,
text_la: Et dixit Jeremias ad Saraiam : Cum veneris in Babylonem, et videris, et legeris omnia verba hæc,
text_pt: E disse Jeremias a Seraías: Quando chegares a babilônia, verás e lerás todas estas palavras.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Ιερεμιας πρὸς Σαραιαν ὅταν ἔλθῃς εἰς Βαβυλῶνα καὶ ὄψῃ καὶ ἀναγνώσῃ πάντας τοὺς λόγους τούτους

text_en: you shall say: O Lord , you have spoken against this place to destroy it: so that there should be neither man nor beast to dwell therein, and that it should be desolate for ever.
text_la: dices : Domine, tu locutus es contra locum istum, ut disperderes eum, ne sit qui in eo habitet, ab homine usque ad pecus, et ut sit perpetua solitudo.
text_pt: E dirás: Senhor, tu falaste contra este lugar, que o havias de desarraigar, até não ficar nele morador algum, nem homem nem animal, e que se tornaria em perpétua desolação.
text_el: καὶ ἐρεῖς κύριε κύριε σὺ ἐλάλησας ἐπὶ τὸν τόπον τοῦτον τοῦ ἐξολεθρεῦσαι αὐτὸν καὶ τοῦ μὴ εἶναι ἐν αὐτῷ κατοικοῦντας ἀπὸ ἀνθρώπου ἕως κτήνους ὅτι ἀφανισμὸς εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα ἔσται

text_en: And when you shall have made an end of reading this book, you shall tie a stone to it, and shall throw it into the midst of the Euphrates:
text_la: Cumque compleveris legere librum istum, ligabis ad eum lapidem, et projicies illum in medium Euphraten,
text_pt: E será que, acabando tu de ler este livro, atar-lhe-ás uma pedra e lançá-lo-ás no meio do Eufrates.
text_el: καὶ ἔσται ὅταν παύσῃ τοῦ ἀναγινώσκειν τὸ βιβλίον τοῦτο καὶ ἐπιδήσεις ἐπ' αὐτὸ λίθον καὶ ῥίψεις αὐτὸ εἰς μέσον τοῦ Εὐφράτου

text_en: And you shall say: Thus shall Babylon sink, and she shall not rise up from the affliction that I will bring upon her, and she shall be utterly destroyed. Thus far are the words of Jeremias.
text_la: et dices : Sic submergetur Babylon, et non consurget a facie afflictionis quam ego adduco super eam, et dissolvetur. Hucusque verba Jeremiæ.
text_pt: E dirás: Assim será afundada babilônia, e não se levantará, por causa do mal que eu hei de trazer sobre ela; e eles se cansarão. Até aqui são as palavras de Jeremias.
text_el: καὶ ἐρεῖς οὕτως καταδύσεται Βαβυλὼν καὶ οὐ μὴ ἀναστῇ ἀπὸ προσώπου τῶν κακῶν ὧν ἐγὼ ἐπάγω ἐπ' αὐτήν

text_en: Sedecias was one and twenty years old when he began to reign: and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem : and the name of his mother was Amital, the daughter of Jeremias of Lobna.
text_la: Filius viginti et unius anni erat Sedecias cum regnare cœpisset, et undecim annis regnavit in Jerusalem. Et nomen matris ejus Amital filia Jeremiæ de Lobna.
text_pt: Era Zedequias da idade de vinte e um anos quando começou a reinar, e reinou onze anos em Jerusalém; e o nome de sua mãe era Hamutal, filha de Jeremias, de Libna.
text_el: ὄντος εἰκοστοῦ καὶ ἑνὸς ἔτους Σεδεκιου ἐν τῷ βασιλεύειν αὐτόν καὶ ἕνδεκα ἔτη ἐβασίλευσεν ἐν Ιερουσαλημ καὶ ὄνομα τῇ μητρὶ αὐτοῦ Αμιτααλ θυγάτηρ Ιερεμιου ἐκ Λοβενα

text_en: And he did that which was evil in the eyes of the Lord , according to all that Joakim had done.
text_la: Et fecit malum in oculis Domini, juxta omnia quæ fecerat Joakim,
text_pt: E fez o que era mau aos olhos do Senhor, conforme tudo o que fizera Jeoiaquim.

text_en: For the wrath of the Lord was against Jerusalem , and against Juda , till he cast them out from his presence: and Sedecias revolted from the king of Babylon .
text_la: quoniam furor Domini erat in Jerusalem et in Juda, usquequo projiceret eos a facie sua : et recessit Sedecias a rege Babylonis.
text_pt: Assim, por causa da ira do SENHOR, contra Jerusalém e Judá, ele os lançou de diante dele, e Zedequias se rebelou contra o rei de babilônia.

text_en: And it came to pass in the ninth year of his reign, in the tenth month, the tenth day of the month, that Nabuchodonosor the king of Babylon came, he and all his army, against Jerusalem , and they besieged it, and built forts against it round about.
text_la: Factum est autem in anno nono regni ejus, in mense decimo, decima mensis, venit Nabuchodonosor rex Babylonis, ipse et omnis exercitus ejus, adversus Jerusalem : et obsederunt eam, et ædificaverunt contra eam munitiones in circuitu.
text_pt: E aconteceu, que no ano nono do seu reinado, no décimo mês, no décimo dia do mês, veio Nabucodonosor, rei de babilônia, contra Jerusalém, ele e todo o seu exército, e se acamparam contra ela, e levantaram contra ela trincheiras ao redor.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο ἐν τῷ ἔτει τῷ ἐνάτῳ τῆς βασιλείας αὐτοῦ ἐν μηνὶ τῷ δεκάτῳ δεκάτῃ τοῦ μηνὸς ἦλθεν Ναβουχοδονοσορ βασιλεὺς Βαβυλῶνος καὶ πᾶσα ἡ δύναμις αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ Ιερουσαλημ καὶ περιεχαράκωσαν αὐτὴν καὶ περιῳκοδόμησαν αὐτὴν τετραπέδοις λίθοις κύκλῳ

text_en: And the city was besieged until the eleventh year of King Sedecias.
text_la: Et fuit civitas obsessa usque ad undecimum annum regis Sedeciæ.
text_pt: Assim esteve cercada a cidade, até ao undécimo ano do rei Zedequias.
text_el: καὶ ἦλθεν ἡ πόλις εἰς συνοχὴν ἕως ἑνδεκάτου ἔτους τῷ βασιλεῖ Σεδεκια

text_en: And in the fourth month, the ninth day of the month, a famine overpowered the city: and there was no food for the people of the land.
text_la: Mense autem quarto, nona mensis, obtinuit fames civitatem, et non erant alimenta populo terræ.
text_pt: No quarto mês, aos nove dias do mês, quando já a fome prevalecia na cidade, e o povo da terra não tinha pão,
text_el: ἐν τῇ ἐνάτῃ τοῦ μηνὸς καὶ ἐστερεώθη ὁ λιμὸς ἐν τῇ πόλει καὶ οὐκ ἦσαν ἄρτοι τῷ λαῷ τῆς γῆς

text_en: And the city was broken up, and the men of war fled, and went out of the city in the night by the way of the gate that is between the two walls, and leads to the king's garden, (the Chaldeans besieging the city round about), and they went by the way that leads to the wilderness .
text_la: Et dirupta est civitas, et omnes viri bellatores ejus fugerunt, exieruntque de civitate nocte, per viam portæ quæ est inter duos muros, et ducit ad hortum regis, Chaldæis obsidentibus urbem in gyro, et abierunt per viam quæ ducit in eremum.
text_pt: Então foi aberta uma brecha na cidade, e todos os homens de guerra fugiram, e saíram da cidade de noite, pelo caminho da porta entre os dois muros, a qual estava perto do jardim do rei (porque os caldeus cercavam a cidade ao redor), e foram pelo caminho da campina.
text_el: καὶ διεκόπη ἡ πόλις καὶ πάντες οἱ ἄνδρες οἱ πολεμισταὶ ἐξῆλθον νυκτὸς κατὰ τὴν ὁδὸν τῆς πύλης ἀνὰ μέσον τοῦ τείχους καὶ τοῦ προτειχίσματος ὃ ἦν κατὰ τὸν κῆπον τοῦ βασιλέως καὶ οἱ Χαλδαῖοι ἐπὶ τῆς πόλεως κύκλῳ καὶ ἐπορεύθησαν ὁδὸν τὴν εἰς Αραβα

text_en: But the army of the Chaldeans pursued after the king: and they overtook Sedecias in the desert which is near Jericho : and all his companions were scattered from him.
text_la: Persecutus est autem Chadæorum exercitus regem, et apprehenderunt Sedeciam in deserto quod est juxta Jericho : et omnis comitatus ejus diffugit ab eo.
text_pt: Mas o exército dos caldeus perseguiu o rei, e alcançou a Zedequias nas campinas de Jericó, e todo o seu exército se espalhou, abandonando-o.
text_el: καὶ κατεδίωξεν ἡ δύναμις τῶν Χαλδαίων ὀπίσω τοῦ βασιλέως καὶ κατέλαβον αὐτὸν ἐν τῷ πέραν Ιεριχω καὶ πάντες οἱ παῖδες αὐτοῦ διεσπάρησαν ἀπ' αὐτοῦ

text_en: And when they had taken the king, they carried him to the king of Babylon to Reblatha, which is in the land of Emath: and he gave judgment upon him.
text_la: Cumque comprehendissent regem, adduxerunt eum ad regem Babylonis in Reblatha, quæ est in terra Emath, et locutus est ad eum judicia.
text_pt: E prenderam o rei, e o fizeram subir ao rei de babilônia, a Ribla, na terra de Hamate, o qual lhe pronunciou a sentença.
text_el: καὶ συνέλαβον τὸν βασιλέα καὶ ἤγαγον αὐτὸν πρὸς τὸν βασιλέα Βαβυλῶνος εἰς Δεβλαθα καὶ ἐλάλησεν αὐτῷ μετὰ κρίσεως

text_en: And the king of Babylon slew the sons of Sedecias before his eyes: and he slew all the princes of Juda in Reblatha.
text_la: Et jugulavit rex Babylonis filios Sedeciæ in oculis ejus, sed et omnes principes Juda occidit in Reblatha.
text_pt: E o rei de babilônia degolou os filhos de Zedequias à sua vista, e também degolou a todos os príncipes de Judá em Ribla.
text_el: καὶ ἔσφαξεν βασιλεὺς Βαβυλῶνος τοὺς υἱοὺς Σεδεκιου κατ' ὀφθαλμοὺς αὐτοῦ καὶ πάντας τοὺς ἄρχοντας Ιουδα ἔσφαξεν ἐν Δεβλαθα

text_en: And he put out the eyes of Sedecias, and bound him with fetters, and the king of Babylon brought him into Babylon , and he put him in prison till the day of his death.
text_la: Et oculos Sedeciæ eruit, et vinxit eum compedibus, et adduxit eum rex Babylonis in Babylonem, et posuit eum in domo carceris usque ad diem mortis ejus.
text_pt: E cegou os olhos a Zedequias, e o atou com cadeias; e o rei de babilônia o levou para babilônia, e o conservou na prisão até o dia da sua morte.
text_el: καὶ τοὺς ὀφθαλμοὺς Σεδεκιου ἐξετύφλωσεν καὶ ἔδησεν αὐτὸν ἐν πέδαις καὶ ἤγαγεν αὐτὸν βασιλεὺς Βαβυλῶνος εἰς Βαβυλῶνα καὶ ἔδωκεν αὐτὸν εἰς οἰκίαν μύλωνος ἕως ἡμέρας ἧς ἀπέθανεν

text_en: And in the fifth month, the tenth day of the month, the same is the nineteenth year of Nabuchodonosor, king of Babylon , came Nabuzardan the general of the army, who stood before the king of Babylon in Jerusalem .
text_la: In mense autem quinto, decima mensis, ipse est annus nonusdecimus Nabuchodonosor regis Babylonis, venit Nabuzardan princeps militiæ, qui stabat coram rege Babylonis, in Jerusalem,
text_pt: E no quinto mês, no décimo dia do mês, que era o décimo nono ano do rei Nabucodonosor, rei de babilônia, Nebuzaradã, capitão da guarda, que assistia na presença do rei de babilônia, veio a Jerusalém.
text_el: καὶ ἐν μηνὶ πέμπτῳ δεκάτῃ τοῦ μηνὸς ἦλθεν Ναβουζαρδαν ὁ ἀρχιμάγειρος ὁ ἑστηκὼς κατὰ πρόσωπον τοῦ βασιλέως Βαβυλῶνος εἰς Ιερουσαλημ

text_en: And he burnt the house of the Lord , and the king's house, and all the houses of Jerusalem , and every great house he burnt with fire.
text_la: et incendit domum Domini, et domum regis, et omnes domos Jerusalem : et omnem domum magnam igni combussit:
text_pt: E queimou a casa do Senhor, e a casa do rei; e também a todas as casas de Jerusalém, e a todas as casas dos grandes ele as incendiou.
text_el: καὶ ἐνέπρησεν τὸν οἶκον κυρίου καὶ τὸν οἶκον τοῦ βασιλέως καὶ πάσας τὰς οἰκίας τῆς πόλεως καὶ πᾶσαν οἰκίαν μεγάλην ἐνέπρησεν ἐν πυρί

text_en: And all the army of the Chaldeans that were with the general broke down all the wall of Jerusalem round about.
text_la: et totum murum Jerusalem per circuitum destruxit cunctus exercitus Chaldæorum qui erat cum magistro militiæ.
text_pt: E todo o exército dos caldeus, que estava com o capitão da guarda, derrubou a todos os muros em redor de Jerusalém.
text_el: καὶ πᾶν τεῖχος Ιερουσαλημ κύκλῳ καθεῖλεν ἡ δύναμις τῶν Χαλδαίων ἡ μετὰ τοῦ ἀρχιμαγείρου

text_en: But Nabuzardan the general carried away captives some of the poor people, and of the rest of the common sort who remained in the city, and of the fugitives that were fled over to the king of Babylon , and the rest of the multitude.
text_la: De pauperibus autem populi, et de reliquo vulgo quod remanserat in civitate, et de perfugis qui transfugerant ad regem Babylonis, et ceteros de multitudine transtulit Nabuzardan princeps militiæ.
text_pt: E dos mais pobres do povo, e a parte do povo, que tinha ficado na cidade, e os rebeldes que se haviam passado para o rei de babilônia, e o mais da multidão, Nebuzaradã, capitão da guarda, levou presos.

text_en: But of the poor of the land, Nabuzardan the general left some for vinedressers, and for husbandmen.
text_la: De pauperibus vero terræ reliquit Nabuzardan princeps militiæ vinitores et agricolas.
text_pt: Mas dos mais pobres da terra Nebuzaradã, capitão da guarda, deixou ficar alguns, para serem vinhateiros e lavradores.
text_el: καὶ τοὺς καταλοίπους τοῦ λαοῦ κατέλιπεν ὁ ἀρχιμάγειρος εἰς ἀμπελουργοὺς καὶ εἰς γεωργούς

text_en: The Chaldeans also broke in pieces the brazen pillars that were in the house of the Lord , and the bases, and the sea of brass that was in the house of the Lord : and they carried all the brass of them to Babylon .
text_la: Columnas quoque æreas quæ erant in domo Domini, et bases, et mare æneum quod erat in domo Domini, confregerunt Chaldæi, et tulerunt omne æs eorum in Babylonem,
text_pt: Quebraram mais os caldeus as colunas de bronze, que estavam na casa do SENHOR, e as bases, e o mar de bronze, que estavam na casa do SENHOR, e levaram todo o bronze para babilônia.
text_el: καὶ τοὺς στύλους τοὺς χαλκοῦς τοὺς ἐν οἴκῳ κυρίου καὶ τὰς βάσεις καὶ τὴν θάλασσαν τὴν χαλκῆν τὴν ἐν οἴκῳ κυρίου συνέτριψαν οἱ Χαλδαῖοι καὶ ἔλαβον τὸν χαλκὸν αὐτῶν καὶ ἀπήνεγκαν εἰς Βαβυλῶνα

text_en: And they took the caldrons, and the fleshhooks, and the psalteries, and the bowls, and the little mortars, and all the brazen vessels that had been used in the ministry : and
text_la: et lebetes, et creagras, et psalteria, et phialas, et mortariola, et omnia vasa ærea quæ in ministerio fuerant, tulerunt:
text_pt: Também tomaram os caldeirões, e as pás, e as espevitadeiras, e as bacias, e as colheres, e todos os utensílios de bronze, com que se ministrava.
text_el: καὶ τὴν στεφάνην καὶ τὰς φιάλας καὶ τὰς κρεάγρας καὶ πάντα τὰ σκεύη τὰ χαλκᾶ ἐν οἷς ἐλειτούργουν ἐν αὐτοῖς

text_en: the general took away the pitchers, and the censers , and the pots, and the basins, and the candlesticks, and the mortars, and the cups: as many as were of gold, in gold: and as many as were of silver, in silver:
text_la: et hydrias, et thymiamateria, et urceos, et pelves, et candelabra, et mortaria, et cyathos, quotquot aurea, aurea, et quotquot argentea, argentea, tulit magister militiæ:
text_pt: E tomou o capitão da guarda as bacias, e os braseiros, e as tigelas, e os caldeirões, e os castiçais, e as colheres, e os copos; tanto o que era de puro ouro, como o que era de prata maciça.
text_el: καὶ τὰ σαφφωθ καὶ τὰ μασμαρωθ καὶ τοὺς ὑποχυτῆρας καὶ τὰς λυχνίας καὶ τὰς θυίσκας καὶ τοὺς κυάθους ἃ ἦν χρυσᾶ χρυσᾶ καὶ ἃ ἦν ἀργυρᾶ ἀργυρᾶ ἔλαβεν ὁ ἀρχιμάγειρος

text_en: And the two pillars, and one sea, and twelve oxen of brass that were under the bases, which King Solomon had made in the house of the Lord : there was no weight of the brass of all these vessels.
text_la: et columnas duas, et mare unum, et vitulos duodecim æreos qui erant sub basibus quas fecerat rex Salomon in domo Domini. Non erat pondus æris omnium horum vasorum.
text_pt: Quanto às duas colunas, ao único mar, e aos doze bois de bronze, que estavam debaixo das bases, que fizera o rei Salomão para a casa do Senhor, o peso do bronze de todos estes utensílios era incalculável.
text_el: καὶ οἱ στῦλοι δύο καὶ ἡ θάλασσα μία καὶ οἱ μόσχοι δώδεκα χαλκοῖ ὑποκάτω τῆς θαλάσσης ἃ ἐποίησεν ὁ βασιλεὺς Σαλωμων εἰς οἶκον κυρίου οὐκ ἦν σταθμὸς τοῦ χαλκοῦ αὐτῶν

text_en: And concerning the pillars, one pillar was eighteen cubits high: and a cord of twelve cubits compassed it about: but the thickness thereof was four fingers, and it was hollow within.
text_la: De columnis autem decem et octo cubiti altitudinis erant in columna una, et funiculus duodecim cubitorum circuibat eam : porro grossitudo ejus quatuor digitorum, et intrinsecus cava erat.
text_pt: Quanto às colunas, a altura de cada uma era de dezoito côvados, e um fio de doze côvados a cercava; e era a sua espessura de quatro dedos, e era oca.
text_el: καὶ οἱ στῦλοι τριάκοντα πέντε πηχῶν ὕψος τοῦ στύλου τοῦ ἑνός καὶ σπαρτίον δώδεκα πήχεων περιεκύκλου αὐτόν καὶ τὸ πάχος αὐτοῦ δακτύλων τεσσάρων κύκλῳ

text_en: And chapiters of brass were upon both: and the height of one chapiter was five cubits: and network, and pomegranates were upon the chapiters round about, all of brass. The same of the second pillar, and the pomegranates.
text_la: Et capitella super utramque ærea : altitudo capitelli unius quinque cubitorum, et retiacula et malogranata super coronam in circuitu, omnia ærea : similiter columnæ secundæ, et malogranata.
text_pt: E havia sobre ela um capitel de bronze; e a altura do capitel era de cinco côvados; a rede e as romãs ao redor do capitel eram de bronze; e semelhante a esta era a segunda coluna, com as romãs.
text_el: καὶ γεῖσος ἐπ' αὐτοῖς χαλκοῦν καὶ πέντε πήχεων τὸ μῆκος ὑπεροχὴ τοῦ γείσους τοῦ ἑνός καὶ δίκτυον καὶ ῥόαι ἐπὶ τοῦ γείσους κύκλῳ τὰ πάντα χαλκᾶ καὶ κατὰ ταῦτα τῷ στύλῳ τῷ δευτέρῳ ὀκτὼ ῥόαι τῷ πήχει τοῖς δώδεκα πήχεσιν

text_en: And there were ninety-six pomegranates hanging down: and the pomegranates being a hundred in all, were compassed with network.
text_la: Et fuerunt malogranata nonaginta sex dependentia : et omnia malogranata centum, retiaculis circumdabantur.
text_pt: E havia noventa e seis romãs em cada lado; as romãs todas, em redor da rede, eram cem.
text_el: καὶ ἦσαν αἱ ῥόαι ἐνενήκοντα ἓξ τὸ ἓν μέρος καὶ ἦσαν αἱ πᾶσαι ῥόαι ἐπὶ τοῦ δικτύου κύκλῳ ἑκατόν

text_en: And the general took Saraias the chief priest , and Sophonias the second priest , and the three keepers of the entry.
text_la: Et tulit magister militiæ Saraiam sacerdotem primum, et Sophoniam sacerdotem secundum, et tres custodes vestibuli:
text_pt: Levou também o capitão da guarda a Seraías, o sacerdote chefe, e a Sofonias, o segundo sacerdote, e aos três guardas da porta.
text_el: καὶ ἔλαβεν ὁ ἀρχιμάγειρος τὸν ἱερέα τὸν πρῶτον καὶ τὸν ἱερέα τὸν δευτερεύοντα καὶ τοὺς τρεῖς τοὺς φυλάττοντας τὴν ὁδὸν

text_en: He also took out of the city one eunuch that was chief over the men of war : and seven men of them that were near the king's person, that were found in the city: and a scribe , an officer of the army who exercised the young soldiers: and threescore men of the people of the land, that were found in the midst of the city.
text_la: et de civitate tulit eunuchum unum, qui erat præpositus super viros bellatores : et septem viros de his qui videbant faciem regis, qui inventi sunt in civitate : et scribam principem militum, qui probabat tyrones : et sexaginta viros de populo terræ, qui inventi sunt in medio civitatis.
text_pt: E da cidade tomou a um eunuco que tinha a seu cargo os homens de guerra, e a sete homens que estavam próximos à pessoa do rei, que se achavam na cidade, como também o escrivão-mor do exército, que alistava o povo da terra para a guerra, e a sessenta homens do povo da terra, que se achavam no meio da cidade.
text_el: καὶ εὐνοῦχον ἕνα ὃς ἦν ἐπιστάτης τῶν ἀνδρῶν τῶν πολεμιστῶν καὶ ἑπτὰ ἄνδρας ὀνομαστοὺς τοὺς ἐν προσώπῳ τοῦ βασιλέως τοὺς εὑρεθέντας ἐν τῇ πόλει καὶ τὸν γραμματέα τῶν δυνάμεων τὸν γραμματεύοντα τῷ λαῷ τῆς γῆς καὶ ἑξήκοντα ἀνθρώπους ἐκ τοῦ λαοῦ τῆς γῆς τοὺς εὑρεθέντας ἐν μέσῳ τῆς πόλεως

text_en: And Nabuzardan the general took them, and brought them to the king of Babylon , to Reblatha.
text_la: Tulit autem eos Nabuzardan magister militiæ, et duxit eos ad regem Babylonis in Reblatha:
text_pt: Tomando-os, pois, Nebuzaradã, capitão da guarda, levou-os ao rei de babilônia, a Ribla.
text_el: καὶ ἔλαβεν αὐτοὺς Ναβουζαρδαν ὁ ἀρχιμάγειρος καὶ ἤγαγεν αὐτοὺς πρὸς βασιλέα Βαβυλῶνος εἰς Δεβλαθα

text_en: And the king of Babylon struck them, and put them to death in Reblatha, in the land of Emath: and Juda was carried away captive out of his land.
text_la: et percussit eos rex Babylonis, et interfecit eos in Reblatha in terra Emath : et translatus est Juda de terra sua.
text_pt: E o rei de babilônia os feriu e os matou em Ribla, na terra de Hamate; assim Judá foi levado cativo para fora da sua terra.
text_el: καὶ ἐπάταξεν αὐτοὺς βασιλεὺς Βαβυλῶνος ἐν Δεβλαθα ἐν γῇ Αιμαθ

text_en: This is the people whom Nabuchodonosor carried away captive: in the seventh year, three thousand and twenty-three Jews .
text_la: Iste est populus quem transtulit Nabuchodonosor : in anno septimo, Judæos tria millia et viginti tres:
text_pt: Este é o povo que Nabucodonosor levou cativo, no sétimo ano: três mil e vinte e três judeus.

text_en: In the eighteenth year of Nabuchodonosor , eight hundred and thirty-two souls from Jerusalem .
text_la: in anno octavodecimo Nabuchodonosor, de Jerusalem animas octingentas triginta duas:
text_pt: No ano décimo oitavo de Nabucodonosor, ele levou cativas de Jerusalém oitocentas e trinta e duas pessoas.

text_en: In the three and twentieth year of Nabuchodonosor , Nabuzardan the general carried away of the Jews seven hundred and forty five souls . So all the souls were four thousand six hundred.
text_la: in anno vigesimo tertio Nabuchodonosor, transtulit Nabuzardan magister militiæ animas Judæorum septingentas quadraginta quinque. Omnes ergo animæ, quatuor millia sexcentæ.
text_pt: No ano vinte e três de Nabucodonosor, Nebuzaradã, capitão da guarda, levou cativas, dos judeus, setecentas e quarenta e cinco pessoas; todas as pessoas foram quatro mil e seiscentas.

text_en: And it came to pass in the seven and thirtieth year of the captivity of Joachin king of Juda , in the twelfth month, the five and twentieth day of the month, that Evilmerodach king of Babylon , in the first year of his reign, lifted up the head of Joachin king of Juda , and brought him forth out of prison .
text_la: Et factum est in trigesimo septimo anno transmigrationis Joachin regis Juda, duodecimo mense, vigesima quinta mensis, elevavit Evilmerodach rex Babylonis, ipso anno regni sui, caput Joachin regis Juda, et eduxit eum de domo carceris.
text_pt: Sucedeu, pois, no ano trigésimo sétimo do cativeiro de Jeoiaquim, rei de Judá, no duodécimo mês, aos vinte e cinco dias do mês, que Evil-Merodaque, rei de babilônia, no primeiro ano do seu reinado, levantou a cabeça de Jeoiaquim, rei de Judá, e tirou-o do cárcere;
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο ἐν τῷ τριακοστῷ καὶ ἑβδόμῳ ἔτει ἀποικισθέντος τοῦ Ιωακιμ βασιλέως Ιουδα ἐν τῷ δωδεκάτῳ μηνὶ ἐν τῇ τετράδι καὶ εἰκάδι τοῦ μηνὸς ἔλαβεν Ουλαιμαραδαχ βασιλεὺς Βαβυλῶνος ἐν τῷ ἐνιαυτῷ ᾧ ἐβασίλευσεν τὴν κεφαλὴν Ιωακιμ βασιλέως Ιουδα καὶ ἐξήγαγεν αὐτὸν ἐξ οἰκίας ἧς ἐφυλάττετο

text_en: And he spoke kindly to him, and he set his throne above the thrones of the kings that were with him in Babylon .
text_la: Et locutus est cum eo bona, et posuit thronum ejus super thronos regum qui erant post se in Babylone.
text_pt: E falou com ele benignamente, e pôs o seu trono acima dos tronos dos reis que estavam com ele em babilônia;
text_el: καὶ ἐλάλησεν αὐτῷ χρηστὰ καὶ ἔδωκεν τὸν θρόνον αὐτοῦ ἐπάνω τῶν θρόνων τῶν βασιλέων τῶν μετ' αὐτοῦ ἐν Βαβυλῶνι

text_en: And he changed his prison garments, and he ate bread before him always all the days of his life.
text_la: Et mutavit vestimenta carceris ejus, et comedebat panem coram eo semper cunctis diebus vitæ suæ.
text_pt: E lhe fez mudar as vestes da sua prisão; e passou a comer pão sempre na presença do rei, todos os dias da sua vida.
text_el: καὶ ἤλλαξεν τὴν στολὴν τῆς φυλακῆς αὐτοῦ καὶ ἤσθιεν ἄρτον διὰ παντὸς κατὰ πρόσωπον αὐτοῦ πάσας τὰς ἡμέρας ἃς ἔζησεν

text_en: And for his diet a continual provision was allowed him by the king of Babylon , every day a portion, until the day of his death, all the days of his life.
text_la: Et cibaria ejus, cibaria perpetua dabantur ei a rege Babylonis, statuta per singulos dies, usque ad diem mortis suæ, cunctis diebus vitæ ejus.
text_pt: E, quanto à sua alimentação, foi-lhe dada refeição contínua do rei de babilônia, porção cotidiana, no seu dia, até o dia da sua morte, todos os dias da sua vida.
text_el: καὶ ἡ σύνταξις αὐτῷ ἐδίδοτο διὰ παντὸς παρὰ τοῦ βασιλέως Βαβυλῶνος ἐξ ἡμέρας εἰς ἡμέραν ἕως ἡμέρας ἧς ἀπέθανεν
